local local_class = newclass('BossKadenAISwordBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		thrust1 = 3,
		thrust2 = 4,
		spin = 5,
		stomp = 6,
		post = 7
	}

	-- prepare params
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0.0)

	-- thrust1 params
	self.thrust1_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust1Duration', 0.3)
	self.thrust1_dash_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust1DashTiming', 0.0)
	self.thrust1_dash_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust1DashSpeed', 24.0)
	self.thrust1_dash_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust1DashDuration', 0.25)
	self.thrust1_attack_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust1AttackTiming', 0.1)
	local a_dur = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust1AttackDuration', 0.1)
	self.thrust1_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust1Modifier', 0.3)
	local length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust1AttackLength', 2.0)
	local width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust1AttackWidth', 1.0)
	local c_size = vector(length, 1, width)
	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(c_size, a_dur, -1)
	self.thrust1_calc = area_collision_util.create(self.character, info)

	-- thrust2 params
	self.thrust2_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust2Duration', 0.4)
	self.thrust2_dash_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust2DashTiming', 0.0)
	self.thrust2_dash_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust2DashSpeed', 15.0)
	self.thrust2_dash_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust2DashDuration', 0.2)
	self.thrust2_attack_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust2AttackTiming', 0.1)
	a_dur = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust2AttackDuration', 0.1)
	self.thrust2_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust2Modifier', 0.4)
	length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust2AttackLength', 2.5)
	width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Thrust2AttackWidth', 1.0)
	info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(c_size, a_dur, -1)
	self.thrust2_calc = area_collision_util.create(self.character, info)

	-- spin params
	self.spin_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SpinDuration', 0.6)
	self.spin_dash_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SpinDashTiming', 0.1)
	self.spin_dash_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SpinDashSpeed', 12.0)
	self.spin_dash_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SpinDashDuration', 0.5)
	self.spin_hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'SpinHitTiming')
	self.spin_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SpinModifier', 0.6)
	length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SpinAttackLength', 3.0)
	width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SpinAttackWidth', 1.0)
	info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(c_size, 99, -1)
	self.spin_calc = area_collision_util.create(self.character, info)

	-- stomp params
	self.stomp_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StompDuration', 0.7)
	self.stomp_dash_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StompDashTiming', 0.0)
	self.stomp_dash_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StompDashSpeed', 20.0)
	self.stomp_dash_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StompDashDuration', 0.3)
	self.stomp_attack_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StompAttackTiming', 0.3)
	self.stomp_hit_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StompHitTiming', 0.3)
	self.stomp_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StompModifier', 0.7)
	local radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StompRadius', 1.5)
	self.stomp_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StompOffset', 0.7)
	info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, 1, self.stomp_duration, -1, nil, true)
	self.stomp_calc = area_collision_util.create(self.character, info)

	-- post params
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	-- etc params
	self.stun_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StunDuration', 0.4)
	self.dir_vector = nil

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thrust1 then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.thrust1_calc:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thrust2 then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.thrust2_calc:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.spin then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.spin_calc:End()
		if next_state ~= self.state.none then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('land')
		end


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.stomp_calc:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then

	elseif next_state == self.state.thrust1 then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('thrust')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('thrust')
		self.thrust1_calc:Start()
		self.dir_vector = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

	elseif next_state == self.state.thrust2 then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('thrust')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('thrust')
		self.thrust2_calc:Start()
		self.dir_vector = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

	elseif next_state == self.state.spin then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('spin')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('jump')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('spin')
		self.spin_calc:Start()
		self.dir_vector = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('stomp')
		self.stomp_calc:Start()
		self.dir_vector = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.thrust1)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thrust1 then
		self:update_thrust(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.thrust1_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.thrust2)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thrust2 then
		self:update_thrust(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.thrust2_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.spin)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.spin then
		self:update_spin(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.spin_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self:update_stomp(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.stomp_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end

	self.old_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end

function local_class:update_dash(dash_timing, dash_duration, dash_speed)
	if self.old_time_passed < dash_timing then
		self.dir_vector = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		if vector_util.is_almost_zero(self.dir_vector) then
			self.dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
		end
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(self.old_time_passed, self.time_passed, dash_timing) then
		--- 대시 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
				self.cs_battle_action,
				self.target,
				self.dir_vector,
				0,
				dash_duration,
				dash_speed,
				dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
				nil,
				false,
				0
		)
	end
end

function local_class:update_thrust(dt)
	local dash_timing, dur, spd, atk_timing, mod, calc
	if self.current_state == self.state.thrust1 then
		dash_timing = self.thrust1_dash_timing
		dur = self.thrust1_dash_duration
		spd = self.thrust1_dash_speed
		atk_timing = self.thrust1_attack_timing
		mod = self.thrust1_modifier
		calc = self.thrust1_calc
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thrust2 then
		dash_timing = self.thrust2_dash_timing
		dur = self.thrust2_dash_duration
		spd = self.thrust2_dash_speed
		atk_timing = self.thrust2_attack_timing
		mod = self.thrust2_modifier
		calc = self.thrust2_calc
	else
		return
	end

	self:update_dash(dash_timing, dur, spd)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(self.old_time_passed, self.time_passed, dash_timing) then
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_battle_action, 'dash')
	end

	--- 찌르기의 경우 aim point를 설정해준다.
	spine_util.set_aim_point(
			self.character,
			bounds_util.get_center(self.character) + self.dir_vector,
			bounds_util.get_center(self.character)
	)

	local key = 'thrust'
	--- 공격 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(self.old_time_passed, self.time_passed, atk_timing) then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(key, bounds_util.get_center(self.character), self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.character))
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, key)
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.character, 0.07, 0.2)

		area_collision_util.set_position(calc, bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
		area_collision_util.set_direction(calc, self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(calc)
	end

	--- 판정 체크
	if area_collision_util.is_started(calc) then
		area_collision_util.set_position(calc, bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
		area_collision_util.set_direction(calc, self.dir_vector)

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(calc, dt)
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			local max_hit = 1
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_battle_action, mod, max_hit)

			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기가 종료된 시점
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(calc) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(calc)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_spin(dt)
	local dash_timing = self.spin_dash_timing
	self:update_dash(dash_timing, self.spin_dash_duration, self.spin_dash_speed)

	--- 대시 시점에 점프 연출 추가
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(self.old_time_passed, self.time_passed, dash_timing) then
		local duration = self.spin_duration - dash_timing
		character_util.jump(self.character, 1.5, duration, duration - 0.1, false)

		--- play sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'jump')
	end

	--- 이펙트가 있는 동안엔 이펙트 위치를 옮겨줌
	if self.spin_fx then
		effect_util.update_object(self.spin_fx, bounds_util.get_center(self.character), self.dir_vector)
	end

	if self.trail_fx then
		effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, bounds_util.get_center(self.character), self.dir_vector)
	end

	local max_hit = #self.spin_hit_timing
	for idx = 1, max_hit do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(self.old_time_passed, self.time_passed, self.spin_hit_timing[idx]) then
			local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.character)

			--- 첫타인 경우엔 이펙트를 생성한다.
			if idx == 1 then
				local key = self.dir_vector.x > 0 and 'spin' or 'spin_rev'
				--- instantiate fx
				self.spin_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(key, bounds_util.get_center(self.character), self.dir_vector)
				self.trail_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('trail', bounds_util.get_center(self.character), self.dir_vector)

				--- play sfx
				battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'spin')
			end

			if idx == max_hit then
				--- shake camera
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.character, 0.12, 0.2)
			else
				--- shake camera
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.character, 0.12, 0.15)
			end

			--- 판정 체크
			self:check_hit_timing(target_pos)
		end
	end

	--- 착지 연출
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(self.old_time_passed, self.time_passed, self.spin_duration) then
		--- play sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'land')
	end
end

function local_class:update_stomp(dt)
	self:update_dash(self.stomp_dash_timing, self.stomp_dash_duration, self.stomp_dash_speed)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(self.old_time_passed, self.time_passed, self.stomp_hit_timing) then
		local target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.character) + self.dir_vector * self.stomp_offset

		--- instantiate fx
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('stomp', target_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--- play sfx
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp')
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.character, 0.22, 0.12)

		--- 판정 체크
		self:check_hit_timing(target_pos)
	end
end

--- hit timing 식 판정 처리
function local_class:check_hit_timing(center)
	local calc, mod, max_hit
	if self.current_state == self.state.spin then
		calc = self.spin_calc
		mod = self.spin_modifier
		max_hit = #self.spin_hit_timing
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		calc = self.stomp_calc
		mod = self.stomp_modifier
		max_hit = 1
	else
		return
	end

	--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_position(calc, center)
	--- 충돌체 방향 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_direction(calc, self.dir_vector)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
	area_collision_util.start(calc)

	local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(calc)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(calc)

	--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 반환함
	if #hit_targets == 0 then
		return
	end

	--- 모디파이어 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_battle_action, mod, max_hit)
	for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
		self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	end
end

function local_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = self.stun_duration
	damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_light_06')
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossLeaderChargeBusterBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.6)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 0.75)
	self.hit_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'HitTiming', 0.1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.5)

	self.attack_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackAngle', 70)
	self.attack_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackDistance', 8)

	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1)
	self.knock_back_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackFactor', CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorNormalStrong)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1) * CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_arc(self.attack_distance, self.attack_angle)
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

	local info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.Direction = unity_class.vector3.right
	info.Duration = self.action_duration - self.hit_timing
	info.Radius = self.attack_distance
	info.Angle = self.attack_angle
	info.Height = 3
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 1)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.right_hand_bone_name = {
		side = 'handF', -- direction right
		front = 'handR',
		back = 'handL'
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, target)
	return distance < self.attack_distance
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(self.target) then
		return
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

		if not is_unity_null(self.cast_fx) then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
		end
		self.cast_fx = nil

		self.cast_fx_bone = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.attack_calculator:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.current_pos = self.character.Position
		local diff = (self.target.Position - self.current_pos)
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.current_pos, vector_util.normalized(diff))
		self:change_spine_direction(vector_util.to_direction(diff))

		-- 주먹 불꽃 이펙트, 임시, 본팔로워가 필요할 수도
		self.cast_fx_bone = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetBone(self.character.SpineController,
				self:get_dir_str(self.character.Direction))
		if self.cast_fx_bone ~= nil then
			local shoot_pos = CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.GetWorldPosition(
					self.cast_fx_bone, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
			self.cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast', shoot_pos, vector_util.zero, self.character.Transform)
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')

		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.current_pos
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
		self:change_spine_direction(vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		self.current_pos = nil
		self.target_dir = nil
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:get_dir_str(dir)
	if dir == direction_util.up then
		return self.right_hand_bone_name.back
	elseif dir == direction_util.down then
		return self.right_hand_bone_name.front
	else
		return self.right_hand_bone_name.side
	end
end

function local_class:update_cast_fx_pos()
	if self.cast_fx_bone == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.cast_fx == nil then
		return
	end

	local pos = CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.GetWorldPosition(
			self.cast_fx_bone, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
	effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, pos)
end

function local_class:change_spine_direction(new_direction)
	local prev_direction = self.character.Direction
	if prev_direction == new_direction then
		return
	end

	self.character.Direction = new_direction

	self.cast_fx_bone = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetBone(self.character.SpineController,
			self:get_dir_str(new_direction))
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	local prev_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		local diff = (self.target.Position - self.current_pos)
		local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.current_pos, dir)
		self:change_spine_direction(vector_util.to_direction(dir))
		self:update_cast_fx_pos()

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self.target_dir = dir
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if prev_time_passed < self.hit_timing and self.time_passed >= self.hit_timing then
			self:punch()
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

		self:update_attack_calculator(dt)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:punch()
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', self.current_pos, self.target_dir)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion')

	self.attack_calculator:Start()
end

function local_class:update_attack_calculator(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted or self.attack_calculator.IsFinished then
		return
	end

	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = self.target_dir
			damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor
			damage_info.knock_back_dir = self.target_dir
			damage_info.knock_back_force = self.knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.right_hand_bone_name = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossLeaderContinuousAttackBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.76)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)

	local range_dist = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RangeDist", 5)
	local range_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RangeWidth", 2)
	self.hittable_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "HittableDistance", range_dist - 0.5)
	local attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDelay", 0)
	local attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDuration", 0.2)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.0) * CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce
	self.knock_back_factor = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackFactor", 0)

	local show_attack_range = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'ShowAttackRange', false)
	self.show_attack_queue = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'ShowAttackQueue', true)

	local range_size = unity_class.vector2(range_dist, range_width)
	local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = attack_duration
	info.Size = unity_class.vector3(range_size.x, self.character.Bounds.size.y, range_size.y)
	info.IsCenterToSide = true
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, attack_delay, 1)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	if show_attack_range then
		self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(range_size)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	local fx_height = 0.8
	local fx_forward_offset = range_dist * 0.5
	self.fx_infos = {[1]={time = 0, offset = unity_class.vector3(fx_forward_offset, fx_height, -0.5)},
					 [2]={time = 0.12, offset = unity_class.vector3(fx_forward_offset + 0.3, fx_height, 0.5)}}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.hittable_distance
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 강제 발동 거부
	if not self:is_hittable(target) then
		return false
	end

	local direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - self.character.Position))

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName,
			direction)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:exit()
	--[[self.fx_infos[1].bone = nil
	self.fx_infos[2].bone = nil]]
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if self.show_attack_queue then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		end
		if self.attack_range then
			battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_calculator:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction)
		if self.show_attack_queue then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		end
		if self.attack_range then
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
			battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local pos = self.character.Position
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack')

		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = pos
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_direction
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self:exit()
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:calculate_attack(dt)
		self:update_fx(self.time_passed - dt, self.time_passed)

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:calculate_attack(dt)
	-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			break
		end

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = self.target_direction
		if self.knock_back_factor > 0 then
			damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor
			damage_info.knock_back_dir = self.target_direction
			damage_info.knock_back_force = self.knock_back_force
		end

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_fx(prev_time_passed, time_passed)
	for _, info in ipairs(self.fx_infos) do repeat
		if info.time >= prev_time_passed and info.time < time_passed then
			-- copy
			local offset = unity_class.vector3(info.offset.x, info.offset.y, info.offset.z)
			if self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
				offset.z = -offset.z
			end
			offset = unity_class.vector3(offset.x * self.target_direction.x - offset.z * self.target_direction.z, offset.y,
					self.target_direction.z * offset.x + self.target_direction.x * offset.z)
			local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + offset
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('attack', shoot_pos, self.target_direction)
		end
	until true end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.left_bone_name = nil
	self.right_bone_name = nil
	self.fx_infos = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.knock_back_force = nil

	self.target_direction = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:start(info)

	if is_unity_null(self.target) then
		return
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		if next_state ~= self.state.shoot then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.target_pos = self.target.Position
		local current_pos = self.character.Position
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - current_pos)
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
		local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
		if dist > self.charge_distance then
			self.target_pos = current_pos + dir * self.charge_distance
		end
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast', current_pos, vector_util.zero, self.character.Transform)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')

	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('charge')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('charge')

		self.traveled_dist = 0

	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('stomp')

		local current_pos = self.character.Position
		self.target_pos = current_pos + self.target_dir * self.target_dist
		self.traveled_dist = 0
		self.shoot_count = 0

		self.projectile_target_table = {}

	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.next_shoot_time = random_util.get_random_value() * self.shoot_term_range + self.shoot_term_min

		for i,target in ipairs(self.projectile_target_table) do
			local current_pos = self.character.Position
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - current_pos)
			local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
			local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
			--self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(current_pos, dir, 1, dist, nil, false)
			self.shoot_helper:SingleShoot(current_pos, dir, dist + 0.2, i, nil, false)
			self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1

			if self.shoot_count >= self.projectile_count then
				self.next_shoot_time = CS.System.Single.MaxValue
				break
			end
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		self.target_dir = nil
		self.target_pos = nil
		self.projectile_target_table = nil

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed <= self.tracking_time then
			self.target_pos = self.target.Position
			local current_pos = self.character.Position
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - current_pos)
			self.target_dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
			self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
			if self.target_dist > self.charge_distance then
				self.target_pos = current_pos + self.target_dir * self.charge_distance
				self.target_dist = self.charge_distance
			end
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)
			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			if self.target_dist > self.charge_drag_dist then
				self:change_state(self.state.charge)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		-- 돌진 AtomicMove
		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = self.target_dir
		move_info.magnitude = self.charge_speed * dt
		self.traveled_dist = self.traveled_dist + move_info.magnitude

		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir), false)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

		-- 스톰프 이동 거리 안 쪽이면 스톰프 시작
		if self.traveled_dist >= self.target_dist - self.charge_drag_dist then
			self.target_dist = self.target_dist - self.traveled_dist
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		local prev_time_passed = self.time_passed - dt;

		if battle_util.check_time_passed(prev_time_passed, self.time_passed, self.stomp_duration) then
			self:stomp(self.character.Position)
		end

		if prev_time_passed >= self.stomp_duration then
			if #self.projectile_target_table > 0 then
				self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
			return
		end

		-- stomp_duration 동안 나머지 거리 이동
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.stomp_duration))
		local prev_dist = self.traveled_dist
		self.traveled_dist = self.target_dist * progress
		local magnitude = self.traveled_dist - prev_dist

		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = self.target_dir
		move_info.magnitude = magnitude

		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir), false)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.shoot_count >= self.projectile_count then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_shoot()
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:stomp(pos)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, math.max(self.projectile_range, self.stomp_radius))

	-- 스톰프 연출
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('stomp', pos)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp')

	self.shoot_count = 0

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local target_pos = v.Position
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - pos)
			local sqr_dist = vector_util.sqr_magnitude(diff)

			if sqr_dist <= self.stomp_radius * self.stomp_radius then
				local dir = diff.normalized
				local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

				damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = v
				damage_info.direction = dir
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.stun_factor = self.stun_factor
				damage_info.stun_duration = self.stun_duration

				command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
			end

			-- 스톰프 시점 투사체 사거리 스캔
			if sqr_dist <= self.projectile_range * self.projectile_range then
				table.insert(self.projectile_target_table, v)
			end
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_shoot()
	if self.time_passed >= self.next_shoot_time then
		-- 랜덤 타겟
		local target_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.projectile_target_table)
		local target = self.projectile_target_table[target_index]

		local current_pos = self.character.Position
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - current_pos)
		local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
		--self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(current_pos, dir, 1, dist, nil, false)
		self.shoot_helper:SingleShoot(current_pos, dir, dist + 0.2, target_index, nil, false)
		self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1

		if self.shoot_count < self.projectile_count then
			self.next_shoot_time = self.next_shoot_time + random_util.get_random_value() * self.shoot_term_range + self.shoot_term_min
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper == nil then return true end

	local pos = hit_info.position

	-- hit 연출
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', pos)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion')

	--[[if hit_info.hitType ~= projectile_hit_type.field_object or hit_info.target == nil then

		else
			local target_pos = fo.Position
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - pos)

			-- 방무뎀, 체력 비례
			local dir = diff.normalized
			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

			damage_info.damage_type = self.missile_damage_type
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.direction = dir

			else
				damage_info.modifier = self.missile_damage_modifier
			end

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()

	--self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)

	return true
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {

local local_class = newclass('BossMagwiChargeBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- tracking
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TrackingDuration', 1.0)

	-- charge
	self.charge_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeSpeed', 5)
	self.charge_distance = 0
	self.charge_duration = 0
	self.charge_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeRadius', 2.5)
	self.charge_direction = vector_util.zero
	local charge_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDamageTerm', 0.2)
	self.charge_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDamageModifier', 1)
	self.charge_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeKnockBackForce', 1)
	self.charge_offset_z = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeOffsetZ', 1.5)
	self.charge_effect_interval = 0.5
	self.charge_effect_count = 0

	self.charge_anim_1st_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeAnimDuration1', 0.53)
	self.charge_anim_2nd_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeAnimDuration2', 1.2)

	self.foot_step_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FootStepDamageModifier', 1)
	self.foot_step_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FootStepKnockBackForce', 1)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeMagnitude', 0.3)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeDuration', 1.0)

	self.move_start_sfx_delay1 = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MoveStartSfxDelay1', 0.1)
	self.move_start_sfx_delay2 = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MoveStartSfxDelay2', 0.4)

	self.prev_pos = nil
	self.min_progress_per = 0.7

	-- damage calc
	local foot_step_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.charge_radius, 10000, 0)
	self.foot_step_attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, foot_step_info, false, 0, 0)

	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(self.character.Hitbox.size, 10000, charge_damage_term, false)
	info.Center = self.character.Hitbox.pivot
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false, 0, 0)

	-- groggy
	self.groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'GroggyDuration', 5.0)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 0.2)


	-- etc
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, unity_class.vector2(15, self.charge_radius * 2), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	self.remain_stones = 0

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		tracking = 2,
		charge = 3,
		charge1 = 4,
		charge2 = 5,
		groggy = 6,
		post = 7,
	}

	-- ani
	self.ready_key = 'ready'
	self.charge_key = 'charge'
	self.groggy_key = 'groggy'

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_magwi_start_ailment_resist' }))
	self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character.Direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge1 then
		self.attack_calculator:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge2 then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.tracking then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:update_attack_range()
		self.attack_range:Show(self.tracking_duration)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.ready_key)
		self.charge_effect_count = 0

	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.is_play_move_sfx = false

		self.start_position = self.character.Position
		self.charge_distance = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, self.charge_direction)
		self.charge_duration = self.charge_speed / self.charge_distance
		self.prev_pos = self.character.Position
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.charge_key)

	elseif next_state == self.state.charge1 then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.is_play_move_sfx = false

	elseif next_state == self.state.charge2 then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.is_play_move_sfx = false

	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		--그로기 상태라면 면역을 풀어준다.
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_magwi_release_ailment_resist' }))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.groggy_key)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		self:update_attack_range()

		if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self:change_state(self.state.charge1)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge1 then
		self:update_charge_collision(dt)
		local is_reached_wall = self:update_move(dt)
		if self.time_passed >=self.move_start_sfx_delay1 and self.is_play_move_sfx == false then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('move_start')
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('move_start2')
			self.is_play_move_sfx = true
		end

		if is_reached_wall and self.time_passed > self.charge_anim_1st_duration then
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_magwi_get_remain_stones' }))
			if self.remain_stones > 0 then
				self:foot_impact()
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:foot_impact()
				self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
			end
		elseif is_reached_wall == false and self.time_passed > self.charge_anim_1st_duration then
			self:foot_impact()
			self:change_state(self.state.charge2)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge2 then
		self:update_charge_collision(dt)
		local is_reached_wall = self:update_move(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_start_sfx_delay2 and self.is_play_move_sfx == false then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('move_start2')
			self.is_play_move_sfx = true
		end

		if is_reached_wall and self.time_passed > self.charge_anim_2nd_duration then
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_magwi_get_remain_stones' }))
			if self.remain_stones > 0 then
				self:foot_impact()
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:foot_impact()
				self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
			end
		elseif is_reached_wall == false and self.time_passed > self.charge_anim_2nd_duration then
			self:foot_impact()
			self:change_state(self.state.charge1)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:foot_impact()
	stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
	self.foot_step_attack_calculator:Start()

	local impact_position = self.character.Position + self:get_offset(self.character.Direction)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', impact_position)
	self:update_foot_step_collision(impact_position)

	self.foot_step_attack_calculator:End()
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('step')
end

function local_class:get_offset(dir)
	if self.current_state == self.state.charge1 then
		if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			return vector(3, 0, 0)
		elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			return vector(-2, 0, 0)
		elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			return vector(1.5, 0, -2)
		elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			return vector(-1.5, 0, 2)
		else
			return vector(0,0,0)
		end
	else
		if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			return vector(3, 0, 0)
		elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			return vector(-2, 0, 0)
		elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			return vector(-1.5, 0, -1)
		elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			return vector(1.5, 0, 2)
		else
			return vector(0, 0, 0)
		end

	end
end


function local_class:get_fix_pos()
	return self.character.Position + vector_util.forward * self.charge_offset_z
end

function local_class:update_attack_range()
	local fix_pos = self:get_fix_pos()
	self.charge_direction = (self.target.Position - fix_pos).normalized
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, fix_pos, self.charge_direction, self.character.Position.y)

	local t_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.charge_direction)
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(t_dir)
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)
end

function local_class:update_move(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.DiagonalAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	-- 실제 이동 거리의 n% 이상 진행되었다면 스무스하게 미끄러지고 있다 판단
	local diff = (self.prev_pos - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if diff > self.charge_speed * dt * self.min_progress_per then
		self.prev_pos = self.character.Position
		return false
	else
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:update_charge_collision(dt)
	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local rocks = {}
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if string.match(fo.Name, 'magnetic_stone') then
			table.insert(rocks, fo.Name)
		end

		---- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
			local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
			local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
			local knock_direction
			if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
			else
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.charge_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.charge_knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	if #rocks > 0 then
		for i = #rocks, 1, -1 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'magnetic_stone_destroy_request', rocks[i], 'charge' }))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_foot_step_collision(position)
	self.foot_step_attack_calculator.Position = position
	local rocks = {}
	local objects = self.foot_step_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if string.match(fo.Name, 'magnetic_stone') then
			table.insert(rocks, fo.Name)
		end

		---- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local knockback_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - position).normalized
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.foot_step_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = knockback_direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.foot_step_knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	if #rocks > 0 then
		for i = #rocks, 1, -1 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'magnetic_stone_destroy_request', rocks[i], 'charge' }))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_magwi_remain_stones' then
			local amount = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
			self.remain_stones = amount
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_magwi_start_ailment_resist' then
			self:set_ailment_resist()
		end
	end
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_magwi_release_ailment_resist' then
			self:reset_ailment()
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil

	self.charge_direction = nil
	self.prev_pos = nil

	if self.foot_step_attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.foot_step_attack_calculator:End()
		self.foot_step_attack_calculator = nil
	end
	if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.attack_calculator = nil
	end

	-- etc
	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	self.state = nil
	-- ani
	self.ready_key = nil
	self.charge_key = nil
	self.groggy_key = nil
	self.start_position = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end



-- 상태이상 면역 추가
function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun | CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end
-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossMagwiChargeGuildBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		charge1 = 4,
		charge2 = 5,
		interval = 6,
		post = 7,
	}

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.0)

	-- action
	self.action_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'AttackAmount', 2)
	self.charge_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeSpeed', 5)
	local charge_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeRadius', 3.0)
	local charge_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDamageTerm', 0.2)
	self.charge_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDamageModifier', 1)
	self.charge_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeKnockBackForce', 1.5)
	self.charge_offset_z = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeOffsetZ', 1.5)

	self.charge_anim_1st_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeAnimDuration1', 0.53)
	self.charge_anim_2nd_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeAnimDuration2', 1.2)

	local foot_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FootRadius', 2.5)
	self.foot_step_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FootStepDamageModifier', 1)
	self.foot_step_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FootStepKnockBackForce', 1)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeMagnitude', 0.3)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeDuration', 1.0)

	self.move_start_sfx_delay1 = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MoveStartSfxDelay1', 0.1)
	self.move_start_sfx_delay2 = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MoveStartSfxDelay2', 0.4)

	self.charge_direction = nil
	self.prev_pos = nil
	self.min_progress_per = 0.85

	local info = collision_info_util.create_pie(charge_radius, 360, 1, 99, charge_damage_term)
	info.Center = self.character.Hitbox.pivot
	self.attack_calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	local foot_step_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(foot_radius, 99, -1)
	self.foot_step_calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, foot_step_info)

	self.send_range_event = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'SendAttackRangeEvent', true)
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, unity_class.vector2(15, charge_radius * 2), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	-- interval
	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'IntervalDuration', 0.5)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 0.2)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self.action_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		if self.send_range_event then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge1 then
		self.attack_calc:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge2 then
		self.attack_calc:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		if self.send_range_event then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('ready')

		self.charge_direction = (self.target.Position - self:get_fix_pos()).normalized
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)

		self.prev_pos = self.character.Position
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('charge')
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		self.action_count = self.action_count + 1
		self.prev_pos = self.character.Position

	elseif next_state == self.state.charge1 then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.is_play_move_sfx = false
		self.attack_calc:Start()

	elseif next_state == self.state.charge2 then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.is_play_move_sfx = false
		self.attack_calc:Start()

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.charge_direction = (self.target.Position - self:get_fix_pos()).normalized
		self.attack_range:Show(self.interval_duration)
		self.prev_pos = self.character.Position
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.interval_duration))
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction)
		self:update_attack_range()

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:change_state(self.state.charge1)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge1 or self.current_state == self.state.charge2 then
		self:publish_damage(dt)
		local is_reached_wall = self:update_move(dt)
		local sfx_delay = self.current_state == self.state.charge1 and self.move_start_sfx_delay1 or self.move_start_sfx_delay2
		local duration = self.current_state == self.state.charge1 and self.charge_anim_1st_duration or self.charge_anim_2nd_duration

		if self.time_passed >= sfx_delay and self.is_play_move_sfx == false then
			if self.current_state == self.state.charge1 then
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('move_start')
			end

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('move_start2')
			self.is_play_move_sfx = true
		end

		if is_reached_wall and self.time_passed > duration then
			self:foot_impact()
			if self.action_amount > self.action_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end

		elseif is_reached_wall == false and self.time_passed > duration then
			self:foot_impact()
			if self.current_state == self.state.charge1 then
				self:change_state(self.state.charge2)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.charge1)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self:update_attack_range()
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction)

		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:foot_impact()
	stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
	self.foot_step_calc:Start()

	local impact_position = self.character.Position + self:get_offset(self.character.Direction)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', impact_position)
	self:publish_damage_foot_step(impact_position)

	self.foot_step_calc:End()
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('step')
end

function local_class:get_offset(dir)
	if self.current_state == self.state.charge1 then
		if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			return vector(3, 0, 0)
		end
		if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			return vector(-2, 0, 0)
		end
		if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			return vector(1.5, 0, -2)
		end
		if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			return vector(-1.5, 0, 2)
		end
		return vector(0, 0, 0)
	end

	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return vector(3, 0, 0)
	end
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return vector(-2, 0, 0)
	end
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return vector(-1.5, 0, -1)
	end
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return vector(1.5, 0, 2)
	end
	return vector(0, 0, 0)
end

function local_class:get_fix_pos()
	return self.character.Position + vector_util.forward * self.charge_offset_z
end

function local_class:update_attack_range()
	local fix_pos = self:get_fix_pos()
	self.charge_direction = (self.target.Position - fix_pos).normalized
	self.attack_range:SetupByDirection(fix_pos, self.charge_direction, self.character.Position.y)
	if self.send_range_event then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end
end

function local_class:update_move(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.DiagonalAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	-- 실제 이동 거리의 n% 이상 진행되었다면 스무스하게 미끄러지고 있다 판단
	local diff = (self.prev_pos - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if diff > self.charge_speed * dt * self.min_progress_per then
		self.prev_pos = self.character.Position
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:publish_damage(dt)
	self.attack_calc.Position = self.character.Position
	self.attack_calc.Direction = self.charge_direction

	local objects = self.attack_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
		-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
		local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
		local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
		local knock_direction
		if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
			knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
		else
			knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
		end

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.charge_damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = direction
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.charge_knockback_force
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:publish_damage_foot_step(pos)
	self.foot_step_calc.Position = pos
	local objects = self.foot_step_calc:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local knockback_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - pos).normalized
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.foot_step_damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.foot_step_knockback_force
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossMagwiCoreAttackBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- ani
	self.qte_key = 'qte'
	self.groggy_start_key = 'groggy_start'
	self.groggy_loop_key = 'groggy_loop'
	self.core_open_key = 'core_open'
	self.core_idle_key = 'core_idle'
	self.core_open_fury_key = 'core_open_fury'
	self.running_core_open_fury = false

	self.direct_damage = false

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1)
	self.core_open_duration = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('groggy')

	-- qte
	self.qte_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'QteDuration', 5)
	self.turbo_tap_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'TurboTapCount', 5)
	self.current_tap_count = 0
	self.is_qte_success = false

	-- groggy_start
	local groggy_total_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'GroggyDuration', 5)
	self.groggy_start_duration = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration(self.groggy_start_key)

	-- groggy_loop
	self.groggy_loop_duration = groggy_total_duration - self.groggy_start_duration

	-- fail
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1)
	self.damage_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageHpRatio', 0.5)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackForce', 1)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 0)

	self.qte_point_offset = unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -1)

	self.is_force_cancel = false

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2, -- 오브젝트 전부 파괴 및 캐스팅, 존 안에 오브젝트 들고 왓는지 검사 ㅇㅇ
		qte = 3,
		groggy_start = 4,
		groggy_loop = 5,
		fail = 6,
		post = 7
	}

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()

end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

function local_class:trigger()

		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true

function local_class:start(info)
