	self.target = target

	if self.direct_damage then
		self:change_state((self.state.fail))
	else
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	end

	self.is_force_cancel = false
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.qte then
		self.is_qte_success = self.current_tap_count >= self.turbo_tap_count

		self.running_core_open_fury = false


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy_start then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy_loop then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.success then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fail then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_tap_count = 0
		self.prepare_duration = 0

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.qte_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('damaged')

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_magwi_qte_prepare' }))

	elseif next_state == self.state.qte then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_magwi_qte_start' }))

	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy_start then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_magwi_qte_success' }))
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('success', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('success_explosion', self.character.Position)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.groggy_start_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('mad')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('success')

	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy_loop then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.groggy_loop_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('mad')

	elseif next_state == self.state.success then
		self:destroy_magnet()

	elseif next_state == self.state.fail then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:destroy_magnet()

		self:publish_damaage()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_magwi_qte_fail' }))
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('fail', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('fail')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('fail2')

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then 	-- QTE 성공순간부터 폭탄이 터지기까지의 시간
			self:change_state(self.state.qte)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.qte then
		self:change_state(self.state.groggy_start)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy_start then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_start_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.groggy_loop)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy_loop then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_loop_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fail then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_move_manual_character()
	local pos = self.character.Position + self.qte_point_offset
	local speed = battle_util.get_number(self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualWalkSpeed)
	local duration = (self.target.Position - pos).magnitude / speed
	character_util.move_to(self.target, pos, duration, speed, true, true)
end

function local_class:publish_damaage()
	if self.target == nil then
		self.target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	end

	local owner = self.target
	local party = party_manager:GetPartyFor(owner)
	local members = party:GetStageMembers()
	for _, v in pairs(members) do
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = v
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(v) * self.damage_hp_ratio)

		local knockback_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, v).normalized
		damage_info.direction = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'magwi_qte_time_out' then
			self:change_state(self.state.fail)
		end

		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'magwi_mode2_start' then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.core_open_key)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_animation_for_prepare, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.current_tap_count = self.current_tap_count + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:destroy_magnet()
	local manual_character = party_manager.UserParty.Leader
	local leader_state = manual_character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local held = manual_character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		character_util.clear_holdup_state(user_party.Leader, held)
	end

	if self.field_magnet_obj == nil then
		self.field_magnet_obj = get_field_object('magnetic_obj')
	end
	if self.field_magnet_obj ~= nil then
		self.field_magnet_obj.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent.Create(self.field_magnet_obj))
	end
end

-- 현재 ai에서 core attack 패턴을 시작한 것처럼 보이게 해주고 있다
-- but 에니메이션을 조정할 수 없어 이 함수가 대신 그 역할을 한다
-- 이벤트를 받아서 처리
function local_class:set_animation_for_prepare()
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.core_open_key)
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('smile')

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(self.core_open_duration))

	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.core_idle_key)
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('smile')
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_cancel = true
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	-- ani
	self.qte_key = nil
	self.groggy_start_key = nil
	self.groggy_loop_key = nil
	self.core_open_key = nil
	self.core_idle_key = nil
	self.core_open_fury_key = nil
	-- prepare

	self.qte_point_offset = nil
	self.state = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossMagwiDrillPunchBattleAction')

-- 드릴 펀치의 장전, 샷, 회수 등을 관리하는 클래스
local punch_class =
{
	action = nil,
	cs_action = nil,
	position = nil,
	is_left = nil,
}
punch_class.mt = { __index = punch_class }

function punch_class:new(parent_class, is_left)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.position = vector_util.zero
	obj.is_left = is_left
	obj.is_touch_wall = false

	self.current_state = self.state.none

function punch_class:set_punch_params()

	self.dir = self.is_left and vector_util.right or vector_util.left

	self.punch_impact_stay_duration = self.action.punch_impact_stay_duration

	self.punch_load_distance = self.action.punch_load_distance

	self.punch_shot_speed = self.action.punch_shot_speed
	self.punch_shot_start_pos = vector_util.zero
	self.punch_shot_end_pos = vector_util.zero

function punch_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.load then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.loaded then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		if self.fx_drill_dash ~= nil then
			self.fx_drill_dash:Dispose()
			self.fx_drill_dash = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stay then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.back then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.back2 then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.disappear then

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.load then
		if self.drill_object == nil then

		self.drill_spine_controller:SetAnimation(1, 'idle', true)

			self.punch_load_start_pos = unity_class.vector3(start_x, start_y, start_z)

			self.drill_spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		else
			local start_x = self.zone_bound.max.x + self.punch_size.x / 2 - self.punch_load_offset
			self.punch_load_start_pos = unity_class.vector3(start_x, start_y, start_z)
			self.punch_load_end_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.zone_bound.max.x - self.punch_size.x / 2, self.target.Position.y, start_z)
			self.drill_spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		end

		self.punch_calculator:Start()
		self.impact_count = 0

	elseif next_state == self.state.loaded then

		self.attack_range:Show(self.punch_tracking_time)

		self.punch_shot_start_pos = self.position
		if self.is_left then
			local end_x = self.zone_bound.max.x - self.action.punch_size.x / 2
			self.punch_shot_end_pos = unity_class.vector3(end_x, self.target.Position.y, self.target.Position.z)
		else
			local end_x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.action.punch_size.x / 2
			self.punch_shot_end_pos = unity_class.vector3(end_x, self.target.Position.y, self.target.Position.z)
		end

		self.punch_shot_distance = (self.punch_shot_start_pos - self.punch_shot_end_pos).magnitude

		if self.fx_drill_dash == nil then
			self.fx_drill_dash = self.is_left and self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('dash_l', self.position)
					or self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('dash_r', self.position)
		end

		self.drill_spine_controller:SetAnimation(1, 'shoot', true)

		-- 트래킹 완료 후 발사 될 때(최초 1회) 재생되도록
		if self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
			self.cs_action:PlaySfx('shoot')
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.stay then
		stage_camera:Shake(self.action.camera_shake_magnitude, self.action.camera_shake_duration)
		self.drill_spine_controller:SetAnimation(1, 'crash', false)

		if self.is_last then
			-- 여기서 낙석 & 번개 생성
			for i, v in pairs(self.action.rockfall_holders) do
				v:set_position_and_start(i)
			end

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_magwi_get_remain_stones' }))
			local repeat_count = self.action.remain_stones * self.action.thunder_once_shot_count
			for i = 1, repeat_count do

		if self.punch_calculator ~= nil and self.punch_calculator.IsStarted == false then
			self.punch_calculator:Start()
		end

		self.punch_back_start_pos = self.position

		local back_x = 0
		if self.is_left then
			back_x = self.zone_bound.min.x - self.punch_size.x / 2 - self.punch_back_offset
		else
			back_x = self.zone_bound.max.x + self.punch_size.x / 2 + self.punch_back_offset
		end
		self.punch_back_end_pos = unity_class.vector3(back_x, self.position.y, self.position.z)
		self.punch_back_distance = (self.punch_back_start_pos - self.punch_back_end_pos).magnitude

		if self.drill_object == nil then
			self.drill_object = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('drill', self.punch_load_start_pos)
		end

		if self.drill_spine_controller == nil then
			self.drill_spine_controller = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.drill_object)
		else
			self.drill_spine_controller:SetAnimation(1, 'return', false)
		end

		if self.current_state == self.state.stay and self.is_last then
			--모드 1일때만 드릴을 뽑으면 다 터뜨린다.

				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_magwi_destroy_all_stone' }))
			end
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.back2 then

	elseif next_state == self.state.disappear then
		self.punch_calculator:End()
		if self.drill_object ~= nil then
			self.drill_object:Dispose()
			self.drill_object = nil
			self.drill_spine_controller = nil
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.impact then
		self.punch_shot_distance = (self.punch_shot_end_pos - self.position).magnitude
		local fx_crash = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('crash', self.position + self.dir * (self.punch_size.x / 2))
		fx_crash.transform.localEulerAngles = self.is_left and vector_util.zero or unity_class.vector3(0, 180, 0)

		self.drill_spine_controller:SetAnimation(1, 'crash', false)
		self.cs_action:PlaySfx('impact_rock')

	else

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function punch_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self:update_collision(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.load then
		if self:update_punch_position(dt) then
			self:change_state(self.state.loaded)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.loaded then
		if self.is_tracking then
			self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.shot)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		self:update_punch_position(dt)
		self:update_tracking_attack_range()

		if self.time_passed >= self.punch_tracking_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then

		if self:update_punch_position(dt) then
			self:change_state(self.state.stay)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stay then
		if self.time_passed >= self.punch_impact_stay_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.back)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.back then
		if self:update_punch_position(dt) then
			self:change_state(self.state.back2)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.back2 then
		if self:update_punch_position(dt) then
			self:change_state(self.state.disappear)
		end

	-- 여기 제어는 local_class에서 합니다(update_frame -> if state.action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.disappear then
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.impact then
		if self.time_passed >= self.punch_impact_stay_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot)
		end
	end
end

function punch_class:update_tracking_attack_range()
	local pos = unity_class.vector3(self.range_x, self.position.y, self.position.z)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, pos, self.dir, self.target.Position.y)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
end

-- return value로 progress가 1이상 => 완료 되었는지 리턴
function punch_class:update_punch_position(dt)
	local progress = 0
	-- 장전 중
	if self.current_state == self.state.load then
		progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.punch_load_distance / self.punch_load_speed)
		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
		local calc_pos = self.punch_load_start_pos + vector_util.down * (self.punch_load_distance * progress)
		self.position = calc_pos

		-- 타겟 트래킹
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		local t_progress = dt / self.punch_tracking_speed
		local diff = (self.position - self.target.Position).z

		if math.abs(diff) <= t_progress then
			self.position = unity_class.vector3(self.position.x, self.position.y, self.target.Position.z)
		else
			if diff < 0 then
				self.position = self.position + vector_util.forward * t_progress
			elseif diff > 0 then
				self.position = self.position + vector_util.back * t_progress
			end
		end

		-- z 고정, 발사
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.punch_shot_distance / self.punch_shot_speed)
		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
		if self.is_left then
			self.position = self.punch_shot_start_pos + vector_util.right * (self.punch_shot_distance * progress)
		else
			self.position = self.punch_shot_start_pos + vector_util.left * (self.punch_shot_distance * progress)
		end

		if self.fx_drill_dash ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_drill_dash, self.position, vector_util.zero)
		end


		-- z 고정, 회수
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.back then
		if self.punch_back_distance == nil then
			self:punch_back_distance_calc()
		end
		progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.punch_back_distance / self.punch_back_speed)
		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
		if self.is_left then
			self.position = self.punch_back_start_pos + vector_util.left * (self.punch_back_distance * progress)
		else
			self.position = self.punch_back_start_pos + vector_util.right * (self.punch_back_distance * progress)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.back2 then
		progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.punch_load_distance / self.punch_back2_speed)
		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
		local calc_pos = self.punch_back2_start_pos + vector_util.up * (self.punch_load_distance * progress)
		self.position = calc_pos
	end

	-- TODO:punch obj update
	 object_pool_extensions.UpdateObject(self.drill_object, self.position, self.dir)
	return progress >= 1
end

function punch_class:punch_back_distance_calc()
	self.punch_back_start_pos = self.position

	local back_x = 0
	if self.is_left then
		back_x = self.zone_bound.min.x - self.punch_size.x / 2 - self.punch_back_offset
	else
		back_x = self.zone_bound.max.x + self.punch_size.x / 2 + self.punch_back_offset
	end
	self.punch_back_end_pos = unity_class.vector3(back_x, self.position.y, self.position.z)
	self.punch_back_distance = (self.punch_back_start_pos - self.punch_back_end_pos).magnitude
end

function punch_class:set_target_and_start(target, is_tracking, is_last)
	self.target = target
	self.is_tracking = is_tracking
	self.is_last = is_last

	self:change_state(self.state.load)
end

function punch_class:update_collision(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.disappear or self.punch_calculator == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.action.is_running_qte then
		return
	end

	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.punch_calculator) then
		self.punch_calculator:Start()
	end


	self.punch_calculator.Position = self.position
	local rocks = {}
	local objects = self.punch_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if string.match(fo.Name, 'magnetic_stone') then
			table.insert(rocks, fo.Name)
		else
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.action.character, fo) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				local knockback_direction = self.position.z < fo.Position.z and vector_util.back or vector_util.forward
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.action.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.direction = knockback_direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.punch_knockback_force
				damage_info.modifier = self.action.punch_damage_modifier
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	if #rocks > 0 then
		for i = #rocks, 1, -1 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.action.character, { 'magnetic_stone_destroy_request', rocks[i], 'drill' }))
			self.impact_count = self.impact_count + 1
		end
		self:change_state(self.state.impact)
	end
end

function punch_class:cancle()
	self:change_state(self.state.back)
end

function punch_class:dispose()
	self.current_state = nil

	if self.fx_drill_dash ~= nil then
		self.fx_drill_dash:Dispose()
		self.fx_drill_dash = nil
	end

	if self.drill_object ~= nil then
		self.drill_object:Dispose()
		self.drill_object = nil
	end

	self.action = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.position = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.drill_spine_controller = nil
end

-- 드릴 펀치 벽 충돌 시 떨어지는 낙석 클래스
function rock_class:new(parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action

	self.state = parent_class.rockfall_state
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.rockfall_height = parent_class.rockfall_height
	self.position = nil
	self.start_pos = nil
	self.end_pos = nil
	self.delay = 0
	self.rockfall_speed = parent_class.rockfall_speed
	self.rockfall_duration = self.rockfall_height / self.rockfall_speed

	self.radius = parent_class.rockfall_radius
	local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.radius, 1, -1)
	self.rockfall_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false)
	self.rockfall_damage_modifier = parent_class.rock_damage_modifier
	self.rockfall_knockback_force = parent_class.rockfall_knockback_force
	self.explosion_offset_y = parent_class.explosion_offset_y

	self.fx_rock = nil
	self.fx_explosion = nil

	self.rockfall_ar = nil

	return obj
end

function rock_class:set_position_and_start(idx)

	self.rockfall_calculator:Start()

	local cnt = 1
	local position = nil
	while (true) do
		position = self.action:get_rand_rockfall_pos(idx)
		self.rockfall_calculator.Position = position
		local rocks = {}
		local objects = self.rockfall_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
		for i = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[i]
			if string.match(fo.Name, 'magnetic_stone') then
				table.insert(rocks, fo.Name)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if #rocks == 0 then
			break
		else
			cnt = cnt + 1
		end
	end

	self.start_pos = position + vector_util.up * self.rockfall_height
	self.end_pos = position
	self.delay = self.action.rockfall_interval * idx

	self.rockfall_calculator:End()

	if self.rockfall_ar == nil then
		self.rockfall_ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		self.rockfall_ar:Hide()
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.delay)
end

function rock_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.delay then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		if self.fx_rock ~= nil then
			self.fx_rock:Dispose()
			self.fx_rock = nil
		end


		if self.rockfall_ar ~= nil then
			self.rockfall_ar:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.rockfall_ar))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.destroy then

	else

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.delay then

	elseif next_state == self.state.move then
		self.fx_rock = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('rock', self.start_pos)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.rockfall_ar, self.end_pos)
		self.rockfall_ar:Show(self.rockfall_duration)
		self.cs_action:PlaySfx('siren')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.rockfall_ar))

	elseif next_state == self.state.destroy then
		self:publish_damage()
		self.fx_explosion = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', vector(self.end_pos.x, self.end_pos.y + self.explosion_offset_y, self.end_pos.z))
		self.cs_action:PlaySfx('rock_destroy')
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function rock_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.delay then
		if self.time_passed >= self.delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.move)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		local is_arrive = self:update_move()
		if self.fx_rock ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_rock, self.position, vector_util.zero)
		end

		if is_arrive then
			self:change_state(self.state.destroy)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.destroy then
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

	end
end

function rock_class:update_move()
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.rockfall_height / self.rockfall_speed)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	local calc_pos = self.start_pos + vector_util.down * (self.rockfall_height * progress)
	self.position = calc_pos

	return progress >= 1
end

function rock_class:publish_damage()
	if self.action.is_running_qte then
		return
	end

	self.rockfall_calculator:Start()
	self.rockfall_calculator.Position = self.position
	local objects = self.rockfall_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.action.character, fo) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			local knockback_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.action.character, fo)
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.action.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.direction = knockback_direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.rockfall_knockback_force
			damage_info.modifier = self.rockfall_damage_modifier
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	self.rockfall_calculator:End()
end

function rock_class:force_cancel()
	if self.fx_rock ~= nil then
		self.fx_rock:Dispose()
		self.fx_rock = nil
	end

	if self.fx_explosion ~= nil and self.fx_explosion.active then
		self.fx_explosion:Dispose()
		self.fx_explosion = nil
	end

	if self.rockfall_ar ~= nil then
		self.rockfall_ar:Hide()
	end
end

function rock_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.rockfall_ar ~= nil then
		self.rockfall_ar:Hide()
		self.rockfall_ar = nil
	end
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- TODO: 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:make_rockfall_area_array()

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then

			if self.left_punch_class.current_state == self.drill_state.none then

		else

				self.selected_class = self.right_punch_class
			else
				self.selected_class = self.left_punch_class
			end
		end
		self.selected_class:set_target_and_start(self.target, true, self.is_last)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else

	end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_drill(dt)
	self:update_thunder(dt)

	if #self.rockfall_holders > 0 then
		for _, v in pairs(self.rockfall_holders) do
			v:update_frame(dt)
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- TODO: 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.selected_class ~= nil and self.selected_class.current_state == self.drill_state.back then
			self.selected_class = nil
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_drill(dt)
	if self.left_punch_class ~= nil and self.left_punch_class.current_state ~= self.drill_state.none then
		self.left_punch_class:update_frame(dt)
	end

	if self.right_punch_class ~= nil and self.right_punch_class.current_state ~= self.drill_state.none then
		self.right_punch_class:update_frame(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:update_thunder(dt)
	if self.thunder_holders == nil or #self.thunder_holders <= 0 then
		return
	end

	for idx = #self.thunder_holders, 1, -1 do
		local holder = self.thunder_holders[idx]
		holder:update_frame_thunder(dt)

		if holder.current_state == self.thunder_state.none then
			holder:change_state_thunder(self.thunder_state.delay)
		end

		if holder.current_state == self.thunder_state.destroy then
			holder:dispose()
			table.remove(self.thunder_holders, idx)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:add_thunder_holder()
	if self.thunder_holders == nil then
		self.thunder_holders = {}
	end

	local delay = #self.thunder_holders * self.thunder_interval
	local temp = thunder_class:new(self, delay)
	table.insert(self.thunder_holders, temp)
end

function local_class:clear_thunder()
	if self.thunder_holders == nil or #self.thunder_holders < 1 then return end

	for idx = #self.thunder_holders, 1, -1 do
		local holder = self.thunder_holders[idx]
		holder:change_state_thunder(self.thunder_state.none)
		holder:dispose()
		table.remove(self.thunder_holders, idx)
	end
end

function local_class:clear_rock_fall()
	for _, v in pairs(self.rockfall_holders) do
		v:force_cancel()
	end
end


function local_class:make_rockfall_area_array()
	-- 기존 맵 삭제
	for i = #self.rand_rockfall_map, 1, -1 do
		table.remove(self.rand_rockfall_map, i)
	end

	local f_num = math.sqrt(self.rockfall_max_count)
	local a, b = math.modf(f_num)
	local s_num = a
	if b > 0 then
		s_num  = s_num  + 1
	end

	local x_length = self.zone_bound.size.x / s_num
	local z_length = self.zone_bound.size.z / s_num
	local map_temp = {}

	for z = 0, s_num - 1 do
		for x = 0, s_num - 1 do
			local v = {}
			v.x_min = self.zone_bound.min.x + x * x_length
			v.x_max = v.x_min + x_length
			v.z_min = self.zone_bound.min.z + z * z_length
			v.z_max = v.z_min + z_length
			v.pass = false
			table.insert(map_temp, v)
		end
	end

	local count = 0

	-- 한번 쓰까
	for _ = #map_temp, 1, -1 do
		local r_idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, #map_temp)
		local temp = table.remove(map_temp, r_idx)
		table.insert(self.rand_rockfall_map, temp)
		count = count + 1
	end

	-- 딱 떨어지면 계산 필요 없음
	if b == 0 then
		return
	end

	local m_num = s_num * s_num - self.rockfall_max_count
	local div_num = (#self.rand_rockfall_map - 1) / m_num
	local pass_num = 0.0

	local iter = 1
	for i = 1, m_num do
		local max_num, pass = math.modf(div_num)
		pass_num = pass_num + pass
		local pass_a, pass_b = math.modf(pass_num)
		if pass_a > 0 then
			max_num = max_num + pass_a
			pass_num = pass_b
		end

		-- 다음애를 pass로 만들어야함
		local rand_idx = random_util.get_random_int(iter, iter + max_num - 2)
		self.rand_rockfall_map[rand_idx + 1].pass = true
		iter = iter + max_num
	end
end

function local_class:get_rand_rockfall_pos(count)
	if #self.rand_rockfall_map == self.rockfall_max_count then
		local rand_map = self.rand_rockfall_map[count]
		local r_x = unity_class.random.Range(rand_map.x_min, rand_map.x_max)
		local r_z = unity_class.random.Range(rand_map.z_min, rand_map.z_max)
		return unity_class.vector3(r_x, 0, r_z)
	end

	local rand_map = self.rand_rockfall_map[count]
	local next_map = self.rand_rockfall_map[count + 1]
	-- 만약 다음 map이 pass라면 랜덤으로 두개 중 하나를 픽
	if next_map ~= nil and next_map.pass then
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(0, 1)
		if rand == 1 then
			rand_map = next_map
		end
	end

	local r_x = unity_class.random.Range(rand_map.x_min, rand_map.x_max)
	local r_z = unity_class.random.Range(rand_map.z_min, rand_map.z_max)

	return unity_class.vector3(r_x, 0, r_z)
end

function local_class:make_thunder_attack_range()
	local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.thunder_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	ar.name = 'thunder_test'
	ar:Hide()
	return ar
end

function local_class:get_thunder_attack_range()
	if #self.thunder_ar_pool > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.thunder_ar_pool)
	end

	local range = self:make_thunder_attack_range()
	return range
end

function local_class:return_thunder_attack_range(ar)
	ar:Hide()
	table.insert(self.thunder_ar_pool, ar)
end

function local_class:publish_damage_thunder(pos)
	self.thunder_calculator:Start()
	self.thunder_calculator.Position = pos
	local objects = self.thunder_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.thunder_damage_modifier
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	self.thunder_calculator:End()
end

-- 프로젝타일 슈터 구현 시 조건 부 함수
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_magwi_qte_prepare' then
			self.is_running_qte = true

		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'magwi_mode2_start' then
			self:change_mode(self.mode.two)

		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'magwi_mode2_end' then
			self:change_mode(self.mode.one)

		end

		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_magwi_qte_success' or e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_magwi_qte_fail' then
			self.is_running_qte = false
			self:clear_thunder()
			self:clear_rock_fall()
		end

		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_magwi_remain_stones' then
			local amount = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
			self.remain_stones = amount
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.left_punch_class ~= nil then
		self.left_punch_class:cancle()
	end

	if self.right_punch_class ~= nil then
		self.right_punch_class:cancle()
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	for _, v in pairs(self.rockfall_holders) do
		v:force_cancel()
	end

	if self.thunder_holders ~= nil then
		for _, v in pairs(self.thunder_holders) do
			v:dispose()
		end
		self.thunder_holders = nil
	end

	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.left_punch_class ~= nil then
		self.left_punch_class:dispose()
	end

	if self.right_punch_class ~= nil then
		self.right_punch_class:dispose()
	end

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.drill_state = nil
	self.rockfall_state = nil
	self.mode = nil
	self.thunder_state = nil
	self.punch_size = nil

	self.selected_class = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = nil
	self.drill_state = nil
	self.rockfall_state = nil

	-- table 비우기
	self.rand_rockfall_map = nil
	if self.rockfall_holders ~= nil then
		if #self.rockfall_holders > 0 then
			for i = #self.rockfall_holders, 1, -1 do
				self.rockfall_holders[i]:dispose()
				table.remove(self.rockfall_holders[i])
			end
		end
		self.rockfall_holders = nil
	end

	if self.thunder_holders ~= nil then
		if #self.thunder_holders > 0 then
			for i = #self.thunder_holders, 1, -1 do
				self.thunder_holders[i]:dispose()
				table.remove(self.thunder_holders)
			end
		end
	end

	self.thunder_holders = nil

	if self.thunder_ar_pool ~= nil then
		if #self.thunder_ar_pool > 0 then
			for _,ar in pairs (self.thunder_ar_pool) do
				ar:Hide()
			end
		end
		self.thunder_ar_pool = nil
	end


	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	if self.left_punch_class ~= nil then
		self.left_punch_class:set_punch_params()
	end

	if self.right_punch_class ~= nil then
		self.right_punch_class:set_punch_params()
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossMagwiElectricityGuildBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.state = {
		move = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		interval = 4,
		post = 5,
	}

	-- move
	self.move_speed = battle_util.get_number(self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualWalkSpeed)

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0.5)

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1.0)
	self.action_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ActionAmount', 2)
	self.inner_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'InnerRadius', 3.0)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1.0)
	self.inner_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'InnerKnockBackForce', 1.5)
	self.outer_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'OuterKnockBackForce', 1.2)
	self.action_count = 0
	self.repeat_count = 0

	-- interval
	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'IntervalDuration', 0.2)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	-- fx
	self.fx_cast = nil

	-- sfx
	self.sfx_cast = nil

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self.action_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.move then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		self.character.Direction = dir

		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_cast)
		self:dispose_sfx(self.sfx_cast)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		self.character.Direction = dir

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.move then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.fx_cast = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast', self.character.Position + vector_util.forward * 1)
		self.sfx_cast = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('action', self.character.Position + vector_util.forward * 1)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack')

		self:publish_damage()
		self.action_count = self.action_count + 1

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.interval_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_cast)
		self:dispose_sfx(self.sfx_cast)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.move then
		if self:update_move(dt) then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.action_count < self.action_amount then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_move(dt)
	local dist = vector_util.sqr_xz_distance(self.character.Position, self.zone_bound.center)
	if dist <= 0.01 then
		return true
	end

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = vector_util.normalized(self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position)
	move_info.magnitude = self.move_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_side_dir(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
	return false
end

function local_class:publish_damage()
	local owner = self.target
	local party = party_manager:GetPartyFor(owner)
	local members = party:GetStageMembers()
	for _, v in pairs(members) do
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = v
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier

		local knockback_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, v).normalized
		damage_info.direction = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction

		local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
		local force = diff > self.inner_radius and self.outer_knockback_force or self.inner_knockback_force
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * force
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx == nil then
		return
	end

	fx:Dispose()
	fx = nil
end

function local_class:dispose_sfx(sfx)
	if sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.sfx_cast:Stop()
	self.sfx_cast = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil

	self.state = nil

	self:dispose_fx(self.fx_cast)
	self:dispose_sfx(self.sfx_cast)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.move then
		if self:update_move(dt) then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)
		self.character.Direction = dir

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.repeat_count > self.action_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_move(dt)
	local dist = vector_util.sqr_xz_distance(self.character.Position, self.zone_bound.center)
	if dist <= 0.01 then
		return true
	end

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = vector_util.normalized(self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position)
	move_info.magnitude = self.move_speed * dt
	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_side_dir(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
	return false
end

function local_class:publish_damage()
	local owner = self.target
	local party = party_manager:GetPartyFor(owner)
	local members = party:GetStageMembers()
	for _, v in pairs(members) do
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = v
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(v) * self.damage_ratio)

		local knockback_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, v).normalized
		damage_info.direction = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_magwi_remain_stones' then
			local amount = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
			self.remain_stones = amount
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil

	self.state = nil

	if self.fx_cast ~= nil then

		self.fx_cast = nil
	end

	if self.sfx_cast ~= nil then
		self.sfx_cast:Stop()
		self.sfx_cast = nil
	end

	self.cast_key = nil
	self.groggy_key = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.target = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.traking then
		if self:update_move(dt) or self.time_passed >= self.tracking_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		else
			local dir_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position - self.target.Position).normalized
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(dir_vector.magnitude) then
				dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.outer_attack)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.outer_attack then
		-- sfx timing
		if self.time_passed >= self.sfx_attack_back_delay and self.sfx_attack_back_run == false then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack_back')
			self.sfx_attack_back_run = true
		end

		-- attack timing
		if self.time_passed >= self.outer_damage_timing and self.outer_attack_ani_running == false then
			self:publish_damage_outer(self.outer_attack_pos_1)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion_small', self.outer_attack_pos_1)

			self:publish_damage_outer(self.outer_attack_pos_2)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion_small', self.outer_attack_pos_2)

			self.outer_attack_ani_running = true
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack')
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.outer_attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_inerval then
			self:change_state(self.state.inner_attack)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.inner_attack then
		if self.time_passed >= self.inner_attack_duration then
			if self.inner_shot_max_count <= self.inner_shot_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

	local distance = vector_util.sqr_distance(vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position), vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position))

	self.outer_damage_calculator.Position = pos
	local objects = self.outer_damage_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)

			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction

	self.send_range_event = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'SendAttackRangeEvent', true)

	local info = collision_info_util.create_arc_donut(safe_r, arc_r, angle, 1, self.action_duration, -1)
	self.damage_calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	self.action_count = 0
	self.action_dir = nil

	-- interval
	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'IntervalDuration', 0.5)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	-- sfx
	self.sfx_attack_back_delay = 0.7
	self.sfx_attack_back_run = false

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self.action_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.traking)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.traking then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.safe_range:Hide()

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if self.send_range_event then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.damage_calc:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.safe_range:Hide()

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if self.send_range_event then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.traking then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('attack')

		self.action_dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.action_dir)
		self.attack_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.action_dir, self.character.Position.y)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		self.safe_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.action_dir, self.character.Position.y)
		self.safe_range:Show()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		if self.send_range_event then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('attack')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', self.character.Position)

		self.action_count = self.action_count + 1
		self.damage_calc:Start()

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.action_dir, self.character.Position.y)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.interval_duration)
		self.safe_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.action_dir, self.character.Position.y)
		self.safe_range:Show()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.interval_duration))
		if self.send_range_event then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.traking then
		if self:update_move(dt) or self.time_passed >= self.tracking_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			return
		end

		local dir_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position - self.target.Position).normalized
		if float_util.is_almost_zero(dir_vector.magnitude) then
			dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:publish_damage(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.action_count < self.action_amount then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_move(dt)
	local nor = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(nor)
	self.character.Direction = dir

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = nor
	move_info.magnitude = self.follow_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, dir, false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	local dist = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	return dist <= self.near_distance
end

function local_class:publish_damage(dt)
	self.damage_calc.Position = self.character.Position
	self.damage_calc.Direction = self.action_dir

	local objects = self.damage_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		local knockback_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		if knockback_direction == vector_util.zero then
			knockback_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(self.target.Direction)
		end
		damage_info.direction = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.shoot_offset = vector_util.zero

	--주 투사체 바운스볼의 사격 스펙
	self.main_projectile_label = 31
	local main_shooter = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)

			main_shooter, main_projtile_spec, main_pattern, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	self.main_ball_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MainBallDamageModifier', 0.5)

	local proj_pixel_to_world = battle_util.get_number(main_projtile_spec.PixelToWorld)

	self.sub_projectile_label = self.sub_projectile_label_default

	self.sub_shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			sub_shooter, sub_projtile_spec, sub_pattern, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	local atk_range_width = battle_util.get_number(main_projtile_spec.HitBoxWidth) * pixel_to_world

	local projectile_max_dist = main_projtile_spec:GetMaxDistance()

	self.laser_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LaserDamageTerm', 0.25)
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(vector(projectile_max_dist*0.5,0, atk_range_width), 1, laser_damage_term, true)
	self.laser_damage_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, collision_info)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
