end
function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_magwi_release_ailment_resist' }))
end

-- 페이즈 변경시 처리
function local_class:change_phase(next_phase)
	if next_phase == self.current_phase then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
	end

	if next_phase == self.phase.one then
		self.shoot_offset = self.phase1_shoot_offset

		self.prepare_duration = self.prepare_duration1
		self.casting_duration = self.casting_duration
		self.action_duration = self.action_duration1

	elseif next_phase == self.phase.two then
		self.shoot_offset = self.phase2_shoot_offset

		self.prepare_duration = 0
		self.casting_duration = self.casting_duration2
		self.action_duration = self.action_duration2
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_phase = next_phase
end
-- 상태 관리 함수
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end
	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_shoot_count = 0
		self:play_prepare_animation()

	elseif next_state == self.state.casting then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_range:Show(self.casting_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.casting_duration))

		local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		local shoot_offset = self.character.Position + self:get_shoot_offset(vector_util.to_direction(dir))
		local shoot_dir = (self.target.Position - shoot_offset).normalized

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, shoot_offset, shoot_dir, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))

		self:play_casting_animation()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:shoot_main()
		self:play_shoot_animation()
		self.current_shoot_count = self.current_shoot_count + 1
		-- 발사 연출이 끝날 때 실제 투사체를 쏜다

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 발사 연출이 끝날 때 실제 투사체를 쏜다

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end
-- Update 함수
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then return end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.casting)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(dir))
		self.character.Direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)

		local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		local shoot_offset = self.character.Position + self:get_shoot_offset(vector_util.to_direction(dir))
		local shoot_dir = (self.target.Position - shoot_offset).normalized

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, shoot_offset, shoot_dir, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))

		if self.time_passed >= self.casting_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.current_shoot_count < self.shoot_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.casting)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:play_prepare_animation()
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key_1)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('idle')
	elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('attack')
	end
end
function local_class:play_casting_animation()
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.casting_key_1)
	elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.casting_key_2)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('ready')
	end
end
function local_class:play_shoot_animation()
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key_1)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('idle')
	elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.two then

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key_2)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('attack')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot')
	end
end


-- 메인 레이저볼을 쏜다. 3번 튕길 수 있는 레이저볼
function local_class:shoot_main()
	local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + self:get_shoot_offset(vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)))
	local shoot_dir = (self.target.Position - shoot_pos).normalized

	self.main_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, shoot_dir, self.main_projectile_label)
	self.sub_projectile_label = self.sub_projectile_label_default
end

--왼쪽 기준으로 오프셋을 회전 시킨 값을 얻는다.
function local_class:get_shoot_offset(dir)
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		return self.phase1_shoot_offset
	end

	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return self.phase2_shoot_offset_left

	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return self.phase2_shoot_offset_right

	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return self.phase2_shoot_offset_up
	else
		return self.phase2_shoot_offset_down
	end
end

-- 2페이즈 전용 분열된 투사체 발사
function local_class:shoot_sub(move_info, hit_info)
	-- 바운스 역방향으로 세팅해서 발사해준다.
	local shoot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(move_info.position)
	local surface_normal_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.target_direction)					-- 4웨이 버전 법선벡터, 벽의 법선 벡터만 캐치 가능
	local surface_true_normal_vector = direction_util.to_8way_vector3(self.target_direction)				-- 8웨이 버전의 법선백터, 구석일 경우 해당 값도 나옴
	local reflected_shoot_dir = unity_class.vector3.Reflect(move_info.direction, surface_normal_vector)	-- 벽에 반사되서 나가는 방향

	local c_angle = 360 - unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(reflected_shoot_dir, vector_util.forward).eulerAngles.y
	local sub_angle1 = c_angle - self.sub_ball_angle	--입사각 기준 45도
	local sub_angle2 = c_angle + self.sub_ball_angle	--입사각 기준 반대 45도
	-- 공 각도에 대한 각각의 보정처리(벽을 넘어가게 되는지, 충돌체 크기를 고려하여 벽과 충돌을 어떻게 시킬건지)

	local sub_dir1 = (unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(sub_angle1, unity_class.vector3.up) * vector_util.forward).normalized
	local sub_dir2 = (unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(sub_angle2, unity_class.vector3.up) * vector_util.forward).normalized

	local mag = vector_util.magnitude(vector(self.ball_width/2, 0, self.ball_height/2))
	local offset = vector_util.get_x0z(shoot_pos + surface_true_normal_vector * mag)

	self.sub_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(offset, sub_dir1, self.sub_projectile_label)
	self.sub_projectile_label = self.sub_projectile_label + 1

	self.sub_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(offset, sub_dir2, self.sub_projectile_label)
	self.sub_projectile_label = self.sub_projectile_label + 1
end

-- 주 투사체/ 분열 투사체 모두 호출된다.
-- 투사체가 바운스 회수를 초과하여 부딪힐 때도 호출된다.
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if label == self.main_projectile_label then
		return self:on_hit_main(move_info, hit_info)
	else
		return self:on_hit_sub(move_info, hit_info)
	end
end

-- 투사체 유형별 히트 이벤트
-- 주 투사체의 마지막 충돌도 이게 호출된다.
function local_class:on_hit_main(move_info, hit_info)
	if self.main_shoot_helper == nil then return true end

	if hit_info.target == nil then		-- 벽과 충돌하여 마지막에 소멸한 경우다.
		self:on_hit_wall(move_info, hit_info, label)
		self:play_main_proj_explode_fx(move_info.position)
		return true
	end

	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) == false then return true end --TODO:벽이 들어오는지 체크가 필요하다.

	if hit_info.target.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
		self:on_hit_wall(move_info, hit_info, label)
		self:play_main_proj_explode_fx(move_info.position)
		return true
	end

	-- 이외의 모든 경우는 개체가 피격된거다. 데미지를 준다.

	if hit_info.target ~= nil then
		self:give_damage_main_ball(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end
function local_class:on_hit_sub(move_info, hit_info)
	if self.sub_shoot_helper == nil then return true end
	self:play_sub_proj_explode_fx(move_info.position)

	if hit_info.target == nil or hit_info.target.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
		-- 작은 구체 벽에 부딧혔을때만 사운드 재생
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('small_hit')
		return true
	end

	self:give_damage_sub_ball(hit_info)

	return false
end

-- 주 투사체의 바운싱 이벤트
function local_class:on_bounce(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if label ~= self.main_projectile_label then return true end		--주 투사체가 아니다. 할거 없다.

	--target 검사를 안해도 된다. 어짜피 벽일때만 onbounce 된다.
	self:on_hit_wall(move_info, hit_info, label)

	return true
end

--벽에 부딪혔을때 처리해야할 로직을 수행한다.
function local_class:on_hit_wall(move_info, hit_info, label)
	self:shoot_laser_beam(move_info, hit_info, label)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('bounce')

	if self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		self:shoot_sub(move_info, hit_info)
	end
	-- 일시적으로 저장한 계산값을 모두 초기화
	self.last_bounce_wall = self.bounce_wall_direction.none
	self.reflect_offset_x = 0
	self.reflect_offset_z = 0
	self.target_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
end

function local_class:shoot_laser_beam(move_info, hit_info, label)
	-- target이 null일 수 있다. target으로 찾지 않는다.
	local wall_positions = {}    --열린 공간, 벽이 없는 타일을 찾는다.

	local left = self.zone_bound.min.x
	local right = self.zone_bound.max.x
	local top = self.zone_bound.max.z
	local bottom = self.zone_bound.min.z

	local move_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(move_info.position)
	local ball_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(hit_info.position)

	local start_pos = ball_pos
	local end_pos_x = 0
	local end_pos_z = 0
	local end_pos = vector_util.zero
	self.target_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	--ball_width를 배율을 0.5보다 크게 준 이유는 바운드 체크는 충돌 했을때만 하기 때문에, 확실하게 바운드 체크를 하기 위해 조금 더 넣었다.
	if ball_pos.x + self.ball_width >= right then -- 오른벽에 충돌했다.
		end_pos_x = left
		self.target_direction = self.target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Left	--왼쪽으로 발사
	end
	if ball_pos.x - self.ball_width <= left then
		end_pos_x = right
		self.target_direction = self.target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end
	if ball_pos.z + self.ball_height >= top then
		end_pos_z = bottom
		self.target_direction = self.target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	end
	if ball_pos.z - self.ball_height <= bottom then
		end_pos_z = top
		self.target_direction = self.target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	end

	-- 필드 안에서 자성 바위랑 충돌한 경우다.
	if end_pos_x == 0 and end_pos_z == 0 then
		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(ball_pos, self.ball_width * 3)    --일단 적당히 두배넓이 탐색
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do

			if fo.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
				local x = fo.Bounds.extents.x + 1
				local z = fo.Bounds.extents.z + 1
				local fo_center = fo.Bounds.center

				local target_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None

				local tileInfo = create_generic_dictionary(CS.Oak.Direction, CS.UnityEngine.Vector3)

				if field:IsThereFloorAt(fo_center + z * vector_util.forward) then
					target_direction = target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Up
					tileInfo:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Up, fo_center + z * vector_util.forward)
				end

				if field:IsThereFloorAt(fo_center - z * vector_util.forward) then
					target_direction = target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Down
					tileInfo:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Down, fo_center - z * vector_util.forward)
				end

				if field:IsThereFloorAt(fo_center + x * vector_util.right) then
					target_direction = target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Right
					tileInfo:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Right, fo_center + x * vector_util.right)
				end

				if field:IsThereFloorAt(fo_center - x * vector_util.right) then
					target_direction = target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Left
					tileInfo:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Left, fo_center - x * vector_util.right)
				end

				local shortestDir = CS.Oak.Direction.None
				local shortestDst = CS.System.Single.MaxValue

				local currentDir = 1
				for i = 1, 4 do
					local direction = CS.Oak.Direction.__CastFrom(currentDir)
					if tileInfo:ContainsKey(direction) == true then
						if (direction & target_direction) ~= 0 then

							local diffVector = ball_pos - tileInfo[direction]
							local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(diffVector)

							if magnitude < shortestDst then
								shortestDst = magnitude
								shortestDir = direction
							end
						end
					end

					currentDir = currentDir * 2
				end
				tileInfo = nil

				if shortestDir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					end_pos_x = left
				end
				if shortestDir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
					end_pos_x = right
				end
				if shortestDir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
					end_pos_z = top
				end
				if shortestDir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
					end_pos_z = bottom
				end
				self.target_direction = shortestDir
			end
		end
		fo_list:Dispose()
	end
	--end

	--수평 빔
	if end_pos_x ~= 0 then
		end_pos = vector(end_pos_x, 0, ball_pos.z)
		self:wall_laser_start(start_pos, end_pos)
	end
	-- 수직빔
	if end_pos_z ~= 0 then
		end_pos = vector(ball_pos.x, 0, end_pos_z)
		self:wall_laser_start(start_pos, end_pos)
	end
end

-- fx start/end0
function local_class:wall_laser_start(start_pos, end_pos)
	local diff = end_pos - start_pos
	local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
	local fx_laser = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('laser', start_pos,dir)
	--레이저 길이를 조정해준다
	fx_laser.transform.localScale = vector(magnitude / 20, 1, 1)

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.laser_damage_calculator, start_pos)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.laser_damage_calculator, dir)
	if not area_collision_util.is_started(self.laser_damage_calculator) then
		area_collision_util.start(self.laser_damage_calculator)
	end

	local targets = area_collision_util.update(self.laser_damage_calculator, 0)
	for _, target in pairs(targets) do
		if target ~= nil then
			self:give_laser_damage(target)
		end
	end
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.laser_damage_calculator)
end

function local_class:wall_laser_end()
	if self.fx_laser ~= nil then
		self.fx_laser:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_laser = nil
end

function local_class:give_laser_damage(field_object)
	local knockback_direction = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(field_object.Direction) * -1
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = field_object
	damage_info.modifier = self.laser_damage_modifier
	damage_info.direction = knockback_direction
	damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
	damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.laser_knockback_force
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

-- 투사체 피격시 데미지 처리
function local_class:give_damage_main_ball(hit_info)
	if self.character == nil or character_util.is_dead(self.character) then return end

	local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(hit_info.target.Position - hit_info.position).normalized
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = hit_info.target
	damage_info.modifier = self.main_ball_damage_modifier
	damage_info.direction = direction
	damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
	damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.main_ball_knockback_force
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end
function local_class:give_damage_sub_ball(hit_info)
	if self.character == nil or character_util.is_dead(self.character) then return end

	local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(hit_info.target.Position - hit_info.position).normalized
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = hit_info.target
	damage_info.modifier = self.sub_ball_damage_modifier
	damage_info.direction = direction
	damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
	damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.sub_ball_knockback_force
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

--외부 호출용
function local_class:set_phase(phase)
	self:change_phase(phase)
end

function local_class:clear_all()
	stage.ProjectileManager:ClearProjectiles()
	if self.fx_wall_lasers ~=nil then
		for _, fx_laser in pairs(self.fx_wall_lasers) do
			if fx_laser ~= nil then
				fx_laser:Dispose()
			end
		end
	end

end

function local_class:play_main_proj_explode_fx(pos)
	local fx_explode = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('big_explode', pos)
end

function local_class:play_sub_proj_explode_fx(pos)
	local fx_explode = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('small_explode', pos)
end


function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end
function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end
function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
end
--보스가 사망해서 호출되는 부분에 clear all 필요
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:clear_all()
	self:cancel()
end
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end
function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.target_direction = nil


	self.state = nil
	self.phase = nil
	self.bounce_wall_direction = nil

	self.phase1_shoot_offset = nil
	self.phase2_shoot_offset_right = nil
	self.phase2_shoot_offset_left = nil
	self.phase2_shoot_offset_down = nil
	self.phase2_shoot_offset_up = nil

	self.shoot_offset = nil
	self.main_shoot_helper = nil
	self.sub_shoot_helper = nil

	self.laser_damage_calculator = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.attack_range)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	self.prepare_key_1 = nil
	self.casting_key_1 = nil
	self.casting_key_2 = nil
	self.action_key_1 = nil
	self.action_key_2 = nil
	self.fx_casting_name = nil
	self.fx_laser_name = nil

	self.current_main_projectile = nil
	self.current_sub_projectiles = nil

	self.wall_check_offsets = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	local projectile_max_dist = main_projtile_spec:GetMaxDistance()

	local atk_range_type = CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward

	-- 액션빔 스펙
	self.laser_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LaserDamageModifier', 0.5)
	self.laser_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LaserKnockbackForce', 0.25)
	self.laser_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LaserDamageTerm', 0.25)
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(vector(projectile_max_dist*0.5,0, atk_range_width), 1, laser_damage_term, true)
	self.laser_damage_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, collision_info)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(atk_start_pos, atk_range_size, atk_range_type)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.prepare_duration1 = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('cast1_start')
	self.action_duration1 = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('core_open')

	self.casting_duration2 = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('laser_ready')
	self.action_duration2 = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('laser_attack')

	self.prepare_key_1 = 'cast1_start'
	self.casting_key_1 = 'cast1_loop'
	self.casting_key_2 = 'laser_ready'

	self.action_key_1 = 'core_open'
	self.action_key_2 = 'laser_attack'

	self.fx_casting_name = 'casting'
	self.fx_laser_name = 'laser'

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.current_main_projectile = nil
	self.current_sub_projectiles = {}

	self.wall_check_offsets = {
		vector_util.right,
		vector_util.left,
		vector_util.forward,
		vector_util.back
	}
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self:change_phase(self.phase.one)

	self.current_shoot_count = 0

end
function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

-- 페이즈 변경시 처리
function local_class:change_phase(next_phase)
	if next_phase == self.current_phase then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
	end

	if next_phase == self.phase.one then
		self.shoot_offset = self.phase1_shoot_offset

		self.prepare_duration = self.prepare_duration1
		self.casting_duration = self.casting_duration
		self.action_duration = self.action_duration1

	elseif next_phase == self.phase.two then
		self.shoot_offset = self.phase2_shoot_offset

		self.prepare_duration = 0
		self.casting_duration = self.casting_duration2
		self.action_duration = self.action_duration2
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_phase = next_phase
end
-- 상태 관리 함수
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end
	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_shoot_count = 0
		self:play_prepare_animation()

	elseif next_state == self.state.casting then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_range:Show(self.casting_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.casting_duration))

		local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		local shoot_offset = self.character.Position + self:get_shoot_offset(vector_util.to_direction(dir))
		local shoot_dir = (self.target.Position - shoot_offset).normalized

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, shoot_offset, shoot_dir, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))

		self:play_casting_animation()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:shoot_main()
		self:play_shoot_animation()
		self.current_shoot_count = self.current_shoot_count + 1

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

-- Update 함수
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then return end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.casting)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(dir))
		self.character.Direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)

		local shoot_offset = self.character.Position + self:get_shoot_offset(vector_util.to_direction(dir))
		local shoot_dir = (self.target.Position - shoot_offset).normalized

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, shoot_offset, shoot_dir, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))

		if self.time_passed >= self.casting_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.current_shoot_count < self.shoot_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:play_prepare_animation()
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key_1)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('idle')
	elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('attack')
	end
end
function local_class:play_casting_animation()
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.casting_key_1)
	elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.casting_key_2)
	end
end
function local_class:play_shoot_animation()
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key_1)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('idle')
	elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.two then

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key_2)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('attack')
	end
end


-- 메인 레이저볼을 쏜다. 3번 튕길 수 있는 레이저볼
function local_class:shoot_main()
	local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + self:get_shoot_offset(vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)))
	local shoot_dir = (self.target.Position - shoot_pos).normalized

	self.main_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, shoot_dir, self.main_projectile_label)
	self.sub_projectile_label = self.sub_projectile_label_default

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot')
end

--왼쪽 기준으로 오프셋을 회전 시킨 값을 얻는다.
function local_class:get_shoot_offset(dir)
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		return self.phase1_shoot_offset
	end

	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return self.phase2_shoot_offset_left

	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return self.phase2_shoot_offset_right

	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return self.phase2_shoot_offset_up
	else
		return self.phase2_shoot_offset_down
	end
end

-- 2페이즈 전용 분열된 투사체 발사
function local_class:shoot_sub(move_info, hit_info)
	-- 바운스 역방향으로 세팅해서 발사해준다.
	local shoot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(move_info.position)
	local surface_normal_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.targetDirection)					-- 4웨이 버전 법선벡터, 벽의 법선 벡터만 캐치 가능
	local surface_true_normal_vector = direction_util.to_8way_vector3(self.targetDirection)				-- 8웨이 버전의 법선백터, 구석일 경우 해당 값도 나옴
	local reflected_shoot_dir = unity_class.vector3.Reflect(move_info.direction, surface_normal_vector)	-- 벽에 반사되서 나가는 방향

	local c_angle = 360 - unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(reflected_shoot_dir, vector_util.forward).eulerAngles.y
	local sub_angle1 = c_angle - self.sub_ball_angle	--입사각 기준 45도
	local sub_angle2 = c_angle + self.sub_ball_angle	--입사각 기준 반대 45도
	-- 공 각도에 대한 각각의 보정처리(벽을 넘어가게 되는지, 충돌체 크기를 고려하여 벽과 충돌을 어떻게 시킬건지)

	local sub_dir1 = (unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(sub_angle1, unity_class.vector3.up) * vector_util.forward).normalized
	local sub_dir2 = (unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(sub_angle2, unity_class.vector3.up) * vector_util.forward).normalized

	local mag = vector_util.magnitude(vector(self.ball_width/2, 0, self.ball_height/2))
	local offset = vector_util.get_x0z(shoot_pos + surface_true_normal_vector * mag)

	self.sub_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(offset, sub_dir1, self.sub_projectile_label)
	self.sub_projectile_label = self.sub_projectile_label + 1

	self.sub_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(offset, sub_dir2, self.sub_projectile_label)
	self.sub_projectile_label = self.sub_projectile_label + 1
end

-- 주 투사체/ 분열 투사체 모두 호출된다.
-- 투사체가 바운스 회수를 초과하여 부딪힐 때도 호출된다.
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if label == self.main_projectile_label then
		return self:on_hit_main(move_info, hit_info)
	else
		return self:on_hit_sub(move_info, hit_info)
	end
end

-- 투사체 유형별 히트 이벤트
-- 주 투사체의 마지막 충돌도 이게 호출된다.
function local_class:on_hit_main(move_info, hit_info)
	if self.main_shoot_helper == nil then return true end

	if hit_info.target == nil then		-- 벽과 충돌하여 마지막에 소멸한 경우다.
		self:on_hit_wall(move_info, hit_info, label)
		self:play_main_proj_explode_fx(move_info.position)
		return true
	end

	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) == false then return true end --TODO:벽이 들어오는지 체크가 필요하다.

	if hit_info.target.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
		self:on_hit_wall(move_info, hit_info, label)
		self:play_main_proj_explode_fx(move_info.position)
		return true
	end

	if hit_info.target ~= nil then
		self:give_damage_main_ball(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end
function local_class:on_hit_sub(move_info, hit_info)
	if self.sub_shoot_helper == nil then return true end
	self:play_sub_proj_explode_fx(move_info.position)

	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) == false then return true end

	self:give_damage_sub_ball(hit_info)
	return false
end

-- 주 투사체의 바운싱 이벤트
function local_class:on_bounce(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if label ~= self.main_projectile_label then return true end		--주 투사체가 아니다. 할거 없다.

	--target 검사를 안해도 된다. 어짜피 벽일때만 onbounce 된다.
	self:on_hit_wall(move_info, hit_info, label)

	return true
end

--벽에 부딪혔을때 처리해야할 로직을 수행한다.
function local_class:on_hit_wall(move_info, hit_info, label)
	self:shoot_laser_beam(move_info, hit_info, label)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('bounce')

	if self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		self:shoot_sub(move_info, hit_info)
	end
	-- 일시적으로 저장한 계산값을 모두 초기화
	self.last_bounce_wall = self.bounce_wall_direction.none
	self.reflect_offset_x = 0
	self.reflect_offset_z = 0
	self.targetDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.None
end

function local_class:shoot_laser_beam(move_info, hit_info, label)
	-- target이 null일 수 있다. target으로 찾지 않는다.
	local wall_positions = {}    --열린 공간, 벽이 없는 타일을 찾는다.

	local left = self.zone_bound.min.x
	local right = self.zone_bound.max.x
	local top = self.zone_bound.max.z
	local bottom = self.zone_bound.min.z

	local move_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(move_info.position)
	local ball_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(hit_info.position)

	local start_pos = ball_pos
	local end_pos_x = 0
	local end_pos_z = 0
	local end_pos = vector_util.zero
	self.targetDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	--ball_width를 배율을 0.5보다 크게 준 이유는 바운드 체크는 충돌 했을때만 하기 때문에, 확실하게 바운드 체크를 하기 위해 조금 더 넣었다.
	if ball_pos.x + self.ball_width >= right then -- 오른벽에 충돌했다.
		end_pos_x = left
		self.targetDirection = self.targetDirection | CS.Oak.Direction.Left	--왼쪽으로 발사
	end
	if ball_pos.x - self.ball_width <= left then
		end_pos_x = right
		self.targetDirection = self.targetDirection | CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end
	if ball_pos.z + self.ball_height >= top then
		end_pos_z = bottom
		self.targetDirection = self.targetDirection | CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	end
	if ball_pos.z - self.ball_height <= bottom then
		end_pos_z = top
		self.targetDirection = self.targetDirection | CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	end

	-- 필드 안에서 자성 바위랑 충돌한 경우다.
	if end_pos_x == 0 and end_pos_z == 0 then
		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(ball_pos, self.ball_width * 3)    --일단 적당히 두배넓이 탐색
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do

			if fo.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
				local x = fo.Bounds.extents.x + 1
				local z = fo.Bounds.extents.z + 1
				local fo_center = fo.Bounds.center

				local targetDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.None

				local tileInfo = create_generic_dictionary(CS.Oak.Direction, CS.UnityEngine.Vector3)

				if field:IsThereFloorAt(fo_center + z * vector_util.forward) then
					targetDirection = targetDirection | CS.Oak.Direction.Up
					tileInfo:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Up, fo_center + z * vector_util.forward)
				end

				if field:IsThereFloorAt(fo_center - z * vector_util.forward) then
					targetDirection = targetDirection | CS.Oak.Direction.Down
					tileInfo:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Down, fo_center - z * vector_util.forward)
				end

				if field:IsThereFloorAt(fo_center + x * vector_util.right) then
					targetDirection = targetDirection | CS.Oak.Direction.Right
					tileInfo:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Right, fo_center + x * vector_util.right)
				end

				if field:IsThereFloorAt(fo_center - x * vector_util.right) then
					targetDirection = targetDirection | CS.Oak.Direction.Left
					tileInfo:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Left, fo_center - x * vector_util.right)
				end

				local shortestDir = CS.Oak.Direction.None
				local shortestDst = CS.System.Single.MaxValue

				local currentDir = 1
				for i = 1, 4 do
					local direction = CS.Oak.Direction.__CastFrom(currentDir)
					if tileInfo:ContainsKey(direction) == true then
						if (direction & targetDirection) ~= 0 then

							local diffVector = ball_pos - tileInfo[direction]
							local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(diffVector)

							if magnitude < shortestDst then
								shortestDst = magnitude
								shortestDir = direction
							end
						end
					end

					currentDir = currentDir * 2
				end
				tileInfo = nil

				if shortestDir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					end_pos_x = left
				end
				if shortestDir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
					end_pos_x = right
				end
				if shortestDir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
					end_pos_z = top
				end
				if shortestDir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
					end_pos_z = bottom
				end
				self.targetDirection = shortestDir
			end
		end
	end
	--end

	--수평 빔
	if end_pos_x ~= 0 then
		end_pos = vector(end_pos_x, 0, ball_pos.z)
		self:wall_laser_start(start_pos, end_pos)
	end
	-- 수직빔
	if end_pos_z ~= 0 then
		end_pos = vector(ball_pos.x, 0, end_pos_z)
		self:wall_laser_start(start_pos, end_pos)
	end
end

-- fx start/end0
function local_class:wall_laser_start(start_pos, end_pos)
	local diff = end_pos - start_pos
	local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
	local fx_laser = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('laser', start_pos,dir)
	--레이저 길이를 조정해준다

	fx_laser.transform.localScale = vector(magnitude / 20, 1, 1)

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.laser_damage_calculator, start_pos)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.laser_damage_calculator, dir)
	if not area_collision_util.is_started(self.laser_damage_calculator) then
		area_collision_util.start(self.laser_damage_calculator)
	end

	local targets = area_collision_util.update(self.laser_damage_calculator, 0)
	for _, target in pairs(targets) do
		if target ~= nil then
			self:give_laser_damage(target)
		end
	end
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.laser_damage_calculator)
end

function local_class:wall_laser_end()
	if self.fx_laser ~= nil then
		self.fx_laser:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_laser = nil
end

function local_class:give_laser_damage(field_object)
	local knockback_direction = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(field_object.Direction) * -1
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = field_object
	damage_info.modifier = self.laser_damage_modifier
	damage_info.direction = knockback_direction
	damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
	damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.laser_knockback_force
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

-- 투사체 피격시 데미지 처리
function local_class:give_damage_main_ball(hit_info)
	if self.character == nil or character_util.is_dead(self.character) then return end

	local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(hit_info.target.Position - hit_info.position).normalized
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = hit_info.target
	damage_info.modifier = self.main_ball_damage_modifier
	damage_info.direction = direction
	damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
	damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.main_ball_knockback_force
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end
function local_class:give_damage_sub_ball(hit_info)
	if self.character == nil or character_util.is_dead(self.character) then return end

	local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(hit_info.target.Position - hit_info.position).normalized
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = hit_info.target
	damage_info.modifier = self.sub_ball_damage_modifier
	damage_info.direction = direction

-- 상태 관리 함수
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end
	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_shoot_count = 0
		self:play_prepare_animation()

	elseif next_state == self.state.casting then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_range:Show(self.casting_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.casting_duration))

		local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		local shoot_offset = self.character.Position + self:get_shoot_offset(vector_util.to_direction(dir))
		local shoot_dir = (self.target.Position - shoot_offset).normalized

		self.attack_range:SetupByDirection(shoot_offset, shoot_dir, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))

		self:play_casting_animation()
		--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:shoot_main()
		self:play_shoot_animation()
		self.current_shoot_count = self.current_shoot_count + 1
		-- 발사 연출이 끝날 때 실제 투사체를 쏜다

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 발사 연출이 끝날 때 실제 투사체를 쏜다

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end
-- Update 함수
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then return end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.casting)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)

		local shoot_offset = self.character.Position + self:get_shoot_offset(vector_util.to_direction(dir))
		local shoot_dir = (self.target.Position - shoot_offset).normalized

		self.attack_range:SetupByDirection(shoot_offset, shoot_dir, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))

		if self.time_passed >= self.casting_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.current_shoot_count < self.shoot_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.casting)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:play_prepare_animation()
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('attack')
end

function local_class:play_casting_animation()

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('ready')
end

function local_class:play_shoot_animation()
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key_2)
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('attack')
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot')
end

-- 메인 레이저볼을 쏜다. 3번 튕길 수 있는 레이저볼
function local_class:shoot_main()
	local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + self:get_shoot_offset(vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)))
	local shoot_dir = (self.target.Position - shoot_pos).normalized

	self.main_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, shoot_dir, self.main_projectile_label)
	self.sub_projectile_label = self.sub_projectile_label_default
end

--왼쪽 기준으로 오프셋을 회전 시킨 값을 얻는다.
function local_class:get_shoot_offset(dir)
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return self.phase2_shoot_offset_left
	end

	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return self.phase2_shoot_offset_right
	end

	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return self.phase2_shoot_offset_up
	end

	return self.phase2_shoot_offset_down
end

-- 2페이즈 전용 분열된 투사체 발사
function local_class:shoot_sub(move_info, hit_info)
	-- 바운스 역방향으로 세팅해서 발사해준다.
	local shoot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(move_info.position)
	local surface_normal_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.target_direction)					-- 4웨이 버전 법선벡터, 벽의 법선 벡터만 캐치 가능
	local surface_true_normal_vector = direction_util.to_8way_vector3(self.target_direction)				-- 8웨이 버전의 법선백터, 구석일 경우 해당 값도 나옴
	local reflected_shoot_dir = unity_class.vector3.Reflect(move_info.direction, surface_normal_vector)	-- 벽에 반사되서 나가는 방향

	local c_angle = 360 - unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(reflected_shoot_dir, vector_util.forward).eulerAngles.y
	local sub_angle1 = c_angle - self.sub_ball_angle	--입사각 기준 45도
	local sub_angle2 = c_angle + self.sub_ball_angle	--입사각 기준 반대 45도
	-- 공 각도에 대한 각각의 보정처리(벽을 넘어가게 되는지, 충돌체 크기를 고려하여 벽과 충돌을 어떻게 시킬건지)

	local sub_dir1 = (unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(sub_angle1, unity_class.vector3.up) * vector_util.forward).normalized
	local sub_dir2 = (unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(sub_angle2, unity_class.vector3.up) * vector_util.forward).normalized

	local mag = vector_util.magnitude(vector(self.ball_width/2, 0, self.ball_height/2))
	local offset = vector_util.get_x0z(shoot_pos + surface_true_normal_vector * mag)

	self.sub_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(offset, sub_dir1, self.sub_projectile_label)
	self.sub_projectile_label = self.sub_projectile_label + 1

	self.sub_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(offset, sub_dir2, self.sub_projectile_label)
	self.sub_projectile_label = self.sub_projectile_label + 1
end

-- 주 투사체/ 분열 투사체 모두 호출된다.
-- 투사체가 바운스 회수를 초과하여 부딪힐 때도 호출된다.
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if label == self.main_projectile_label then
		return self:on_hit_main(move_info, hit_info)
	else
		return self:on_hit_sub(move_info, hit_info)
	end
end

-- 투사체 유형별 히트 이벤트
-- 주 투사체의 마지막 충돌도 이게 호출된다.
function local_class:on_hit_main(move_info, hit_info)
	if self.main_shoot_helper == nil then return true end

	if hit_info.target == nil then		-- 벽과 충돌하여 마지막에 소멸한 경우다.
		self:on_hit_wall(move_info, hit_info, label)
		self:play_main_proj_explode_fx(move_info.position)
		return true
	end

	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) == false then return true end --TODO:벽이 들어오는지 체크가 필요하다.

	if hit_info.target.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
		self:on_hit_wall(move_info, hit_info, label)
		self:play_main_proj_explode_fx(move_info.position)
		return true
	end

	-- 이외의 모든 경우는 개체가 피격된거다. 데미지를 준다.

	if hit_info.target ~= nil then
		self:give_damage_main_ball(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end
function local_class:on_hit_sub(move_info, hit_info)
	if self.sub_shoot_helper == nil then return true end
	self:play_sub_proj_explode_fx(move_info.position)

	if hit_info.target == nil or hit_info.target.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
		-- 작은 구체 벽에 부딧혔을때만 사운드 재생
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('small_hit')
		return true
	end

	self:give_damage_sub_ball(hit_info)

	return false
end

-- 주 투사체의 바운싱 이벤트
function local_class:on_bounce(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if label ~= self.main_projectile_label then return true end		--주 투사체가 아니다. 할거 없다.

	--target 검사를 안해도 된다. 어짜피 벽일때만 onbounce 된다.
	self:on_hit_wall(move_info, hit_info, label)

	return true
end

--벽에 부딪혔을때 처리해야할 로직을 수행한다.
function local_class:on_hit_wall(move_info, hit_info, label)
	self:shoot_laser_beam(move_info, hit_info, label)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('bounce')

	self:shoot_sub(move_info, hit_info)

	-- 일시적으로 저장한 계산값을 모두 초기화
	self.last_bounce_wall = self.bounce_wall_direction.none
	self.reflect_offset_x = 0
	self.reflect_offset_z = 0
	self.target_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
end

function local_class:shoot_laser_beam(move_info, hit_info, label)
	local left = self.zone_bound.min.x
	local right = self.zone_bound.max.x
	local top = self.zone_bound.max.z
	local bottom = self.zone_bound.min.z

	local move_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(move_info.position)
	local ball_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(hit_info.position)

	local start_pos = ball_pos
	local end_pos_x = 0
	local end_pos_z = 0
	local end_pos = vector_util.zero
	self.target_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	--ball_width를 배율을 0.5보다 크게 준 이유는 바운드 체크는 충돌 했을때만 하기 때문에, 확실하게 바운드 체크를 하기 위해 조금 더 넣었다.
	if ball_pos.x + self.ball_width >= right then -- 오른벽에 충돌했다.
		end_pos_x = left
		self.target_direction = self.target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Left	--왼쪽으로 발사
	end
	if ball_pos.x - self.ball_width <= left then
		end_pos_x = right
		self.target_direction = self.target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end
	if ball_pos.z + self.ball_height >= top then
		end_pos_z = bottom
		self.target_direction = self.target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	end
	if ball_pos.z - self.ball_height <= bottom then
		end_pos_z = top
		self.target_direction = self.target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	end

	-- 필드 안에서 자성 바위랑 충돌한 경우다.
	if end_pos_x == 0 and end_pos_z == 0 then
		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(ball_pos, self.ball_width * 3)    --일단 적당히 두배넓이 탐색
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do

			if fo.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
				local x = fo.Bounds.extents.x + 1
				local z = fo.Bounds.extents.z + 1
				local fo_center = fo.Bounds.center

				local target_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None

				local tileInfo = create_generic_dictionary(CS.Oak.Direction, CS.UnityEngine.Vector3)

				if field:IsThereFloorAt(fo_center + z * vector_util.forward) then
					target_direction = target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Up
					tileInfo:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Up, fo_center + z * vector_util.forward)
				end

				if field:IsThereFloorAt(fo_center - z * vector_util.forward) then
					target_direction = target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Down
					tileInfo:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Down, fo_center - z * vector_util.forward)
				end

				if field:IsThereFloorAt(fo_center + x * vector_util.right) then
					target_direction = target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Right
					tileInfo:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Right, fo_center + x * vector_util.right)
				end

				if field:IsThereFloorAt(fo_center - x * vector_util.right) then
					target_direction = target_direction | CS.Oak.Direction.Left
					tileInfo:Add(CS.Oak.Direction.Left, fo_center - x * vector_util.right)
				end

				local shortestDir = CS.Oak.Direction.None
				local shortestDst = CS.System.Single.MaxValue

				local currentDir = 1
				for i = 1, 4 do
					local direction = CS.Oak.Direction.__CastFrom(currentDir)
					if tileInfo:ContainsKey(direction) == true then
						if (direction & target_direction) ~= 0 then

							local diffVector = ball_pos - tileInfo[direction]
							local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(diffVector)

							if magnitude < shortestDst then
								shortestDst = magnitude
								shortestDir = direction
							end
						end
					end

					currentDir = currentDir * 2
				end
				tileInfo = nil

				if shortestDir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					end_pos_x = left
				end
				if shortestDir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
					end_pos_x = right
				end
				if shortestDir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
					end_pos_z = top
				end
				if shortestDir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
					end_pos_z = bottom
				end
				self.target_direction = shortestDir
			end
		end
		fo_list:Dispose()
	end
	--end

	--수평 빔
	if end_pos_x ~= 0 then
		end_pos = vector(end_pos_x, 0, ball_pos.z)
		self:wall_laser_start(start_pos, end_pos)
	end
	-- 수직빔
	if end_pos_z ~= 0 then
		end_pos = vector(ball_pos.x, 0, end_pos_z)
		self:wall_laser_start(start_pos, end_pos)
	end
end

-- fx start/end0
function local_class:wall_laser_start(start_pos, end_pos)
	local diff = end_pos - start_pos
	local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
	local fx_laser = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('laser', start_pos,dir)
	--레이저 길이를 조정해준다
	fx_laser.transform.localScale = vector(magnitude / 20, 1, 1)

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.laser_damage_calculator, start_pos)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.laser_damage_calculator, dir)
	if not area_collision_util.is_started(self.laser_damage_calculator) then
		area_collision_util.start(self.laser_damage_calculator)
	end

	local targets = area_collision_util.update(self.laser_damage_calculator, 0)
	for _, target in pairs(targets) do
		if target ~= nil then
			self:give_laser_damage(target)
		end
	end
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.laser_damage_calculator)
end

function local_class:wall_laser_end()
	if self.fx_laser ~= nil then
		self.fx_laser:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_laser = nil
end

function local_class:give_laser_damage(field_object)
	local knockback_direction = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(field_object.Direction) * -1
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = field_object
	damage_info.modifier = self.laser_damage_modifier
	damage_info.direction = knockback_direction
	damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
	damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.laser_knockback_force
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

--update frame
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_fence_state(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.move_to_point then
		if self:update_move(dt) then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.current_drop_order_count >= self.drop_order_count or self.current_stone_count >= self.max_stone_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval then
			if self.current_drop_order_count >= self.drop_order_count or self.current_stone_count >= self.max_stone_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

function local_class:update_move(dt)

	self.current_fence_time_passed = self.current_fence_time_passed + dt

	elseif self.current_fence_state == self.fence_state.post then

	else

	end

	if drop_request_count > self.drop_count_at_once then
		drop_request_count = self.drop_count_at_once
	end
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'magnetic_stone_create_request', tonumber(drop_request_count) }))
	self.current_stone_count = self.current_stone_count + drop_request_count
end

function local_class:set_phase(phase)
	if phase == self.phase.two then
		self:phase_change(self.phase.two)
		self.drop_count_at_once = self.at_once_phase2
		self.drop_order_count = self.order_count_phase2
	end

	-- 보스이름 세팅 하여 컨트롤러 동작 하도록 수정됨
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
		'magnetic_stone_init',
		self.character.Name,
		tostring(self.max_stone_count),
		tostring(self.drop_count_at_once),
		tostring(self.drop_order_count),
		tostring(self.max_magnetic_stone_count),
		tostring(self.current_phase)
	}))
end


-- 이벤트 수신 (바위 파괴 요청, 페이즈 변경)
function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'magnetic_stone_created' then
		self.activated_stone_count = self.activated_stone_count + 1
		-- 자석이 동시에 떨어져서 완전히 설치가 완료되면
		if self.activated_stone_count == self.current_stone_count then
			self:change_fence_state(self.fence_state.prepare)
		end

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'magnet_drop_on' then
		self.drop_order_count = self.order_count_mode2
		self.drop_count_at_once = self.at_once_mode2

		self.current_stone_count = 0
		self.activated_stone_count = 0

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'magnet_drop_off' then
		self.drop_order_count = self.order_count_mode1
		self.drop_count_at_once = self.at_once_mode1
		self.current_stone_count = 0
		self.activated_stone_count = 0

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'magwi_mode2_start' then
		self.play_animation = false
		self:change_fence_state(none)

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'magwi_mode2_end' then
		self.play_animation = true
		self:change_fence_state(none)

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_magwi_destroy_all_stone' then
		self.current_stone_count = 0
		self.activated_stone_count = 0
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'magnetic_stone_destroyed' then
			self.current_stone_count = self.current_stone_count - 1
			self.activated_stone_count = self.activated_stone_count - 1

			if self.current_stone_count < 0 then
				self.current_stone_count = 0
			end

			if self.activated_stone_count < 0 then
				self.activated_stone_count = 0
			end
		end
	end
end

-------- 관리 함수 --------
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
	local x_hsize = self.character.Hitbox.size.x / 2 + 0.5
	local z_hsize = self.character.Hitbox.size.z / 2 + 0.5
	local y = self.zone_bound.center.y

	self.zone_center = bound.center

	-- top left
	table.insert(self.move_point_list, unity_class.vector3(bound.min.x + x_hsize, y, bound.max.z - z_hsize))
	-- top right
	table.insert(self.move_point_list, unity_class.vector3(bound.max.x - x_hsize, y, bound.max.z - z_hsize))
	-- bot left
	table.insert(self.move_point_list, unity_class.vector3(bound.min.x + x_hsize, y, bound.min.z + z_hsize))
	-- bot right
	table.insert(self.move_point_list, unity_class.vector3(bound.max.x - x_hsize, y, bound.min.z + z_hsize))
end

function local_class:set_move_point()
	-- true -> center / false -> longest point from manual character
	if self.is_move_center then
		self.move_point = self.zone_center
	else
		local temp_dist = 0
		local index = 0
		for i, v in pairs(self.move_point_list) do
			local distance = vector_util.sqr_xz_distance(self.target.Position, v)
			if temp_dist < distance then
				temp_dist = distance
				index = i
			end
		end
		self.move_point = self.move_point_list[index]
	end
end

function local_class:is_max_stones()
	return self.current_stone_count >= self.max_stone_count
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
end
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
	self.current_stone_count = 0
	self.current_drop_order_count = 0

	--사망에 의해 호출 되었다면 초기화 해준다.
	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead == true then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'magnetic_stone_battle_end' }))
	end
end
function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.fence_state = nil
	self.phase = nil

	-- move_to_point
	self.move_point = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.zone_center = nil
	self.move_point_list = nil

	-- 리소스 이름
	self.prepare_key_1 = nil    --바껴있는거 맞음.
	self.prepare_key_2 = nil

	if self.fx_cast_p2 ~= nil then
		self.fx_cast_p2:Dispose()
		self.fx_cast_p2 = nil
	end

	self.target = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossMagwiPollutantBattleAction')

local aoe_class =
{
	position = nil,
	direction = nil,
}
aoe_class.mt = { __index = aoe_class }

function aoe_class:new(pos, dir)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.position = pos
	obj.direction = dir

	return obj
end

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- move_to_center
	self.zone_center = nil
	self.move_speed = battle_util.get_number(self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualWalkSpeed)
	self.move_duration = nil
	self.move_direction = vector_util.zero
	self.prev_progress = 0
	self.near_distance = 0.01

	-- preapre
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.5)

	-- tracking
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TrackingDuration', 1)

	-- action
	self.shoot_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ShootOffset', 1)
	self.shoot_max_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ShootMaxCount', 3)
	self.shoot_count = 0
	self.aoe_start_index = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'AoeStartIndex', 3)

	-- projectile
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'Projectile', 'boss_magwi_pollutant')
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec(proj_name)
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Cannon,
			ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	self.proj_max_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ProjMaxCount', 6)
	self.proj_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ProjInterval', 0.2)

	self.proj_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ProjDistance', 1.5)
	self.proj_count = 0
	self.proj_interval_passed = 0

	-- aoe
	self.aoe_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AoeRadius', 0.5)
	self.aoe_spec = CS.Oak.AreaOfEffectManager.AoeSpecParams()
	self.aoe_spec.shape = CS.AttackRangeShape.Circle
	self.aoe_spec.radius = self.aoe_radius
	self.aoe_spec.rotateDirection = unity_class.vector3.right
	self.aoe_spec.duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AoeDuration', 5)
	self.aoe_spec.damageTerm = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AoeDamageTerm', 0.8)
	self.aoe_spec.modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AoeDamgeModifier', 0.01)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackForce', 0)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeMagnitude', 0.2)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeDuration', 0.7)

	-- ani keys
	self.prepare_key = 'prepare'
	self.action_key = 'action'

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		move_to_center = 2,
		prepare = 3,
		tracking = 4,
		action = 5,
		post = 6,
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	self.on_aoe_hit_callback = function(fo, dir, param1, param2)
		self:on_aoe_hit(fo, dir, param1, param2)
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target

	local dist = vector_util.sqr_xz_distance(self.character.Position, self.zone_center)
	if dist > self.near_distance then
		self:change_state(self.state.move_to_center)
	else
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	end
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_magwi_release_ailment_resist' }))
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.move_to_center then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide(self.tracking_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.move_to_center then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.move_distance = (self.character.Position - self.zone_center).magnitude
		self.move_duration = self.move_distance / self.move_speed
		self.move_direction = vector_util.normalized(self.zone_center - self.character.Position)
		self.prev_progress = 0

		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)
		self.character.Direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.shoot_count = 0
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.tracking then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('damaged')

		self:target_lock_on()
		self:update_tracking_ar()
		for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			v:Show(self.tracking_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('attack')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('sit')

		self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1
		self.proj_count = 0
		self.shot_interval_passed = self.proj_interval
		self:target_lock_on()


	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.move_to_center then
		if self:update_move(dt) then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)
		self.character.Direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)
		self.character.Direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)

		self.target_lock_pos = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		self:update_tracking_ar()

		if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		local is_aoe = self.shoot_count == self.aoe_start_index

		if self.proj_count < self.proj_max_count then
			self.proj_interval_passed = self.proj_interval_passed + dt
			-- shot
			if self.proj_interval_passed >= self.proj_interval then
				self:shoot_projectile(is_aoe, self.proj_count)
				self.proj_count = self.proj_count + 1
			end
		else
			if self.shoot_count < self.shoot_max_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_tracking_ar()
	local order_dir = self.target_lock_pos
	local order_angle = 360 - unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(order_dir, vector_util.forward).eulerAngles.y
	local height = self.target.Position.y
	for i, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		local angle = (order_angle + i * 90) % 360
		local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * vector_util.forward).normalized
		local pos = self.character.Position + dir * self.shoot_offset
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(v, pos, dir, height)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, v))
	end
end

function local_class:target_lock_on()
	self.target_lock_pos = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
end

function local_class:update_move(dt)
	local dist = vector_util.sqr_xz_distance(self.character.Position, self.zone_center)
	if dist <= self.near_distance then
		return true
	end

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.move_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.move_speed * dt
	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_side_dir(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
	return false
end

function local_class:set_aoe(aoe)
	local pos = vector_util.get_x0z(aoe.position)
	local dir = aoe.direction

	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.aoe_radius)
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if string.match(fo.Name, 'magnetic_stone') then
			return
		end
	end

	stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, pos, self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('aoe'), self.aoe_spec, self.on_aoe_hit_callback)
end

-- 장판에 데미지 주기 위한 콜백
function local_class:on_aoe_hit(fo, dir, damage_mod, max_num_hits)
	if not is_unity_null(fo) then
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = damage_mod

		damage_info.direction = dir
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_projectile(is_aoe, count)
	local order_dir = self.target_lock_pos
	local order_angle = 360 - unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(order_dir, vector_util.forward).eulerAngles.y
	for i = 0, 3 do
		local angle = (order_angle + i * 90) % 360
		local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * vector_util.forward).normalized
		local pos = self.character.Position + dir * (self.shoot_offset + self.proj_distance * count)
		local offset = vector_util.zero

		if is_aoe then
			self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(pos, offset, 1)
		else
			self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(pos, offset, 0)
		end
	end

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot')
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)

	if label > 0 then
		if hit_info.hitType == CS.Oak.Projectile.HitType.MapHit then
			local aoe = aoe_class:new(hit_info.position, vector_util.zero)
			self:set_aoe(aoe)
		else
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_bounce(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return true
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	-- attack range
	self.attack_range_list = {}
	local x2 = unity_class.mathf.Pow(self.zone_bound.size.x / 2, 2)
	local y2 = unity_class.mathf.Pow(self.zone_bound.size.z / 2, 2)
	local range_width = math.sqrt(x2 + y2) - self.shoot_offset
	local size = unity_class.vector2(range_width, 1.5)
	for i = 0, 3 do
		local new_ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, size, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		new_ar:Hide();
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, new_ar)
	end

	self.zone_center = bound.center
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.on_aoe_hit_callback = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
