--체인 도착지점 계산
function local_class:get_hook_destination_position(b, p, d)
	local height = battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position) + 1
	local origin = vector_util.get_xz(p)
	local direction = vector_util.get_xz(d)

	local left_top = unity_class.vector2(b.min.x, b.max.z)
	local left_bottom = unity_class.vector2(b.min.x, b.min.z)
	local right_top = unity_class.vector2(b.max.x, b.max.z)
	local right_bottom = unity_class.vector2(b.max.x, b.min.z)

	if d.x > 0 then
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, direction, right_top, right_bottom, height, 0)
		if result then
			return true, vector_util.get_x0z(intersection, height)
		end
	end

	if d.x < 0 then
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, direction, left_top, left_bottom, height, 0)
		if result then
			return true, vector_util.get_x0z(intersection, height)
		end
	end

	if d.z > 0 then
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, direction, left_top, right_top, height, 0)
		if result then
			return true, vector_util.get_x0z(intersection, height)
		end
	end

	if d.z < 0 then
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, direction, left_bottom, right_bottom, height, 0)
		if result then
			return true, vector_util.get_x0z(intersection, height)
		end
	end
	return false, p
end

--체인 도착지점 계산
function local_class:get_hook_shot_land_position(b, p, safe_dist)
	if p.x > b.max.x - safe_dist then
		p.x = b.max.x - safe_dist
	elseif p.x < b.min.x + safe_dist then
		p.x = b.min.x + safe_dist
	end

	if p.z > b.max.z - safe_dist then
		p.z = b.max.z - safe_dist
	elseif p.z < b.min.z + safe_dist then
		p.z = b.min.z + safe_dist
	end

	return p
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.start_chain_shot = false
	self.target = target
	self.remain_cool_times = {}
	self.charge_hit_targets = {}

	self.chain_synced = false
	self.charge_synced = false

	self:change_state(self.state.chain_prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.attack_range_charge:Hide()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_charge))
	for _,v in pairs(self.chain_attack_range_list) do
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
	end
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self.start_chain_shot = false
	self.attack_calculator:End()
	self:dispose_chain_shot()
	self:dispose_effect(self.dash_effect)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

--사슬 비주얼 셋팅
function local_class:set_chain_shot(dist_front, dist_back)
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.destination - self.character.Bounds.center,
			battle_util.get_height(self.destination - self.character.Bounds.center) + 0.5)
	local dir = diff.normalized

	local reached = false
	if dist_front >= diff.magnitude then
		dist_front = diff.magnitude
		reached = true
	end

	if dist_front < CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength then
		dist_front = CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength
	end

	self.chain_position_list.target_pos[1] = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Bounds.center + dir * dist_front, 1)

	local diff2 = vector_util.get_x0z(self.destination2 - self.character.Bounds.center,
			battle_util.get_height(self.destination2 - self.character.Bounds.center) + 0.5)
	local dir2 = -dir --Front의 정반대로 발사
	local reached2 = false
	if dist_back >= diff2.magnitude then
		dist_back = diff2.magnitude
		reached2 = true
	end

	if dist_back < CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength then
		dist_back = CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength
	end

	self.chain_position_list.target_pos[2] = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Bounds.center + dir2 * dist_back,
			battle_util.get_height(self.character.Bounds.center + dir2 * dist_back) + 1)
	self:chain_visual_update()

	return reached, reached2
end

function local_class:check_chain_shot_collision(dt)
	local collision_width = self.chain_width
	local chain_bound_size = unity_class.vector3(collision_width, 1.5, collision_width)

	for fo, time_info in pairs(self.remain_cool_times) do
		time_info.time_passed = time_info.time_passed + dt
	end

	for i = 1, 2 do
		if self.chain_position_list.target_pos[i] ~= nil and self.chain_position_list.from ~= nil  then
			local b = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.chain_position_list.target_pos[i], chain_bound_size)
			local move = vector_util.get_x0z(self.chain_position_list.from - self.chain_position_list.target_pos[i])
			self:collision_check(b, move, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:collision_check(b, move, index)
	if self.remain_cool_times == nil then
		self.remain_cool_times = {}
	end

	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(b, move)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do repeat
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
				fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
			break
		end

		--사슬 히트간격 조절
		if self.remain_cool_times[fo] == nil then
			self.remain_cool_times[fo] =
			{
				time_passed = 0,
				last_knockback_time = 0,
				last_damage_time = 0,
			}
			self:hit_chain_damage(fo, move, self.chain_damage_modifier, true)
			break
		end

		local time_info = self.remain_cool_times[fo]
		local knock_back = (time_info.time_passed - time_info.last_knockback_time) >= self.chain_hit_interval
		local damage = (time_info.time_passed - time_info.last_damage_time) >= self.chain_damage_interval

		self:hit_chain_damage(fo, move, damage and self.chain_damage_modifier or nil, knock_back)

		if knock_back then
			self.remain_cool_times[fo].last_knockback_time = time_info.time_passed
		end

		if damage then
			self.remain_cool_times[fo].last_damage_time = time_info.time_passed
		end

		break
	until true end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:hit_chain_damage(fo, move, damage_modifier, is_knockback)
	local dir_xz = vector_util.get_xz(move).normalized
	local target_dir_xz = vector_util.get_xz(fo.Bounds.center - self.chain_position_list.from).normalized
	local det = vector_util.cross(dir_xz, target_dir_xz)
	local angle = self.chain_knockback_offset_angle
	if det > 0 then
		angle = -self.chain_knockback_offset_angle
	end

	local knockback_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * move.normalized

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.direction = knockback_dir
	if damage_modifier ~= nil then
		damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
	end
	if is_knockback then
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_dir
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.chain_knockback_force
	end

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

function local_class:dispose_chain_shot()
	for _,v in pairs(self.chain_info_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v.cs_hook_shot) then
			v.cs_hook_shot:SetFromTo(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self:dispose_effect(v.chain_effect)
			self:dispose_effect(v.chain_glow_effect)
		end
		v.cs_hook_shot = nil
	end
	self.chain_info_list = {}
	self.chain_position_list.from = nil
	for _,v in pairs(self.chain_position_list.target_pos) do
		v = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_effect(effect)
	if not is_unity_null(effect) then
		effect:Dispose()
	end
	effect = nil
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.chain_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.chain then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		for _,v in pairs(self.chain_attack_range_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self:dispose_chain_shot()
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self:dispose_effect(self.dash_effect)
		self.dash_effect = nil
		self.start_chain_shot = false
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.chain_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("chain_prepare")
		if self.chain_prepare_duration > 0 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.chain_prepare_duration))
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.chain then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("charge_ready")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("chain", nil)

		--사슬 이펙트 처리
		local dir = (self.destination - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
		self.chain_position_list.from = self.character.Bounds.center + dir * CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local chain_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("hook_shot", self.character.Bounds.center)
			local cs_hook_shot = chain_effect:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))
			cs_hook_shot.HeadLength = 0.1
			local chain_glow_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("chain_glow", self.character.Bounds.center)
			chain_glow_effect.transform:SetParent(cs_hook_shot.Chain.transform.parent)
			chain_glow_effect.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
			chain_glow_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

			table.insert(self.chain_info_list,{
				cs_hook_shot = cs_hook_shot,
				chain_effect = chain_effect,
				chain_glow_effect = chain_glow_effect,
				chain_length = 0
			})
		end

		for _,v in pairs(self.chain_attack_range_list) do
			if v == nil then
				v = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, 0, 0, 0)
			end
		end

		self:chain_attack_range_update()
		self.start_chain_shot = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_range_charge:Show(self.charge_prepare_duration + 0.1)
		if self.charge_prepare_duration > 0 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_prepare_duration))
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
			self.attack_calculator:Start()
		end
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_charge))
		self.attack_range_charge:Hide()
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("charge_action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("charge", nil)
		self.dash_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("dash", self.character.Position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.remain_cool_times = nil
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:chain_attack_range_update()
	local ar1 = self.chain_attack_range_list[1]
	ar1.Size = vector(vector_util.get_x0z(self.destination - self.character.Bounds.center).magnitude, self.chain_width)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(ar1, self.character.Position, self.destination)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar1))

	local ar2 = self.chain_attack_range_list[2]
	ar2.Size = vector(vector_util.get_x0z(self.destination2 - self.character.Bounds.center).magnitude, self.chain_width)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(ar2, self.character.Position, self.destination2)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar2))
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	--사슬 전개시점부터 돌진 종료시점까지 사슬판정 유효
	if self.start_chain_shot then
		self:check_chain_shot_collision(dt)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.chain_prepare then
		if self.time_passed < self.chain_prepare_duration then
		elseif not self.chain_synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
			if self.battle_zone == nil then
				return
			end

			self.chain_synced = true

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				direction = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
			end

			--정면도착지점과 후면도착지점 계산
			local result, dest_pos = self:get_hook_destination_position(self.battle_zone, self.character.Bounds.center, direction)
			local result2, dest_pos2 = self:get_hook_destination_position(self.battle_zone, self.character.Bounds.center, -direction)
			if result then
				self.destination = dest_pos
			end
			if result2 then
				self.destination2 = dest_pos2
			end

			self.destination = vector_util.get_x0z(self.destination, battle_util.get_height(self.destination) + 1)
			self.destination2 = vector_util.get_x0z(self.destination2, battle_util.get_height(self.destination) + 1)

			local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
			info:AppendNumber(1)
			info:AppendPosition(self.destination)
			info:AppendPosition(self.destination2)
			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.chain then
		if self.start_chain_shot then
			local chain_length1 = self.chain_info_list[1].chain_length
			local chain_length2 = self.chain_info_list[2].chain_length
			local reached1, reached2 = self:set_chain_shot(chain_length1, chain_length2)
			if not reached1  then
				self.chain_info_list[1].chain_length = chain_length1 + self.chain_speed * dt
			end
			if not reached2 then
				self.chain_info_list[2].chain_length = chain_length2 + self.chain_speed * dt
			end

			--양쪽사슬이 다 전개됐으면 돌진 state로 이동
			if reached1 and reached2 then
				self:change_state(self.state.charge_prepare)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		if self.time_passed < self.charge_prepare_duration then
			local t, dir = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_battle_action, self.target, direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)))
			self.charge_direction = dir
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_charge, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		elseif not self.charge_synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
			self.charge_synced = true

			-- 돌진 싱크 커맨드
			local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.charge_direction)
			info:AppendNumber(2)
			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		--chain update
		if self.start_chain_shot then
			self.chain_position_list.from = self.character.Bounds.center
			self.chain_position_list.from.y = 1
			self:chain_visual_update()
			self:chain_attack_range_update()
		end

		--데미지 및 벽충돌
		self:charge_update(dt)

		local crashed_wall = false
		local movement = self.charge_speed * dt
		local sorted_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_collided_by(self.character.Bounds,
				self.charge_speed * dt * self.charge_direction)
		local dists = sorted_list.Keys
		local ifos = sorted_list.Values
		for i = 0, ifos.Count - 1 do
			local ifo = ifos[i]
			if (ifo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and
					not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(ifo.CrashBehaviour) then
				movement = dists[i].distance
				crashed_wall = true

				-- 화면 흔들기
				stage_camera:Shake(0.4, 0.3)

				-- 벽꿍 이팩트
				local wall_pos = self.character.Position + self.charge_direction * movement
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wall_impact", wall_pos)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("wall_charge", nil)
				break
			end
		end
		sorted_list:Dispose()
		self.dash_effect.transform.localPosition = self.character.Position

		if crashed_wall then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.charge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:chain_visual_update()
	for i = 1, 2 do
		self.chain_info_list[i].cs_hook_shot:SetFromTo(self.chain_position_list.from, self.chain_position_list.target_pos[i])
		local chain_scale = self.chain_info_list[i].cs_hook_shot.Chain.transform.localScale * 0.8
		self.chain_info_list[i].cs_hook_shot.Chain.transform.localScale = chain_scale
		self.chain_info_list[i].chain_glow_effect.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, chain_scale.y)
	end
end

function local_class:charge_update(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			if not table_util.contain_value(self.charge_hit_targets, fo) then
				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

				-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
				local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
				local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
				local knock_direction
				if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
					knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
				else
					knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.charge_damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.charge_knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				table.insert(self.charge_hit_targets, fo)
			end
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	-- 체인/돌진 싱크
	if idx == 1 then
		self.destination = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self.destination2 = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 1)

		self:change_state(self.state.chain)
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self.charge_direction = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_charge, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)

		self:change_state(self.state.charge)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.attack_range_charge = nil
	self.chain_attack_range_list = nil

	self.charge_hit_targets = nil
	self.chain_position_list = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.remain_cool_times = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.enhanced_mine_count_width = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "EnhancedMineRowCount", 2)
	self.enhanced_mine_count_height = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "EnhancedMineColCount", 2)
	self.enhanced_mine_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "EnhancedMineDuration", 20)
	self.enhanced_mine_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "EnhancedMineRange", 3)

	self.is_risk_map_on = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsUseRiskMap', false)

	local enhanced_mine_count = self.enhanced_mine_count_width * self.enhanced_mine_count_height
	--강화 패턴 attack range
	self.enhanced_attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, enhanced_mine_count do
		local attack_range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.enhanced_mine_radius)
		table.insert(self.enhanced_attack_range_list, attack_range)
	end

	--Slash Attack Info
	local info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.Direction = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = self.slash_duration
	info.Radius = self.slash_range
	info.Angle = self.slash_angle
	info.Height = 3
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0.1, 1)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		teleport_prepare = 2,
		teleport = 3,
		mine_prepare = 4,
		mine_action = 5,
		slash_prepare = 6,
		slash = 7,
		slash_delay = 9,
		post = 10
	}

	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.is_start_slash_effect = false
	self.current_slash_count = 0
	self.is_active_mine = false
	self.mine_info_list = {}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)
	self.zone_bounds = bounds
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.Create(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, nil, dir, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.shot_dir = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.current_slash_count = 0
	self.teleport_finish = false
	self:change_state(self.state.teleport_prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.is_risk_map_on then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	end


	--남아 있던 지뢰 모두 폭발
	if self.mine_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.mine_info_list) do
			if not v.is_hit and v.is_ready then
				self:explosion_mine(v)
				v.is_hit = true
			end

			if not is_unity_null(v.mine_effect) then
				v.mine_effect:Dispose()
			end
			v.mine_effect = nil
		end


	end
	self.is_active_mine = false

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(
				self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.mine_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.mine_action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.mine_action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
		self.attack_range:Hide()

		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_delay then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		    .transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink_start", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink_thunder", self.zone_bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		    .transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink_end", nil)

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.mine_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("mine_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("mine_prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.mine_action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		--AI가 접근못하도록 가상레인지 설치
		self:active_attack_range()
		--마인 투척
		self:distribute_mine()
		if self.enhanced then
			self:enhanced_distribute_mine()
		end
		self.is_active_mine = true
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot_mine", nil)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("mine_action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("mine_action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.slash_prepare then
		--4방향
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		self.target_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(diff))

		character_util.set_direction(self.character, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.slash_prepare_duration))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.slash_prepare_duration + self.slash_delay)
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		self.attack_finish = false

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("slash_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("slash_prepare", nil)

		self.is_start_slash_effect = false
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.slash then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_finish = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("slash")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("slash", nil)
		self.current_slash_count = self.current_slash_count + 1

		--slash attackcalculator info
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	elseif next_state == self.state.slash_delay then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--남아 있던 지뢰 모두 폭발
		if self.mine_info_list ~= nil then
			for _,v in pairs(self.mine_info_list) do
				if not v.is_hit and v.is_ready then
					self:explosion_mine(v)
					v.is_hit = true
				end
			end
		end
		self.is_active_mine = false
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
		self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:active_attack_range()
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_list[1], self.zone_bounds.min + vector(self.mine_radius, 0, self.mine_radius), unity_class.vector3.right)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_list[2], self.zone_bounds.min + vector(self.mine_radius, 0, -self.mine_radius), unity_class.vector3.forward)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_list[3], self.zone_bounds.max - vector(self.mine_radius, 0, self.mine_radius), unity_class.vector3.left)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_list[4], self.zone_bounds.max - vector(self.mine_radius, 0, -self.mine_radius), unity_class.vector3.back)
	if self.is_risk_map_on then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:distribute_mine()
	if self.mine_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.mine_info_list) do
			if not is_unity_null(v.mine_effect) then
				v.mine_effect:Dispose()
			end
			v.mine_effect = nil
		end
		self.mine_info_list = nil
	end

	self.mine_info_list = {}

	-- 가로라인 마인 투척
	local start_z_list = {
		self.zone_bounds.min.z + self.mine_radius,
		self.zone_bounds.max.z - self.mine_radius
	}
	-- 세로라인 마인 투척
	-- 세로는 각 끝점은 발사안함
	local start_x_list = {
		self.zone_bounds.min.x + self.mine_radius,
		self.zone_bounds.max.x - self.mine_radius
	}
	local interval_x = (self.zone_bounds.size.x - self.mine_radius * 2) / (self.mine_count_width - 1)
	local interval_z = (self.zone_bounds.size.z - self.mine_radius * 2) / (self.mine_count_height - 1)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local start_z = start_z_list[i]
		for j = 1, self.mine_count_width do
			local dest_pos = vector(start_x_list[1] + (interval_x * (j - 1)), 0, start_z)
			dest_pos.y = battle_util.get_height(dest_pos)
			local info = {
				start_pos = self.character.Position,
				dest_pos = dest_pos,
				progress_time = 0,
				life_time = self.mine_duration,
				mine_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("mine", self.character.Position),
				is_hit = false,
				is_ready = false
			}
			table.insert(self.mine_info_list, info)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot_mine, self, info))
		end
	end


	for i = 1, 2 do
		local start_x = start_x_list[i]
		for j = 2, self.mine_count_height - 1 do
			local dest_pos = vector(start_x, 0, start_z_list[1] + (interval_z * (j - 1)))
			dest_pos.y = battle_util.get_height(dest_pos)
			local info = {
				start_pos = self.character.Position,
				dest_pos = dest_pos,
				progress_time = 0,
				life_time = self.mine_duration,
				mine_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("mine", self.character.Position),
				is_hit = false,
				is_ready = false
			}
			table.insert(self.mine_info_list, info)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot_mine, self, info))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_mine(info)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local vertical_speed = 4.5
	local gravity = 5.5
	local horizontal_speed = 2.5
	local y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(vertical_speed, gravity, 0, 0)
	y_calculator:ScaleTime(horizontal_speed)

	while self.is_active_mine do
		if info.mine_effect == nil then
			-- force cancel 및 중복 실행 등으로 취소하고 이펙트 지워버렸다면 더 돌리지 않는다.
			-- (Dispose 시킬 때 명시적으로 다 nil 로 넣어주므로 is_unity_null 체크 안함).
			return
		elseif y_calculator:IsDone() then
			info.mine_effect.transform.position = info.dest_pos
			info.is_ready = true
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			return
		else
			y_calculator:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

			local progress = y_calculator:GetProgress()
			local move_pos = info.start_pos * (1 - progress) + info.dest_pos * progress
			move_pos.y = y_calculator:GetDistance() + info.dest_pos.y
			info.mine_effect.transform.position = move_pos
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.mine_info_list ~= nil then
		self:mine_update(dt)
	end

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then
			if not self.teleport_finish then
				self.teleport_finish = true
				self.character.Position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.zone_bounds.center)
				character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
				self:change_state(self.state.mine_prepare)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.mine_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.mine_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.mine_action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.slash_prepare)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.slash_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.slash)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash then
		if self.time_passed >= self.slash_duration then
			if self.current_slash_count < self.slash_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.slash_delay)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end

		elseif self.time_passed >= self.slash_delay then

			if self.time_passed >= self.slash_effect_delay then
				if not self.is_start_slash_effect then
					local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("slash", self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
					local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, self.target_dir)
					effect.transform.rotation = rot
					self.is_start_slash_effect = true
				end
			end

			if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
				self.attack_calculator:Start()
			end
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.slash_damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = self.target_dir
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.target_dir
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.slash_knockback_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_delay then
		if self.time_passed >= self.slash_repeat_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.slash_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:mine_update(dt)
	if self.mine_info_list == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.mine_info_list) do
		if not v.is_hit and v.is_ready then
			if v.progress_time >= v.life_time then
				self:explosion_mine(v)
				v.is_hit = true
			else
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt

				local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(v.dest_pos, self.mine_radius)

				for _,v2 in pairs(fo_list) do
					if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
							v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
							lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) then
						--???
					else
						local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v2.Position - v.dest_pos).normalized
						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = v2
						damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
						damage_info.modifier = self.mine_damage_modifier

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

						self:explosion_mine(v)
						v.is_hit = true
					end
				end

				fo_list:Dispose()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:explosion_mine(mine_info)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(mine_info.dest_pos, self.mine_explosion_radius)

	--폭파 이펙트
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("mine_explosion", mine_info.dest_pos)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("mine_explosion", mine_info.dest_pos)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do

local local_class = newclass('BossMinisterMineJingakBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 4)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 3)

	--순간이동 Param
	self.teleport_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TeleportDuration", 0.15)

	--진각 Param
	self.stomp_attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StompDuration", 1)
	self.stomp_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StompModifier", 1.5)
	self.stomp_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StompRadius", 10)
	self.stomp_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StompAngle", 60)
	self.stomp_section_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "StompSectionCount", 3)
	self.stomp_cycle_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "StompCycleCount", 2)
	self.stomp_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StompKnockBackForce", 11000)

	--지뢰 Param
	self.mine_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MineRadius", 0.5)
	self.mine_amount_x = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MineAmountX", 2)
	self.mine_amount_z = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MineAmountZ", 4)
	self.mine_interval_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MineIntervalRange", 3)
	self.mine_life_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MineLifeTime", 5)
	self.mine_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MineAttackModifier", 0.5)
	self.mine_explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MineExposeionRadius", 2)

	self.teleport_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TeleportPrepareDuration", 0.5)

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.stomp_section_count do
		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateArc(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.stomp_radius, self.stomp_angle, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		attack_range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, attack_range)
	end

	--
	self.attack_calculator_list = {}

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		teleport_prepare = 2,
		teleport = 3,
		prepare = 4,
		action = 5,
		post = 6
	}

	self.current_jingak_count = 0

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.Create(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.zone_bound.center, nil, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

function local_class:start(info)

	self.center_position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	self.current_jingak_count = 0
	self.synced = false

	self:change_state(self.state.teleport_prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.current_jingak_count = 0

	for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
	end

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	--중앙으로 텔레포트
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.character.LockedDirection & CS.Oak.Direction.Side ~= 0 then
			self.stomp_effect_offset = 1
		else
			self.stomp_effect_offset = 0.3
		end

		for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide()
		end

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end

			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.synced = nil
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_calculator_list) do
			v:End()
		end

		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.teleport_finish = false
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink_start", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink_thunder", self.center_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		    .transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink_end", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.synced = false

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.attack_calculator_list = nil
		self.attack_calculator_list = {}

		for i = 1, self.stomp_section_count do
			local attack_range = self.attack_range_list[i]
			local target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position - self.character.Position).normalized
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.stomp_section_count, 0) * target_dir
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, self.character.Position, dir)
			attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, attack_range))

			local info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()
			info.Center = self.character.Position
			info.Direction = dir
			info.DamageTerm = -1
			info.Duration = 0.3
			info.Radius = self.stomp_radius
			info.Angle = self.stomp_angle
			local attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
			table.insert(self.attack_calculator_list, attack_calculator)
		end

		self.stomp_effect_target_pos = self.target_position

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("targeting", nil)

		--지뢰생성
		if self.current_jingak_count == 0 then
			self:distribute_mine()
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot_mine", nil)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.current_jingak_count = self.current_jingak_count + 1

		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_calculator_list) do
			v:Start()
		end

		for i = 1, self.stomp_section_count do
			local target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.stomp_effect_target_pos - self.character.Position).normalized
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.stomp_section_count, 0) * target_dir

			local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(-dir.z, dir.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg

			local create_pos = self.character.Position
			create_pos.y = create_pos.y + 0.03


			local jingak_effect_pool = self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("stomp")
			jingak_effect_pool:Instantiate(create_pos,
					unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up), nil)
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jingak", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.current_jingak_count = 0
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--다음 BA에 영향이 가도록
	if self.mine_info_list ~= nil then
		self:check_mine_damage(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then
			if not self.teleport_finish then
				self.teleport_finish = true
				self.character.Position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.center_position)
				character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
			end

			if not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.synced = true
				local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.target.Position)
				command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed <= self.stomp_attack_duration then
			self.hitted_targets = create_generic_hashset(CS.Oak.IFieldObject)

			for i = 1, self.stomp_section_count do
				if not self.attack_calculator_list[i].IsStarted then
					self.attack_calculator_list[i]:Start()
				end

				local objects = self.attack_calculator_list[i]:UpdateFrame(dt)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

						if self.hitted_targets:Add(fo) then
							local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center)
							local dist = diff.magnitude
							local dir = diff.normalized

							local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
							--진각 당기는것 일단 똑같이 셋팅
							if dist > 4 then
								damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
								damage_info.sender = self.character
								damage_info.target = fo
								damage_info.modifier = self.stomp_modifier
								damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
								damage_info.knockBackDirection = -dir
								damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce + self.stomp_knockback_force
							else
								damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
								damage_info.sender = self.character
								damage_info.target = fo
								damage_info.modifier = self.stomp_modifier
							end


							command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			if self.current_jingak_count >= self.stomp_cycle_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			elseif not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.synced = true
				local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.target.Position)
				command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:distribute_mine()
	if self.mine_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.mine_info_list) do
			if not is_unity_null(v.mine_effect) then
				v.mine_effect:Dispose()
			end
			v.mine_effect = nil
		end
		self.mine_info_list = nil
	end

	self.mine_info_list = {}
	local start_angle = 0

	for i = 1, self.mine_amount_x do
		-- 내부 함수로?
		for j = 1, self.mine_amount_z do
			if i % 2 == 0 then
				start_angle = 45
			else
				start_angle = 0
			end

			local start_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction).normalized

			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, start_angle + 90 * j, 0) * start_dir
			local dest_pos = self.character.Position + dir * (self.mine_interval_range * i)

			local info = {
				start_pos = self.character.Position,
				dest_pos = dest_pos,
				progress_time = 0,
				life_time = self.mine_life_time,
				mine_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("mine", self.character.Position),
				is_hit = false,
				is_ready = false
			}
			table.insert(self.mine_info_list, info)

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot_mine, self, info))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_mine(info)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local vertical_speed = 4.5
	local gravity = 5.5
	local horizontal_speed = 2.5
	local y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(vertical_speed, gravity, 0, 0)
	y_calculator:ScaleTime(horizontal_speed)

	while true do
		if info.mine_effect == nil then
			-- force cancel 및 중복 실행 등으로 취소하고 이펙트 지워버렸다면 더 돌리지 않는다.
			-- (Dispose 시킬 때 명시적으로 다 nil 로 넣어주므로 is_unity_null 체크 안함).
			return
		elseif y_calculator:IsDone() then
			info.mine_effect.transform.position = info.dest_pos
			info.is_ready = true
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			return
		else
			y_calculator:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

			local progress = y_calculator:GetProgress()
			local move_pos = info.start_pos * (1 - progress) + info.dest_pos * progress
			move_pos.y = y_calculator:GetDistance() + info.dest_pos.y
			info.mine_effect.transform.position = move_pos
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_mine_damage(dt)
	if self.mine_info_list == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.mine_info_list) do
		if not v.is_hit and v.is_ready then
			if v.progress_time >= v.life_time then
				self:explosion_mine(v)
				v.is_hit = true
			else
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt

				local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(v.dest_pos, self.mine_radius)

				for _,v2 in pairs(fo_list) do
					if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
							v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
							lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) then
						--???
					else
						local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v2.Position - v.dest_pos).normalized
						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = v2
						damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
						damage_info.modifier = self.mine_modifier

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

						self:explosion_mine(v)
						v.is_hit = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

--Mine적중 또는 지속시간 종료 후 폭발
function local_class:explosion_mine(mine_info)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(mine_info.dest_pos, self.mine_explosion_radius)

	--폭파 이펙트
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("mine_explosion", mine_info.dest_pos)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("mine_explosion", mine_info.dest_pos)


	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else

			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - mine_info.dest_pos).normalized
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.mine_modifier

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	if not is_unity_null(mine_info.mine_effect) then
		mine_info.mine_effect:Dispose()
	end
	mine_info.mine_effect = nil
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	--강제 종료일때만 지뢰 삭제
	if self.mine_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.mine_info_list) do
			if not is_unity_null(v.mine_effect) then
				v.mine_effect:Dispose()
			end
			v.mine_effect = nil
		end
		self.mine_info_list = nil
	end
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		self.target_position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.attack_calculator_list = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
		self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

function local_class:trigger()

		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.move_synced = false
	self.target = target
	self.attack_finish = false
	self.attack_range_finish = false
	self:change_state(self.state.move)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if(self.mine_info_list ~= nil) then
		for _,v in pairs(self.mine_info_list) do
			if not is_unity_null(v.mine_effect) then
				v.mine_effect:Dispose()
			end
			v.mine_effect = nil
		end
	end

	self.attack_range:Hide()
	if self.is_risk_map_on then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	self.mine_info_list = nil

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.attack_range_finish = true
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			if self.is_risk_map_on then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			end

			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.move then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		-- target dir 는 sync 되었음.
		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.target_dir)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.attack_range_finish = false

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.attack_delay)
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		--Slash action info setting
		self.attack_start_pos = self.character.Position
		self.attack_start_target_pos = self.attack_start_pos + (self.target_dir * self.slash_range)
		--지뢰 생성
		self:distribute_mine(self.attack_start_pos, self.attack_start_target_pos)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot_mine", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("slash")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("slash", nil)

		--slash attackcalculator info
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.attack_start_pos
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.mine_info_list ~= nil then
		self:check_mine_damage(dt)
	end

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.move then

		if self.move_synced == true then
			-- already synced
			-- do noting
		elseif self.time_passed < self.move_duration then

			local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, self.target)
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)

			if dist > 0.3 then

				local direction = diff.normalized
				local move_dist = unity_class.mathf.Min(diff.magnitude, self.move_speed * dt)

				local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
				move_info.direction = direction
				move_info.magnitude = move_dist
				local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction), true)
				message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
			elseif CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.move_synced = true

				self.target_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(diff))
				local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.target_dir)
				command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
			end

		elseif CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
			self.move_synced = true
			-- TODO: SYNC

			self.target_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.character.Direction)
			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.target_dir)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.attack_delay then
			if self.time_passed >= self.attack_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end

			if not self.attack_finish then

				if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
					self.attack_calculator:Start()
				end
				local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
						local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = direction
						damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
						damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
						damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

					end
				end
				self.attack_finish = true
				objects:Dispose()
			end
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.attack_delay - 0.1 and not self.attack_range_finish then
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			if self.is_risk_map_on then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			end
			self.attack_range_finish = true
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:distribute_mine(start_pos, target_pos)
	--Sound
	self.mine_info_list = {}

	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - start_pos)
	local direction = diff.normalized

	for i = 1, self.mine_amount do
		local center_angle = self.slash_angle / (self.mine_amount - 1) * (i - 1)
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, center_angle - (self.slash_angle / 2), 0) * direction

		local dest_pos = start_pos + dir * self.mine_range

		local info = {
			start_pos = start_pos,
			dest_pos = dest_pos,
			progress_time = 0,
			life_time = self.mine_life_time,
			mine_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("mine", start_pos),
			is_hit = false,
			is_ready = false
		}
		table.insert(self.mine_info_list, info)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot_mine, self, info))
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_mine(info)
	local vertical_speed = 4.5
	local gravity = 5.5
	local horizontal_speed = 2.5
	local y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(vertical_speed, gravity, 0, 0)
	y_calculator:ScaleTime(horizontal_speed)

	--- 캔슬될 경우를 대비하여 지뢰 이펙트가 있는지도 판단 하여야함
	while true and info.mine_effect ~= nil do
		if y_calculator:IsDone() then
			info.mine_effect.transform.position = info.dest_pos
			info.is_ready = true
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			return
		else
			y_calculator:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

			local progress = y_calculator:GetProgress()
			local move_pos = info.start_pos * (1 - progress) + info.dest_pos * progress
			move_pos.y = y_calculator:GetDistance() + info.dest_pos.y
			info.mine_effect.transform.position = move_pos
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_mine_damage(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.mine_info_list) do
		if not v.is_hit and v.is_ready then
			if v.progress_time >= v.life_time then
				self:explosion_mine(v)
				v.is_hit = true
			else
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt

				local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(v.dest_pos, self.mine_radius)

				for _,v2 in pairs(fo_list) do
					if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
							v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
							lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) then
						--???
					else
						local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v2.Position - v.dest_pos).normalized
						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = v2
						damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
						damage_info.modifier = self.mine_damage_modifier

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
						self:explosion_mine(v)
						v.is_hit = true
					end
				end

				fo_list:Dispose()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:explosion_mine(mine_info)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(mine_info.dest_pos, self.mine_explosion_radius)

	--폭파 이펙트
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("mine_explosion", mine_info.dest_pos)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("mine_explosion", mine_info.dest_pos)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else

			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - mine_info.dest_pos).normalized
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.mine_damage_modifier

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()

	if not is_unity_null(mine_info.mine_effect) then
		mine_info.mine_effect:Dispose()
	end
	mine_info.mine_effect = nil
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	self.target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.mine_info_list = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.slash_key)
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.slash_key)

			self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.prepare_time
			self.current_state = self.state.slash
			return
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash then
		local fo_list = self.slash_hit_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

		for i = 0, fo_list.Count-1 do
			local fo = fo_list[i]
			local knockback_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center))

			local dmg_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			dmg_info.sender = self.character
			dmg_info.target = fo
			dmg_info.modifier = self.slash_atk_mod
			dmg_info.hitEffect = CS.Oak.BasicMeHitEffect.Create(fo.Bounds.center)
			dmg_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorNormalStrong
			dmg_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_dir
			dmg_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce + 10000

			command_util.publish_damage(dmg_info)
		end

		fo_list:Dispose()

		if self.time_passed >= self.slash_animation_duration then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.shoot_key)

			self:shoot_fireballs(self.shoot_angle_first, self.fireball_count_first, self.phase.first)

			self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.slash_animation_duration

			if self.target == nil then
				self:cancel()
			end
			self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))
			local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(self.character.Position):GetHeightAt(self.character.Position)

			message_system:SendSync(self.character.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.MoveStopEvent.Instance)

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.prepare_key)
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)
			local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.LockedDirection)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_second, self.character.Position, dir, floor_height)
			self.attack_range_second:Show(self.slash_interval)

			self.current_state = self.state.prepare_second

			return
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_second then
		if self.time_passed >= self.slash_interval then
			self.attack_range_second:Hide()

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.slash_key)
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.slash_key)

			self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.slash_interval
			self.current_state = self.state.slash_second
			return
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_second then
		local fo_list = self.slash_hit_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

		for i = 0, fo_list.Count-1 do
			local fo = fo_list[i]
			local knockback_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center))

			local dmg_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			dmg_info.sender = self.character
			dmg_info.target = fo
			dmg_info.modifier = self.slash_atk_mod
			dmg_info.hitEffect = CS.Oak.BasicMeHitEffect.Create(fo.Bounds.center)
			dmg_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorNormalStrong
			dmg_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_dir
			dmg_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce + 10000

			command_util.publish_damage(dmg_info)
		end

		fo_list:Dispose()

		if self.time_passed >= self.slash_animation_duration then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.shoot_key)

			self:shoot_fireballs(self.shoot_angle_second, self.fireball_count_second, self.phase.second)

			self.fire_aura_ash:FadeOut()

			self.fire_aura:Dispose()

			self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.slash_animation_duration

			self.current_state = self.state.end_state
			return
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.end_state then
		if self.time_passed >= self.end_animation_duration_first then
			self:cancel()
			return
		end
	end

	for effect, life_time in pairs(self.fireball_life_time_map) do
		local move_dir = self.fireball_move_direction_map[effect]
		local hit_calculator = self.fireball_hit_calculator_map[effect]

		if unity_class.time.time - life_time > self.fireball_life_time then
			table.insert(self.remove_fireball_list, effect)
		else
			local hitted_any_one = false
			local fo_list = hit_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

			for i = 0, fo_list.Count-1 do
				local fo = fo_list[i]
				local dmg_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				dmg_info.sender = self.character
				dmg_info.target = fo
				dmg_info.modifier = self.fireball_atk_mod
				dmg_info.convertAttackTo = CS.Oak.ElementalType.Fire

				command_util.publish_damage(dmg_info)
			end

			if fo_list.Count>0 then
				hitted_any_one = true
				table.insert(self.remove_fireball_list, effect)
			end

			fo_list:Dispose()

			if not hitted_any_one then
				local effect_pos = effect.transform.position
				if self.phase_map[effect] == self.phase.first then
					effect_pos = effect_pos + move_dir * self.fireball_speed_first * dt
				elseif self.phase_map[effect] == self.phase.second then
					effect_pos = effect_pos + move_dir * self.fireball_speed_second * dt
				end
				effect.transform.position = effect_pos
				hit_calculator.Position = effect_pos
			end
		end
	end


end

function local_class:shoot_fireballs(shoot_angle, fireball_count, phase)
	local unit_angle = shoot_angle / fireball_count

	for i = 0, fireball_count-1 do
		local angle = ((i - (fireball_count - 1) / 2) * unit_angle)
		local move_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, vector_util.up) * self.target_dir
		local create_pos = self.character.Position + self.target_dir * self.projectile_offset
		local fireball = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.fireball_key, create_pos)

		local trail = self.fireball_trail_renderer_map[fireball:GetInstanceID()]
		if trail == nil then
			trail = fireball.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.TrailRenderer))
			self.fireball_trail_renderer_map[fireball:GetInstanceID()] = trail
		end
		trail:Clear()

		local hit_spec = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
		hit_spec.Center = fireball.transform.position
		hit_spec.DamageTerm = -1
		hit_spec.Duration = self.fireball_life_time
		hit_spec.Extents = vector_util.one * 0.4

		local hit_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, hit_spec)
		hit_calculator:Start()

		self.phase_map[fireball] = phase
		self.fireball_life_time_map[fireball] = unity_class.time.time
		self.fireball_move_direction_map[fireball] = move_dir
		self.fireball_hit_calculator_map[fireball] = hit_calculator
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
	for key, _ in pairs(self.fireball_life_time_map) do
		self.fireball_life_time_map[key] = nil
		if key ~= nil then
			key:Dispose()
		end
	end

	for i = #self.remove_fireball_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.remove_fireball_list[i] ~= nil then
			self.remove_fireball_list[i]:Dispose()
			table.remove(self.remove_fireball_list, i)
		end
	end

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end

	if self.attack_range_second ~= nil then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_second))
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range_second)
	end

	self.fire_aura = nil

	for key, _ in pairs(self.fireball_trail_renderer_map) do
		self.fireball_trail_renderer_map[key] = nil
	end

	for key, _ in pairs(self.phase_map) do
		self.phase_map[key] = nil
	end

	self.phase_map = nil
	self.fireball_trail_renderer_map = nil
	self.remove_fireball_list = nil
	self.fireball_life_time_map = nil

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_range_second = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossOberonTeleportBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
