	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.battle_zone = nil

	--파라미터 파싱
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeMagnitude", 0.08)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeDuration", 2)

	self.buff_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "BuffName", 'damage_reduction_persistent')
	self.buff_level = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "BuffLevel", 250)

	self.effect_offset = vector(0, 0, 2)


	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	self.target = nil
	self.buff_aura_effect = nil
	self.is_active_aura = false
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		--시그널빔 파훼이벤트 오면 오라 해제
		if  e:GetParamAt(0) == 'large_orb_destroyed' then
			self:remove_aura()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_aura()
	if self.buff_aura_effect ~= nil then
		self.buff_aura_effect:Dispose()
		self.buff_aura_effect = nil
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('aura_end', self.character.Bounds.center + self.effect_offset)
	end

	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, self.buff_name)

	self.is_active_aura = false
end

function local_class:is_active_powder_aura()
	return self.is_active_aura
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character,
				self.buff_name, self.buff_level, false, false)
		--self:set_ailment_resist()

		self.buff_aura_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("aura",
				self.character.Bounds.center + self.effect_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.buff_aura_effect.transform.parent = self.character.transform

		self.is_active_aura = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action1", nil)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action2", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	self:remove_aura()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.buff_aura_effect = nil

	self.buff_name = nil
	self.effect_offset = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.buff_aura_effect = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("interval", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then

	end

	self.current_state = next_state

		local dir1 = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle - (90 / 2), 0) * target_dir
		local angle = 90

		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
				self.target_pos = self.target.Position
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		--일정시간동안 미사일시퀸스가 안끝나면 패턴 종료
		if self.time_passed >= 10 then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			--다음타겟 간격 missile_delay
			--미사일 간격 missile_persnal_delay
			--몇번째 타겟인지? current_target_count
			--딜레이TimePassed를 생성해서 쉬어야될때마다 업데이트 해줘서 처리하자.
			if self.current_shot_delay_time_passed > 0 then
				self.current_shot_delay_time_passed = self.current_shot_delay_time_passed - dt
			else
				if self.current_missile_count <= self.missile_count then

					local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + self.shot_offset
					shoot_pos.y = 0.1
					local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.plus_angle * self.total_missile_count +
							self.start_angle, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized

					self.shoot_helper[1]:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos,
							dir, -1, -1, nil, false)

					self.current_shot_delay_time_passed = self.missile_persnal_delay
					self.current_missile_count = self.current_missile_count + 1
					self.total_missile_count = self.total_missile_count + 1
				else
					if self.current_shot_count < self.shot_count then
						self:change_state(self.state.interval)
					else
						self:change_state(self.state.post)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_term then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed <= self.interval_tracking_duration then
				self.target_pos = self.target.Position
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.battle_zone = nil

	--파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 2)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockbackForce", 1.3)
	self.action_interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionIntervalDuration", 0.1)

	self.powder_shot_casting_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PowderShotCastingDuration", 2)
	self.powder_shot_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "PowderShotCount", 3)
	self.powder_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PowderRadius", 2.5)
	self.powder_shot_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PowderShotSpeed", 7)
	self.powder_effect_scale_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PowderEffectScaleDuration", 1)
	self.powder_shot_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PowderShotHeight", 5)
	self.powder_shot_trail_end_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TrailEffectEndDelay", 0.8)

	local offset = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "ShotOffset")
	if offset == nil then
		self.shot_offset = vector(0, 0, 4)
	else
		self.shot_offset = vector(offset[1], offset[2], offset[3])
	end

	local shot_effect_offset = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "ShotEffectOffset")
	if shot_effect_offset == nil then
		self.shot_effect_offset = vector(0, 0, 0)
	else
		self.shot_effect_offset = vector(shot_effect_offset[1], shot_effect_offset[2], shot_effect_offset[3])
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		interval = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	--인분AttackRange
	self.powder_attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.powder_shot_count do
		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero,
				self.powder_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		table.insert(self.powder_attack_range_list, ar)
	end

	self.powder_shot_info_list = nil
	self.current_shot_count = 0
	self.is_start_animation = false
	self.is_start_sfx = false
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false

	self.target = target
	self.powder_shot_info_list = {}
	self.current_shot_count = 0
	self.is_start_animation = false
	self.is_start_sfx = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.powder_attack_range_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.powder_attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	end

	if self.powder_shot_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.powder_shot_info_list) do
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				v.effect:Dispose()
				v.effect = nil
			end
			if v.trail_effect ~= nil then
				v.trail_effect:Dispose()
				v.trail_effect = nil
			end
			v.is_move_powder = false
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		--if self.current_shot_count == 1 then
		--	self:init_powder_shot()
		--end

		if not self.is_start_animation then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
			self.is_start_animation = true
		end

		if not self.is_start_sfx then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
			self.is_start_sfx = true
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.current_shot_count = self.current_shot_count + 1

		self:init_powder_shot()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:check_target_pos_by_battle_zone(target_pos)
	local final_target_pos = target_pos
	if target_pos.x <= self.battle_zone.min.x + self.powder_radius then
		final_target_pos.x = self.battle_zone.min.x + self.powder_radius
	end
	if target_pos.x >= self.battle_zone.max.x - self.powder_radius then
		final_target_pos.x = self.battle_zone.max.x - self.powder_radius
	end
	if target_pos.z <= self.battle_zone.min.z + self.powder_radius then
		final_target_pos.z = self.battle_zone.min.z + self.powder_radius
	end
	if target_pos.z >= self.battle_zone.max.z - self.powder_radius then
		final_target_pos.z = self.battle_zone.max.z - self.powder_radius
	end

	return final_target_pos
end

function local_class:init_powder_shot()
	local target_pos = self:check_target_pos_by_battle_zone(self.target.Position)
	local start_pos = self.character.Position + self.shot_offset
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shot", self.character.Position + self.shot_effect_offset,
			unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("powder_proj", start_pos,
			unity_class.vector3.zero)
	effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("powder_proj_trail", start_pos,
			unity_class.vector3.zero)
	trail_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

	table.insert(self.powder_shot_info_list, {
		start_pos = start_pos,
		target_pos = target_pos,
		current_pos = start_pos,
		effect = effect,
		trail_effect = trail_effect,
		is_move_powder = false,
		time_passed = 0,
		move_duration = 0,
		is_shoot = false,
		index = self.current_shot_count,
		is_trail_end = false
	})

	local ar = self.powder_attack_range_list[self.current_shot_count]
	battle_range_util.show(ar, self.powder_shot_casting_duration)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, target_pos)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
end

function local_class:shoot_powder_shot(shot_index)
	local info = self.powder_shot_info_list[shot_index]
	local dist = (info.target_pos - info.current_pos):GetX0z().magnitude
	local move_duration = dist / self.powder_shot_speed
	info.move_duration = move_duration
	info.is_move_powder = true
	info.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot", nil)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_powder_shot(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if not self.powder_shot_info_list[self.current_shot_count].is_shoot then
				self:shoot_powder_shot(self.current_shot_count)
				self.powder_shot_info_list[self.current_shot_count].is_shoot = true
			end

			if self.current_shot_count < self.powder_shot_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		else
			self:update_powder_shot_ready(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_powder_shot_ready(dt)
	local info = self.powder_shot_info_list[self.current_shot_count]
	if info.is_shoot then return end

	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(
			self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.powder_effect_scale_duration))
	info.effect.transform.localScale = 1 * progress * unity_class.vector3.one
	info.trail_effect.transform.localScale = 1 * progress * unity_class.vector3.one

	if self.time_passed >= self.powder_shot_casting_duration then
		self:shoot_powder_shot(self.current_shot_count)
		info.is_shoot = true
	else
		info.target_pos = self:check_target_pos_by_battle_zone(self.target.Position)
		local ar = self.powder_attack_range_list[self.current_shot_count]
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, info.target_pos)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
	end
end

function local_class:update_powder_shot(dt)
	for i = #self.powder_shot_info_list, 1, -1 do
		local info = self.powder_shot_info_list[i]
		if info.is_move_powder then
			local progress = info.time_passed / info.move_duration
			if progress > 1 then
				--도착하면 딜 체크하고 이팩트는 사라지고
				--인분오브젝트 생성
				info.current_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(info.target_pos, battle_util.get_height(info.target_pos))
				self:update_powder_damage(info.target_pos)

				if info.effect ~= nil then
					info.effect:Dispose()
					info.effect = nil
				end
				--if info.trail_effect ~= nil then
				--	info.trail_effect:Dispose()
				--	info.trail_effect = nil
				--end

				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.powder_attack_range_list[info.index]))
				self.powder_attack_range_list[info.index]:Hide()

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("powder_proj_explosion", info.target_pos,
						unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
				info.is_move_powder = false
				info.time_passed = 0
				info.is_trail_end = true

				--인분오브젝트 생성
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
					'instantiate_powder_orb', info.current_pos.x .. ', '
							.. info.current_pos.y .. ', ' .. info.current_pos.z, -1}))
			else
				info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt
				local h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * self.powder_shot_height
				local temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(info.start_pos, info.target_pos, progress)
						+ unity_class.vector3.up * h
				info.current_pos = temp_pos
				info.effect.transform.localPosition = temp_pos
				info.trail_effect.transform.localPosition = temp_pos
			end
		end

		if info.is_trail_end then
			if info.time_passed >= self.powder_shot_trail_end_delay then
				if info.trail_effect ~= nil then
					info.trail_effect:Dispose()
					info.trail_effect = nil
				end
				info.is_trail_end = false
			else
				info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_powder_damage(target_pos)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(target_pos, self.powder_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - v.Position).normalized
			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(v.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = -dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.shot_offset = nil
	self.cs_shooter = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.proj_spec = nil
	self.powder_attack_range_list = nil
	self.powder_shot_info_list = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.powder then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		--마커 랜덤 index
		self:set_random_marker()

		self.current_missile_count = 0

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.powder then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self:init_powder_shot()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("powder")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("powder", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

function local_class:init_powder_shot()
	for i = 1, self.powder_object_count do
		local marker_index = self.random_marker_index_list[self.current_marker_index]
		local target_pos = self.marker_pos_list[marker_index]
		self.current_marker_index = self.current_marker_index + 1
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.powder_attack_range_list[i], target_pos)
		local dist = (target_pos - self.character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
		local duration = dist / self.powder_shot_speed
		local speed = dist / duration
		local start_pos = self.character.Position + self.shot_offset
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shot", self.character.Position + self.shot_effect_offset,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("powder_proj", start_pos,

		effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
		local trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("powder_proj_trail", start_pos,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		trail.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

		table.insert(self.powder_proj_info_list, {
			is_active = false,
			start_pos = start_pos,
			target_pos = target_pos,
			current_pos = start_pos,
			time_passed = 0,
			duration = duration,
			speed = speed,
			height = 5,
			effect = effect,
			trail = trail,
			is_trail_end = false,
			is_shoot = false
		})

		local ar = self.powder_attack_range_list[i]
		battle_range_util.show(ar, self.powder_shot_duration)

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_powder_object(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.powder)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.powder then
		if self.time_passed >= self.powder_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_powder_shot_ready(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end

function local_class:update_powder_shot_ready(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.powder_proj_info_list) do
		if v.is_shoot then return end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(
				self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.powder_effect_scale_duration))
		v.effect.transform.localScale = 1 * progress * unity_class.vector3.one
		v.trail.transform.localScale = 1 * progress * unity_class.vector3.one

		if self.time_passed >= self.powder_shot_casting_duration then
			self:shoot_powder_shot(self.current_shot_count)
			v.is_shoot = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_powder_object(dt)
	if self.powder_proj_info_list == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.powder_proj_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			local progress = v.time_passed / v.duration
			if progress > 1 then
				--도착하면 딜 체크하고 이팩트는 사라지고
				--인분오브젝트 생성
				v.current_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(v.target_pos, battle_util.get_height(v.target_pos))
				self:update_powder_damage(v)

				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.powder_attack_range_list[_]))
				self.powder_attack_range_list[_]:Hide()
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("powder_proj_explosion", v.current_pos,
						unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("powder_proj_explosion")
				v.is_active = false
				v.is_trail_end = true
				v.time_passed = 0

				--인분오브젝트 생성
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'instantiate_powder_orb',
																						v.current_pos.x .. ', ' .. v.current_pos.y .. ', ' .. v.current_pos.z, -1}))
			else
				v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
				local h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * v.height
				local temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(v.start_pos, v.target_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * h
				v.current_pos = temp_pos
				v.effect.transform.localPosition = temp_pos
				v.trail.transform.localPosition = temp_pos
			end
		elseif v.is_trail_end then
			if v.time_passed >= self.powder_shot_trail_end_delay then
				if v.trail ~= nil then
					v.trail:Dispose()
					v.trail = nil
				end
				v.is_trail_end = false
			else
				v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_powder_damage(info)
	if info.is_active then
		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(info.current_pos, self.powder_radius)

		for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
					v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
			else
				local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(info.current_pos - v.Position).normalized
				if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
					dir = direction_util.to_vector3(v.Direction)
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = v
				damage_info.direction = dir
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = -dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end

		fo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.cs_shooter = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.proj_spec = nil
	self.powder_attack_range_list = nil
	self.powder_proj_info_list = nil
	self.marker_pos_list = nil
	self.random_marker_index_list = nil
	self.marker_pos_list = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {

		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,

	local random_index = {}
	local missile_idx = self.missile_count
	if missile_idx < 4 then
		missile_idx = 4
	end

	for i = 1, missile_idx do
		table.insert(random_index, i)
	end

	local center = self.battle_zone.center

	random_index = random_util.get_values_in_array(random_index, {count = missile_idx})
	local target_pos_offset_list = {}

	--1발은 무조건 타겟 근처에 떨어지도록
	local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, unity_class.random.Range(0, 360), 0)
			* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
	local random_range = unity_class.random.Range(0.1, 1)
	local target_pos = self.target.Position + dir * random_range
	table.insert(target_pos_offset_list, target_pos)

	for i = 1, self.missile_count - 1 do

				* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized

		local offset = dir * random_range

	if target_pos.x >= self.battle_zone.max.x - self.missile_radius then

function local_class:update_missile_shot(dt)

			if self.time_passed > self.missile_shot_start_delay then
				local missile_time = self.time_passed - self.missile_shot_start_delay
				if missile_time > self.current_missile_repeat_count * self.missile_interval then

local local_class = newclass('BossOberonPowderExplosionBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.battle_zone = nil

	--파라미터 파싱
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockbackForce", 1.1)

	self.wave_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WaveRadius", 10)
	self.explosion_delay_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDelayDuration", 1)
	self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionRadius", 1)
	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeMagnitude", 0.08)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeDuration", 2)

	self.radial_shot_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RadialShotCount", 6)

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.character)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	--인분AttackRange
	self.attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, 10 do
		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.explosion_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, ar)
	end

	-- event sub
	self.on_custom_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_event_func)

	self.target = nil
	self.destroy_orb_info_list = nil
	self.powder_orb_list = {}
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false

	self.target = target
	self.destroy_orb_info_list = {}
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action1", nil)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action2", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.destroy_orb_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_destroy_orb(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.action_duration
			if progress < 1 then
				local radius = progress * self.wave_radius
				--범위내에 인분오브가 있으면 폭파 대기

				self:destroy_powder_orb(radius)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(pos)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.explosion_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(pos - v.Position).normalized
			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(v.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = -dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:check_destroy_orb(id)
	for _,v in pairs(self.destroy_orb_info_list) do
		if v.id == id then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:destroy_powder_orb(radius)
	for _,v in pairs(self.powder_orb_list) do
		local dist = v.pos - self.character.Position
		if dist.magnitude < radius then
			--범위에 걸린 인분오브젝트 폭파
			if self:check_destroy_orb(v.id) then
				table.insert(self.destroy_orb_info_list, {
					is_active = true,
					id = v.id,
					destroy_delay_time_passed = self.explosion_delay_duration,
					pos = v.pos
				})
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_destroy_orb(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.destroy_orb_info_list) do
		if v.destroy_delay_time_passed > 0 and v.is_active then
			v.destroy_delay_time_passed = v.destroy_delay_time_passed - dt
		elseif v.is_active then
			self:shoot_radial_shot(v.pos)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
					{ 'remove_powder_orb', v.id}))
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", nil)
			self:update_damage(v.pos)
			v.is_active = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_radial_shot(pos)
	for i = 1, self.radial_shot_count do
		local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.radial_shot_count, 0)
				* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
		self.shoot_helper[1]:ShootDirectionAtPosition(pos + vector(0, 0.2, 0), dir, i, -1, nil, false, 0.3)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper[1] == nil or self.proj_spec[1] == nil then return true end
	self.shoot_helper[1]:OnHit(hit_info)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'powder_orb_created' then
		local orb_id = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		local orb_pos = self:string_to_vector(e:GetParamAt(2))

		--id 중복체크 후 테이블에 넣는다.
		if self:check_powder_orb(orb_id) then
			table.insert(self.powder_orb_list, {
				id = orb_id,
				pos = orb_pos})
		end
	end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'small_orb_destroyed' then
		for i = 1, #self.powder_orb_list do
			local orb_id = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
			if orb_id == self.powder_orb_list[i].id then
				table.remove(self.powder_orb_list, i)
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_powder_orb(id)
	for _,v in pairs(self.powder_orb_list) do
		if v.id == id then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

--'a, b, c' 형태의 string
function local_class:string_to_vector(str)
	local value_table = {}

	local start_idx = 1
	local idx = string.find(str, ',', start_idx)
	while idx ~= nil do
		table.insert(value_table, tonumber(string.sub(str, start_idx, idx - 1)))
		start_idx = idx + 2
		idx = string.find(str, ',', start_idx)
	end
	table.insert(value_table, tonumber(string.sub(str, start_idx)))

	if #value_table == 3 then
		return vector(value_table[1], value_table[2], value_table[3])
	end

	return vector(0,0,0)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_custom_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_event_func)
		self.on_custom_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.cs_shooter = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.proj_spec = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.destroy_orb_info_list = nil
	self.powder_orb_list = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossOberonSignalBeamBattleAction')

local orb = {
	g = -9.8,
	state = {
		none = 0,
		fly = 1,
		fall = 2,
	}
}

function orb:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.fall then

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self.position = self.target_pos
		self.fx.po:Dispose()
		self.fx.contrail:Dispose()
		self.fx = nil
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'instantiate_powder_orb', self.position.x .. ', ' .. self.position.y .. ', ' .. self.position.z, self.limit, self.instantiate_duration, self.instantiate_damage_modifier}))
		self:apply_fall_damage()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.none then
		if self.fx ~= nil then
			self.fx.po:Dispose()
			self.fx.contrail:Dispose()
			self.fx = nil
		end
	end
end

function orb:apply_fall_damage()
	self.calculator.Position = self.position

	self.calculator:Start()

	local objects = self.calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		local dir = vector_util.normalized(fo.Position - self.position)
		if vector_util.is_almost_zero(dir) then
			dir = vector_util.back
		end

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.fall_modifier
		damage_info.direction = dir
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = dir
		damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.fall_knock_back_force

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	self.calculator:End()
end

function orb:update_frame(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.fly then
		if self.time_passed > self.duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		else
			self:update_pos()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end
end

function orb:update_pos()
	self.position = self.start_pos + self.xz_direction * (self.xz_speed * self.time_passed) + vector_util.up * (self.y_speed * self.time_passed + self.g * self.time_passed ^ 2 / 2)
	self.fx.transform.position = self.position
end

function orb:shoot(duration, target_pos)
	local xz_dist = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - self.start_pos))
	local xz_speed = xz_dist / duration

	local y_speed = (target_pos.y - self.start_pos.y) / duration - 0.5 * self.g * duration

	self.xz_speed = xz_speed
	self.xz_direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - self.start_pos))
	self.y_speed = y_speed
	self.target_pos = target_pos
	self.duration = duration

	self:change_state(self.state.fly)
end

function orb:new(fx, start_pos, fall_radius, fall_modifier, fall_knock_back_force, explosion_limit)
	fx.transform.position = start_pos

	local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(fall_radius, 2, 1, -1)
	local calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, info)

	local orb_instance = {
		fx = fx,
		position = start_pos,
		start_pos = start_pos,
		time_passed = 0,
		current_state = self.state.none,

		calculator = calculator,
		fall_modifier = fall_modifier,
		fall_knock_back_force = fall_knock_back_force,
		limit = explosion_limit
	}

	setmetatable(orb_instance, {__index = orb})

	return orb_instance
end

	self.beam_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BeamSpeed', 7)
	self.beam_attack_duration = self.beam_length / self.beam_speed
	self.beam_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BeamDamageTerm', 0.5)
	self.beam_wave_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BeamWaveDelay', 0.2)
	self.beam_wave_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BeamWaveDuration', 0.5)
	self.beam_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BeamModifier', 1)
	self.beam_knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BeamKnockBackForce', 1)
	local beam_angle_list = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(params, 'BeamAngle')
	self.beam_angle = {}
	for i = 0, beam_angle_list.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.beam_angle, beam_angle_list[i])
	end
	self.airborne_key = 'airborne_area'
	self.airborne_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AirborneModifier', 1)
	self.beam_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(self.beam_length, self.beam_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.beam_trace_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BeamTraceDuration', 1.5)
	self.beam_range_fix_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BeamRangeFixDuration', 1)

	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(vector(self.beam_length, 2, self.beam_width), self.beam_wave_duration, -1)
	self.airborne_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, info)
	info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(vector(self.beam_height, 2, self.beam_width), self.beam_attack_duration, self.beam_damage_term)
	self.beam_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, info)

	--airborne_area
	self.airborne_area_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AirborneAreaDuration', 1)
	self.airborne_fx = nil
	self.airborne_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AirborneDelay', 0.2)
	self.airborne_table = {}
	self.use_airborne = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'UseAirborne', true)

	--explode_orb
	self.explode_orb_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplodeOrbDelay', 3) + self.airborne_delay

	self.action_duration = self.shoot_large_orb_duration - self.large_orb_duration + self.shoot_small_orb_duration + (self.beam_trace_duration + self.beam_attack_duration) * self.beam_count

	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 2)

	--groggy
	self.groggy_key = 'groggy'
	self.groggy_ani_time = 0.9
	self.groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'GroggyDuration', 3)
	self.groggy_camera_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'GroggyCameraDuration', 1.5)
	self.fail_camera_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FailCameraDuration', 1.5)
	self.groggy_ani_delay = 0.5

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		teleport = 1,
		cast = 2,
		shoot_large_orb = 3,
		shoot_small_orb = 4,
		cast_signal_beam = 5,
		trace_signal_beam = 6,
		shoot_signal_beam = 7,
		airborne_area = 8,
		explode_orb = 9,
		post = 10,
		groggy = 11,
	}
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = self.state.none

	self.subscribe_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)
	end
	self.small_orb_table = {}
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.subscribe_func)
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'powder_orb_created' then
		local id = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		local pos = self:string_to_vector(e:GetParamAt(2))
		table.insert(self.small_orb_table, {id = id, pos = pos})
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'small_orb_destroyed' then
		local id = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		for i = 1, #self.small_orb_table do
			if self.small_orb_table[i].id == id then
				table.remove(self.small_orb_table, i)
				return
			end
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'large_orb_destroyed' then
		if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
			self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
		end
	end
end

--'a, b, c' 형태의 string
function local_class:string_to_vector(str)
	local value_table = {}

	local start_idx = 1
	local idx = string.find(str, ',', start_idx)
	while idx ~= nil do
		table.insert(value_table, tonumber(string.sub(str, start_idx, idx - 1)))
		start_idx = idx + 2
		idx = string.find(str, ',', start_idx)
	end
	table.insert(value_table, tonumber(string.sub(str, start_idx)))

	if #value_table == 3 then
		return vector(value_table[1], value_table[2], value_table[3])
	end

	return vector(0,0,0)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(self.target) then
		return
	end

	self:configure_target_pos_candidate()
	self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
end

function local_class:configure_target_pos_candidate()
	self.small_orb_pos_candidate = {}

	for i = 1, self.marker_cnt do
		local marker = field:GetMarker(self.marker_prefix .. i)
		local rand_pos = marker.position + random_util.get_random_value() * self.marker_radius * vector(math.cos(random_util.get_random_value() * math.pi * 2), 0, math.sin(random_util.get_random_value() * math.pi * 2))
		table.insert(self.small_orb_pos_candidate, rand_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.character.Position = self:determine_teleport_pos()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		if self.character.Position.x < self.battle_zone.center.x then
			self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		else
			self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		end
		--방향설정
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_large_orb then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_small_orb then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast_signal_beam then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace_signal_beam then
		self.beam_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.beam_range))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_signal_beam then

		self:dispose_beam()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.airborne_area then
		if self.airborne_fx ~= nil then
			self.airborne_fx:Dispose()
			self.airborne_fx = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode_orb then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--fx
		--카메라 크기 설정, 고정
		self.origin_size = stage_camera.Size
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.action_cam_size, self.action_cam_duration)
		stage_camera:OverrideDefaultCameraSize(self.action_cam_size)
		stage_camera:Move(self.battle_zone.center, self.action_cam_duration, nil)

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		self.character.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		self:set_invincible()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)
		--애니 설정
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_large_orb then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--애니설정
		local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.shoot_large_orb_key)
		self:shoot_large_orb()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_small_orb then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.shoot_large_orb_key)

		self:shoot_small_orb()
		self.current_shoot_count = 1
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast_signal_beam then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_beam_count = 0
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_clara_boss_jump_01')
		self.prev_pos = self.character.Position

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace_signal_beam then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local angle = self.beam_angle[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.beam_angle)]
		while angle == self.current_angle do
			angle = self.beam_angle[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.beam_angle)]
		end
		self.current_angle = angle
		self.current_direction = vector(math.cos(self.current_angle / 180 * math.pi), 0, -math.sin(self.current_angle / 180 * math.pi))
		self.current_normal = vector(self.current_direction.z, 0, -self.current_direction.x)
		self:update_beam_info()
		self.beam_range:Show(self.beam_trace_duration)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_signal_beam then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:shoot_signal_beam()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.airborne_area then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.beam_length, self.beam_width, 0)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(range, self.current_start_pos, self.current_direction)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))

		table.insert(self.airborne_table, {
			start_pos = self.current_start_pos,
			direction = self.current_direction,
			range = range,
			time_passed = 0
		})

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode_orb then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.airborne_table = {}

		if self.prev_pos ~= nil then
			self.character.Position = self.prev_pos
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
			self.prev_pos = nil
		end
		if self.origin_size ~= nil and self.origin_size ~= stage_camera.Size then
			stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.origin_size, self.fail_camera_duration)
			stage_camera:ResetDefaultCameraSize()
			self.origin_size = nil
			stage_camera:Move(user_party, vector_util.zero, self.groggy_camera_duration, user_party)
		end
		self:remove_invincible()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.airborne_table = {}

		self.prev_pos = nil
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.battle_zone.center, battle_util.get_height(self.battle_zone.center))

		local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		self:remove_invincible()
		if self.origin_size ~= nil and self.origin_size ~= stage_camera.Size then
			stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.origin_size, self.groggy_camera_duration)
			stage_camera:ResetDefaultCameraSize()
			self.origin_size = nil
			stage_camera:Move(user_party, vector_util.zero, self.groggy_camera_duration, user_party)
		end

		self.beam_range:Hide()

		if self.crack_fx ~= nil then
			self.crack_fx:Dispose()
			self.crack_fx = nil
		end

		for i = #self.orb_list, 1, -1 do
			self.orb_list[i]:change_state(orb.state.none)
		end

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		if not self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.character))
		end

		self.airborne_table = {}

		if self.crack_fx ~= nil then
			self.crack_fx:Dispose()
			self.crack_fx = nil
		end

		if self.origin_size ~= nil and self.origin_size ~= stage_camera.Size then
			stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.origin_size, 0)
			stage_camera:ResetDefaultCameraSize()
			self.origin_size = nil
			if not user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				stage_camera:Move(user_party, vector_util.zero, self.groggy_camera_duration, user_party)
			end
		end

		self.beam_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.beam_range))

		for i = #self.orb_list, 1, -1 do
			self.orb_list[i]:change_state(orb.state.none)
		end

		self:remove_invincible()
		if self.prev_pos ~= nil then
			self.character.Position = self.prev_pos
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
			self.prev_pos = nil
		end

	end
end

function local_class:determine_teleport_pos()
	if self.target.Position.x > self.battle_zone.center.x then
		return vector(
				self.battle_zone.center.x - self.battle_zone.extents.x + self.teleport_offset,
				self.target.Position.y,
				random_util.get_random_value() * (self.battle_zone.extents.z - self.teleport_offset) * 2 - (self.battle_zone.extents.z - self.teleport_offset) + self.battle_zone.center.z)
	else
		return vector(
				self.battle_zone.center.x + self.battle_zone.extents.x - self.teleport_offset,
				self.target.Position.y,
				random_util.get_random_value() * (self.battle_zone.extents.z - self.teleport_offset) * 2 - (self.battle_zone.extents.z - self.teleport_offset) + self.battle_zone.center.z)
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_large_orb()
	local orb_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.shoot_large_orb_key, self.character.Position + self.large_orb_offset)
	local contrail_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('orb_contrail', self.character.Position + self.large_orb_offset, vector_util.zero, orb_fx.transform)

	local fx = {
		po = orb_fx,
		contrail = contrail_fx,
		transform = orb_fx.transform
	}
	local orb_instance = orb:new(fx, self.character.Position + self.large_orb_offset, self.fall_large_orb_radius, self.fall_large_orb_modifier, self.fall_large_orb_knock_back_force, self.action_duration)
	table.insert(self.orb_list, orb_instance)
	orb_instance:shoot(self.large_orb_duration, self.battle_zone.center)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.shoot_large_orb_key)
end

function local_class:shoot_small_orb()
	local orb_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.shoot_small_orb_key, self.character.Position + self.small_orb_offset)
	local contrail_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('orb_contrail', self.character.Position + self.small_orb_offset, vector_util.zero, orb_fx.transform)

	local fx = {
		po = orb_fx,
		contrail = contrail_fx,
		transform = orb_fx.transform
	}
	local orb_instance = orb:new(fx, self.character.Position + self.small_orb_offset, self.fall_small_orb_radius, self.fall_small_orb_modifier, self.fall_small_orb_knock_back_force, -1)
	table.insert(self.orb_list, orb_instance)
	orb_instance:shoot(self.small_orb_duration, table.remove(self.small_orb_pos_candidate, random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.small_orb_pos_candidate)))
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.shoot_small_orb_key)
end

function local_class:update_beam_info()
	self.current_start_pos = self:get_beam_center_pos() - self.beam_length / 2 * self.current_direction

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.beam_range, self.current_start_pos, self.current_direction, 0.1)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.beam_range))
end

function local_class:get_beam_center_pos()
	local rel_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.battle_zone.center)
	return vector_util.dot(rel_pos, self.current_normal) / vector_util.dot(self.current_normal, self.current_normal) * self.current_normal + vector_util.get_x0z(self.battle_zone.center)
end

function local_class:shoot_signal_beam()

	if self.current_angle == 0 or self.current_angle == 180 then
		self.beam_fx = {
			po = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.beam_key, self.current_start_pos)
		}

		if self.current_angle == 0 then
			self.beam_fx.po.transform.localScale = vector(1,1,1)
		else
			self.beam_fx.po.transform.localScale = vector(-1,1,1)
		end
	elseif self.current_angle == 90 then
		self.beam_fx = {
			po = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.beam_key .. '_down', self.current_start_pos)
		}
	elseif self.current_angle == -90 then
		self.beam_fx = {
			po = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.beam_key .. '_up', self.current_start_pos)
		}
	end
	self.beam_fx.transform = self.beam_fx.po.transform
	self.beam_calculator.Position = self.current_start_pos
	self.beam_calculator.Direction = self.current_direction
	self.crack_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('beam_crack', self.current_start_pos + self.current_direction * self.beam_length / 2, self.current_direction)
	self.beam_calculator:Start()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_light_laser_01')
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	self:update_airborne(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	for i = #self.orb_list, 1, -1 do
		self.orb_list[i]:update_frame(dt)
		if self.orb_list[i].current_state == orb.state.none then
			table.remove(self.orb_list, i)
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed > self.teleport_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.cast)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_large_orb)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_large_orb then
		if self.time_passed > self.shoot_large_orb_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_small_orb)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_small_orb then
		if self.time_passed > self.shoot_small_orb_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.cast_signal_beam)
		elseif self.small_orb_count > self.current_shoot_count and self.time_passed > self.small_orb_shoot_interval * self.current_shoot_count then
			self:shoot_small_orb()
			self.current_shoot_count = self.current_shoot_count + 1
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast_signal_beam then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_signal_beam_duration then
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, self.cast_signal_beam_duration * self.fly_speed)
			self:change_state(self.state.trace_signal_beam)
		else
			self.character.Position = self.character.Position + vector_util.up * (self.fly_speed * dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace_signal_beam then
		if self.time_passed > self.beam_trace_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_signal_beam)
		elseif self.time_passed < self.beam_range_fix_duration then
			self:update_beam_info()

		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_signal_beam then
		if self.time_passed > self.beam_attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.airborne_area)

		else
			self:update_beam(dt)

		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.airborne_area then
		self.current_beam_count = self.current_beam_count + 1

		if self.current_beam_count >= self.beam_count then
			self:change_state(self.state.explode_orb)

		else
			self:change_state(self.state.trace_signal_beam)

		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode_orb then
		--todo: 수정필요
		if self.time_passed > self.explode_orb_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed > self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.groggy_ani_delay and self.time_passed - dt < self.groggy_ani_delay then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.groggy_key)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.groggy_ani_time + self.groggy_ani_delay and self.time_passed - dt < self.groggy_ani_time + self.groggy_ani_delay then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.groggy_key .. '_loop')
		end

	end
end

function local_class:update_airborne(dt)

	for i = #self.airborne_table, 1, -1 do

		self.airborne_table[i].time_passed = self.airborne_table[i].time_passed + dt

		if self.airborne_table[i].time_passed > self.airborne_delay and self.airborne_table[i].time_passed - dt < self.airborne_delay then
			self:trigger_airborne(self.airborne_table[i].start_pos, self.airborne_table[i].direction)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.airborne_table[i].range))
			table.remove(self.airborne_table, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_invincible()
	if self.character.DamagedBehaviour ~= CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance then
		self.invincible = true
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	end
end
function local_class:remove_invincible()
	-- 아닌 경우에만 할당한다
	if not self.invincible then
		return
	end

	self.invincible = false

	if self.character.DamagedBehaviour ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) == false then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(CS.Oak.DeathType.None)
	end
end

function local_class:trigger_airborne(start_pos, direction)
	self.airborne_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.airborne_key, start_pos + direction * self.beam_length / 2, direction)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_lina_b_explosion_01')

	self.airborne_calculator.Position = start_pos + direction * self.beam_length / 2
	self.airborne_calculator.Direction = direction

	if self.crack_fx ~= nil then
		self.crack_fx:Dispose()
		self.crack_fx = nil
	end

	self.airborne_calculator:Start()

	local objects = self.airborne_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.airborne_modifier

		if self.use_airborne then
			local ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo()
			ailment_info.Ailment = CS.Oak.Ailment.Aerial
			ailment_info.AilmentGauge = 100
			damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, ailment_info, 1)
			damage_info.force_ailment = true
		else
			local normal = vector(direction.z, 0, -direction.x)
			local dir = vector_util.dot(fo.Position - start_pos, normal) > 0 and normal or -normal
			if vector_util.is_almost_zero(dir) then
				dir = vector_util.back
			end

			damage_info.direction = dir
			damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knock_back_dir = dir
			damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.beam_knock_back_force
		end

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	self.airborne_calculator:End()
end

function local_class:update_beam(dt)
	self.beam_calculator.Position = self.beam_calculator.Position + self.beam_speed * dt * self.current_direction
	self.beam_fx.transform.position = self.beam_calculator.Position

	for i = 1, #self.small_orb_table do
		if self:is_in_range(self.small_orb_table[i].pos) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'remove_powder_orb', tostring(self.small_orb_table[i].id) }))
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('destroy_orb', self.small_orb_table[i].pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('destroy_orb', self.small_orb_table[i].pos)
		end
	end

	local objects = self.beam_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		local dir = vector_util.dot(fo.Position - self.current_start_pos, self.current_normal) > 0 and self.current_normal or -self.current_normal
		if vector_util.is_almost_zero(dir) then
			dir = vector_util.back
		end

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.beam_modifier
		damage_info.direction = dir
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = dir
		damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.beam_knock_back_force

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:is_in_range(position)
	local rel_pos = position - self.beam_calculator.Position
	return math.abs(vector_util.dot(rel_pos, self.current_normal)) <= self.beam_width / 2
			and math.abs(vector_util.dot(rel_pos, self.current_direction)) <= self.beam_height / 2
end

function local_class:dispose_beam()
	self.beam_calculator:End()
	if self.beam_fx ~= nil then
		self.beam_fx.po:Dispose()
		self.beam_fx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	if self.subscribe_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		self.subscribe_func = nil
	end

	if orb ~= nil then
		orb.character = nil
		orb = nil
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
