local local_class = newclass('BossOberonTeleportBattleAction')

--zone center기준 랜덤 범위내에 텔레포트 한다.

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.battle_zone = nil

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_delay_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDelayDuration", 0.2)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.lock_direction = CS.Utils.GetDirectionFromDictionary(params, "LockDirection")
	self.side_only = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "SideOnly")
	self.show_attack_range = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowAttackRange", false)

	self.disable_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DisableDelay", 0.3)
	self.enable_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "enableDelay", 0.1)

	self.marker_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'MarkerName', 'red_marker_')
	self.marker_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MarkerCount", 8)

	local attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRadius", 1)
	local attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDelay", 0)
	local attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDuration", self.action_duration)
	self.random_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RandomRange", 3)

	-- 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = attack_duration
	info.Radius = attack_radius
	info.Height = 2
	info.IsCenterToBottom = true
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, attack_delay, 1)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, attack_radius)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.is_center_teleport = false
	self.is_disabled = false
	self:get_marker_list()

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

function local_class:get_marker_list()
	self.marker_pos_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.marker_count do
		local marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.marker_name .. i)
		table.insert(self.marker_pos_list, marker.position)
	end
end

function local_class:center_teleport()
	self.is_center_teleport = true
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false

	self.target = target
	self.is_disabled = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel(is_dispose)
	--dispose에서 불렸을 경우 SetActive()관련 동작은 하지 않는다.
	if is_dispose ~= true then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if self.show_attack_range then
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.is_center_teleport = false
		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local target_pos = self:get_teleport_position()
		local random_range = unity_class.random.Range(0, self.random_range)
		local dir = -(self.target.Position - self.battle_zone.center).normalized
		self.target_pos = target_pos + (dir * random_range)

		local dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(dir_to_look,
				CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.BattleAction))

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		if self.show_attack_range then
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)
			self.attack_range:Show(0)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		--순간이동 위치 이펙트
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		-- 이펙트 생성 및 순간이동 처리
		self.character.Position = self.target_pos
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", self.target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_pos
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:get_teleport_position()
	local final_dist = nil
	local target_pos
	for _,v in pairs(self.marker_pos_list) do
		local dist = self.target.Position - v
		if final_dist == nil then
			final_dist = dist.magnitude
			target_pos = v
		elseif math.abs(dist.magnitude) < final_dist then
			final_dist = dist.magnitude
			target_pos = v
		end
	end

	return target_pos
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if not self.is_disabled and self.time_passed >= self.disable_delay then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
			self.is_disabled = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.is_disabled and self.time_passed >= self.enable_delay then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
			self.is_disabled = false
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel(true)

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.marker_pos_list = nil
	self.marker_name = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false

	self.current_attack_count = 0
	self.target = target
	self.is_effect_start = false
	self.is_disabled = false
	self:change_state(self.state.teleport_prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel(is_dispose)
	--dispose에서 불렸을 경우 SetActive()관련 동작은 하지 않는다.
	if is_dispose ~= true then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if next_state ~= self.state.teleport then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.final_attack_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
		self.attack_range_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
		if self.current_attack_count % 2 == 1 then
			self.final_attack_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
			self.attack_range_pos = self.target_pos + vector(0, 0, self.bound_size.x / 2)
		else
			self.attack_range_pos = self.target_pos - vector(0, 0, self.bound_size.x / 2)
		end

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir, self.target_pos.y)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.attack_range_pos
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.final_attack_dir
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.current_attack_count = self.current_attack_count + 1
		self.is_effect_start = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if self.current_attack_count < self.attack_count then
			self.target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position + (self.target_dir * (self.rush_range + self.attack_offset)))

			self.final_attack_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
			if self.current_attack_count % 2 == 1 then
				self.final_attack_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
				self.attack_range_pos = self.target_pos + vector(0, 0, self.bound_size.x / 2)
			else
				self.attack_range_pos = self.target_pos - vector(0, 0, self.bound_size.x / 2)
			end
		end

		self.current_whip_sfx_count = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:get_teleport_pos()
	self.teleport_pos = self.battle_zone.center
	if self.battle_zone.center.x < self.target.Position.x then
		--우측면에있을 경우 캐릭터 좌측으로 이동
		self.teleport_pos = self.target.Position - unity_class.vector3.right * self.character.Bounds.extents.x
	else
		self.teleport_pos = self.target.Position - unity_class.vector3.left * self.character.Bounds.extents.x
	end

	local margin = self.bound_size.x / 2
	if self.teleport_pos.z > self.battle_zone.max.z - margin then
		self.teleport_pos.z = self.battle_zone.max.z - margin
	elseif self.teleport_pos.z < self.battle_zone.min.z + margin then
		self.teleport_pos.z = self.battle_zone.min.z + margin
	end

	self.target_dir = (self.target.Position - self.teleport_pos).normalized
	self.target_direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target_dir)
	self.target_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.target_direction)

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.target_dir)
	self.target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.teleport_pos + (self.target_dir * (self.rush_range + self.attack_offset)))

	self.character.Position = self.teleport_pos
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if not self.is_disabled and self.time_passed >= self.disable_delay then
			--순간이동 위치 이펙트
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
			self.is_disabled = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.is_disabled and self.time_passed >= self.enable_delay then
			self:get_teleport_pos()
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink", nil)
			self.is_disabled = false
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.current_attack_count < self.attack_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		else
			if not self.is_effect_start then
				if self.time_passed >= self.effect_delay then
					local effect = nil
					if self.target_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
						effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("left_action", self.character.Position + self.left_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					elseif self.target_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
						effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("right_action", self.character.Position + self.right_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					end

					effect.transform.parent = self.character.transform
					self.is_effect_start = true
				end
			end
			if self.time_passed <= self.rush_duration then
				--전진
				local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
				move_info.direction = self.target_dir
				move_info.magnitude = self.rush_range / self.rush_duration * dt
				local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir), false
				, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.SlipAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
			end

			if self.current_whip_sfx_count < self.whip_sfx_count and self.time_passed >= self.whip_sfx_start_delay +
					self.current_whip_sfx_count * self.whip_sfx_interval then
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("whip")
				self.current_whip_sfx_count = self.current_whip_sfx_count + 1
			end

			self:update_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		if string.find(fo.Name, 'small_powder_orb_') then
			self:remove_orb(fo.Name)
		end

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_harvester_01')

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:remove_orb(name)
	local i, j = string.find(name, 'small_powder_orb_')
	local start_index = j + 1
	local last_index = string.len(name)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'remove_powder_orb', string.sub(name, start_index, last_index) }))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.bound_size = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.target_pos = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossOberonWindBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

		none = 1,
		trace = 2,
		cast = 3,
		shoot = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	self.cast_key = 'cast'

	self.trace_duration = 'trace'
	self.trace_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TraceDuration', 1)

	self.origin_offset = vector(list[0], list[1], list[2])

	self.explosion_camera_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionCameraShakeDuration', 0.5)
	self.explosion_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionModifier', 0.3)
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(20, self.attack_radius * 2), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.use_powder_orb_bounce = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'UsePowderOrbBounce', false)

	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1)

	if self.use_powder_orb_bounce then
		local ps = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.character)
		local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec('proj_oberon_bounce')
		local pattern_info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()

		self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional, ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)
	end

			this.calculator:Start()
			this.calculator.Position = this.center_pos
			this.fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('storm', this.center_pos + self.character.Bounds.center.y * vector_util.up)
			--music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.sfx_key.storm)
			this.fx_transform = this.fx.transform
		end,

		deactivate = function(this)
			this.active_self = false

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, this.attack_range))

		end,

			end

			local fo_list = this.calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
				local target = fo_list[i]

				if target == user_party.Leader then
					hit = true
				else
					local direction = vector_util.normalized(target.Position - this.center_pos)
					if direction == vector_util.zero then
						direction = vector_util.back
					end

					local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
					damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = target
					damage_info.modifier = self.orb_modifier
					damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knock_back_dir = direction
					damage_info.knock_back_force = self.knock_back_force * CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce
					damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_simple_slash_hit_01')

					command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
				end
			end
			fo_list:Dispose()

			if hit then
				this:explode(true)
			end
		end,
		explode = function(this, immidiately)
			this.update_frame = this.update_explosion
			if immidiately then
				this.time_passed = self.orb_explosion_duration
			else
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(this.attack_range, this.center_pos)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, this.attack_range))
				this.attack_range:Show(self.orb_explosion_duration)
				this.time_passed = 0

		update_explosion = function(this, dt)
			this.time_passed = this.time_passed + dt
			if this.time_passed > self.orb_explosion_duration then
				this.explosion_calculator.Position = this.center_pos
				this.explosion_calculator:Start()

				for i = 1, #self.small_orb_table do
					if vector_util.distance(this.center_pos, self.small_orb_table[i].pos) < self.orb_explosion_radius + self.powder_orb_radius then
						message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'remove_powder_orb', tostring(self.small_orb_table[i].id) }))
					end
				end

				local fo_list = this.explosion_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
				for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
					local target = fo_list[i]

					local direction = vector_util.normalized(target.Position - this.center_pos)
					if direction == vector_util.zero then
						direction = vector_util.back
					end

					local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
					damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = target
					damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_modifier
					damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knock_back_dir = direction
					damage_info.knock_back_force = self.knock_back_force * CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

					command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
				end
				fo_list:Dispose()

				this.explosion_calculator:End()

				stage_camera:Shake(self.explosion_camera_shake, self.explosion_camera_duration)

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', this.center_pos)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', this.center_pos)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion2', this.center_pos)

		optimize_pos_and_direction = function(this)
			if this.current_direction == nil then
				this.center_pos = vector(
						unity_class.mathf.Clamp(this.center_pos.x, self.min_x, self.max_x),
						this.center_pos.y,
						unity_class.mathf.Clamp(this.center_pos.z, self.min_z, self.max_z)
				)
				return

				if this.center_pos.x < self.min_x then
					this.center_pos.x = self.min_x * 2 - this.center_pos.x

					this.current_direction.x = -this.current_direction.x

				elseif this.center_pos.x > self.max_x then
					this.center_pos.x = self.max_x * 2 - this.center_pos.x

					this.current_direction.x = -this.current_direction.x

				end

				if this.center_pos.z < self.min_z then
					this.center_pos.z = self.min_z * 2 - this.center_pos.z

					this.current_direction.z = -this.current_direction.z

				elseif this.center_pos.z > self.max_z then
					this.center_pos.z = self.max_z * 2 - this.center_pos.z

					this.current_direction.z = -this.current_direction.z
				end
			end
		end,
	}
	self.storm_table = {}

	--post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	self.subscribe_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)
	end
	self.small_orb_table = {}
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.subscribe_func)
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'powder_orb_created' then
		local id = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		local pos = self:string_to_vector(e:GetParamAt(2))
		table.insert(self.small_orb_table, {id = id, pos = pos})
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'small_orb_destroyed' then
		local id = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		for i = 1, #self.small_orb_table do
			if self.small_orb_table[i].id == id then
				table.remove(self.small_orb_table, i)
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

--'a, b, c' 형태의 string
function local_class:string_to_vector(str)
	local value_table = {}

	local start_idx = 1
	local idx = string.find(str, ',', start_idx)
	while idx ~= nil do
		table.insert(value_table, tonumber(string.sub(str, start_idx, idx - 1)))
		start_idx = idx + 2
		idx = string.find(str, ',', start_idx)
	end
	table.insert(value_table, tonumber(string.sub(str, start_idx)))

	if #value_table == 3 then
		return vector(value_table[1], value_table[2], value_table[3])
	end

	return vector(0,0,0)
end

function local_class:generate_storm_info()
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.attack_radius, 2, self.orb_life_time, -1)
	local explosion_collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.orb_explosion_radius, 2, 1, -1)
	local info = {
		fx = nil,
		center_pos = nil,
		calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, collision_info),
		explosion_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, explosion_collision_info),
		attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.orb_explosion_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward),

		time_passed = 0,
		move_time_passed = 0,
		current_direction = nil,
		idx = -1,

		active_self = false
	}
	setmetatable(info, {__index = self.storm_methods})
	return info
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(self.target) then
		return
	end

	if #self.storm_table ~= self.storm_pool_count then
		self:configure_storm_info()
	end
	self:change_state(self.state.cast)
end

function local_class:configure_storm_info()
	self.storm_table = {}
	for i = 1, self.storm_pool_count do
		table.insert(self.storm_table, self:generate_storm_info())
	end
end

function local_class:remove_all_storm()
	for i = 1, #self.storm_table do
		self.storm_table[i]:deactivate()
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace then
		if self.cast_fx ~= nil then
			self.cast_fx:Dispose()
			self.cast_fx = nil
		end

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.current_shoot_count = 0
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.cast_duration))

		local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))
		self.character.Direction = side_dir
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)

	elseif next_state == self.state.trace then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.storm_offset = self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left and self.origin_offset or vector(-self.origin_offset.x, self.origin_offset.y, self.origin_offset.z)
		local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + self.storm_offset
		self.cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_key, shoot_pos + vector_util.up * self.character.Bounds.center.y)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cast_key)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, shoot_pos, vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - shoot_pos))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range:Show(self.trace_duration + self.trace_post_delay)

	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + self.storm_offset
		if self.use_powder_orb_bounce then
			self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, vector_util.normalized(self.target_pos - shoot_pos))
		else
			for i = 1, #self.storm_table do
				if not self.storm_table[i].active_self then
					self.storm_table[i]:shoot(shoot_pos, vector_util.normalized(self.target_pos - shoot_pos))
					break
				end
			end
		end
		self.current_shoot_count = self.current_shoot_count + 1

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.shoot_key)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	for i = 1, #self.storm_table do
		if self.storm_table[i].update_frame ~= nil then
			self.storm_table[i]:update_frame(dt)
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed >= self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.trace)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace then
		if self.time_passed >= self.trace_duration + self.trace_post_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		elseif self.time_passed < self.trace_duration then
			self.target_pos = self.target.Position
			local pos = self.character.Position + self.storm_offset
			local dir = vector_util.normalized(self.target_pos - self.character.Position - self.storm_offset)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, pos, dir)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_duration then
			if self.current_shoot_count < self.storm_shoot_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.trace)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:remove_all_storm()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
	self.min_x = bound.center.x - bound.extents.x + self.attack_radius
	self.max_x = bound.center.x + bound.extents.x - self.attack_radius

	self.min_z = bound.center.z - bound.extents.z + self.attack_radius
	self.max_z = bound.center.z + bound.extents.z - self.attack_radius
end

function local_class:on_bounce(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return true
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not is_unity_null(self.shoot_helper) then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()

	if self.subscribe_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		self.subscribe_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossOrcaBigWaveBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 2)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)
	self.attack_anim_duration = 0.9

	-- 공격 파라미터
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1.1)
	self.knock_back_factor = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackFactor', CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorNormalStrong)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1)

	self.spawn_data_table = {}
	local has_value, spawn_monsters = params:TryGetValue('SpawnMonsters')
	if has_value then
		for _, info in pairs(spawn_monsters) do
			local monster_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(info, 'MonsterId', 104605)
			local offsets = CS.Utils.GetJsonObjectFromDictionary(info, 'SpawnOffsets')
			local x_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(offsets, 'X')
			local z_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(offsets, 'Z')
			local length = x_offsets.Count

			local spawn_data = {
				id = monster_id,
				offset_table = {}
			}

			for i = 0, length - 1 do
				table.insert(spawn_data.offset_table, unity_class.vector3(x_offsets[i], 0, z_offsets[i]))
			end

			table.insert(self.spawn_data_table, spawn_data)
		end
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.prepare_preset_name = 'prepare'
	self.wave_preset_name = 'action'

	-- 발사 포지션 조정용 스파인 본
	self.shoot_bone = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetBone(self.character.SpineController, 'bomb_target')

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	self.deck_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem().Deck

	self.is_loaded_flag = false
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.load_monster_routine, self))
end

function local_class:load_monster_routine()
	if self.is_loaded_flag then
		return
	end

	if self.spawn_data_table == nil or #self.spawn_data_table == 0 then
		self.is_loaded_flag = true
		return
	end

	self.is_loaded_flag = false

	self.spawn_monsters = {}
	for i = 1, #self.spawn_data_table do repeat
		local monster_id = self.spawn_data_table[i].id
		local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('Characters'):GetSpec(monster_id)
		if spec == nil then
			break
		end

		spec = spec:DeepClone()
		spec.ElementalType = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ElementalType

		local offset_table = self.spawn_data_table[i].offset_table
		for j = 1, #offset_table do
			local offset = offset_table[j]
			local loader = CS.Oak.CharacterLoader(spec)
			coroutine.yield(loader)

			local monster = loader.Character
			if monster == nil then
				break
			end

			local damaged_behaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterConstantDamagedBehaviour()
			damaged_behaviour.UseAura = false
			damaged_behaviour.UseFadeColor = false

			monster.Name = 'boss_orca_spawn_' .. monster_id .. '_' .. j
			monster.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0
			monster.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviour()
			monster.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.MonsterCharacterController()
			monster.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
			monster.DamagedBehaviour = damaged_behaviour
			monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
			monster.transform.parent = stage.StageTransform
			monster.Position = vector(999, 0 , 999)
			monster.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local
			CS.Oak.NetworkEntityManager.Instance:RegisterEntity(monster)
			--stage.CharacterManager:RegisterCharacterByName(monster)

			coroutine.yield(monster:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())
			character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'disabled')

			table.insert(self.spawn_monsters, {
				fo = monster,
				spawn_offset = offset
			})
		end

		break
	until true end

	self.is_loaded_flag = true
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return self.is_loaded_flag
end

function local_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.prepare_fx_played = false

		-- sfx
		local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('cast')
		if has_value then
			sfx_info.parent = nil
			music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')

		self:shoot()
		self:summon()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if not self.prepare_fx_played and self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration - 1 then
			self.prepare_fx_played = true

			-- 준비 이펙트
			-- 왼팔 폭탄 발사 위치 기준 조정
			local is_left = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character) == CS.Oak.Direction.Left
			local shoot_pos_left = CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.GetWorldPosition(
					self.shoot_bone, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
			local shoot_pos_right = shoot_pos_left + unity_class.vector3(is_left and -0.6 or 0.6, 0, 1.4)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.prepare_preset_name, shoot_pos_left, unity_class.vector3.left)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.prepare_preset_name, shoot_pos_right, unity_class.vector3.left)

			-- sfx
			local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('cast2')
			if has_value then
				sfx_info.parent = nil
				music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
			end
		end

		if self.prepare_duration <= self.time_passed then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.attack_anim_duration <= self.time_passed then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.post_duration <= self.time_passed then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot()
	local roaster_count = self.deck_system.Rosters.Count

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
	damage_info.direction = unity_class.vector3.left
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = unity_class.vector3.left
	damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

	for i = 0, roaster_count - 1 do repeat
		local roaster = self.deck_system.Rosters[i]
		if not roaster.IsPlaying then
			break
		end

		local member = roaster.Character
		damage_info.target = member
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, member) then
			damage_info.target = member
			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

			local summoned_list = summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)
			for _,summoned in ipairs(summoned_list) do
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, summoned) then
					damage_info.target = summoned
					command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
				end
			end
		end

		break
	until true end

	local forward_offset = 2
	local character_pos = self.character.Position
	local height = character_pos.y + 1
	local fx_pos = unity_class.vector3(character_pos.x - forward_offset, height, self.zone_bound.center.z)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.wave_preset_name, fx_pos, unity_class.vector3.left)

	-- sfx
	local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('attack')
	if has_value then
		sfx_info.parent = nil
		music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
	end
	has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('attack2')
	if has_value then
		sfx_info.parent = nil
		music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
	end
end

function local_class:summon()
	local battle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleFor(self.character)
	if battle == nil then
		return
	end

	for _, monster_data in ipairs(self.spawn_monsters) do repeat
		local monster = monster_data.fo
		local spawn_offset = monster_data.spawn_offset

		if monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Level ~= self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Level then
			local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
			local level = self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Level
			local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, level)
			monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:AddExp(exp)
		end

		monster.Position = self.character.Position + spawn_offset

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
		heal_info.sender = self.character
		heal_info.target = monster
		heal_info.heal = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		battle:AddEnemy(monster)
		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(monster, self.character.Direction)

		break
	until true end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		local dead_fo = e.FieldObject
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(dead_fo, self.character) then
			for _, monster_data in pairs(self.spawn_monsters) do repeat
				local fo = monster_data.fo
				if is_unity_null(fo) or fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
					break
				end

				local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
				damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
				damage_info.sender = fo

	action = nil,
	cs_battle_action = nil,

	duration = 1,
	projectile_fx_name = nil,

	projectile_fx = nil,
	base_pos = nil,
	target_pos = nil,
	index = 0,
}
bomb_class.mt = { __index = bomb_class }

function bomb_class:new(base_pos, target_pos, index)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.projectile_fx = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(self.projectile_fx_name, base_pos)
	obj.index = index
	obj.time_passed = 0
	obj.base_pos = base_pos
	obj.target_pos = target_pos

	obj.initial_distance = vector_util.distance(base_pos, target_pos)
	local y_diff = target_pos.y - base_pos.y
	obj.initial_vertical_speed = (self.cannon_gravity * self.duration) + y_diff / self.duration

	return obj
end

function bomb_class:set_data(parent_class, duration, projectile_fx_name)
	self.action = parent_class
	self.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	self.duration = duration
	self.projectile_fx_name = projectile_fx_name
end

function bomb_class:unset_data()
	self.action = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.duration = nil
	self.projectile_fx_name = nil
end

function bomb_class:update_frame(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.duration)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)

	local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.base_pos, self.target_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * self:get_current_height()
	effect_util.update_object(self.projectile_fx, pos)

	if progress == 1 then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function bomb_class:get_current_height()
	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		return 0
	end

	return self.initial_vertical_speed * self.time_passed - self.cannon_gravity * self.time_passed * self.time_passed
end

function bomb_class:dispose()
	if self.projectile_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.projectile_fx)

	end

	self.action = nil
	self.cs_action = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

function local_class:sort_target_dist()
	-- 거리가 먼 순서 파티 리스트
	local roaster_count = self.deck_system.Rosters.Count

	for i = 0, roaster_count - 1 do repeat
		local roaster = self.deck_system.Rosters[i]
		if not roaster.IsPlaying then
			break
		end

		local member = roaster.Character
		if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, member) then
			break
		end

		local data = {
			fo = member,
			dist = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, member.Position)
		}
		table.insert(self.sorted_targets, data)

		local summoned_list = summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)
		for _,summoned in ipairs(summoned_list) do
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, summoned) then
				local summoned_data = {
					fo = summoned,
					dist = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, summoned.Position)
				}
				table.insert(self.sorted_targets, summoned_data)
			end
		end

		break
	until true end
	table.sort(self.sorted_targets, function(a, b) return a.dist > b.dist end)

	local get_closest = function()
		for i = #self.sorted_targets, 1, -1 do
			local target = self.sorted_targets[i].fo
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
				return target
			end
		end

		return self.target
	end

	local get_target = function(shoot_count)
		if #self.sorted_targets < shoot_count then
			return get_closest()
		end

		local count = 0
		for _, data in ipairs(self.sorted_targets) do repeat
			if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, data.fo) then
				break
			end
			count = count + 1
			if count == shoot_count then
				return data.fo
			end

			break
		until true end

		return get_closest()
	end

	self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1
	local target_pos = get_target(self.shoot_count).Position

	local index = 0
	while true do
		index = index + 1
		if self.bomb_list[index] == nil then
			break
		end
	end

	local shoot_pos = CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.GetWorldPosition(
			self.shoot_bone, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
	local new_bomb = bomb_class:new(shoot_pos, target_pos, index)
	self.bomb_list[index] = new_bomb

	if index > #self.attack_range_list then
		local new_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(target_pos, self.attack_radius,
				CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(new_attack_range, target_pos)
		new_attack_range:Show(self.attack_range_duration)
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, new_attack_range)
		return
	end

	-- 어택레인지
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_list[index], target_pos)
	self.attack_range_list[index]:Show(self.attack_range_duration)

	-- 발사 이펙트
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.shoot_preset_name, shoot_pos)

	local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('attack')
	if has_value then
		sfx_info.parent = nil
		music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
	end
end

function local_class:explode(index)
	local get_new_damage_info = function(fo, direction)
		local damage = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp_mod(fo) * self.damage_rate);

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.direction = direction
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = direction
		damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

		if self.elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.None then
			damage_info.damage = damage
		elseif self.elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Fire then
			damage_info.damage = damage
		elseif self.elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Ice then
			damage_info.damage = damage
		elseif self.elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Earth then
			damage_info.damage = damage
		elseif self.elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Light then
			damage_info.damage = damage
		elseif self.elemental_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Darkness then
			damage_info.damage = damage
		end

		return damage_info
	end

	local expiring_bomb = self.bomb_list[index]
	local target_pos = expiring_bomb.target_pos
	expiring_bomb:dispose()
	self.bomb_list[index] = nil

	-- 폭발 이펙트
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_preset_name, target_pos)

	-- sfx
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', target_pos)

	-- 원형 범위 데미지
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(target_pos, self.attack_radius)
	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - target_pos))

			if vector_util.magnitude(direction) == 0 then
				direction = unity_class.vector3.left
			end

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(get_new_damage_info(fo, direction))
		end
	end
	collide_objs:Dispose()

	-- 어택레인지
	self.attack_range_list[index]:Hide()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	bomb_class:unset_data()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.bomb_list = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil

	self.deck_system = nil
	self.sorted_targets = nil

	self.shoot_bone = nil
end

	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,

	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')

		local target_pos = unity_class.vector3(
				self.current_x_pos,
				self.target.Position.y + 0.1,
				self.zone_bound.center.z
		)
		self.attack_calculator.Position = target_pos
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_preset, target_pos)

		-- 발사 이펙트
		local offset_1 = self.muzzle_offset_1
		local offset_2 = self.muzzle_offset_2
		if character_util.get_look_direction(self.character) == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			offset_1.x = -offset_1.x
			offset_2.x = -offset_2.x
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.muzzle_fire_preset, self.character.Position + offset_1)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.muzzle_fire_preset, self.character.Position + offset_2)

		self.shell_count = 0

		-- sfx
		local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('attack')
		if has_value then
			sfx_info.parent = nil
			self.attack_sfx_holder = music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.prepare_duration <= self.time_passed then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		elseif self.range_move_duration > self.time_passed then
			local x_diff = self.target.Position.x - self.current_x_pos
			local move_amount = math.min(self.range_move_speed * dt, math.abs(x_diff))
			move_amount = x_diff > 0 and move_amount or - move_amount
			self.current_x_pos = self.current_x_pos + move_amount

			local range_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.current_x_pos, self.target.Position.y, self.zone_bound.min.z)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, range_pos, unity_class.vector3.forward, self.character.Position.y)
			--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.shoot_duration <= self.time_passed then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:shoot(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.post_duration <= self.time_passed then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot(dt)
	self.attack_calculator.Position = unity_class.vector3(self.current_x_pos, self.target.Position.y, self.zone_bound.center.z)

	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do repeat
		local fo = objects[index]

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.base_obj) then
			if self.base_hit_count >= self.base_max_hit_count then break end
			self.base_hit_count = self.base_hit_count + 1
		end

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = unity_class.vector3.left

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction

			if self.knock_back_force >= 0 then
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.knock_back_factor
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force
			end

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	until true end
	objects:Dispose()

	if self.time_passed > self.shell_count * 0.1 then
		self.shell_count = self.shell_count + 1

		-- 탄피 이펙트
		local has_value, object_pool = self.cs_battle_action.PresetInfos:TryGetValue(self.bullet_shell_case_preset)
		if has_value then
			local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.character)
			center.y = self.character.Position.y

			-- 위쪽(오른손)은 어차피 가려지거나 보스 위로 출력되는게 어색하므로 제외함
			local random_angle_1 = (random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5) * 10
			--local random_angle_2 = (random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5) * 10
			local bounce_dir_vector_1 = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_angle_1, 0) * unity_class.vector3.left
			--local bounce_dir_vector_2 = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_angle_2, 0) * unity_class.vector3.left
			CS.Oak.ActionEffectHelper.RequestCartridgeBounce(center + self.cartridge_offset_1, bounce_dir_vector_1, object_pool)
			--CS.Oak.ActionEffectHelper.RequestCartridgeBounce(center + self.cartridge_offset_2, bounce_dir_vector_2, object_pool)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	local zone_height = self.zone_bound.size.z

	-- 공격 범위 표시기 생성
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,

return {

		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then

	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.prepare_duration <= self.time_passed then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_delay)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_delay then
		--- 애니메이션 타임라인 이벤트 대기
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.shoot_duration <= self.time_passed then
			self:update_hook_shot(1)
			self:apply_damage(self.target_pos)
			self:change_state(self.state.delay)
		else
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.shoot_duration
			self:update_hook_shot(progress)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.delay then
		if self.delay_duration <= self.time_passed then
			self:change_state(self.state.pull)
		else
			-- 캐릭터, 스파인 본 포지션 변경 대비
			self:update_hook_shot(1)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pull then
		if self.pull_duration <= self.time_passed then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.pull_duration))
			self:update_hook_shot(1 - progress, true)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.post_duration <= self.time_passed then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_hook_shot(progress, is_reverse)
	is_reverse = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_reverse, false)

	if self.hook_shot == nil then
		return
	end

	local min_dist = 1.5
	local from = CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.GetWorldPosition(
			self.shoot_bone, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
	from = unity_class.vector3(from.x, self.target_pos.y, from.y + from.z)

	if is_reverse then
		local diff = self.target_pos - from
		local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
		local target_dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
		local min_rate = min_dist / target_dist
		if progress < min_rate then
			-- end 모션에 있는 갈고리에 맞게 정렬
			local original_progress = progress
			progress = min_rate
			local look_dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
			dir = look_dir_vector * (min_rate - original_progress) / min_rate + dir * original_progress / min_rate
			local to = from + dir * min_rate * target_dist
			self.hook_shot:SetFromTo(from, to)
			return
		end
	end

	local to = from * (1 - progress) + self.target_pos * progress
	self.hook_shot:SetFromTo(from, to)
end

function local_class:apply_damage(target_pos)
	-- 원형 범위 데미지
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(target_pos, self.attack_radius)
	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - target_pos))

			if vector_util.magnitude(direction) == 0 then
				direction = unity_class.vector3.left
			end

			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor
			damage_info.knock_back_dir = direction
			damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end
	collide_objs:Dispose()

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_preset_name, target_pos)
	stage_camera:Shake(0.15, 0.1)

	-- sfx
	local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('explosion')
	if has_value then
		sfx_info.parent = nil
		music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
	end
end

function local_class:search_target_pos()
	local roaster_count = self.deck_system.Rosters.Count
	if roaster_count == 0 then
		return unity_class.vector3.zero, 0
	end

	local target_pos, max, max_possible = self:simple_search_target_pos()
	local break_num = math.min(max_possible, self.target_search_count)
	for i = 0, roaster_count - 2 do
		for j = i + 1, roaster_count - 1 do repeat
			-- 대상 카운트가 최댓값이거나 대상 카운트가 일정 이상이면 탐색 중지
			if max >= break_num then
				break
			end

			local roaster_a = self.deck_system.Rosters[i]
			if not roaster_a.IsPlaying then
				break
			end

			local roaster_b = self.deck_system.Rosters[j]
			if not roaster_b.IsPlaying then
				break
			end

			local pos_a = roaster_a.Character.Position
			pos_a = unity_class.vector2(pos_a.x, pos_a.z)
			local pos_b = roaster_b.Character.Position
			pos_b = unity_class.vector2(pos_b.x, pos_b.z)

			-- 두 점을 지나고 반지름이 정해진 원의 중심점 2개 반환, 끝부분을 기준으로 하면 조금 어색해서 반지름을 약간 줄여서 계산
			local has_value, center_a, center_b = CS.GeometryUtils.TwoPointsWithRadiusToCenter(
					pos_a, pos_b, self.attack_radius * 0.9
			)

			if not has_value then
				break
			end

			local count_a = 0
			local fo_list_a = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(vector_util.get_x0z(center_a), self.attack_radius)
			for n = 0, fo_list_a.Count - 1 do
				local fo = fo_list_a[n]
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					count_a = count_a + 1
				end
			end
			fo_list_a:Dispose()

			local count_b = 0
			local fo_list_b = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(vector_util.get_x0z(center_b), self.attack_radius)
			for n = 0, fo_list_b.Count - 1 do
				local fo = fo_list_b[n]
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					count_b = count_b + 1
				end
			end
			fo_list_b:Dispose()

			if count_a <= count_b and max < count_b then
				target_pos = center_b
				max = count_b
			elseif count_b <= count_a and max < count_a then
				target_pos = center_a
				max = count_a
			end

			break
		until true end

		-- 대상 카운트가 최댓값이거나 대상 카운트가 일정 이상이면 탐색 중지
		if max >= break_num then
			break
		end
	end

	-- 타겟 포지션 타겟들 중앙으로 다시 계산
	if max > 1 then
		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos), self.attack_radius)
		local target_count = 0
		target_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
		for n = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
			local fo = fo_list[n]
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				target_pos = target_pos + fo.Position
				target_count = target_count + 1
			end
		end
		fo_list:Dispose()

		target_pos = target_pos / target_count
	end

	return target_pos, max
end

function local_class:simple_search_target_pos()
	local roaster_count = self.deck_system.Rosters.Count
	if roaster_count == 0 then
		return self.target.Position, 0
	end

	local max_possible = 0

	local max = 0
	local target_pos = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem().EndCondition.HasBaseObject and CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem().EndCondition.BaseObject.Position or vector_util.zero
	for i = 0, roaster_count - 1 do repeat
		local roaster = self.deck_system.Rosters[i]
		if not roaster.IsPlaying then
			break
		end

		max_possible = max_possible + 1

		local member = roaster.Character
		local count = 0
		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(vector_util.get_x0z(member.Position), self.search_range)
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				count = count + 1
			end
		end
		fo_list:Dispose()

		if max < count then
			max = count
			target_pos = member.Position
		end

		local summoned_list = summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)
		max_possible = max_possible + #summoned_list
	until true end

	return target_pos, max, max_possible
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행

	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action

	self.critical_chance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CriticalDamageChance", 0.5)
	self.critical_damage_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SuperDamageScale", 1.5)

	self.shot_effect_offset = self:get_shot_effect_data(params, "ShotEffectOffset")

	self.camera_size = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraSize', 10)
	self.camera_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraDuration', 2)

	--AttackRange
	self.attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.arrow_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, ar)

function local_class:get_shot_effect_data(params, data_name)
	local has_value, value = params:TryGetValue(data_name)

	local offset_list = {}
	if has_value then
		for _, info in pairs(value) do
			local index = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(info, "Index", _)

			local offset_data = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(info, "Offset")

			local offset = vector(offset_data[1], offset_data[2], offset_data[3])

			table.insert(offset_list, offset)
		end
	end

	return offset_list
end

function local_class:get_shot_effect_offset(dir)
	local pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return self.shot_effect_offset[1]
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return self.shot_effect_offset[2]
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return self.shot_effect_offset[3]
	elseif CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return self.shot_effect_offset[4]
	end

function local_class:is_loaded()

function local_class:trigger()

		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	self:set_battle_zone(battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position))

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false
	self.arrow_info_list = {}

	self.is_critical_attack = false

	--강공 발동 여부
	if CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
		if random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance then
			self.is_critical_attack = true
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 9)--강공 여부
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
		end
	end

	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.show_target_arrow and target or nil)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		if v ~= nil then
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
			self.casting_effect:Dispose()
			self.casting_effect = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)

		for i, v in pairs(target_list) do
			if v ~= nil and summonable_util.get_master(v) == nil then
				local pos = self:check_target_pos(v.Position)
				local ar = self.attack_range_list[i + 1]
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, pos)
				battle_range_util.show(ar, self.prepare_duration)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

				table.insert(self.arrow_info_list, {
					target = v,
					index = i + 1,
					pos = pos
				})
			end
		end

		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_duration)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, unity_class.vector3.left)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
		self.casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prepare", self.character.Position +
				self:get_shot_effect_offset(CS.Oak.Direction.Left))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		for _,v in pairs(self.arrow_info_list) do
			stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, v.pos,
					self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('bomb_shot'), self.aoe_spec, self.on_aoe_hit_func, nil, nil)
			self.attack_range_list[_]:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_list[_]))
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", self.character.Position +
				self:get_shot_effect_offset(CS.Oak.Direction.Left))
		effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 45)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(self.camera_duration)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(0.1)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			if not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.synced = true
				local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
				local target_count = #self.arrow_info_list
				trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 1)
				trigger_info_util.append_number(info, target_count)
				for _,v in pairs(self.arrow_info_list) do
					trigger_info_util.append_position(info, v.pos)
				end
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
			end
			--self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.tracking_duration then
				self:update_attack_range(dt)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	for i, v in pairs(self.arrow_info_list) do
		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.target.Position - v.pos).normalized
		local diff = math.abs(vector_util.get_x0z(v.target.Position - v.pos).magnitude)

		if diff > 0.05 then
			local new_pos = v.pos + dir * dt * self.tracking_speed
			new_pos = self:check_target_pos(new_pos)
			v.pos = new_pos
			local ar = self.attack_range_list[i]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, new_pos)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_target_pos(dest_pos)
	local final_dest_pos = dest_pos

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self:get_zone_bounds()
	end

	if dest_pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x + (self.arrow_radius - self.wall_margin) then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x + (self.arrow_radius - self.wall_margin)
	end
	if dest_pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x - (self.arrow_radius - self.wall_margin) then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x - (self.arrow_radius - self.wall_margin)
	end
	if dest_pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z + (self.arrow_radius - self.wall_margin) then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z + (self.arrow_radius - self.wall_margin)
	end
	if dest_pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z - (self.arrow_radius - self.wall_margin) then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z - (self.arrow_radius - self.wall_margin)
	end

	return final_dest_pos
end

function local_class:get_zone_bounds()
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
end

-- 장판에 데미지 주기 위한 콜백
function local_class:on_aoe_hit(fo, dir, param1, param2)
	if not is_unity_null(fo) then
		self:update_damage(fo, dir)
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(fo, dir)
	local damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier
	if self.is_critical_attack then
		damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier + self.damage_modifier * self.critical_damage_rate
	end

	if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
	end

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
	damage_info.direction = dir
	damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
	damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * 1.1

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	if idx == 1 then
		local count = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 1))
		for i = 0, count - 1 do
			if self.arrow_info_list[i + 1] ~= nil then
				self.arrow_info_list[i + 1].pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, i)
			end
		end
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end

	return false
end

	self.character = nil

	self.current_state = nil

	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.arrow_info_list = nil
	self.character_direction = nil

function local_class:start(info)
