		return
	end

	self.is_shot = false
	self.target = target
	self.target_dir = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.synced = false
	self.is_finish_backstep = false
	if self.proj_info ~= nil then
		if self.proj_info.proj_effect ~= nil then
			self.proj_info.proj_effect:Dispose()
			self.proj_info.proj_effect = nil
		end
		if self.proj_info.contrail_effect ~= nil then
			self.proj_info.contrail_effect:Dispose()
			self.proj_info.contrail_effect = nil
		end
		self.proj_info = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)

function local_class:cancel()

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.backstep_time_passed = 0
		self.backstep_progress = 0
		self.backstep_direction = -self.target_dir

		--벽근처면 중앙으로 뛰게?
		if self:check_battle_zone_by_wall() then
			self.backstep_direction = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) *
					vector_util.get_x0z(self.zone_bounds.center - self.character.Position).normalized
		end
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("back_step")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("back_step", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:check_battle_zone_by_wall()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.backstep_distance + 0.5)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			return true
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
	return false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.proj_info ~= nil then
		self:update_proj(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.backstep_duration then
				self:update_backstep(dt)
			else
				self.shoot_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
				self:shoot_proj()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_proj()
	if not self.is_shot then
		local shot_pos = self.character.Position + self:get_shot_effect_offset(self.character_direction)
		shot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(shot_pos, 0.1)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shot")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shot", shot_pos)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot", nil)
		local proj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj", shot_pos)
		local contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_contrail", shot_pos)
		local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
				unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(self.shoot_dir)).eulerAngles.y
		proj.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)
		contrail.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)
		self.proj_info = {
			pos = shot_pos,
			proj_effect = proj,
			contrail_effect = contrail,
			time_passed = 0,
			dir = self.shoot_dir,
			is_active = true,
			is_contrail_remove_delay = false
		}
		self.attack_calculator.Position = shot_pos
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.is_shot = true
		self:change_state(self.state.post)
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj(dt)
	if self.proj_info.is_active then
		if self.proj_info.time_passed < self.proj_duration then
			self.proj_info.time_passed = self.proj_info.time_passed + dt
			local calc_pos = self.proj_info.pos + dt * self.proj_speed * self.proj_info.dir
			self.attack_calculator.Position = calc_pos
			self.proj_info.time_passed = self.proj_info.time_passed + dt
			self.proj_info.pos = calc_pos
			self.proj_info.proj_effect.transform.position = calc_pos
			self.proj_info.contrail_effect.transform.position = calc_pos
			self:update_proj_damage(dt)
		else
			self:remove_proj()
		end
	end

	if self.proj_info.is_contrail_remove_delay then
		if self.proj_info.time_passed < self.proj_contrail_delay then
			self.proj_info.time_passed = self.proj_info.time_passed + dt
		else
			if self.proj_info.contrail_effect ~= nil then
				self.proj_info.contrail_effect:Dispose()
				self.proj_info.contrail_effect = nil
			end

			self.proj_info = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_proj()
	if self.proj_info ~= nil then
		self.proj_info.is_active = false
		self.proj_info.is_contrail_remove_delay = true
		self.proj_info.time_passed = 0
		if self.proj_info.proj_effect ~= nil then
			self.proj_info.proj_effect:Dispose()
			self.proj_info.proj_effect = nil
		end
	end
	if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj_damage(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.proj_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = self.target_dir
			damage_info.stun_factor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.stun_duration = self.stun_duration

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
			self:remove_proj()
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_backstep(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(self.backstep_time_passed, 0, 1, self.backstep_duration)
	local movement = progress - self.backstep_progress
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.backstep_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.backstep_distance * movement

	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
	self.character_direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
	local lock_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.character_direction)

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(lock_dir), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.backstep_time_passed = self.backstep_time_passed + dt
	self.backstep_progress = progress

	local speed = self.backstep_distance / self.backstep_duration
	local movement = speed * dt
	local sorted_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_collided_by(self.character.Bounds,
			speed * dt * self.target_dir)
	local dists = sorted_list.Keys
	local ifos = sorted_list.Values
	for i = 0, ifos.Count - 1 do
		local ifo = ifos[i]

		if (ifo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and
				not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(ifo.CrashBehaviour) then
			self.shoot_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

			local lock_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(self.shoot_dir))
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(lock_dir))

			self:shoot_proj()
		end
	end
	sorted_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:sync(info)

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	if self.proj_info ~= nil then
		if self.proj_info.proj_effect ~= nil then
			self.proj_info.proj_effect:Dispose()
			self.proj_info.proj_effect = nil
		end
		if self.proj_info.contrail_effect ~= nil then
			self.proj_info.contrail_effect:Dispose()

		end

end

	self.synced = false
	self.target = target
	self.synced_target_dir = nil
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.is_camera_shake = false
	self.is_target_seach = false

	--강공 발동 여부
	if CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
		if random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance then
			self.is_critical_attack = true
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 9)--강공 여부
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
		end
	end
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.show_target_arrow and target or nil)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self.attack_range:Hide()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

	if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
	end
	if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
		self.casting_effect:Dispose()
		self.casting_effect = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
			self.casting_effect:Dispose()
			self.casting_effect = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		self.character_direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.is_target_seach = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
		self.casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prepare", self.character.Position +
				self:get_shot_effect_offset(self.character_direction))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("earthquake", self.character.Position)
		local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
				unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_dir)).eulerAngles.y
		effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", self.character.Position + self.shot_effect_offset)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
				self:update_attack_range(dt)
				self:set_character_diration()
			elseif not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.synced = true
				self:sync_target_dir()
				self:set_character_diration()
			elseif self.synced and self.synced_target_dir ~= nil and self.target_dir ~= nil then
				if self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
					self:update_sync_dir(dt)
					self:set_character_diration()
				end
			end

			if self.show_target_arrow and self.time_passed > self.target_search_duration and self.is_target_seach then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
				self.is_target_seach = false
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_damage(dt)

			if not self.is_camera_shake and self.time_passed >= self.attack_delay then
				stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
				self.is_camera_shake = true
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_character_diration()
	--케스팅시간동안 캐릭터 방향 수정
	local new_direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
	if self.character_direction ~= new_direction then
		self.character_direction = new_direction
		if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
			self.casting_effect.transform.position = self.character.Position + self:get_shot_effect_offset(self.character_direction)
		end
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character_direction)
	end
end

function local_class:sync_target_dir()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 5)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.target_dir)
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	--호스트의 마지막 TargetDir에 맞춰서 싱크
	if idx == 5 then
		self.synced_target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		--현재 로컬의 target_dir이 sync로 날라온 dir과 다르다면 자연스럽게 이동시켜준다.
		if self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
			self.synced_dir_move_speed = 15
			--TODO: 현재 셋팅상 대기시간이 너무 짧기때문에 바로 싱크 옮겨줌
			self.target_dir = self.synced_target_dir
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
		-- 만약 확정된 타겟이 ai와 다른 경우
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.character)) then
			-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
			command_util.publish_change_target(self.character, self.target)
		end
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:update_sync_dir(dt)
	local diff = math.abs((self.synced_target_dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.1 then
		local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - self.synced_target_dir).normalized * dt * self.synced_dir_move_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = move_dir
	else
		self.target_dir = self.synced_target_dir
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	if dir.magnitude <= 0.05 then
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
	end

	local diff = math.abs((dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.05 then
		local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - dir).normalized * dt * self.tracking_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = move_dir
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier + (self.damage_modifier * self.critical_damage_rate)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.target_dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.shot_effect_offset = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.synced_target_dir = nil
	self.character_direction = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, 800014)
		self.character.Position = self.zone_bound.center
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('teleport', self.character.Bounds.center, direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction))
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('teleport')
		stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(self.camera_duration)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, 800014)
		stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(0.1)
		--fx

	end
end

function local_class:hide_all_range()
	for i = 1, #self.current_ranges do
		self.current_ranges[i].attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.current_ranges[i].attack_range))

	end
end

function local_class:activate_attack_calculators()
	for i = 1, #self.current_ranges do
		self.current_ranges[i].calculator:Start()
	end
end

function local_class:deactivate_attack_calculator()
	for i = 1, #self.current_ranges do
		self.current_ranges[i].calculator:End()
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed < self.trace_duration then
			self:determine_attack_range(false)

		elseif self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)

		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		if self.time_passed > self.jump_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fly)
			return
		end

		if self.character.Position.y < self.jump_height then
			self.character.Position = self.character.Position + vector_util.up * self.jump_speed * dt
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fly then
		if self.time_passed > self.current_instantiate_time and self.time_passed - dt < self.current_instantiate_time then
			self.fly_fx = {
				po = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.target_fx_name, field:GetMarker(self.start_marker_name).position),
			}
			self.fly_fx.transform = self.fly_fx.po.transform

		elseif self.time_passed > self.current_instantiate_time and self.time_passed < self.fx_duration + self.current_instantiate_time then
			self.fly_fx.transform.position = self.fly_fx.transform.position + self.fly_dir * self.fly_speed * dt

		elseif self.time_passed > self.fx_duration + self.current_instantiate_time then
			self.fly_fx.po:Dispose()
			self.fly_fx = nil

			self:change_state(self.state.attack)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		if self.time_passed > self.attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_attack(dt)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:determine_attack_range(force_update)
	local center_count = 0

	local targets = battle_manager_util.get_targets(self.character)
	for i = 1, #targets do
		if targets[i].Position.x > self.zone_bound.center.x - self.center_width / 2
				and targets[i].Position.x < self.zone_bound.center.x + self.center_width / 2 then
			center_count = center_count + 1
		end
	end

	local is_center = false

	if #targets == 2 * center_count and self.is_random_decided then
		return
	elseif #targets == 2 * center_count then
		self.is_random_decided = true
		if random_util.get_random_value() > 0.5 then
			is_center = false
		else
			is_center = true
		end
	elseif #targets > 2 * center_count then
		self.is_random_decided = false
		is_center = false
	elseif #targets < 2 * center_count then
		self.is_random_decided = false
		is_center = true
	end

	if force_update or is_center ~= self:is_current_range_center() then
		local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
		info:AppendNumber(is_center and 1 or 2)
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
	end
end

function local_class:is_current_range_center()
	return #self.current_ranges == 1 and true or false
end

function local_class:set_attack_range(is_center)
	if is_center then
		self.current_ranges = {
			self.center_range
		}
	else
		self.current_ranges = {
			self.left_range,
			self.right_range
		}
	end
end

function local_class:show_attack_range(left_time)
	if #self.current_ranges == 1 then
		self.left_range.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.left_range.attack_range))
		self.right_range.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.right_range.attack_range))
		self.center_range.attack_range:Show(left_time)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.center_range.attack_range))
	elseif #self.current_ranges == 2 then
		self.left_range.attack_range:Show(left_time)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.left_range.attack_range))
		self.right_range.attack_range:Show(left_time)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.right_range.attack_range))
		self.center_range.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.center_range.attack_range))
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.current_ranges do
		local fo_list = self.current_ranges[i].calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.attack_modifier * self.current_damage_scale
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force
			if lua_helper.type_compare(fo, CS.Oak.Character) then
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite(fo.Direction))
			end
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if info:GetNumberAt(0) == 1 then
		self:set_attack_range(true)
	else
		self:set_attack_range(false)
	end
	self:show_attack_range(self.prepare_duration - self.time_passed)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	--return bool
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.center_range = nil
	self.left_range = nil
	self.right_range = nil

	self.current_ranges = nil

	self.state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	self.info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	self.info:AppendNumber(random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance and 1 or 0)

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	end

	self:initialize_attack_ranges()
	self:determine_first_attack()
	self:determine_second_attack()
	self:determine_last_attack()
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	end
	if info:GetNumberAt(0) == 1 then
		self.current_damage_scale = self.critical_scale + 1
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
	else
		self.current_damage_scale = 1
	end

	self:initialize_attack_ranges()
	self:determine_first_attack(info)
	self:determine_second_attack(info)
	self:determine_last_attack(info)

	--화살표 안나오도록
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, nil)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:initialize_attack_ranges()
	--zone 기반으로 각 candidate 초기화
	if #self.first_attack_infos ~= 0 or #self.second_attack_infos ~= 0 then
		self:retrieve_attack_ranges()
	elseif #self.first_attack_candidates ~= self.first_attack_candidate_count then
		self:generate_attack_ranges()
	end
end

function local_class:retrieve_attack_ranges()
	for i = #self.first_attack_infos, 1, -1 do
		table.insert(self.first_attack_candidates, table.remove(self.first_attack_infos, i))
	end
	table.sort(self.first_attack_candidates, function(a,b) return a.pos.x < b.pos.x  end)

	for i = #self.second_attack_infos, 1, -1 do
		table.insert(self.second_attack_candidates, table.remove(self.second_attack_infos, i))
	end
	table.sort(self.second_attack_candidates, function(a,b) return a.pos.z < b.pos.z  end)
end

function local_class:generate_attack_ranges()
	self.first_attack_length = self.zone_bound.extents.z * 2
	self.second_attack_length = self.zone_bound.extents.x * 2
	local attack_start_pos = self.zone_bound.center + vector_util.left * self.zone_bound.extents.x + vector_util.forward * self.zone_bound.extents.z
	local first_attack_interval = self.zone_bound.extents.x * 2 / (self.first_attack_candidate_count + 1) * vector_util.right

	for i = 1, self.first_attack_candidate_count do
		--attackrange & calculator 쌍 생성
		local pos = attack_start_pos + first_attack_interval * i
		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, vector(self.first_attack_length, self.first_attack_width))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, pos, vector_util.back, 0.05)
		attack_range:Hide()

		local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
		info.Direction = vector_util.back
		info.Center = attack_range.transform.position
		info.DamageTerm = self.first_damage_term
		info.Duration = 2
		info.Size = unity_class.vector3(self.first_attack_length, 1, self.first_attack_width)
		local calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

		table.insert(self.first_attack_candidates, {
			pos = pos,
			attack_range = attack_range,
			calculator = calculator
		})
	end

	local second_attack_interval = self.zone_bound.extents.z * 2 / (self.second_attack_candidate_count + 1) * vector_util.back
	for i = 1, self.second_attack_candidate_count do
		--attackrange & calculator 쌍 생성
		local pos = attack_start_pos + second_attack_interval * i
		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, vector(self.second_attack_length, self.second_attack_width))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, pos, vector_util.right, 0.05)
		attack_range:Hide()

		local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
		info.Direction = vector_util.right
		info.Center = attack_range.transform.position
		info.DamageTerm = self.second_damage_term
		info.Duration = 2
		info.Size = unity_class.vector3(self.second_attack_length, 1, self.second_attack_width)
		local calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

		table.insert(self.second_attack_candidates, {
			pos = pos,
			attack_range = attack_range,
			calculator = calculator
		})
	end

	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
			vector_util.zero, vector(self.zone_bound.extents.x * 2, (self.zone_bound.extents.z - self.side_safe_zone_width) * 2))
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range, self.zone_bound.center, 0.05)
	attack_range:Hide()

	local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = attack_range.transform.position
	info.DamageTerm = self.last_damage_term
	info.Duration = self.last_attack_duration
	info.Size = vector(self.zone_bound.extents.x * 2, 1, (self.zone_bound.extents.z - self.side_safe_zone_width) * 2)
	local calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
	self.side_safe_attack_ranges = {
		{
			attack_range = attack_range,
			calculator = calculator
		}
	}

	local size = vector(self.zone_bound.extents.x * 2, (self.zone_bound.extents.z - self.center_safe_zone_width / 2))
	local attack_range_up = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, size)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range_up, self.zone_bound.center + vector_util.forward * (self.zone_bound.extents.z - size.y / 2), 0.05)
	attack_range_up:Hide()
	local attack_range_down = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, size)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range_down, self.zone_bound.center + vector_util.back * (self.zone_bound.extents.z - size.y / 2), 0.05)
	attack_range_down:Hide()

	info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = attack_range_up.transform.position
	info.DamageTerm = self.last_damage_term
	info.Duration = self.last_attack_duration
	info.Size = vector(self.zone_bound.extents.x * 2, 1, (self.zone_bound.extents.z - self.center_safe_zone_width / 2))
	local calculator_1 = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = attack_range_down.transform.position
	info.DamageTerm = self.last_damage_term
	info.Duration = self.last_attack_duration
	info.Size = vector(self.zone_bound.extents.x * 2, 1, (self.zone_bound.extents.z - self.center_safe_zone_width / 2))
	local calculator_2 = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
	self.center_safe_attack_ranges = {
		{
			attack_range = attack_range_up,
			calculator = calculator_1
		},
		{
			attack_range = attack_range_down,
			calculator = calculator_2
		}
	}
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.prepare_fx:Dispose()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

function local_class:determine_first_attack(info)
	local except_num = random_util.get_random_int(2, self.first_attack_candidate_count - 1)
	local left_area_num = random_util.get_random_int(math.max(1, self.first_attack_count - self.first_attack_candidate_count + except_num), math.min(except_num - 1, self.first_attack_count - 1))

	for i = 1, self.first_attack_count do
		if info == nil then
			local rand
			if i <= left_area_num then
				rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, except_num - 1)
				except_num = except_num - 1
			else
				rand = random_util.get_random_int(except_num + 1, #self.first_attack_candidates)
			end

			self.info:AppendInteger(rand)
			table.insert(self.first_attack_infos, table.remove(self.first_attack_candidates, rand))
		else
			local to_remove = info:GetIntegerAt(i - 1)
			table.insert(self.first_attack_infos, table.remove(self.first_attack_candidates, to_remove))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:determine_second_attack(info)
	local except_num = random_util.get_random_int(2, self.second_attack_candidate_count - 1)
	local left_area_num = random_util.get_random_int(math.max(1, self.second_attack_count - self.second_attack_candidate_count + except_num), math.min(except_num - 1, self.second_attack_count - 1))

	for i = 1, self.second_attack_count do
		if info == nil then
			local rand
			if i <= left_area_num then
				rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, except_num - 1)
				except_num = except_num - 1
			else
				rand = random_util.get_random_int(except_num + 1, #self.second_attack_candidates)
			end

			self.info:AppendInteger(rand)
			table.insert(self.second_attack_infos, table.remove(self.second_attack_candidates, rand))
		else
			local to_remove = info:GetIntegerAt(self.first_attack_count + i - 1)
			table.insert(self.second_attack_infos, table.remove(self.second_attack_candidates, to_remove))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:determine_last_attack(info)
	if info == nil then
		local rand = random_util.get_random_value()
		self.info:AppendNumber(rand)
		if rand > 0.5 then
			self.current_attack_ranges = self.center_safe_attack_ranges
		else
			self.current_attack_ranges = self.side_safe_attack_ranges
		end
	else
		if info:GetNumberAt(1) > 0.5 then
			self.current_attack_ranges = self.center_safe_attack_ranges
		else
			self.current_attack_ranges = self.side_safe_attack_ranges
		end
	end
end


function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		if self.time_passed > self.jump_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_attack_first)
			return
		end

		if self.character.Position.y < self.jump_height then
			self.character.Position = self.character.Position + vector_util.up * self.jump_speed * dt
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_attack_first then
		if self.time_passed > self.first_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.attack_first)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_first then
		if self.time_passed > self.first_attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_attack_second)
			return
		end

		if self.time_passed <= self.first_attack_damage_duration then
			self:update_first_attack(dt)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_attack_second then
		if self.time_passed > self.second_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.attack_second)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_second then
		if self.time_passed > self.second_attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_attack_third)
			return
		end

		if self.time_passed <= self.second_attack_damage_duration then
			self:update_second_attack(dt)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_attack_third then
		if self.time_passed > self.third_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.attack_third)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_third then
		if self.time_passed > self.third_attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_attack_last)
			return
		end

		if self.time_passed <= self.third_attack_damage_duration then
			self:update_third_attack(dt, self.time_passed > self.third_attack_interval)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_attack_last then
		if self.time_passed > self.last_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.attack_last)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_last then
		if self.time_passed > self.last_attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
			return
		end

		if self.time_passed <= self.last_attack_damage_duration then
			self:update_last_attack(dt)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end

end

function local_class:update_first_attack(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.first_attack_infos do
		local fo_list = self.first_attack_infos[i].calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.first_attack_modifier * self.current_damage_scale
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.first_attack_knock_back_force

			if lua_helper.type_compare(fo, CS.Oak.Character) then
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite(fo.Direction))
			end
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:add_wind_road_attack_calc()

			vector(self.wind_road_distance, bounds_util.get_size(self.character).y, self.wind_road_width),
			self.wind_road_duration, self.wind_road_damage_term, true)
	local cl = area_collision_util.create(self.character,
			info, true, 0, 99)
	table.insert(self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list, cl)
end

function local_class:get_attack_calc()
	if #self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list == 0 then
		self:add_wind_road_attack_calc()
	end

	local calc = self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list[1]
	table.remove(self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list, 1)

	return calc
end

function local_class:remove_attack_calc(calc)
	table.insert(self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list, calc)
end

function local_class:on_aggro_change_event(e)

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.Target) then
			self.target = e.Target
			self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			--타겟표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 변경된 타겟을 보내 줌
			if self.show_target_arrow then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false
	self.target = target
	self.is_start_wind_attack = false
	self.wind_road_time_passed = 0
	self.wind_road_effect_list = {}
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.is_target_seach = false

	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.show_target_arrow and target or nil)

	--강공 발동 여부
	if CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
		if random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance then
			self.is_critical_attack = true
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 9)--강공 여부
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
	end
	if self.wave_effect ~= nil then
		self.wave_effect:Dispose()
		self.wave_effect = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	if self.wind_road_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.wind_road_info_list) do
			for _,v2 in pairs(v.effect_list) do
				if v2 ~= nil then
					v2:Dispose()
					v2 = nil
				end
			end

			for i = 2, 1, -1 do
				if v.calc_list ~= nil and v.calc_list[i] ~= nil then
					v.calc_list[i]:End()
					local clac = v.calc_list[i]
					table.remove(v.calc_list, i)
					self:remove_attack_calc(clac)
				end
			end
			v.calc_list = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end

		if self.wave_effect ~= nil then
			self.wave_effect:Dispose()
			self.wave_effect = nil
		end

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		self.character_direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character_direction)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.is_target_seach = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		self.wave_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", self.character.Position)
		local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
				unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_dir)).eulerAngles.y
		self.wave_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.wind_road_info_list ~= nil and #self.wind_road_info_list > 0 then
		for i = #self.wind_road_info_list, 1, -1 do
			local info = self.wind_road_info_list[i]
			if info.time_passed < self.wind_road_duration then
				info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt
				self:update_wind_road_damage(dt, info.calc_list, info.target_dir)
			else
				for j = 2, 1, -1 do
					if info.calc_list ~= nil and info.calc_list[j] ~= nil then
						info.calc_list[j]:End()
						local clac = info.calc_list[j]
						table.remove(info.calc_list, j)
						self:remove_attack_calc(clac)
					end
				end
				info.calc_list = nil

				for _,v in pairs(info.effect_list) do
					if v ~= nil then
						v:Dispose()
						v = nil
					end
				end
				table.remove(self.wind_road_info_list, i)
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
				self:update_attack_range(dt)
				self:set_character_diration()
			elseif not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.synced = true
				self:sync_target_dir()
				self:set_character_diration()
			elseif self.synced and self.synced_target_dir ~= nil then
				if self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
					self:update_sync_dir(dt)
					self:set_character_diration()
				end
			end

			if self.show_target_arrow and self.time_passed > self.target_search_duration and self.is_target_seach then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
				self.is_target_seach = false
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_damage(dt)

			if self.time_passed >= self.wind_attack_delay and not self.is_start_wind_attack then
				self:start_wind_attack()
				self.is_start_wind_attack = true
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_character_diration()
	--케스팅시간동안 캐릭터 방향 수정
	local new_direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
	if self.character_direction ~= new_direction then
		self.character_direction = new_direction
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character_direction)
	end
end

function local_class:update_wind_road_damage(dt, calc_list, target_dir)
	if calc_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(calc_list) do
			local objects = v:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) and
						not lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.FanTotemBehaviour) then
					local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
					damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.wind_road_damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = target_dir
					damage_info.stun_factor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.stun_duration = self.stun_duration
					damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_snow_01')

					command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_wind_attack()
	local effect_list = {}
	local calc_list = {}
	local target_dir = self.target_dir
	local pos = self.character.Position
	for i = 1, 2 do
		self.current_wind_road_count = self.current_wind_road_count + 1
		local angle = (self.attack_angle / 2) / 1 * (i - 1)
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle - (self.attack_angle / 4), 0) * target_dir

		local ac = self:get_attack_calc()
		ac.Position = pos
		ac.Direction = dir
		ac:Start()
		table.insert(calc_list, ac)

		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wind_road", pos)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("wind_road", nil)
		local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
				unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(dir)).eulerAngles.y
		effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)
		table.insert(effect_list, effect)
	end
	table.insert(self.wind_road_info_list, {
		time_passed = 0,
		target_dir = target_dir,
		effect_list = effect_list,
		calc_list = calc_list
	})
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	if dir.magnitude <= 0.05 then
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
	end

	local diff = math.abs((dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.05 then
		local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - dir).normalized * dt * self.tracking_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = move_dir
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

			local damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier + self.damage_modifier * self.critical_damage_rate
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.target_dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:sync_target_dir()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 5)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.target_dir)
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	--호스트의 마지막 TargetDir에 맞춰서 싱크
	if idx == 5 then
		self.synced_target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		--현재 로컬의 target_dir이 sync로 날라온 dir과 다르다면 자연스럽게 이동시켜준다.
		if self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
			self.synced_dir_move_speed = 15
		end

		self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
		-- 만약 확정된 타겟이 ai와 다른 경우
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.character)) then
			-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
			command_util.publish_change_target(self.character, self.target)
		end
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:update_sync_dir(dt)
	local diff = math.abs((self.synced_target_dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.1 then
		local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - self.synced_target_dir).normalized * dt * self.synced_dir_move_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = move_dir
	else
		self.target_dir = self.synced_target_dir
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.on_aoe_hit_func = nil
	self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.wind_road_effect_list = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.synced_target_dir = nil
	self.character_direction = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.jump_time_passed = 0
	self.target_pos = nil
	self.current_pos = nil
	self.jump_start_pos = nil
	self.synced_target_pos = nil
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.is_target_seach = false
	self.jump_trail_effect = nil

	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.show_target_arrow and target or nil)

	--강공 발동 여부
	if CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
		if random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance then
			self.is_critical_attack = true
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 9)--강공 여부
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
	end

	if self.jump_trail_effect ~= nil then
		self.jump_trail_effect:Dispose()
		self.jump_trail_effect = nil
	end

	if self.is_immune then
		self:remove_immune()
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		if self.jump_trail_effect ~= nil then
			self.jump_trail_effect:Dispose()
			self.jump_trail_effect = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.target_pos = self:check_target_pos(self.target.Position)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target.Position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		self.is_target_seach = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.jump_start_pos = self.character.Position
		self.current_pos = self.jump_start_pos
		self.is_jump_active = true
		self.is_stomp_sound = false

		local dist = (self.target_pos - self.jump_start_pos).magnitude
		self.jump_move_duration = dist / self.jump_speed

		self:set_immune()

		self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("contrail",
				self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.jump_trail_effect.transform.parent = self.character.transform
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_pos
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
		local lock_dir = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, lock_dir)

		self:remove_immune()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		--self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", nil)
		--idle애니
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_immune()
	buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, 800014, 9999, false, false)
	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.is_immune = true
end

function local_class:remove_immune()
	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, 800014)
	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	self.is_immune = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed < self.prepare_duration then
			--TODO: 어택레인지 추적
			if self.time_passed < self.tracking_duration then
				self:update_attack_range(dt)
			elseif not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.synced = true
				self:sync_target_position()
			elseif self.synced and self.synced_target_pos ~= nil then
				if self.target_pos ~= self.synced_target_pos then
					self:update_sync_pos(dt)
				end
			end

			if self.show_target_arrow and self.time_passed > self.target_search_duration and self.is_target_seach then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
				self.is_target_seach = false
			end
		elseif CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
			--TODO: 점프위치 확정되면 싱크
			self.synced = true
			local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
			info:AppendNumber(1)
			info:AppendPosition(self.target_pos)
			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.jump_move_duration - 0.1 and not self.is_stomp_sound then
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", nil)
				self.is_stomp_sound = true
			end
			if self.is_jump_active then
				self:update_stomp_move(dt)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.action)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_sync_pos(dt)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.synced_target_pos - self.target_pos).normalized
	local diff = math.abs(vector_util.get_x0z(self.synced_target_pos - self.target_pos).magnitude)

	local new_pos = self.target_pos + dir * dt * self.synced_pos_move_speed
	if diff > 0.05 then
		self.target_pos = new_pos
	else
		self.target_pos = self.synced_target_pos
	end
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:sync_target_position()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 5)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target_pos)
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:check_target_pos(dest_pos)
	local final_dest_pos = dest_pos

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self:get_zone_bounds()
	end

	if dest_pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x + self.stomp_radius then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.stomp_radius
	end
	if dest_pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x - self.stomp_radius then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x - self.stomp_radius
	end
	if dest_pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z + self.stomp_radius then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z + self.stomp_radius
	end
	if dest_pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z - self.stomp_radius then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z - self.stomp_radius
	end

	return final_dest_pos
end

function local_class:get_zone_bounds()
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.target_pos).normalized
	local diff = math.abs(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.target_pos).magnitude)

	if diff > 0.05 then
		local new_pos = self.target_pos + dir * dt * self.tracking_speed

		local dist = math.abs(vector_util.get_x0z(new_pos - self.character.Position).magnitude)
		if dist > self.max_distance then
			local new_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
			new_pos = self.character.Position + new_dir * self.max_distance
		end

		new_pos = self:check_target_pos(new_pos)

		self.target_pos = new_pos
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, new_pos)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end
end

function local_class:update_stomp_move(dt)
	if self.is_jump_active then
		local progress = self.jump_time_passed / self.jump_move_duration
		if progress > 1 then
			self.current_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos, battle_util.get_height(self.target_pos))

			self.is_jump_active = false
		else
			self.jump_time_passed = self.jump_time_passed + dt
			local h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * self.jump_height
			local temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.jump_start_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
					+ unity_class.vector3.up * h
			self.current_pos = temp_pos
			self.character.Position = self.current_pos
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier + self.damage_modifier * self.critical_damage_rate
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	--싱크
	if idx == 1 then
		self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self:change_state(self.state.jump)
	end

	--호스트의 마지막 TargetDir에 맞춰서 싱크
	if idx == 5 then
		self.synced_target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		--현재 로컬의 target_pos이 sync로 날라온 dir과 다르다면 자연스럽게 이동시켜준다.
		if self.target_pos ~= self.synced_target_pos then
			local diff = (self.synced_target_pos - self.target_pos).magnitude
			self.synced_pos_move_speed = diff / (self.prepare_duration - self.tracking_duration)
		end

		self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
		-- 만약 확정된 타겟이 ai와 다른 경우
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.character)) then
			-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
			command_util.publish_change_target(self.character, self.target)
		end
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.target_pos = nil
	self.current_pos = nil
	self.jump_start_pos = nil
	self.death_type = nil
	self.synced_target_pos = nil
	self.jump_trail_effect = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		return false

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prepare", self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local storm_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("storm",
				self.target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.is_start_storm = true
		self.storm_time_passed = 0

		local attack_calc = self:init_attack_calc()
		attack_calc.Position = self.target_pos
		attack_calc:Start()

		table.insert(self.storm_info_list, {
			attack_calc = attack_calc,
			is_active = true,
			effect = storm_effect,
			time_passed = 0,
			target_pos = self.target_pos,
			is_critical_attack = self.is_critical_attack
		})

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.storm_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.storm_info_list) do
			if v.is_active then
				if v.time_passed < self.storm_duration + self.storm_lef_duration then
					v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
					if v.time_passed < self.storm_duration then
						self:update_storm(dt, v)
					end
					self:update_damage(dt, v)
				else
					if v.attack_calc ~= nil then
						v.attack_calc:End()
					end
					v.is_active = false
					if v.effect ~= nil then
						v.effect:Dispose()
						v.effect = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed < self.prepare_duration then
			--TODO: 어택레인지 추적
			if self.time_passed < self.tracking_duration then
				self:update_attack_range(dt)
			end
		elseif CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
			self.synced = true

			local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
			info:AppendNumber(1)
			info:AppendPosition(self.target_pos)
			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.target_pos).normalized
	local diff = math.abs(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.target_pos).magnitude)

	if diff > 0.05 then
		local new_pos = self.target_pos + dir * dt * self.tracking_speed

		self.target_pos = new_pos
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, new_pos)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end
end

function local_class:update_storm(dt, info)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - info.target_pos).normalized
	local diff = math.abs(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - info.target_pos).magnitude)

	if diff > 0.05 then
		local new_pos = info.target_pos + dir * dt * self.storm_speed
		info.attack_calc.Position = new_pos
		info.effect.transform.position = new_pos
		info.target_pos = new_pos
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt, info)
	if not info.attack_calc.IsStarted then
		info.attack_calc:Start()
	end
	local objects = info.attack_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier
			if info.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier + (self.damage_modifier * self.critical_damage_rate)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.storm_knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	--싱크
	if idx == 1 then
		self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.target_pos = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.casting_effect = nil
	self.storm_info_list = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossPanTripleShotBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action

	--self.enhanced_proj_attack_calculator_list = {}
