function local_class:get_shot_effect_data(params, data_name)
	local has_value, value = params:TryGetValue(data_name)

	local offset_list = {}
	if has_value then
		for _, info in pairs(value) do
			local index = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(info, "Index", _)

			local offset_data = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(info, "Offset")

			local offset = vector(offset_data[1], offset_data[2], offset_data[3])

			table.insert(offset_list, offset)
		end
	end

	return offset_list
end

function local_class:get_shot_effect_offset(dir)
	local pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return self.shot_effect_offset[1]
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return self.shot_effect_offset[2]
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return self.shot_effect_offset[3]
	elseif CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return self.shot_effect_offset[4]
	end

	return pos
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.Create(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, nil, dir, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false
	self.target_dir = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.current_shot_count = 0
	self.target = target
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.is_casting_effect = false
	self:dispose_proj_info()
	self.proj_info_list = {}

	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.show_target_arrow and target or nil)
	--강공 발동 여부
	if CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
		if random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance then
			self.is_critical_attack = true
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 9)--강공 여부
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:dispose_proj_info()
	if self.proj_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.proj_info_list) do
			if v.proj_effect ~= nil then
				v.proj_effect:Dispose()
				v.proj_effect = nil
			end
			if v.contrail_effect ~= nil then
				v.contrail_effect:Dispose()
				v.contrail_effect = nil
			end
		end
		self.proj_info_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
		self.casting_effect:Dispose()
		self.casting_effect = nil
	end

	self:dispose_proj_info()

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
			self.casting_effect:Dispose()
			self.casting_effect = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.triple_shot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_shot_count = self.current_shot_count + 1
		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
		self.character_direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character_direction)

		local shot_pos = self.character.Position + self:get_shot_effect_offset(self.character_direction)
		shot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(shot_pos, 0.1)
		self:shoot_proj(shot_pos, self.target_dir, false, self.current_shot_count)
		self.synced = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shot")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.casting then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("casting")

		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
		self.character_direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
		self.is_casting_effect = true
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("casting", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.triple_shot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local shot_pos = self.character.Position + self:get_shot_effect_offset(self.character_direction)
		shot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(shot_pos, 0.1)

		for i = 1, 3 do
			local angle = self.triple_shot_angle / 2 * (i - 1)
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle - (self.triple_shot_angle / 2), 0) * self.target_dir
			self:shoot_proj(shot_pos, dir, true, 2 + i)
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("triple_shot")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shot", self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("triple_shot", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:shoot_proj(pos, dir, is_enhanced, index)
	local proj, contrail

	local damage_mod, enhanced
	if not is_enhanced then
		proj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj", pos)
		contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_contrail", pos)
		damage_mod = self.proj_damage_modifier
		enhanced = true
	else
		proj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_b", pos)
		contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_b_contrail", pos)
		damage_mod = self.enhanced_proj_damage_modifier
		enhanced = false
	end
	local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
			unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(dir)).eulerAngles.y
	proj.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)
	contrail.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)
	self.proj_attack_calculator_list[index].Position = pos
	self.proj_attack_calculator_list[index]:Start()
	local info = {
		index = index,
		pos = pos,
		proj_effect = proj,
		contrail_effect = contrail,
		time_passed = 0,
		dir = dir,
		is_active = true,
		is_contrail_remove_delay = false,
		damage_mod = damage_mod,
		is_enhanced = enhanced
	}
	if self.proj_info_list == nil then
		self.proj_info_list = {}
	end

	table.insert(self.proj_info_list, info)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.proj_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_proj(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed < self.prepare_duration then
		elseif not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
			self:sync_shot(self.current_shot_count)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			if self.current_shot_count < 2 then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.casting)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		if self.time_passed < self.casting_duration then
			--케스팅시간동안 캐릭터 방향맞출거면 해제

			if self.is_casting_effect and self.time_passed >= self.casting_effect_delay then
				self.is_casting_effect = false
				self.casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("casting", self.character.Position +
						self:get_shot_effect_offset(self.character_direction))
			end

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
			local new_direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
			if self.character_direction ~= new_direction then
				self.character_direction = new_direction
				if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
					self.casting_effect.transform.position = self.character.Position + self:get_shot_effect_offset(self.character_direction)
				end
				battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character_direction)
			end

		elseif not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
			self:sync_shot(self.current_shot_count)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.triple_shot then
		if self.time_passed < self.triple_shot_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj(dt)
	for i = #self.proj_info_list, 1, -1 do
		local info = self.proj_info_list[i]
		if info.is_active then
			if info.time_passed < self.proj_duration then
				info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt
				local calc_pos = info.pos + dt * self.proj_speed * info.dir
				self.proj_attack_calculator_list[info.index].Position = calc_pos
				info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt
				info.pos = calc_pos
				info.proj_effect.transform.position = calc_pos
				info.contrail_effect.transform.position = calc_pos
				self:update_proj_damage(dt, self.proj_attack_calculator_list[info.index], info.dir, info)
			else
				self:remove_proj(info)
			end
		end

		if info.is_contrail_remove_delay then
			if info.time_passed < self.proj_contrail_delay then
				info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt
			else
				if info.contrail_effect ~= nil then
					info.contrail_effect:Dispose()
					info.contrail_effect = nil
				end

				table.remove(self.proj_info_list, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_proj(info)
	if info ~= nil then
		info.is_active = false
		info.is_contrail_remove_delay = true
		info.time_passed = 0
		if info.proj_effect ~= nil then
			info.proj_effect:Dispose()
			info.proj_effect = nil
		end
	end
	if self.proj_attack_calculator_list[info.index] ~= nil then
		self.proj_attack_calculator_list[info.index]:End()
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj_damage(dt, attack_Calc, dir, info)
	local objects = attack_Calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_modifier = info.damage_mod
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				local critical_rate = self.critical_rate_list[1]
				if info.is_enhanced then
					critical_rate = self.critical_rate_list[2]
				end
				damage_modifier = damage_modifier + damage_modifier * critical_rate
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = dir

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			self:remove_proj(info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:sync_shot(index)
	self.synced = true

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	info:AppendNumber(index)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
	info:AppendDirection(dir)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	self.target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	--싱크
	if idx < 2 then
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self:change_state(self.state.triple_shot)
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end

function local_class:on_event(e)

function local_class:dispose()

	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.shot_effect_offset = nil
	self.casting_effect = nil
	self.critical_rate_list = nil
	self.character_direction = nil
	self.proj_info_list = nil

end

local local_class = newclass('BossPanWaveAttackBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.battle_zone = nil

	--파라미터 파싱
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)

	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRadius", 1.25)
	self.wave_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WaveSpeed", 7)

	self.show_target_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

	--파동 데미지 정보
	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = 0.3
	info.Radius = self.attack_radius
	info.Height = 2
	info.IsCenterToBottom = true
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 1)

	--aoe 정보
	self.aoe_spec = CS.Oak.AreaOfEffectManager.AoeSpecParams()
	self.aoe_spec.shape = CS.AttackRangeShape.Circle
	self.aoe_spec.radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldRadius", 1.25)
	self.aoe_spec.duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDuration", 3)
	self.aoe_spec.damageTerm = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDamageTerm", 0.3)
	self.aoe_spec.modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDamageModifier", 0.7)
	self.aoe_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDamageModifier", 0.7)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.target = nil
	self.target_pos = nil

	self.wave_move_duration = 0
	self.wave_state = {
		none = 1,
		move = 2,
		wave = 3
	}

	self.on_aoe_hit_func = function(fo, dir, param1, param2)
		self:on_aoe_hit(fo, dir, param1, param2)
	end

	self.wave_effect = nil
	self.wave_time_passed = 0
	self.current_wave_state = self.wave_state.none
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false
	self.target = target
	self.wave_time_passed = 0
	self.current_wave_state = self.wave_state.none

	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.show_target_arrow and target or nil)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
	end
	if self.wave_effect ~= nil then
		self.wave_effect:Dispose()
		self.wave_effect = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.target_pos = self.target.Position
		self.wave_start_pos = self.character.Position
		local dist = (self.wave_start_pos - self.target_pos).magnitude
		self.wave_move_duration = dist / self.wave_speed

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.current_wave_state = self.wave_state.move
		self.wave_time_passed = 0
		self.wave_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wave", self.wave_start_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_wave_state ~= self.wave_state.none then
		self:update_wave(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed < self.prepare_duration then
		elseif not self.chain_synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
			self.synced = true
			local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
			info:AppendNumber(1)
			info:AppendPosition(self.target_pos)
			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_wave(dt)
	if self.current_wave_state == self.wave_state.move then
		self.wave_time_passed = self.wave_time_passed + dt
		local progress = self.wave_time_passed / self.wave_move_duration
		if progress > 1 then
			if self.wave_effect ~= nil then
				self.wave_effect:Dispose()
				self.wave_effect = nil
			end

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("hit")
			self:update_wave_damage(dt)

			self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_pos
			self.attack_calculator:Start()

			self.current_wave_state = self.wave_state.wave
			self.wave_time_passed = 0

			stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, self.target_pos,
					self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('wind'), self.aoe_spec, self.on_aoe_hit_func, nil, nil)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
		else
			local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.wave_start_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
			if self.wave_effect ~= nil then
				self.wave_effect.transform.position = move_pos
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_wave_state == self.wave_state.wave then
		self.wave_time_passed = self.wave_time_passed + dt
		if self.wave_time_passed >= 0.5 then
			if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
				self.attack_calculator:End()
			end
			self.current_wave_state = self.wave_state.none
		end
	end
end

-- 장판에 데미지 주기 위한 콜백
function local_class:on_aoe_hit(fo, dir, param1, param2)
	if not is_unity_null(fo) then
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.aoe_damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = dir

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
end

function local_class:update_wave_damage(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))
	local pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	self.target_pos = pos
	--싱크
	if idx == 1 then
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.aoe_spec = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.target_pos = nil
	self.wave_state = nil
	self.wave_effect = nil
	self.current_wave_state = nil
	self.on_aoe_hit_func = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.is_target_seach = false

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.attack_range_row:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_row))
		self.attack_range_ver:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_ver))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
			self.casting_effect:Dispose()
			self.casting_effect = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.current_attack_calc ~= nil then
			self.current_attack_calc:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.blast_effect ~= nil then
			self.blast_effect:Dispose()
			self.blast_effect = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		if self.attack_range_row == nil or self.attack_range_ver == nil then
			self:get_zone_bounds()
			self:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bounds)
		end

		--오버레이를 맞추기위해서 미리켜놓구 안보이는데 갖다놓는다.
		self.attack_range_row:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_row, vector(999, 0, 999), unity_class.vector3.left)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_row))
		self.attack_range_ver:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_ver, vector(999,0, 999), unity_class.vector3.left)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_ver))
		self:set_attack_range(self:check_target_position())
		self:set_character_direction()

		self.is_target_seach = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
		self.casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prepare", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self:set_attack_calc_for_dir()

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_character_direction()

	if self.current_area_type == self.attack_area.left then
		self.character_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	elseif self.current_area_type == self.attack_area.right then
		self.character_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	elseif self.current_area_type == self.attack_area.down then
		self.character_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	elseif self.current_area_type == self.attack_area.up then
		self.character_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	end

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character_direction)
end

function local_class:set_attack_calc_for_dir()
	local dir = nil
	local pos = nil
	if self.current_area_type == self.attack_area.left then
		dir = unity_class.vector3.left
		pos = self.zone_bounds.center - vector(self.zone_bounds.size.x / 4, 0, 0)
		self.current_attack_calc = self.row_attack_calculator
		self.current_attack_calc.Position = pos
	elseif self.current_area_type == self.attack_area.right then
		dir = unity_class.vector3.right
		pos = self.zone_bounds.center + vector(self.zone_bounds.size.x / 4, 0, 0)
		self.current_attack_calc = self.row_attack_calculator
		self.current_attack_calc.Position = pos
	elseif self.current_area_type == self.attack_area.down then
		dir = unity_class.vector3.back
		pos = self.zone_bounds.center - vector(0, 0, self.zone_bounds.size.z / 4)
		self.current_attack_calc = self.ver_attack_calculator
		self.current_attack_calc.Position = pos
	elseif self.current_area_type == self.attack_area.up then
		dir = unity_class.vector3.forward
		pos = self.zone_bounds.center + vector(0, 0, self.zone_bounds.size.z / 4)
		self.current_attack_calc = self.ver_attack_calculator
		self.current_attack_calc.Position = pos
	end

	if self.current_area_type == self.attack_area.up then
		self.blast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wind_blast_up", pos)
	elseif self.current_area_type == self.attack_area.down then
		self.blast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wind_blast_down", pos)
	elseif self.current_area_type == self.attack_area.left then
		self.blast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wind_blast_width", pos)
	elseif self.current_area_type == self.attack_area.right then
		self.blast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wind_blast_width", pos)
		self.blast_effect.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
	end

	self.current_attack_calc.Direction = dir
	self.current_attack_calc:Start()
end

function local_class:check_target_position()
	if self.target.Position.x < self.zone_bounds.center.x - self.zone_bounds.size.x / 4 then
		return self.attack_area.left
	elseif self.target.Position.x > self.zone_bounds.center.x + self.zone_bounds.size.x / 4 then
		return self.attack_area.right
	elseif self.target.Position.z < self.zone_bounds.center.z then
		return self.attack_area.down
	elseif self.target.Position.z >= self.zone_bounds.center.z then
		return self.attack_area.up
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:set_attack_range(area_type)
	self.current_area_type = area_type

	if self.zone_bounds == nil then
		self:get_zone_bounds()
	end

	if area_type == self.attack_area.left then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_row, self.zone_bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.left)
	elseif area_type == self.attack_area.right then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_row, self.zone_bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.right)
	elseif area_type == self.attack_area.down then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_ver, self.zone_bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.back)
	elseif area_type == self.attack_area.up then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_ver, self.zone_bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.forward)
	end

	if area_type == self.attack_area.left or area_type == self.attack_area.right then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_ver, vector(999, 0, 999), unity_class.vector3.forward)
	else
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_row, vector(999, 0, 999), unity_class.vector3.forward)
	end
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_row))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_ver))
end

function local_class:get_zone_bounds()
	self.zone_bounds = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
end

function local_class:sync_tracking()
	if not CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
		return
	end

	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 1)
	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, self.current_area_type)
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	--호스트의 마지막 Target에 맞춰서 싱크
	if idx == 1 then
		local dir_type = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 1))
		self:set_attack_range(dir_type)
		--self:set_character_direction()

		self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
		-- 만약 확정된 타겟이 ai와 다른 경우
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.character)) then
			-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
			command_util.publish_change_target(self.character, self.target)
		end
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.tracking_duration then
				self:set_attack_range(self:check_target_position())
				--self:set_character_direction()
			else
				self:sync_tracking()
			end

			if self.show_target_arrow and self.time_passed > self.target_search_duration and self.is_target_seach then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
				self.is_target_seach = false
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.time_passed <= self.damage_duration then
				self:update_damage(dt)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	if not self.current_attack_calc.IsStarted then
		self.current_attack_calc:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.current_attack_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier + self.damage_modifier * self.critical_damage_rate
			end

			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.stun_factor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.stun_duration = self.stun_duration

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.attack_area = nil
	self.current_area_type = nil
	self.current_attack_calc = nil
	self.casting_effect = nil
	self.blast_effect = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.attack_range_row = nil
	self.attack_range_ver = nil
	self.row_attack_calculator = nil
	self.ver_attack_calculator = nil
	self.character_direction = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossPanWindShotBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.battle_zone = nil

	--파라미터 파싱
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.wind_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WindDamageModifier", 1)
	self.wind_road_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WindRoadDamageModifier", 1)
	self.tracking_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TrackingSpeed", 0.7)
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TrackingDuration", 2)

	self.wind_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WindDistance", 10)
	self.wind_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WindWidth", 1.5)
	self.wind_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WindDuration", 0.3)
	self.wind_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WindDamageTerm", 0.3)
	self.wind_damage_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WindDamageDelay", 0.3)

	self.wind_attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WindAttackDelay", 0.3)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeMagnitude", 0.08)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeDuration", 0.3)

	--해당 시간동안 어그로수치 변경 이벤트가 들어올 경우 타겟을 변경해 준다.
	self.target_search_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetSearchDuration", 2)

	--강공 확률과 강공 데미지 증가 배율
	self.critical_chance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CriticalDamageChance", 0.5)
	self.critical_damage_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SuperDamageScale", 1.5)

	--wave attack info
	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			vector(self.wind_distance, bounds_util.get_size(self.character).y, self.wind_width),
			self.wind_duration, self.wind_damage_term, true
	)
	self.wind_attack_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character,
			info, true, self.wind_damage_delay, 1)

	self.wind_road_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WindRoadDistance", 10)
	self.wind_road_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WindRoadWidth", 1.5)
	self.wind_road_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WindRoadDuration", 3)
	self.wind_road_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WindRoadDamageTerm", 0.3)

	--up, right, down, left순
	self.shot_effect_offset = self:get_shot_effect_data(params, "ShotEffectOffset")

	self.show_target_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

	--wave attack info

	self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
				vector(self.wind_road_distance, bounds_util.get_size(self.character).y, self.wind_road_width),
				self.wind_road_duration, self.wind_road_damage_term, true)

		local ca = 	area_collision_util.create(self.character, info, true, 0, 99)
		table.insert(self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list, ca)
	end

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(self.wind_distance, self.wind_width),
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,

	}

	self.wind_road_info_list = nil
	self.casting_effect = nil
	self.wind_road_effect = nil
	self.synced_target_dir = nil
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.current_wind_road_count = 0
	self.is_target_seach = false
	self.is_start_wind_road = false

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent),
			self.on_aggro_change_event_func)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:get_shot_effect_data(params, data_name)
	local has_value, value = params:TryGetValue(data_name)

	local offset_list = {}
	if has_value then
		for _, info in pairs(value) do
			local index = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(info, "Index", _)

			local offset_data = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(info, "Offset")

			local offset = vector(offset_data[1], offset_data[2], offset_data[3])

			table.insert(offset_list, offset)
		end
	end

	return offset_list
end

function local_class:get_shot_effect_offset(dir)
	local pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return self.shot_effect_offset[1]
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return self.shot_effect_offset[2]
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return self.shot_effect_offset[3]
	elseif CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return self.shot_effect_offset[4]
	end

	return pos
end

function local_class:add_wind_road_attack_calc()
	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			vector(self.wind_road_distance, bounds_util.get_size(self.character).y, self.wind_road_width),
			self.wind_road_duration, self.wind_road_damage_term, true)
	local cl = area_collision_util.create(self.character,
			info, true, 0, 99)
	table.insert(self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list, cl)
end

function local_class:get_attack_calc()
	if #self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list == 0 then
		self:add_wind_road_attack_calc()
	end

	local calc = self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list[1]
	table.remove(self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list, 1)

	return calc
end

function local_class:remove_attack_calc(calc)
	table.insert(self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list, calc)
end

function local_class:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare and self.time_passed < self.target_search_duration then
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.Target) then
			self.target = e.Target
			self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			--타겟표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 변경된 타겟을 보내 줌
			if self.show_target_arrow then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end


	self.synced = false
	self.target = target
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.is_target_seach = false
	self.is_start_wind_road = false

	--강공 발동 여부
	if CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
		if random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance then
			self.is_critical_attack = true
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 9)--강공 여부
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
		end
	end

	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.show_target_arrow and target or nil)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
		self.casting_effect:Dispose()
		self.casting_effect = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	if self.wind_road_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.wind_road_info_list) do
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				v.effect:Dispose()
				v.effect = nil
			end
		end
		self.wind_road_info_list = nil
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list) do
		if v ~= nil then
			v:End()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
			self.casting_effect:Dispose()
			self.casting_effect = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.wind_attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.wind_attack_calculator:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		self.character_direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.is_target_seach = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prepare", self.character.Position +
				self:get_shot_effect_offset(self.character_direction))
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.wind_attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.wind_attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
		self.wind_attack_calculator:Start()
		self.is_start_wind_road = false

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", self.character.Position)
		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wind", self.character.Position)
		local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
				unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_dir)).eulerAngles.y
		effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:start_wind_road()
	self.current_wind_road_count = self.current_wind_road_count + 1
	local index = self.current_wind_road_count

	local ac = self:get_attack_calc()
	ac.Position = self.character.Position
	ac.Direction = self.target_dir
	ac:Start()

	local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wind_road", self.character.Position)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("wind_road", nil)
	local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
			unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_dir)).eulerAngles.y
	effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)
	if self.wind_road_info_list == nil then
		self.wind_road_info_list = {}
	end
	table.insert(self.wind_road_info_list, {
		index = index,
		effect = effect,
		time_passed = 0,
		dir = self.target_dir,
		attack_calc = ac
	})
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.wind_road_info_list ~= nil and #self.wind_road_info_list > 0 then
		for i = #self.wind_road_info_list, 1, -1 do
			local info = self.wind_road_info_list[i]
			if info.time_passed < self.wind_road_duration then
				info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt

				self:update_wind_road_damage(dt, info.attack_calc, info.dir)
			else
				if info.attack_calc ~= nil then
					info.attack_calc:End()
					self:remove_attack_calc(info.attack_calc)
				end
				info.attack_calc = nil

				if info.effect ~= nil then
					info.effect:Dispose()
					info.effect = nil
				end
				self.current_wind_road_count = self.current_wind_road_count - 1
				table.remove(self.wind_road_info_list, i)
			end
		end
	end
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.tracking_duration then
				self:update_attack_range(dt)
				self:set_character_diration()
			elseif not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.synced = true
				self:sync_target_dir()
				self:set_character_diration()
			elseif self.synced and self.synced_target_dir ~= nil then
				if self.target_dir ~= nil and self.synced_target_dir ~= nil and self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
					self:update_sync_dir(dt)
					self:set_character_diration()
				end
			end

			if self.show_target_arrow and self.time_passed > self.target_search_duration and self.is_target_seach then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
				self.is_target_seach = false
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_wind_damage(dt)

			if self.time_passed >= self.wind_attack_delay and not self.is_start_wind_road then
				self.is_start_wind_road = true
				self:start_wind_road()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync_target_dir()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 5)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.target_dir)
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	--호스트의 마지막 TargetDir에 맞춰서 싱크
	if idx == 5 then
		self.synced_target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		--현재 로컬의 target_dir이 sync로 날라온 dir과 다르다면 자연스럽게 이동시켜준다.
		if self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
			self.synced_dir_move_speed = 15
		end

		self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
		-- 만약 확정된 타겟이 ai와 다른 경우
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.character)) then
			-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
			command_util.publish_change_target(self.character, self.target)
		end
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:update_sync_dir(dt)
	local diff = math.abs((self.synced_target_dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.1 then
		local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - self.synced_target_dir).normalized * dt * self.synced_dir_move_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = move_dir
	else
		self.target_dir = self.synced_target_dir
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:update_wind_damage(dt)
	local objects = self.wind_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_modifier = self.wind_damage_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.wind_damage_modifier + self.wind_damage_modifier * self.critical_damage_rate
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = self.target_dir
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_wind_road_damage(dt, calc, dir)
	local objects = calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) and
				not lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.FanTotemBehaviour) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.wind_road_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = dir
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_snow_01')

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:set_character_diration()
	--케스팅시간동안 캐릭터 방향 수정
	local new_direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
	if self.character_direction ~= new_direction then
		self.character_direction = new_direction
		if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
			self.casting_effect.transform.position = self.character.Position + self:get_shot_effect_offset(self.character_direction)
		end
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character_direction)
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	if dir.magnitude <= 0.05 then
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
	end

	local diff = math.abs((dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.05 then
		local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - dir).normalized * dt * self.tracking_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = move_dir
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.wind_attack_calculator = nil
	self.shot_effect_offset = nil
	self.wind_road_attack_calculator_list = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.wind_road_info = nil
	self.casting_effect = nil
	self.wind_road_effect = nil
	self.character_direction = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossPanWingAttackBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.battle_zone = nil

	--파라미터 파싱
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRadius", 3.5)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockbackForce", 1.1)

	self.show_target_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = 0.3
	info.Radius = self.attack_radius
	info.Height = 2
	info.IsCenterToBottom = true
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 1)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false

	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.show_target_arrow and target or nil)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
	end
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			if not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.synced = true
				local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

				trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 1)
				trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.character.Position)
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))
	if idx == 1 then
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.tornado_sfx_holder ~= nil then
		self.tornado_sfx_holder:FadeOut(0.5)
		self.tornado_sfx_holder = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		if self.tornado_sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.tornado_sfx_holder:FadeOut(0.5)
			self.tornado_sfx_holder = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.tornado_position = self.target.Position

		--attackrange
		self.attack_range.Position = self.tornado_position
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.tornado_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("tornado", self.tornado_position,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.current_tornado_radius = self.tornado_min_radius
		self.tornado_time_passed = 0
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.tornado_sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", self.tornado_position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:tornado_update(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:tornado_update(dt)
	if self.tornado_time_passed <= self.action_duration then
		self.tornado_time_passed = self.tornado_time_passed + dt
		if self.current_tornado_radius <= self.tornado_max_radius then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.tornado_time_passed / self.size_up_duration)
			local value = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.current_tornado_radius, self.tornado_max_radius, progress)
			self.current_tornado_radius = value
		end

		if self.enhanced then
			--추적기능 활성화
			local diff = self.target.Position - self.tornado_position
			self.tornado_position = self.tornado_position + diff.normalized * (self.tornado_move_speed * dt)
			self.tornado_effect.transform.position = self.tornado_position
			self.attack_range.Position = self.tornado_position
		end

		--damage
		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.tornado_position, self.current_tornado_radius)

		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do

			local is_hit_delayed = false
			for i = #self.tornado_hit_list, 1, -1 do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.tornado_hit_list[i].fo) then
					self.tornado_hit_list[i].life_time = self.tornado_hit_list[i].life_time - dt
					if self.tornado_hit_list[i].life_time ~= nil and self.tornado_hit_list[i].life_time >= 0 then
						is_hit_delayed = true
					else
						table.remove(self.tornado_hit_list, i)
					end
				end
			end

			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
					fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) or is_hit_delayed then
			else
				local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.tornado_position).normalized

				if dmg_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
					dmg_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = dmg_dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				table.insert(self.tornado_hit_list, { fo = fo, life_time = self.damage_delay })
			end
		end

		fo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		--attack range
		local create_pos = self.character.Position + self.hell_flare_offset
		local dest = self.target.Position
		local diff = dest - create_pos
		local est_time = vector_util.distance(unity_class.vector3.zero, diff) / self.shot_speed + self.prepare_duration + self.attack_delay
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target.Position)
		self.attack_range:Show(est_time)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		--hell flare effect
		self.hell_flare_info.effect_obj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(
				"hell_flare", create_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.hell_flare_info.trail_effect_obj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(
				"hell_flare_trail", create_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.hell_flare_info.trail_effect_obj.transform.parent = self.hell_flare_info.effect_obj.transform
		self.hell_flare_info.effect_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
		self.hell_flare_info.start_pos = create_pos
		self.hell_flare_info.dest_pos = dest
		self.hell_flare_info.diff = diff
		self.hell_flare_info.life_time = diff.magnitude / self.shot_speed
		self.hell_flare_info.passed_time = 0

		self.cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(
				"cast", create_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.track_finish = false

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("end")
		self.cast_effect:Dispose()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")

		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.hell_flare_info.dest_pos
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		--hell ball 삭제
		if not is_unity_null(self.hell_flare_info.effect_obj) then
			self.hell_flare_info.effect_obj:Dispose()
		end
		self.hell_flare_info.effect_obj = nil

		if not is_unity_null(self.hell_flare_info.trail_effect_obj) then
			self.hell_flare_info.trail_effect_obj:Dispose()
		end
		self.hell_flare_info.trail_effect_obj = nil

				"explosion", self.hell_flare_info.dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		--폭발 사운드
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", self.hell_flare_info.dest_pos)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion2", self.hell_flare_info.dest_pos)

		--if self.enhanced then
		--	--장판 생성
		--	stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, self.hell_flare_info.dest_pos,
		--			self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("aoe"), self.aoe_spec)
		--end

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target.Position)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			else
				if not self.track_finish then
					local dest = self.target.Position
					local diff = dest - self.hell_flare_info.start_pos
					self.hell_flare_info.dest_pos = dest
					self.hell_flare_info.diff = diff
					self.hell_flare_info.life_time = diff.magnitude / self.shot_speed

					self.track_finish = true
				end

			end

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(
					self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.prepare_duration))
			self.hell_flare_info.effect_obj.transform.localScale = 1 * progress * unity_class.vector3.one
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:move_hell_flare_update(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.none)
			end
		else
			if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
				self.attack_calculator:Start()
			end
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]
				-- TombShot에서 생성된 알 맞췄다면 Disable 시킴
				if string.find(fo.Name, "dm_spawn_point") then
					fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				elseif battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_hell_flare_update(dt)
	if not self.hell_flare_info.is_move_finish then

		if self.hell_flare_info.passed_time <= self.hell_flare_info.life_time then
			self.hell_flare_info.passed_time = self.hell_flare_info.passed_time + dt

			self.hell_flare_info.effect_obj.transform.position = self.hell_flare_info.start_pos +
					self.hell_flare_info.passed_time / self.hell_flare_info.life_time * self.hell_flare_info.diff
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
		end

	else
		self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	--if CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager ~= nil then
	--	CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoe(self.character)
	--end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	self.hell_flare_info = nil
	self.cast_effect = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.hell_flare_offset = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if not is_unity_null(self.casting_effect) then
		self.casting_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.casting_effect = nil

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		if not is_unity_null(self.casting_effect) then
			self.casting_effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.casting_effect = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(
				"cast", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirection(dir,
				unity_class.vector3.zero, 0, 0, nil, false)
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.shot_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end

		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.casting_effect = nil
end

return {

		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
