function local_class:update_summon_info(dt)

		local monster_info = self.summoned_monsters[i]

		if monster_info.exploding then
			monster_info.explode_time_passed = monster_info.explode_time_passed + dt

			if monster_info.explode_time_passed > self.monster_explode_time then
				self:explode_monster(i)
			end
		else
			if vector_util.magnitude(self.target.Position - monster_info.monster.Position) < self.monster_explode_radius then
				self:kill_summoned_monster(i)
				return
			end

			monster_info.time_passed = monster_info.time_passed + dt
			if monster_info.time_passed > self.summon_monster_death_duration then
				self:kill_summoned_monster(i)
			end

	end

function local_class:set_monster_explode(idx)

		monster_info.monster.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	end

	monster_info.monster:SetAnimation(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('dead', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, false))

	monster_info.explode_time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:explode_monster(idx)

	info.monster.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explode', info.monster.Position)
	if info.instantiate_area then
		self:instantiate_area(info.monster.Position)
	else
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_key(self.sfx_key.explosion_without_area))
	end
end

function local_class:kill_summoned_monster(idx)
	local monster_info = self.summoned_monsters[idx]
	local monster = monster_info.monster

	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	damage_info.sender = monster
	damage_info.target = monster
	damage_info.noCritical = true
	damage_info.damage = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
	damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '01_nothing_01')

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
end

function local_class:instantiate_area(pos)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_key(self.sfx_key.instantiate_area))
	local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.summon_area_radius, 2, self.summon_area_duration, self.summon_area_damage_term)
	local area = {
		time_passed = 0,
		calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, info, true),
		pos = pos,
		fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('area', pos)
	}
	area.calculator.Position = area.pos
	area.calculator:Start()

	table.insert(self.summon_areas, area)
end

function local_class:update_summon_area_info(dt)
	local hit_target_list = {}

	for i = #self.summon_areas, 1, -1 do
		--update attack
		local area = self.summon_areas[i]
		local fo_list = area.calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

		for j = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
			local target = fo_list[j]

			if target ~= self.character then
				local already_hit = false
				for k = 1, #hit_target_list do
					if hit_target_list[k] == target then
						already_hit = true
						break
					end
				end

				if not already_hit then
					table.insert(hit_target_list, target)

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = target
					damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self:get_damage_rate(self.summon_area_damage_rate, target))
					if vector_util.is_almost_zero(area.pos - target.Position) then
						damage_info.direction = vector_util.back
					else
						damage_info.direction =  vector_util.normalized(target.Position - area.pos)
					end
					damage_info.stunFactor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.stunDuration = self.area_stun_duration
					damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self:get_sfx_key(self.sfx_key.hit_area))

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
		end
		fo_list:Dispose()

		--update time
		area.time_passed = area.time_passed + dt

		if area.time_passed > self.summon_area_duration then
			table.remove(self.summon_areas, i)
			area.calculator:End()
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('area_end', area.pos)
			if area.fx ~= nil then
				area.fx:Dispose()
			end
		end
	end

end

function local_class:update_cast(dt)
	local current_matter = self.matter_table[self.current_matter_idx]

	if current_matter ~= nil then
		current_matter.time_passed = current_matter.time_passed + dt

		if current_matter.time_passed > self.matter_generate_term then
			current_matter.time_passed = 0
			current_matter.prepare_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_key, current_matter.offset + self.character.Position)
			self.current_matter_idx = self.current_matter_idx + 1

			if not self.generate_sfx_played then
				self.generate_sfx_played = true
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_key(self.sfx_key.generate))
			end

			if self.current_matter_idx > #self.matter_table then
				self.current_matter_idx = self.disabled_matter_generate_idx
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:trace_range(dt)
	local target_pos = self.target.Position

	if vector_util.magnitude(target_pos - self.character.Position) < self.attack_range_radius + self.attack_range_min_distance then
		target_pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.normalized(target_pos - self.character.Position) * (self.attack_range_radius + self.attack_range_min_distance)
	end

	local move_vec = target_pos - self.trace_center
	local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(move_vec)
	move_vec = vector_util.normalized(move_vec)

	local intersection_distance = self:calculate_circle_intersection_distance(move_vec, self.trace_center - self.character.Position, self.attack_range_radius + self.attack_range_min_distance)
	local target_distance = magnitude
	local real_distance = self.trace_speed * dt

	--구면이동
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(intersection_distance) or intersection_distance >= 0 and target_distance > intersection_distance then
		if intersection_distance < real_distance then
			self.trace_center = self.trace_center + move_vec * intersection_distance
			real_distance = real_distance - intersection_distance

			local cross = self:cross(self.trace_center - self.character.Position, target_pos - self.character.Position)
			if vector_util.is_almost_zero(cross) then
				return
			end

			local target_theta = math.asin(vector_util.magnitude(cross) / (self.attack_range_radius + self.attack_range_min_distance)^2)
			if vector_util.dot(self.trace_center - self.character.Position, target_pos - self.character.Position) < 0 then
				target_theta = math.pi - target_theta
			end

			local real_theta = real_distance / (self.attack_range_radius + self.attack_range_min_distance)

			if target_theta < real_theta then
				self.trace_center = self.character.Position + unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(target_theta / math.pi * 180, cross) * (self.trace_center - self.character.Position)
			else
				self.trace_center = self.character.Position + unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(real_theta / math.pi * 180, cross) * (self.trace_center - self.character.Position)
			end
		else
			self.trace_center = self.trace_center + move_vec * real_distance
		end
	--직선이동
	else
		if real_distance > target_distance then
			magnitude = target_distance
		else
			magnitude = real_distance
		end

		self.trace_center = self.trace_center + move_vec * magnitude
	end

	self.trace_center = vector(
			unity_class.mathf.Clamp(self.trace_center.x, self.x_min, self.x_max),
			self.character.Position.y,
			unity_class.mathf.Clamp(self.trace_center.z, self.z_min, self.z_max))
end

function local_class:calculate_circle_intersection_distance(move_vec, origin_diff, radius)
	local b = vector_util.dot(move_vec, origin_diff)
	local c = vector_util.magnitude(origin_diff)^2 - radius^2

	return -b - math.sqrt(b^2-c)
end

function local_class:cross(v1, v2)
	return vector(v1.y * v2.z - v1.z * v2.y, v1.z * v2.x - v1.x * v2.z, v1.x * v2.y - v1.y * v2.x)
end

function local_class:update_attack(dt)
	local current_matter = self.matter_table[self.current_matter_idx]

	if current_matter ~= nil then
		current_matter.time_passed = current_matter.time_passed + dt

		if current_matter.time_passed > self.matter_attack_term then
			current_matter:dispose()
			self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(
					self.character.Position + current_matter.offset,
					vector_util.normalized(self.trace_center + current_matter.target_offset - (current_matter.offset + self.character.Position)),
					self.current_matter_idx)
			self.current_matter_idx = self.current_matter_idx + 1

			if not self.shoot_sfx_played then
				self.shoot_sfx_played = true
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_key(self.sfx_key.shoot))
			end

			if self.current_matter_idx > #self.matter_table then
				self.current_matter_idx = self.disabled_matter_generate_idx
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.x_min = bound.center.x - bound.extents.x + self.attack_range_radius
	self.x_max = bound.center.x + bound.extents.x - self.attack_range_radius
	self.z_min = bound.center.z - bound.extents.z + self.attack_range_radius
	self.z_max = bound.center.z + bound.extents.z - self.attack_range_radius

end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)

		self:explode_projectile(hit_info.position)
		self:summon_monster(label)
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:explode_projectile(pos)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.explosion_radius)

	stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_magnitude, self.camera_duration)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_key(self.sfx_key.explosion_without_area))

	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if fo ~= self.character and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(fo.Position - vector_util.get_x0z(pos, fo.Position.y))

			if dir_vector:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir_vector = vector_util.back
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self:get_damage_rate(self.damage_rate, fo))
			damage_info.direction = dir_vector
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir_vector
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:summon_monster(label)
	if self.matter_table[label] ~= nil and self.matter_table[label].summon_target ~= nil then
		local summon_target = self.matter_table[label].summon_target
		self.matter_table[label].summon_target = nil

		local rand_pos = self.matter_table[label].target_offset + self.trace_center
				+ vector_util.normalized(
				vector(random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5, 0, random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5))
				* random_util.get_random_value() * self.matter_radius

		local limit = 250
		local it_cnt = 0

		while battle_util.get_height(rand_pos) ~= battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position)
				and it_cnt < limit do
			rand_pos = self.matter_table[label].target_offset + self.trace_center
					+ vector_util.normalized(
					vector(random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5, 0, random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5))
					* random_util.get_random_value() * self.matter_radius
			it_cnt = it_cnt + 1
		end

		if it_cnt == limit then
			rand_pos = self.matter_table[label].target_offset + self.trace_center
		end

		summon_target.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(rand_pos, battle_util.get_height(rand_pos))
		summon_target.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		summon_target:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.heal = summon_target.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.sender = self.character
		heal_info.target = summon_target

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(summon_target, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
		message_system:Send(summon_target.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(summon_target, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, summon_target, self.buff_name)
		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, summon_target, self.buff_name, self.defense_buff_level, false, false)

		table.insert(self.summoned_monsters, {
			monster = summon_target,
			time_passed = 0,
			exploding = false,
			explode_time_passed = 0,
			explode_range = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explode_alert', summon_target.Position, vector_util.zero, summon_target.Transform)
		})
	end
end

function local_class:force_remove_all_monsters_and_area()
	for i = #self.summoned_monsters, 1, -1 do
		self.summoned_monsters[i].instantiate_area = false
		self:kill_summoned_monster(i)
	end

	for i = #self.summon_areas, 1, -1 do
		self.summon_areas[i].fx:Dispose()
		self.summon_areas[i].calculator:End()
		table.remove(self.summon_areas, i)
	end
end

function local_class:is_cast_or_post()
	return self.current_state == self.state.cast
			or self.current_state == self.state.post
end

function local_class:get_damage_rate(origin_rate, target)
	if target == user_party.Leader and target.FieldObjectBehaviour.BattleStyleSpec.Name == self.sword_style_name then
		return origin_rate * self.sword_damage_rate
	else
		return origin_rate
	end
end

function local_class:get_sfx_key(origin_key)
	if self.dark_zone_state == true then
		return origin_key .. '_eq'
	end

	return origin_key
end

function local_class:set_dark_zone_state(is_activated)
	self.dark_zone_state = is_activated
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_destroyed_event_func)

	self.matter_table = nil
	self.trace_center = nil

	self.cast_key = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil

	self.summon_monster_a_prefix = nil
	self.summon_monster_b_prefix = nil

	self.summoned_monsters = nil
	self.summon_areas = nil

	self.state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	}

end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

function local_class:trigger()

		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.cast)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if not self.is_enhanced then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		self.attack_calculator:End()

		if not self.is_enhanced then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.origin_size = stage_camera.Size
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_duration)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.cast_duration))

		self.attack_direction = vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)

		self.level = math.min(self.level + 1, self.max_level)
		self.info.Angle = self.default_range_angle + self.level * self.level_angle_modifier

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.attack_direction

		if self.is_enhanced then
			self.cast_boss_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast_boss', self.character.Position + vector_util.up * 5.8)
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast_' .. self.level, self.character.Position, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, (360 - self.default_range_angle - self.level * self.level_angle_modifier) / 2, 0) * -self.attack_direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("cast")
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_key(self.sfx_key.cast))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('attack_' .. self.level, self.character.Position, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, (360 - self.default_range_angle - self.level * self.level_angle_modifier) / 2, 0) * -self.attack_direction)

		if not self.is_enhanced then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("attack")

		end

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_key(self.sfx_key.attack))
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_magnitude, self.camera_duration)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.origin_size, self.camera_duration)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("attack_end")

		if self.cast_boss_fx ~= nil then
			self.cast_boss_fx:Dispose()
			self.cast_boss_fx = nil
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast_boss_end', self.character.Position + vector_util.up * 5.8)
		end

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if self.origin_size ~= nil and self.origin_size ~= stage_camera.Size then
			stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.origin_size, self.camera_duration)

		end

		if self.cast_boss_fx ~= nil then
			self.cast_boss_fx:Dispose()
			self.cast_boss_fx = nil
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast_boss_end', self.character.Position + vector_util.up * 5.8)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then

		self:update_attack(dt)

		if self.time_passed > self.attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()

end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.first_attack_circle_table do
		self.first_attack_circle_table[i].calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	end
	self.second_attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.cast_first_attack)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast_first_attack then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if not self.is_enhanced then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.first_attack then
		if self.current_first_attack_index ~= self.first_attack_disabled_index then
			self.first_attack_circle_table[self.current_first_attack_index]:dispose()
			self.current_first_attack_index = self.first_attack_disabled_index
		end

		if not self.is_enhanced then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post_first_attack then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast_second_attack then
		if self.second_cast_effect ~= nil then
			self.second_cast_effect:Dispose()
			self.second_cast_effect = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.second_attack then
		self.second_attack_calculator:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast_first_attack then
		self.origin_size = stage_camera.Size
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_duration)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_attack_state = nil
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.first_cast_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("cast")
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_key(self.sfx_key.cast))

		if self.is_enhanced then
			self.cast_boss_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast_boss', self.character.Position + vector_util.up * 5.8)
		end

		self:determine_cast_direction()

		if self.current_attack_state == self.attack_state.inward then
			self.second_cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast_out', self.character.Position)
		else
			self.second_cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast_in', self.character.Position)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.first_attack then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if not self.is_enhanced then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("attack")
		end

		self.current_first_attack_index = self.current_attack_state == self.attack_state.outward
		and 1
		or #self.first_attack_circle_table

		self.first_attack_circle_table[self.current_first_attack_index].calculator:Start()
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_magnitude, self.camera_duration)

		if self.current_attack_state == self.attack_state.inward then
			self.second_cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('attack_out', self.character.Position)
		else
			self.second_cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('attack_in', self.character.Position)
		end
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_key(self.sfx_key.attack))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post_first_attack then
		if not self.is_enhanced then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("attack_end")
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast_second_attack then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self:second_attack_trace_target()

		local direction = vector_util.zero
		if self.current_second_safe_area >= 3 and self.current_second_safe_area <= 8 then
			direction = vector_util.normalized(vector(-1,0, -math.tan((self.current_second_safe_area + 0.5) * self.second_trace_angle)))
		else
			direction = vector_util.normalized(vector(1,0, math.tan((self.current_second_safe_area + 0.5) * self.second_trace_angle)))
		end

		if self.current_attack_state == self.attack_state.inward then
			self.second_cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.dark_zone_state == true and 'cast_out_unsafe' or 'cast_out_safe', self.character.Position, direction)
		else
			self.second_cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.dark_zone_state == true and 'cast_in_unsafe' or 'cast_in_safe', self.character.Position, direction)
		end
		self.second_attack_calculator.Direction = -direction
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_key(self.sfx_key.cast))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.second_attack then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.second_attack_calculator:Start()
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_magnitude, self.camera_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("attack")

		local direction = vector_util.zero
		if self.current_second_safe_area >= 3 and self.current_second_safe_area <= 8 then
			direction = vector_util.normalized(vector(-1,0, -math.tan((self.current_second_safe_area + 0.5) * self.second_trace_angle)))
		else
			direction = vector_util.normalized(vector(1,0, math.tan((self.current_second_safe_area + 0.5) * self.second_trace_angle)))
		end

		if self.current_attack_state == self.attack_state.inward then
			self.second_cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('attack_out_safe', self.character.Position, direction)
		else
			self.second_cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('attack_in_safe', self.character.Position, direction)
		end
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_key(self.sfx_key.attack))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.origin_size, self.camera_duration)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("attack_end")

		if self.cast_boss_fx ~= nil then
			self.cast_boss_fx:Dispose()
			self.cast_boss_fx = nil
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast_boss_end', self.character.Position + vector_util.up * 5.8)
		end

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if self.origin_size ~= nil and self.origin_size ~= stage_camera.Size then
			stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.origin_size, self.camera_duration)
		end

		if self.cast_boss_fx ~= nil then
			self.cast_boss_fx:Dispose()
			self.cast_boss_fx = nil
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast_boss_end', self.character.Position + vector_util.up * 5.8)
		end

	end

end

function local_class:determine_cast_direction()
	if vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.target.Position) < self.first_trace_distance then
		self.current_attack_state = self.attack_state.outward
	else
		self.current_attack_state = self.attack_state.inward
	end
end

function local_class:second_attack_trace_target()
	if self.current_attack_state == self.attack_state.inward then
		self.current_attack_state = self.attack_state.outward
	else
		self.current_attack_state = self.attack_state.inward
	end

	local direction = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
	local target_area = math.floor(math.atan(direction.z, direction.x)/self.second_trace_angle) % 12
	local opposite_area = -1

	self.current_second_target_area = target_area
	if random_util.get_random_value() > 0.5 then
		self.current_second_safe_area = (self.current_second_target_area + 3) % 12
		opposite_area = (self.current_second_target_area - 3) % 12
	else
		self.current_second_safe_area = (self.current_second_target_area - 3) % 12
		opposite_area = (self.current_second_target_area + 3) % 12
	end

	if self:is_forbidden_safe_area(self.current_second_safe_area) then
		self.current_second_safe_area = opposite_area
	end
end

function local_class:is_forbidden_safe_area(area)
	return self.current_attack_state == self.attack_state.outward and (area == 2 or area == 3)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast_first_attack then
		if self.time_passed > self.first_cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.first_attack)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.first_attack then
		self:update_first_attack(dt)

		if self.current_first_attack_index == self.first_attack_disabled_index then
			--todo: phase에 따른 분기 필요
			if self.is_enhanced then
				self:change_state(self.state.post_first_attack)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post_first_attack then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_first_attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.cast_second_attack)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast_second_attack then
		if self.time_passed > self.second_cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.second_attack)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.second_attack then
		if self.time_passed > self.second_attack_delay then
			self:update_second_attack(dt)
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.second_attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_first_attack(dt)
	local current_donut = self.first_attack_circle_table[self.current_first_attack_index]

	if current_donut ~= nil then
		current_donut.time_passed = current_donut.time_passed + dt

		local objects = current_donut.calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for i = objects.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
			local target = objects[i]
			if target ~= self.character then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = target
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self:get_damage_rate(self.first_damage_rate, target))
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal_strong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.current_attack_state == self.attack_state.outward
						and vector_util.normalized(target.Position - self.character.Position)
						or vector_util.normalized(self.character.Position - target.Position)
				damage_info.knockBackForce = knock_back_constants.standard_force * current_donut.circle_knock_back_force
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if current_donut.time_passed > current_donut.attack_term then
			current_donut:dispose()
			if self:is_last_first_attack() then
				self.current_first_attack_index = self.first_attack_disabled_index

			else
				self:first_attack_determine_next_circle()
				self.first_attack_circle_table[self.current_first_attack_index].calculator:Start()

				if self:is_last_first_attack() then
					stage_camera:Shake(self.last_camera_magnitude, self.last_camera_duration)
				else
					stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_magnitude, self.camera_duration)
				end

			end
		end
	end

end

function local_class:is_last_first_attack()
	return self.current_attack_state == self.attack_state.outward and self.current_first_attack_index == self.first_attack_circle_count
			or self.current_attack_state == self.attack_state.inward and self.current_first_attack_index == #self.first_attack_circle_table + 1 - self.first_attack_circle_count
end

function local_class:first_attack_determine_next_circle()
	self.current_first_attack_index = self.current_attack_state == self.attack_state.outward
			and self.current_first_attack_index + 1
			or self.current_first_attack_index - 1
end

function local_class:update_second_attack(dt)
	local objects = self.second_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for i = objects.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		local target = objects[i]
		if target ~= self.character then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = target
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self:get_damage_rate(self.second_damage_rate, target))
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal_strong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.current_attack_state == self.attack_state.outward

				damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction

				ailment_info.AilmentGauge = self.ailment_gauge
				damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(ailment_info, 1)

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		self.target_dir = self:to_8_way_vector(vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))

		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.first_attack)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.first_attack then

		if self.time_passed < self.first_attack_duration then
			self:update_first_attack(dt)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.first_attack_duration + self.first_attack_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.second_attack)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.second_attack then

		if self.time_passed < self.second_attack_duration then
			self:update_second_attack(dt)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.second_attack_duration + self.second_attack_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.third_attack)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.third_attack then

		if self.time_passed < self.third_attack_duration then
			self:update_third_attack(dt)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.third_attack_duration + self.third_attack_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed > self.teleport_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fourth_attack)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fourth_attack then
		if self.time_passed > self.fourth_attack_fall_time then
			if self.time_passed - dt < self.fourth_attack_fall_time then
				self.fourth_attack_calculator:Start()
				self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('fourth', self.character.Position)
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.sfx_key.stomp)
				stage_camera:Shake(self.fourth_camera_shake_magnitude, self.fourth_camera_shake_duration)
			end

			self:update_fourth_attack(dt)
		else
			self.character.Position = self.character.Position + vector_util.down * self.fall_speed * dt
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.fourth_attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:to_8_way_vector(vector)
	local max_idx = 1
	local max_dot = -1
	for i = 1, #self.eight_way_vector do
		local dot = vector_util.dot(vector, self.eight_way_vector[i])
		if dot > max_dot then
			max_dot = dot
			max_idx = i
		end
	end
	return self.eight_way_vector[max_idx]
end

function local_class:update_first_attack(dt)

	if self.time_passed < self.first_attack_thrust_duration then
		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = self.target_dir
		move_info.magnitude = dt * self.second_attack_thrust_speed

		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.None, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
	end


	self.first_attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position

	local fo_list = self.first_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

	if fo_list.Count ~= 0 then
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
	end

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local target = fo_list[i]

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

		ailment_info.AilmentGauge = self.first_ailment_gauge
		damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.forceAilment = true

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()

	self.current_storm = nil
	self.storm_methods = {
		activate = function(this)
			this.active_self = true
			this.time_passed = 0
			this.move_time_passed = 0
			this.calculator:Start()
			this.calculator.Position = this.center_pos
			this.fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('storm', this.center_pos)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.sfx_key.storm)
			this.fx_transform = this.fx.transform
		end,

		deactivate = function(this)
			this.active_self = false
			if this.fx ~= nil then
				this.fx:Dispose()
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('storm_end', this.center_pos)
				this.fx = nil
				this.fx_transform = nil
			end
			this.current_direction = nil
			this.calculator:End()
		end,

		shoot = function(this, direction)
			this.current_direction = direction
			this.move_time_passed = 0
		end,

		update_frame = function(this, dt)
			if this.current_direction ~= nil then
				this.move_time_passed = this.move_time_passed + dt
			else
				this.time_passed = this.time_passed + dt
			end

			if this.time_passed > self.storm_remove_duration then
				this:deactivate()
				this:return_to_pool()
				return
			elseif this.move_time_passed > self.storm_link_duration then
				this.current_direction = nil
			end


			if this.current_direction ~= nil then
				this.center_pos = this.center_pos + this.current_direction * dt * self.storm_link_speed
				this:optimize_pos_and_direction()
				this.fx_transform.position = this.center_pos
				this.calculator.Position = this.center_pos
			end

			local fo_list = this.calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

			if fo_list.Count ~= 0 then
				stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
			end

			for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
				local target = fo_list[i]

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = target
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self:get_damage_rate(self.damage_rate, target))
				if this.current_direction ~= nil then
					damage_info.direction = this.current_direction
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = this.current_direction
				elseif vector_util.is_almost_zero(this.center_pos - target.Position) then
					damage_info.direction = vector_util.back
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = vector_util.back
				else
					damage_info.direction =  vector_util.normalized(target.Position - this.center_pos)
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = vector_util.normalized(target.Position - this.center_pos)
				end
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

				local ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo()
				ailment_info.Ailment = CS.Oak.Ailment.Down
				ailment_info.AilmentGauge = self.ailment_gauge
				damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(ailment_info, 1)
				damage_info.forceAilment = true

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
			fo_list:Dispose()
		end,

		optimize_pos_and_direction = function(this)
			if this.current_direction == nil then
				this.center_pos = vector(
						unity_class.mathf.Clamp(this.center_pos.x, self.min_x, self.max_x),
						this.center_pos.y,
						unity_class.mathf.Clamp(this.center_pos.z, self.min_z, self.max_z)
				)
				return
			else
				if this.center_pos.x < self.min_x then
					this.center_pos.x = self.min_x * 2 - this.center_pos.x

					this.current_direction.x = -this.current_direction.x

				elseif this.center_pos.x > self.max_x then
					this.center_pos.x = self.max_x * 2 - this.center_pos.x

					this.current_direction.x = -this.current_direction.x

				end

				if this.center_pos.z < self.min_z then
					this.center_pos.z = self.min_z * 2 - this.center_pos.z

					this.current_direction.z = -this.current_direction.z

				elseif this.center_pos.z > self.max_z then
					this.center_pos.z = self.max_z * 2 - this.center_pos.z

					this.current_direction.z = -this.current_direction.z
				end
			end
		end,

		return_to_pool = function(this)
			table.insert(self.storm_pool, this)
			for i = #self.instantiated_storm_table, 1, -1 do
				if self.instantiated_storm_table[i] == this then
					table.remove(self.instantiated_storm_table, i)
				end
			end
		end
	}
	self.storm_max_count = 2

	--storm_link_cast
	self.storm_link_cast_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StormLinkCastDuration', 1)

	--storm_link
	self.storm_link_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StormLinkTerm', 0.3)
	self.storm_link_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StormLinkSpeed', 5)
	self.storm_link_bound_limit = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'StormLinkBoundLimit', 3)
	self.storm_link_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StormLinkDuration', 4)
	self.shoot_disabled_idx = -1
	self.current_shoot_idx = self.shoot_disabled_idx

	--post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		cast = 1,
		attack = 2,
		storm_post = 3,
		storm_link_cast = 4,
		storm_link = 5,
		post = 6,
	}
	self.current_state = self.state.none

	for i = 1, self.storm_max_count do
		table.insert(self.storm_pool, self:generate_storm_info())
	end

	self.on_destroyed_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_destroyed_event(e)
	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_destroyed_event_func)
	self.sword_style_name = 'lw_boss_knight_champion'
	self.sword_damage_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SwordDamageRate', 1)

	self.sfx_key = {
		storm = '02_plagueboss_storm_01',
		storm_link = '02_plagueboss_storm_02',
	}

	for _, key in pairs(self.sfx_key) do
		music_player:PreloadSfx(key)
	end
end

function local_class:on_destroyed_event(e)
	if e.FieldObject == self.character then
		self:deactivate_all_storms()
	end
end

function local_class:generate_storm_info()
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.attack_radius, 2, self.storm_remove_duration + self.storm_link_duration, self.damage_term)
	local info = {
		fx = nil,
		center_pos = nil,
		calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, collision_info),
		attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward),

		time_passed = 0,
		move_time_passed = 0,
		current_direction = nil,
		idx = -1,

		active_self = false
	}
	setmetatable(info, {__index = self.storm_methods})
	return info
end

function local_class:get_new_storm()
	local ret = nil

	if #self.storm_pool == 0 then
		local canceled_storm = self.instantiated_storm_table[1]
		canceled_storm:deactivate()
		canceled_storm:return_to_pool()
	end

	ret = table.remove(self.storm_pool, 1)

	table.insert(self.instantiated_storm_table, ret)

	return ret
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.cast)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.current_storm.attack_range:Hide()

		if next_state ~= self.state.attack then
			self.current_storm:return_to_pool()
		end


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.storm_post then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.storm_link_cast then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.storm_link then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.cast_duration))
		self.current_storm = self:get_new_storm()
		self.current_storm.attack_range:Show(self.cast_duration)

		self.current_storm.center_pos = self.target.Position
		self.current_storm:optimize_pos_and_direction()

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.current_storm.attack_range, self.current_storm.center_pos)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast' .. self:get_animation_postfix())

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.current_storm:activate()
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack' .. self:get_animation_postfix())

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.storm_post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.storm_link_cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast' .. self:get_animation_postfix())
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.storm_link_cast_duration))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.storm_link then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack' .. self:get_animation_postfix())
		self.current_shoot_idx = 1
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	for i = #self.instantiated_storm_table, 1, -1 do
		--todo: 죽었을 때 에러 픽스
		if self.instantiated_storm_table[i].active_self then
			self.instantiated_storm_table[i]:update_frame(dt)
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed < self.trace_duration then
			self.current_storm.center_pos = self.target.Position
			self.current_storm:optimize_pos_and_direction()

			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.current_storm.attack_range, self.current_storm.center_pos)
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.attack)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		if self.time_passed > self.attack_duration then
			if self.is_aerial then
				self:change_state(self.state.storm_post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.storm_post then

		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.storm_link_cast)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.storm_link_cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.storm_link_cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.storm_link)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.storm_link then

		if self.current_shoot_idx == self.shoot_disabled_idx then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.time_passed > self.storm_link_term * self.current_shoot_idx then
				self.instantiated_storm_table[self.current_shoot_idx]:shoot(vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.instantiated_storm_table[self.current_shoot_idx].center_pos))
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.sfx_key.storm_link)
				self.current_shoot_idx = self.current_shoot_idx + 1
				if self.current_shoot_idx > #self.instantiated_storm_table then
					self.current_shoot_idx = self.shoot_disabled_idx
				end
			end
		end


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:deactivate_all_storms()
	for i = #self.instantiated_storm_table, 1, -1 do
		self.instantiated_storm_table[i]:deactivate()
		self.instantiated_storm_table[i]:return_to_pool()
	end
end

function local_class:get_damage_rate(origin_rate, target)
	if target == user_party.Leader and target.FieldObjectBehaviour.BattleStyleSpec.Name == self.sword_style_name then
		return origin_rate * self.sword_damage_rate
	else
		return origin_rate
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate_all_storms()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.storm_pool = nil
	self.instantiated_storm_table = nil
	self.current_storm = nil
	self.storm_methods = nil

	self.state = nil
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_destroyed_event_func)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
	self.min_x = bound.center.x - bound.extents.x + self.attack_radius
	self.max_x = bound.center.x + bound.extents.x - self.attack_radius

	self.min_z = bound.center.z - bound.extents.z + self.attack_radius
	self.max_z = bound.center.z + bound.extents.z - self.attack_radius
end

function local_class:set_aerial_state(is_aerial)
	self.is_aerial = is_aerial
end

function local_class:get_animation_postfix()
	return self.is_aerial and '_aerial' or '_stage'
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)

function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then

	end

function local_class:determine_stage_target_pos()
	local rand_vec = vector_util.normalized(vector(random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5, 0, random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5))
	local rand_pos = self.target.Position + rand_vec * self.stage_teleport_radius

	while not field:IsThereFloorAt(rand_pos) do
		rand_vec = vector_util.normalized(vector(random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5, 0, random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5))
		rand_pos = self.target.Position + rand_vec * self.stage_teleport_radius
	end

	self.target_pos = rand_pos
end

function local_class:teleport_to_aerial()
	self:remove_area()
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action,
			self.target_pos.x < self.battle_zone.center.x
					and CS.Oak.Direction.Right
					or CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
	self.character.Direction = self.character.LockedDirection

	self.character.Position = self.target_pos
	self.character.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'unique/Idle_wing'
	self.character.CustomDamagedAnimationName = 'unique/damaged_wing'
	message_system:Send(self.character.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(self.character)))

	self.character.CustomIdleAnimationName = ''
	self.character.CustomDamagedAnimationName = ''

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('teleport', self.character.Position)

	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.stage_knock_back_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) and
				not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and
				not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then

			local direction = vector_util.normalized(v.Position - self.character.Position)
			if vector_util.is_almost_zero(direction) then
				direction = vector_util.forward
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.stage_knock_back_force
			local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()

	self:set_area()
	self.character.Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('shield')

	self.current_boss_state = self.boss_state.stage
end

function local_class:remove_area()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.None
	if self.barrier_fx ~= nil then
		self.barrier_fx:Dispose()
		self.barrier_fx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:set_area()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCheckDistanceDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour.MaxDist = self.area_max_dist
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.None

	self.barrier_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('barrier', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero, self.character.transform)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed > self.teleport_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil

	self.boss_state = nil
	self.target_pos = nil

	self.aerial_point_prefix = nil

	if self.barrier_fx ~= nil then
		self.barrier_fx:Dispose()
		self.barrier_fx = nil
	end

	self.state = nil
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_destroyed_event_func)
end

function local_class:force_disable_barrier_fx()
	if self.barrier_fx ~= nil then
		self.barrier_fx:Dispose()
		self.barrier_fx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:force_enable_barrier_fx()
	if self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then

	end

	if self.barrier_fx == nil then
		self.barrier_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('barrier', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero, self.character.transform)
	end
end

function local_class:is_aerial_state()
	return self.current_boss_state == self.boss_state.aerial
end

function local_class:initialize_state()
	if not self:is_aerial_state() then
		self:set_area()
	else
		self:determine_aerial_target_pos()
		self:teleport_to_aerial()
	end
end

function local_class:set_aerial_state()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossPlagueFatChargeBattleAction')
-- BossInvaderKnightChargeBattleAction 참고

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.5)
	self.charge_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargePrepareDuration', 0.3)
	self.trace_target_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TraceTargetDuration', 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.5)
	self.charge_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDistance', 20)
	local charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeWidth', 2)
	local damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageTerm', 0.25)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1)
	self.charge_repeat_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'MaxCombo', 3)
	self.side_only = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'PostSideOnly', true)

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(self.charge_distance, charge_width))
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = damage_term
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(charge_width / 2, 2, charge_width / 2)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		charge_prepare = 3,
		action = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	self.target = nil

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.charge_distance
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.current_charge_count = 0
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(
				self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.casting_effect) then
		self.casting_effect:Dispose()
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.is_shot_start = false

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare or self.current_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()

		if not is_unity_null(self.casting_effect) then
			self.casting_effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.synced = nil
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if not is_unity_null(self.smoke_fx) then
			self.smoke_fx:Dispose()
			self.smoke_fx = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.attack_range:Show(0)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if not self.is_casting_start then
			self.casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('casting', self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('casting')
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('casting')
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('casting')
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_prepare_duration))
		local _, dir = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_battle_action, self.target, direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)))
		self.charge_direction = dir
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(0)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.synced = false
		-- 돌진 시작
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('charge')

		self.current_charge_count = self.current_charge_count + 1
		local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
				unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(self.charge_direction)).eulerAngles.y

		self.smoke_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('smoke', self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.Transform)
		self.smoke_fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 사이드만 사용하는 애니메이션일 경우 방향 변경, AtomicMoveEvent로 인해 변경되기 때문에 방향 고정
		if self.side_only then
			local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed <= self.trace_target_duration then
				local _, dir = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_battle_action, self.target, direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)))
				self.charge_direction = dir
				battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.charge_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.action_duration * dt

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
					local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
					local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
					local knock_direction
					if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
					else
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		else
			if self.current_charge_count < self.charge_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.charge_prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.charge_distance = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil
	self.charge_repeat_count = nil
	self.side_only = nil

	self.charge_direction = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then

		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_direction
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action')
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 사이드만 사용하는 애니메이션일 경우 방향 변경
		if self.side_only then
			local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
			character_util.set_direction(self.character, side_dir)
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		-- 이펙트 출력
		if not self.effect_shown and self.time_passed >= self.attack_effect_delay then
			self.effect_shown = true
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('shockwave', self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shockwave')
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_radius = nil
	self.attack_effect_delay = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil
	self.side_only = nil

	self.effect_shown = nil

	self.target_direction = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
