local local_class = newclass('BossPlagueFatStompBattleAction')
-- BossSuperInvaderFireStompBattleAction 참고

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 0.2)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.5)

	self.dangling_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DanglingDuration', 1)
	self.fall_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FallDuration', 0.3)
	self.jump_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'JumpTime', 0.3)
	self.jump_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'JumpHeight', 15)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1.0)

	local stomp_damage_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StompDamageDuration', 0.2)
	local stomp_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StompRadius', 3)
	local damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageTerm', 0.25)

	self.lock_direction = CS.Utils.GetDirectionFromDictionary(params, 'LockDirection')
	self.side_only = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'SideOnly')

	self.rock_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'RockAmount', 3)
	self.initial_fall_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'InitialFallDelay', 0.3)
	self.rock_fall_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RockFallDelay', 1.0)
	self.rock_fall_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RockFallHeight', 10.0)
	self.rock_fall_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RockFallDuration', 1.0)
	self.rock_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RockModifier', 1)
	self.rock_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RockRadius', 1)

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, stomp_radius)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 낙하 바위 어택레인지
	self.rock_ranges = {}
	for _ = 1, self.rock_count do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.rock_radius)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.rock_ranges, range)
	end

	-- 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = damage_term
	info.Duration = stomp_damage_duration
	info.Radius = stomp_radius
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false)

	-- 투사체
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'Projectile', 'demon_rock_piece')
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec(proj_name)
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		jump = 3,
		dangling = 4,
		fall = 5,
		stomp = 6,
		post = 7
	}

	self.target = nil
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.target_position = nil
	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.jump_pos_offset = 2

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:get_fall_range()
	if #self.rock_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.rock_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.rock_radius)
		range:Hide()
		return range
	end

end

function local_class:return_fall_range(range)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	range:Hide()

	if self.rock_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.rock_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:show_attack_range(position)
	if not self.attack_range.gameObject.activeSelf then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, position)
		self.attack_range:Show(0)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end
end

function local_class:hide_attack_range()
	if self.attack_range.gameObject.activeSelf then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if not is_unity_null(self.shoot_helper) then
		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	local dir_to_look = self.lock_direction
	if dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		if self.side_only == true then
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		else
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		end
	end

	if dir_to_look ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir_to_look)
	end

	self.is_jump_start = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.is_jump_start then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'enabled')
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
	end
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:hide_attack_range()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'enabled')
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self:hide_attack_range()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.jump_start_position, self.zone_center, false)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('jump')
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('jump', self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('jump', self.character.Position)
		self.is_jump_start = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.dangling then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'disabled')
		self:show_attack_range(self.target_position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('stomp')
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.is_jump_start = false
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self:distribute_rock()

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('stomp', self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp', self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:falling_rock_damage(damage_pos)
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(damage_pos, self.rock_radius, 2)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects.Values[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.rock_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 낙하 오브젝트 업데이트 처리
	if self.falling_rocks ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.falling_rocks, 1, -1 do
			local rock_tp =  self.falling_rocks[i].time_passed + dt
			self.falling_rocks[i].time_passed = rock_tp

			-- 완료시 삭제
			if rock_tp >= self.rock_fall_duration then
				-- 낙하 위치에 데미지 + 넉백
				self:falling_rock_damage(self.falling_rocks[i].position)
				-- 투사체 패턴 발사.
				local shoot_pos = self.falling_rocks[i].position
				shoot_pos.y = shoot_pos.y + 0.2
				self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, unity_class.vector3.forward, i, -1, nil, false, 0)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shot', shoot_pos)
				-- 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('break', shoot_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('break', self.falling_rocks[i].position)
				-- 오브젝트 삭제
				if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object) then
					self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
				end
				self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object = nil
				-- 그림자 제거 (TimeLimit 이므로 연출로 자연 소멸하게 놔둠)
				self.falling_rocks[i].shadow = nil
				-- 어택 레인지 반납
				self:return_fall_range(self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range)
				self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range = nil
				-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
				table.remove(self.falling_rocks, i)
			elseif rock_tp >= 0 then
				local prog = rock_tp / self.rock_fall_duration
				local calc_pos = self.falling_rocks[i].position + self.rock_fall_height * (1 - prog * prog) * unity_class.vector3.up

				if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object) then
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				else
					self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('rock', calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.falling_rocks[i].shadow = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('shadow', self.falling_rocks[i].position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.dangling)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

					if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
						dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_rocks()
	-- 낙하중이던 오브젝트 해제
	if self.falling_rocks ~= nil then
		for i = #self.falling_rocks, 1, -1 do
			-- 오브젝트 제거
			if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object) then
				self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object = nil
			-- 그림자 제거 (remove 시엔 즉시 제거)
			if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].shadow) then
				self.falling_rocks[i].shadow:Dispose()
			end
			self.falling_rocks[i].shadow = nil
			-- 어택 레인지 반납
			self:return_fall_range(self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range)
			self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range = nil
			-- 해제 & 리스트에서 제거
			table.remove(self.falling_rocks, i)
		end
	end
	self.falling_rocks = nil
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:remove_rocks()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	-- Active 상태일 때만 sync.
	if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		-- 이전 데이터 남아있다면 먼저 지움
		if self.falling_rocks ~= nil then
			self:remove_rocks()
		end

		-- 새 바위 데이터 생성해서 넣음
		self.falling_rocks = {}
		local poses = info.Positions
		for i = 0, poses.Count-1 do
			local pos = poses[i]
			local range = self:get_fall_range()
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, pos)
			range:Show(i * self.rock_fall_delay)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			table.insert(self.falling_rocks, {
				position = pos,
				time_passed = - self.initial_fall_delay - i * self.rock_fall_delay,
				attack_range = range
			})
		end
	end
end

function local_class:distribute_rock()
	if self.sliced_zone_positions ~= nil then
		-- get_values_in_array 에서 배열에 있는 값을 제거하기 때문에 복제 필요
		local copied_shoot_points = {}
		for _, point in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_positions) do
			table.insert(copied_shoot_points, point)
		end

		-- 돌 떨어질 위치 설정
		local random_points = random_util.get_values_in_array(copied_shoot_points, {count = self.rock_count})

		-- 돌 떨어질 위치에 대해 싱크 커맨드
		local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
		for _, point in ipairs(random_points) do
			point.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(point):GetHeightAt(point)
			info:AppendPosition(point)
		end

		local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
		command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not is_unity_null(self.shoot_helper) then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	if self.rock_ranges ~= nil then
		for _, range in ipairs(self.rock_ranges) do
			if not is_unity_null(range) then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(range)
			end
		end
		self.rock_ranges = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.zone_center = nil
	self.sliced_zone_positions = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.target_position = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
	-- zone bound 9등분 해서 저장, 중심은 착지할 위치이기 때문에 저장하지 않음
	self.zone_center = bound.center
	local modX = bound.size.x / 3
	local modZ = bound.size.z / 3

	self.sliced_zone_positions = {}
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_positions, self.zone_center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_positions, self.zone_center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, modZ))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_positions, self.zone_center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_positions, self.zone_center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, 0))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_positions, self.zone_center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, 0))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_positions, self.zone_center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_positions, self.zone_center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -modZ))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_positions, self.zone_center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, -modZ))
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossPortraitMeteorStrikeBattleAction')

local meteor_class = {
	parent_class = nil,
}
meteor_class.mt = { __index = meteor_class }

function meteor_class:new(parent_class, destination)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	-- 기본 정보
	obj.parent_class = parent_class
	obj.action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.character = parent_class.character
	obj.time_passed = 0
	obj.height = parent_class.falling_height
	obj.duration = parent_class.falling_duration
	obj.destination = destination
	obj.state = parent_class.meteor_state
	obj.aoe_duration = parent_class.aoe_duration
	obj.height_offset = parent_class.height_offset
	obj.aoe_radius = parent_class.aoe_radius
	obj.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, parent_class.aoe_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	obj.attack_range:Hide()

	obj.fx_cast = nil

	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(obj.aoe_radius, obj.aoe_duration, -1)
	obj.calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(parent_class.character, collision_info, false, 0, 0)

	obj.current_state = nil

	obj:change_state(obj.state.none)
	return obj
end

function meteor_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.falling then
		if self.fx_meteor ~= nil then
			self.fx_meteor:Dispose()
			self.fx_meteor = nil
		end

		if self.fx_cast ~= nil then
			self.fx_cast:Dispose()
			self.fx_cast = nil
		end

		self:attack_range_end()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.impact then
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.falling then
		self:attack_range_start(self.destination, self.duration)
		self.fx_meteor = self.action:InstantiateEffect("meteor", self.destination + self.height_offset)
		self.fx_cast = self.action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.destination)

	elseif next_state == self.state.impact then
		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 지정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.destination)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		self.action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.destination)
		self.action:PlaySfx("explosion", self.destination)

		stage_camera:Shake(self.parent_class.camera_shake_strength, 0.7)
	else

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function meteor_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then return end

	if self.current_state == self.state.falling then
		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.impact)
		else
			if self.fx_meteor ~= nil then
				local progress = self.time_passed / self.duration
				local current_height = (1 - progress) * self.height
				local current_pos = self.destination + current_height * vector_util.up
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_meteor, current_pos)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.impact then
		if self.time_passed >= self.aoe_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		else
			self:update_aoe(dt)
		end
	end

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self:change_state(self.state.post)
	else

	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end
function meteor_class:update_aoe(dt)
	--- 충돌 판정 활성화
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) and not area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
				self:apply_damage(target)
			end
		end

		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

function meteor_class:attack_range_start()
	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.destination, 0)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end
end
function meteor_class:attack_range_end()
	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self. attack_range))
	end
end

function meteor_class:apply_damage(target)
	if target == nil then return end

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.parent_class.damage_modifier

	local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - self.destination).normalized
	local knock_direction = direction

	if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
		--일반 디렉션은 수정 안해줘도 되는지?
		knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(target))
	end

	damage_info.direction = direction
	damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
	damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.parent_class.knockback_modifier

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

function meteor_class:dispose()
	if self.fx_meteor ~= nil then
		self.fx_meteor:Dispose()
	end

	if self.calculator ~= nil then
		self.calculator:End()
		self.calculator = nil
	end

	self.parent_class = nil
	self.fx_meteor = nil
	self.destination = nil

	if self.calculator ~= nil then
		if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
		self.calculator = nil
	end
end

	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 싱크용 빈 커맨드 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.current_drop_count = 0

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.current_drop_count = self.current_drop_count + 1
		self.meteor_time_passed = 0

		local meteor = meteor_class:new(self, self.character.Position + self.drop_offset)
		meteor:change_state(self.meteor_state.falling)
		table.insert(self.meteors, meteor)

		--[[
		for _, pos in pairs(self.meteor_drop_positions) do
			local meteor = meteor_class:new(self, pos)
			meteor:change_state(self.meteor_state.falling)
			table.insert(self.meteors, meteor)
		end]]

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 메테오가 있다면 BattleAction의 상태와 무관하게 업데이트 해준다.
	self:update_meteor(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.current_drop_count >= self.drop_count then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_meteor(dt)
	if self.meteors ~= nil and #self.meteors > 0 then
		for idx = #self.meteors, 1, -1 do
			local meteor = self.meteors[idx]
			if meteor ~= nil then
				if meteor.current_state == self.meteor_state.none then
					meteor:dispose()
					table.remove(self.meteors, idx)
				else
					meteor:update_frame(dt)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	for idx = #self.meteors, 1, -1 do
		local meteor = self.meteors[idx]
		if meteor ~= nil then
			meteor:dispose()
			table.remove(self.meteors, idx)
		end
	end
	self.meteors = nil
	self.meteor_drop_positions = nil

	self.center_drop_pos = nil
	self.left_drop_pos = nil
	self.right_drop_pos = nil

	self.drop_offset = nil
	self.height_offset = nil
	self.meteor_state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

			if not is_unity_null(self.cast_effect) then
				self.cast_effect:Dispose()
			end
			self.cast_effect = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

		if not is_unity_null(self.cast_effect) then
			self.cast_effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.cast_effect = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.character.Position + self.fx_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attacked = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.attacked and self.time_passed >= self.attack_timing then
			self.attacked = true

			if not is_unity_null(self.cast_effect) then
				self.cast_effect:Dispose()
			end
			self.cast_effect = nil
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("attack", self.character.Position + self.fx_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)

			local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
			if targets ~= nil then
				for i = 0, targets.Count-1 do
					local fo = targets[i]
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

						-- 디버프
						buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, self.debuff_name, self.debuff_lv, false, false)
						-- 도트
						buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, self.poison_name, self.poison_lv, false, false)
					end
				end
				targets:Dispose()
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossPriscillaAbsorptionBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.2)

	self.blood_bead_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "BloodBeadCount", 9)
	self.special_bead_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "SpecialBloodBeadCount", 3)
	self.special_bead_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SpecialBeadDamageModifier", 1.2)

	self.monster_summon_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "SummonCount", 4)
	self.monster_name_Base = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "SummonNameBase", "priscilla_summon_")
	self.summon_margin = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SummonMargin", 0.5)
	self.summon_characters = {}

	self.bead_max_pos_z = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BeadMaxPosY", 5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 5)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3, --구슬 생성 및 흡수
		post = 4
	}

	self.on_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_event_func)

	self.bead_interval_duration = self.action_duration / self.blood_bead_count
	self.current_bead_count = 0
	self.current_special_bead_count = 0
	self.current_total_bead_count = 0
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.summon_positions = {}
	self.special_bead_index_list = nil
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	local min = bound.min
	local max = bound.max
	local center = bound.center
	--소환 몬스터용 존 상하좌우 위치
	self.summon_positions = {
		unity_class.vector3(center.x, 0, max.z - self.summon_margin),
		unity_class.vector3(min.x + self.summon_margin, 0, center.z),
		unity_class.vector3(max.x - self.summon_margin, 0, center.z),
		unity_class.vector3(center.x, 0, min.z + self.summon_margin)
	}

	self.bead_margin = 1
	self.bead_min_x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.bead_margin
	self.bead_min_z = self.zone_bound.min.z + self.bead_margin
	self.bead_max_z = self.bead_min_z + self.bead_max_pos_z
	self.bead_max_x = self.zone_bound.max.x - self.bead_margin
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.current_bead_count = 0
	self.special_bead_index_list = nil
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:reset_ailment()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self:reset_ailment()
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		--상태이상 면역
		self:set_ailment_resist()
		self.special_bead_index_list = self:get_special_bead_index_list()
		self.current_special_bead_count = 1
		self.current_bead_count = 1
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:knockback_party()
		self:summon_character()
		self:blood_bead_absorb()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("blood_bead")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("blood_bead")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blood_bead")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:get_special_bead_index_list()
	local idx_list = {}
	local list = {}
	for i = 1, self.blood_bead_count do
		table.insert(list, i)
	end

	idx_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(list, {count = self.special_bead_count})
	return idx_list
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.current_bead_count >= self.blood_bead_count then
				if self.current_total_bead_count <= 0 then
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			end
			self:update_blood_bead()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:knockback_party()
	--타겟타피 넉백
	local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if targets ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(targets) do
			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
					v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
			else
				local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.zone_bound.center - v.Position).normalized
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = v
				damage_info.modifier = 0
				damage_info.direction = -dir
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = -dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		targets:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:get_random_bead_position()
	local random_pos_x = unity_class.random.Range(self.bead_min_x, self.bead_max_x)
	local random_pos_z = unity_class.random.Range(self.bead_min_z, self.bead_max_z)
	local pos = vector(random_pos_x, 0, random_pos_z)

	return vector_util.get_x0z(pos, battle_util.get_height(pos) + 0.1)
end

function local_class:update_blood_bead()
	if self.time_passed <= self.action_duration then
		if self.time_passed >= self.bead_interval_duration * self.current_bead_count then
			if self.current_bead_count < self.blood_bead_count then
				self.current_bead_count = self.current_bead_count + 1
				--랜덤위치에 소환
				--
				local random_pos = self:get_random_bead_position()
				local bead_mode = 1
				if self.current_special_bead_count < self.special_bead_count then
					if self:check_special_bead_index(self.current_bead_count) then
						bead_mode = 2
						self.current_special_bead_count = self.current_special_bead_count + 1
					end
				end

				self:blood_bead(random_pos, bead_mode)
				self:blood_bead_absorb()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_special_bead_index(idx)
	for _,v in pairs(self.special_bead_index_list) do
		if idx == v then
			return true, _
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:blood_bead(pos, mode)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
			{
				-- 어떤 이벤트인지
				'blood_bead_drop_request_by_position',
				-- x좌표
				pos.x,
				-- y좌표
				pos.y,
				-- z좌표
				pos.z,
				mode
			}))
end

--모든 구슬 모스에게 이동
function local_class:blood_bead_absorb()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
			{
				-- 어떤 이벤트인지
				'blood_bead_move_request_by_target',
				-- 이동할 타겟
				self.character.Name
			}))
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if self.character ~= nil then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
			if  e:GetParamAt(0) == 'blood_bead_collide' then
				if e:GetParamAt(1) ~= self.character.Name then
					local target = get_character(e:GetParamAt(1))
					if tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2)) == 2 then --특별 구슬 증감 이벤트
						if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, target.EntityGroup) or
								target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, target) then
						else
							local dir = unity_class.vector3.back

							local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
							damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
							damage_info.sender = self.character
							damage_info.target = target
							damage_info.modifier = self.special_bead_damage_modifier * 5
							damage_info.direction = dir

							command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		elseif e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
			-- 구슬 갯수 증감 이벤트
			if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'blood_bead_create' then
				self.current_total_bead_count = self.current_total_bead_count + 1
				self:try_check_bloody_hail()
			elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'blood_bead_dispose' then
				self.current_total_bead_count = self.current_total_bead_count - 1
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)

end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:summon_character()
	local picker = {}
	for _,p in ipairs(self.summon_positions) do
		table.insert(picker, p)
	end

	local random_points = random_util.get_values_in_array(picker, {count = self.monster_summon_count})
	local count = 1
	for _,v in ipairs(self.summon_characters) do
		if v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead or not stage.BattleManager:IsCharacterInActiveBattle(v) then

			local pos = random_points[count]
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("summon", pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			v.Position = pos
			v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

			-- 힐
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
			heal_info.heal = v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			heal_info.sender = self.character
			heal_info.target = v

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

			-- 몬스터 노티스 이벤트를 쏴준다
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(v, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
			message_system:Send(v.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(v, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

			count = count + 1

			if count > #random_points then
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

--소환 몬스터 리스트 생성
function local_class:initialize_summon_list()
	-- 팬 캐릭터
	self.summon_characters = {}

	for i = 1, 99 do
		local obj = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.monster_name_Base, i))
		if is_unity_null(obj) then
			break
		else
			table.insert(self.summon_characters, obj)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	-- 모든 살아있는 팬 전부 강제 킬
	for _,v in ipairs(self.summon_characters) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			if not v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(v.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
					v.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
				else
					v.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterConstantDamagedBehaviour()
					v.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
				damage_info.sender = v
				damage_info.target = v
				damage_info.noCritical = true
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10)

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

				v.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	-- NOTE: 이 액션은 Dispose땐 force_cancel 불필요
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_event_func)
		self.on_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.summon_positions = nil
	self.special_bead_index_list = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	self.character = c

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)

	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.2)

	self.shot_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotPrepareDuration", 3)
	self.shot_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ShootCount", 5)
	self.damage_modifier_proj_a = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifierProjA", 1)
	self.shot_radius_proj_a = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotRadiusProjA", 1)
	self.explosion_radius_proj_a = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionRadiusProjA", 1)
	self.shot_move_speed_proj_a = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotMoveSpeedProjA", 15)
	self.shoot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootInterval", 0.5)
	self.shot_duration_proj_a = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotDurationProjA", 4)
	local proj_a_offset_x_list = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "ProjAOffsetX")
	local proj_a_offset_z_list = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "ProjAOffsetZ")
	local proj_b_offset_list = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "ProjBOffset")

	self.damage_modifier_proj_b = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifierProjB", 1.5)
	self.shot_radius_proj_b = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotRadiusProjB", 1)
	self.explosion_radius_proj_b = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionRadiusProjB", 1.5)
	self.shot_move_speed_proj_b = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotMoveSpeedProjB", 5)
	self.shot_duration_proj_b = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotDurationProjB", 5)

	self.laser_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserDistance", 10)
	self.laser_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserWidth", 1)
	self.laser_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Laserduration", 15)
	self.laser_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserDamageModifier", 1.2)
	self.laser_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserDamageTerm", 0.5)
	self.chain_knockback_offset_angle = 110

	self.enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced", false)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2, --케스팅
		shot_prepare = 3, --proj 순차 생성
		shot_proj_a = 4, -- 1차 포격 순차 발사
		shot_proj_b = 5, -- 2차 포격 후 레이저
		post = 6
	}

	self.proj_a_range_list = {}
	for _ = 1, self.shot_count do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.explosion_radius_proj_a, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.proj_a_range_list, range)
	end

	self.proj_b_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.explosion_radius_proj_b, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.proj_b_range:Hide()

	self.proj_a_offset_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.shot_count do
		table.insert(self.proj_a_offset_list, vector(proj_a_offset_x_list[i], 0, proj_a_offset_z_list[i]))
	end
	self.proj_b_offset = vector(proj_b_offset_list[1], proj_b_offset_list[2], proj_b_offset_list[3])

	self.shoot_dir_list = {
		unity_class.vector3.right,
		unity_class.vector3.left,
		unity_class.vector3.forward,
		unity_class.vector3.back
	}

	self.laser_info_list = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(self.laser_info_list, {
			laser_effect = nil,
			shoot_dir = self.shoot_dir_list[i],
			distance = 0
		})
	end

	self.laser_attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local attack_range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,
				self.laser_distance, self.laser_width, 0)
		table.insert(self.laser_attack_range_list, attack_range)
	end

	self.laser_start_pos = nil
	self.proj_b_info = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.laser_core_effect = nil
	self.proj_a_info_list = nil
	self.laser_hit_target_list = nil
	self.proj_a_time_passed = 0
	self.current_proj_a_index = 0
	self.laser_time_passed = 0
	self.is_laser_start = false
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	if self.proj_a_info_list ~= nil then
		self.proj_a_info_list = nil
	end
	self.proj_a_info_list = {}
	if self.laser_hit_target_list ~= nil then
		self.laser_hit_target_list = nil
	end
	self.laser_hit_target_list = {}
	self.proj_b_info = nil
	self.laser_start_pos = nil
	self.is_laser_start = false
	self.start_laser = false
	self.proj_a_time_passed = 0
	self.current_proj_a_index = 0

	for _,v in pairs(self.laser_info_list) do
		if v.effect ~= nil then
			v.effect:Dispose()
			v.effect = nil
		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range_list[_]))
	end
	if self.laser_core_effect ~= nil then
		self.laser_core_effect:Dispose()
		self.laser_core_effect = nil
	end

	self.laser_time_passed = 0
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.proj_a_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.proj_a_info_list) do
			if not v.is_done then
				v.is_done = true
				if self.proj_a_range_list[_] ~= nil then
					CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.proj_a_range_list[_]))
					self.proj_a_range_list[_]:Hide()
				end
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.proj_b_info ~= nil and not self.proj_b_info.is_done then
		self.proj_b_info.is_done = true
		if self.proj_b_range ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.proj_b_range))
			self.proj_b_range:Hide()
		end
		if self.proj_b_info.effect ~= nil then
			self.proj_b_info.effect:Dispose()
			self.proj_b_info.effect = nil
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.shot_prepare then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		if not self.enhanced then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_proj_a then
		if not self.enhanced then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_proj_b then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:init_projs()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shot_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("shot_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot_prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.shot_proj_a then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--폭발형 구체 순차적으로 발사
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shot_a")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("shot_a")
	elseif next_state == self.state.shot_proj_b then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--폭발 후 레이저 생성 구체 발사
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shot_b")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("shot_b")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot_b")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:init_projs()
	for i = 1, self.shot_count do
		local start_pos = self.character.Position + self.proj_a_offset_list[i]
		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(
				"proj_a", start_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		table.insert(self.proj_a_info_list, {
			effect = effect,
			start_pos = start_pos,
			time_passed = 0,
			is_start = false,
			is_done = false,
		})
	end

	if self.enhanced then
		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(
				"proj_b", self.character.Position + self.proj_b_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)

		self.proj_b_info = {
			start_pos = self.character.Position + self.proj_b_offset,
			effect = effect,
			time_passed = 0,
			is_start = false,
			is_done = false
		}
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_laser_start then
		self:update_laser(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot_prepare)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot_proj_a)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_proj_a then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_duration_proj_a then
			if self.enhanced then
				self:change_state(self.state.shot_proj_b)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		else
			if self.current_proj_a_index < self.shot_count then
				if self.proj_a_time_passed > self.shoot_interval * self.current_proj_a_index + self.shoot_interval then
					self.current_proj_a_index = self.current_proj_a_index + 1
					self.proj_a_info_list[self.current_proj_a_index].dest_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.target.Position))

					local diff = self.target.Position - self.proj_a_info_list[self.current_proj_a_index].start_pos
					local dist = diff.magnitude
					local move_duration = dist / self.shot_move_speed_proj_a
					self.proj_a_info_list[self.current_proj_a_index].move_duration = move_duration
					self.proj_a_info_list[self.current_proj_a_index].is_start = true

					local ar = self.proj_a_range_list[self.current_proj_a_index]
					battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, self.target.Position)
					battle_range_util.show(ar, move_duration)
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shoot_a")
				else
					self.proj_a_time_passed = self.proj_a_time_passed + dt
				end
			end
			self:update_proj_a(dt)

			if self:is_done_proj_a() then
				if self.enhanced then
					self:change_state(self.state.shot_proj_b)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_proj_b then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_duration_proj_b then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if not self.proj_b_info.is_start then
				local diff = self.target.Position - self.proj_b_info.start_pos
				local dist = diff.magnitude
				local move_duration = dist / self.shot_move_speed_proj_b
				self.proj_b_info.dest_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.target.Position))
				self.proj_b_info.move_duration = move_duration
				self.proj_b_info.is_start = true
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.proj_b_range, self.target.Position)
				self.proj_b_range:Show(move_duration)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.proj_b_range))
			else
				if self.proj_b_info.is_done then
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				else
					self:update_proj_b(dt)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

--흡혈 구슬 생성
function local_class:blood_bead(target)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
			{
				-- 어떤 이벤트인지
				'blood_bead_drop_request_by_target',
				-- 어느 캐릭터 주위로 뿌릴것인지
				target.Name,
				-- 몇개 뿌릴것인지
				1
			}))
end

function local_class:update_proj_a(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.proj_a_info_list) do
		if v.is_start and not v.is_done then
			v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
			local progress = v.time_passed / v.move_duration
			if progress > 1 then
				--폭발이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_a_explosion", v.dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("proj_a_explosion")
				--폭발 데미지 체크
				self:explosion_proj_a(v)

				v.is_done = true
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.proj_a_range_list[_]))
				self.proj_a_range_list[_]:Hide()
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end
			else
				local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(v.start_pos, v.dest_pos, progress)
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(v.effect,
							move_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj_b(dt)
	if self.proj_b_info.is_start and not self.proj_b_info.is_done then
		self.proj_b_info.time_passed = self.proj_b_info.time_passed + dt
		local progress = self.proj_b_info.time_passed / self.proj_b_info.move_duration
		if progress > 1 then
			--폭발 이펙트 및 십자 레이저
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_b_explosion", self.proj_b_info.dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("laser_start")

			self.proj_b_info.is_done = true
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.proj_b_range))
			self.proj_b_range:Hide()
			if self.proj_b_info.effect ~= nil then
				self.proj_b_info.effect:Dispose()
				self.proj_b_info.effect = nil
			end
			--레이저 생성
			self:start_laser_routine(self.proj_b_info.dest_pos)

			--폭발 데미지 체크
			local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.proj_b_info.dest_pos, self.explosion_radius_proj_b)

			for _,v2 in pairs(fo_list) do
				if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
						v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
						lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) then
				else
					local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v2.Position - self.proj_b_info.dest_pos).normalized

					if dmg_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
						dmg_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.target))
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = v2
					damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier_proj_b
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = dmg_dir
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					self:blood_bead(v2)
				end
			end

			fo_list:Dispose()
		else
			local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.proj_b_info.start_pos, self.proj_b_info.dest_pos, progress)
			if self.proj_b_info.effect ~= nil then
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.proj_b_info.effect,
						move_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:explosion_proj_a(info)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(info.dest_pos, self.explosion_radius_proj_a)

	for _,v2 in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
				v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) then
		else
			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v2.Position - info.dest_pos).normalized

			if dmg_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dmg_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.target))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v2
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier_proj_a
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dmg_dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			self:blood_bead(v2)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_laser(dt)
	if self.laser_time_passed > self.laser_duration then
		--레이저 종료
		self.start_laser = false
		for _,v in pairs(self.laser_info_list) do
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				v.effect:Dispose()
				v.effect = nil
			end
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range_list[_]))
		end

		if self.laser_core_effect ~= nil then
			self.laser_core_effect:Dispose()
			self.laser_core_effect = nil
		end
	else
		self.laser_time_passed = self.laser_time_passed + dt
		--레이저 데미지 체크
		local col_width = self.laser_width
		local boundP_size = vector(col_width, 1.5, col_width)

		for i = #self.laser_hit_target_list, 1, -1 do
			self.laser_hit_target_list[i].time_passed = self.laser_hit_target_list[i].time_passed - dt
			if self.laser_hit_target_list[i].time_passed <= 0 then
				table.remove(self.laser_hit_target_list, i)
			end
		end

		for _,v in pairs(self.laser_info_list) do
			local target_pos = self.laser_start_pos + (v.shoot_dir * self.laser_distance)
			local b = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(target_pos, boundP_size)
			local move = vector_util.get_x0z(self.laser_start_pos - target_pos)
			self:collision_check(b, move, dt)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:collision_check(b, move, dt)
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(b, move)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or
				self:check_hit_target(v) then
		else
			local dir_xz = vector_util.get_xz(move).normalized
			local target_dir_xz = vector_util.get_xz(v.Bounds.center - self.laser_start_pos).normalized
			local det = vector_util.cross(dir_xz, target_dir_xz)
			local angle = self.chain_knockback_offset_angle
			if det > 0 then
				angle = -self.chain_knockback_offset_angle
			end

			local knockback_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * move.normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = knockback_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.laser_damage_modifier
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			table.insert(self.laser_hit_target_list, {
				target = v,
				time_passed = self.laser_damage_term
			})

			self:blood_bead(v)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(target)
	for _,v in pairs(self.laser_hit_target_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.target, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_laser_routine(pos)
	self.laser_start_pos = pos
	for i, v in pairs(self.laser_info_list) do
		v.effect = self:create_laser_effect(pos, v.shoot_dir)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.laser_attack_range_list[i], pos, v.shoot_dir, self.laser_distance)
		self.laser_attack_range_list[i].Size = vector(self.laser_distance, self.laser_width)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range_list[i], 1000))
	end

	self.laser_core_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("laser_core", pos,
			unity_class.vector3.zero, nil)

	self.is_laser_start = true
end

function local_class:create_laser_effect(start_pos, shoot_dir)
	local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(shoot_dir.z, -shoot_dir.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
	local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
	local create_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(start_pos)
	local laser_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("laser", create_pos,
			vector(0, angle, 0), nil)
	laser_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation
	laser_effect.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)

	return laser_effect
end

function local_class:is_done_proj_a()
	for _,v in pairs(self.proj_a_info_list) do
		if not v.is_done then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	self.is_laser_start = false
	for _,v in pairs(self.laser_info_list) do
		if v.effect ~= nil then
			v.effect:Dispose()
			v.effect = nil
		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range_list[_]))
	end
	if self.laser_core_effect ~= nil then
		self.laser_core_effect:Dispose()
		self.laser_core_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.proj_a_range_list = nil
	self.proj_b_range = nil
	self.proj_a_offset_list = nil
	self.proj_b_offset = nil
	self.shoot_dir_list = nil
	self.laser_info_list = nil
	self.laser_attack_range_list = nil
	self.laser_start_pos = nil
	self.proj_a_info_list = nil
	self.proj_b_info = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
