local local_class = newclass('BossPriscillaBloodBeadExplosionBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 3)

	self.teleport_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TeleportDuration", 0.15)
	self.teleport_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TeleportPrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.teleport_effect_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TeleportEffectDelay", 0.3)

	self.absob_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AbsorbDuration", 2)
	self.explosion_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDuration", 1)
	self.explosion_damage_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDamageDuration", 0.1)
	self.explosion_damage_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDamageRate", 0.5)
	self.bead_damage_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDamageBloodBeadRate", 0.05)

	self.monster_summon_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "SummonCount", 4)
	self.monster_name_Base = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "SummonNameBase", "priscilla_summon_")
	self.summon_margin = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SummonMargin", 0.5)
	self.summon_characters = {}

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		teleport_prepare = 3,
		teleport = 4,
		Absorption = 5,
		explosion = 6,
		post = 7
	}

	self.on_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_event_func)

	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.is_teleport_effect = false
	self.teleport_finish = false
	self.current_bead_count = 0
	self.summon_positions = {}
	self.hit_target_list = nil
	self.cast_effect = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	local min = bound.min
	local max = bound.max
	local center = bound.center
	-- 존 상하좌우 위치
	self.summon_positions = {
		unity_class.vector3(center.x, 0, max.z - self.summon_margin),
		unity_class.vector3(min.x + self.summon_margin, 0, center.z),
		unity_class.vector3(max.x - self.summon_margin, 0, center.z),
		unity_class.vector3(center.x, 0, min.z + self.summon_margin)
	}

	--전체범위 공격 범위 표시기
	center.y = 0.3
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(center, unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.size.x, self.zone_bound.size.z))
	self.attack_range:Hide()
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.is_teleport_effect = false
	self.teleport_finish = false
	if self.hit_target_list ~= nil then
	self.hit_target_list = nil
	end
	self.hit_target_list = {}
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.Absorption then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		if self.cast_effect ~= nil then
			self.cast_effect:Dispose()
			self.cast_effect = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.is_teleport_effect = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("teleport")
		local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue("teleport_start")
		if has_value then
			sfx_info.parent = nil
			music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
		end
		self.teleport_finish = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink_thunder", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
	elseif next_state == self.state.Absorption then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.absob_duration))
		self:summon_character()
		self:blood_bead_absorb()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("Absorption")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("Absorption")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("Absorption")
		self.cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		-- 전체공격 어택 레인지
		self.attack_range:Show(self.absob_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("explosion")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("explosion")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("post")
		self.current_bead_count = 0
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport_prepare)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.teleport_effect_delay and not self.is_teleport_effect then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

			self.is_teleport_effect = true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then
			if not self.teleport_finish then
				self.teleport_finish = true
				self.character.Position = self.zone_bound.center
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
				self:change_state(self.state.Absorption)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.Absorption then
		if self.time_passed >= self.absob_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.explosion_damage_duration then
				self.attack_range:Hide()
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
				self:explosion_damage_update(dt)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:explosion_damage_update(dt)
	local b = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.zone_bound.center, self.zone_bound.size)
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(b, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or self:check_hit_target(v) then
		else
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			local add_rate = self.current_bead_count * self.bead_damage_rate
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(v) * (self.explosion_damage_rate + add_rate))

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(self.hit_target_list, v)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(target)
	for _,v in pairs(self.hit_target_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--모든 구슬 보스에게 이동
function local_class:blood_bead_absorb()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
			{
				-- 어떤 이벤트인지
				'blood_bead_move_request_by_target',
				-- 이동할 타겟
				self.character.Name
			}))
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if self.character ~= nil then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
			if  e:GetParamAt(0) == 'blood_bead_collide' then
				if e:GetParamAt(1) == self.character.Name then
					if tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2)) == 1 then --일반 구슬 증감 이벤트
						self.current_bead_count = self.current_bead_count + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:summon_character()
	local picker = {}
	for _,p in ipairs(self.summon_positions) do
		table.insert(picker, p)
	end

	local random_points = random_util.get_values_in_array(picker, {count = self.monster_summon_count})
	local count = 1
	for _,v in ipairs(self.summon_characters) do
		if v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead or not stage.BattleManager:IsCharacterInActiveBattle(v) then

			local pos = random_points[count]
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("summon", pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			v.Position = pos
			v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

			-- 힐
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
			heal_info.heal = v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			heal_info.sender = self.character
			heal_info.target = v

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

			-- 몬스터 노티스 이벤트를 쏴준다
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(v, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
			message_system:Send(v.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(v, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

			count = count + 1

			if count > #random_points then
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

--소환 몬스터 리스트 생성
function local_class:initialize_summon_list()
	-- 팬 캐릭터
	self.summon_characters = {}

	for i = 1, 99 do
		local obj = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.monster_name_Base, i))
		if is_unity_null(obj) then
			break
		else
			table.insert(self.summon_characters, obj)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	-- 모든 살아있는 팬 전부 강제 킬
	for _,v in ipairs(self.summon_characters) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			if not v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(v.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
					v.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
				else
					v.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterConstantDamagedBehaviour()
					v.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
				damage_info.sender = v
				damage_info.target = v
				damage_info.noCritical = true
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10)

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

				v.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	-- NOTE: 이 액션은 Dispose땐 force_cancel 불필요
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_event_func)
		self.on_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.summon_positions = nil
	self.hit_target_list = nil
	self.cast_effect = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.repeat_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RepeatCount", 3)
	self.crystal_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "CrystalCount", 3)
	self.casting_duration_list = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "CastingDuration")
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.2)
	self.knockback_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackDuration", 0.3)
	self.explosion_damage_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDamageRate", 0.5)
	self.bead_explosion_damage_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDamageBeadRate", 0.01)

	self.explosion_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDuration", 2)
	self.explosion_damage_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDamageDuration", 0.3)
	local rune_effect_offset = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "RuneEffectOffset")
	local casting_Effect_offset = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "CastingEffectOffset")
	self.crystal_min_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CrystalMinRange", 1)
	self.crystal_max_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CrystalMaxRange", 5)
	self.crystal_save_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CrystalSaveRange", 1)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeMagnitude", 0.08)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeDuration", 0.3)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		knockback = 3,
		casting = 4, --장애물 생성 및 캐스팅
		explosion = 5, --카운트가 남아있다면 3번으로
		post = 6
	}

	self.crystal_pos_count_x = 0
	self.crystal_pos_count_z = 0
	self.crystal_margin = 1
	self.cristal_size = vector(1, 2, 1)
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.current_bead_count = 0
	self.hit_target_list = nil
	self.crystal_info_list = nil
	self.attack_oder_list = nil --공격 색상을 어떤순서로 사용할건지
	self.rune_effect = nil
	self.casting_effect = nil
	self.crystal_shadow_effect = nil
	self.current_crystal_count = 0

	self.effect_name_list = {
		{
			obj_effect = "crystal_blue",
			end_effect = "crystal_blue_end",
			rune_effect = "rune_blue",
			explosion = "explosion_blue"
		},
		{
			obj_effect = "crystal_green",
			end_effect = "crystal_green_end",
			rune_effect = "rune_green",
			explosion = "explosion_green"
		},
		{
			obj_effect = "crystal_red",
			end_effect = "crystal_red_end",
			rune_effect = "rune_red",
			explosion = "explosion_red"
		},
		{
			obj_effect = "crystal_black",
			end_effect = "crystal_black_end"
		},
	}

	self.crystal_index = {
		blue = 1,
		green = 2,
		red = 3,
		black = 4
	}

	self.rune_offset = vector(rune_effect_offset[1], rune_effect_offset[2], rune_effect_offset[3])
	self.casting_offset = vector(casting_Effect_offset[1], casting_Effect_offset[2], casting_Effect_offset[3])

	self.crystal_pool_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.crystal_count do
		local fo
		fo = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(self.cristal_size)
		fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullCrashBehaviour.Instance
		fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
		fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		table.insert(self.crystal_pool_list, fo)
	end

	self.on_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_event_func)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if self.character ~= nil then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
			if  e:GetParamAt(0) == 'blood_bead_collide' then
				if e:GetParamAt(1) == self.character.Name then
					if tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2)) == 1 then --일반 구슬 증감 이벤트
						self.current_bead_count = self.current_bead_count + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.target = target
	self.current_crystal_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.crystal_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.crystal_info_list) do
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				v.effect:Dispose()
				v.effect = nil
			end
			if v.fo ~= nil then
				v.fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
				table.insert(self.crystal_pool_list, v.fo)
			end
		end
	end
	self.crystal_info_list = nil

	if self.crystal_shadow_effect ~= nil then
		self.crystal_shadow_effect:Dispose()
		self.crystal_shadow_effect = nil
	end

	if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
		self.casting_effect:Dispose()
		self.casting_effect = nil
	end

	self:reset_ailment()

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.casting then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.knockback then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
			self.casting_effect:Dispose()
			self.casting_effect = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)


		if self.crystal_info_list ~= nil then
			for _,v in pairs(self.crystal_info_list) do
				self:dispose_crystal(v)
			end
			self.crystal_info_list = nil
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("crystal_end")

		if self.crystal_shadow_effect ~= nil then
			self.crystal_shadow_effect:Dispose()
			self.crystal_shadow_effect = nil
		end

		if self.rune_effect ~= nil then
			self.rune_effect:Dispose()
			self.rune_effect = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		--패턴 종료 뒤 구슬카운트 초기화
		self.current_bead_count = 0
		self:reset_ailment()
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

		if self.attack_oder_list ~= nil then
			self.attack_oder_list = nil
		end
		self.attack_oder_list = {}
		self.attack_oder_list = self:get_random_index_list()
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		--상태이상 면역
		self:set_ailment_resist()
	elseif next_state == self.state.knockback then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("knockback")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("knockback")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("knockback")
		--적 전체 넉백
		self:knockback_party()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wave",
				vector(self.zone_bound.center.x, 0.1, self.zone_bound.max.z), unity_class.vector3.back)
	elseif next_state == self.state.casting then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.casting_duration_list[self.current_repeat_count]))
		if self.crystal_info_list ~= nil then
			self.crystal_info_list = nil
		end
		self.crystal_info_list = {}
		if self.hit_target_list ~= nil then
			self.hit_target_list = nil
		end
		self.hit_target_list = {}
		self:set_crystal()
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("crystal_start")

		local idx = self.attack_oder_list[self.current_repeat_count]
		self.rune_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.effect_name_list[idx].rune_effect,
		self.character.Position + self.rune_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("casting")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("casting")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("casting")
	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local idx = self.attack_oder_list[self.current_repeat_count]
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.effect_name_list[idx].explosion,
				self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("explosion")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("explosion")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)

end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:get_random_index_list()
	local index_list = {}
	local random_index_list = {}

	for i = 1, 3 do
		table.insert(index_list, i)
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local random_idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, #index_list)
		table.insert(random_index_list, index_list[random_idx])
		table.remove(index_list, random_idx)
	end

	return random_index_list
end

function local_class:knockback_party()
	--타겟타피 넉백
	local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if targets ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(targets) do
			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
					v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
			else
				local dir = unity_class.vector3.back

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = v
				damage_info.modifier = 0
				damage_info.direction = dir
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		targets:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:set_crystal()
	--위치는 중심 기준
	--random_dir(0, 360/count) * random_range(min_range, max_range)
	--count가 4이상일 경우 블랙크리스탈로 생성
	--1,2,3의 색상순서는 매회마다 랜덤
	local idx_list = self:get_random_index_list()
	for i = 1, self.crystal_count do
		local min_angle, max_angle
		local range_interval = 360 / self.crystal_count
		min_angle = (range_interval * i) - range_interval + 10
		max_angle = (range_interval * i) - 10
		local random_angle = unity_class.random.Range(min_angle, max_angle)
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_angle, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward

		local random_range = unity_class.random.Range(self.crystal_min_range, self.crystal_max_range)
		local target_pos = self.zone_bound.center + dir * random_range
		if i <= 3 then
			local info = self:init_crystal(idx_list[i], target_pos)
			table.insert(self.crystal_info_list, info)
		else
			--4번째 크리스탈 부터는 장애물용 블랙크리스탈 생성
			local info = self:init_crystal(4, target_pos)
			table.insert(self.crystal_info_list, info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:init_crystal(crystal_idx, pos)
	local info = {}

	local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.effect_name_list[crystal_idx].obj_effect,
			pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	if crystal_idx == self.attack_oder_list[self.current_repeat_count] then
		self.crystal_shadow_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shadow", pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(pos - self.zone_bound.center)
		local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.forward, dir)
		self.crystal_shadow_effect.transform.rotation = rot
	end

	local v_obj = table.remove(self.crystal_pool_list)
	v_obj.Position = pos
	v_obj.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	info.effect = effect
	info.fo = v_obj
	info.crystal_idx = crystal_idx
	info.pos = pos

	return info
end

function local_class:dispose_crystal(info)
	if info.effect ~= nil then
		info.effect:Dispose()
		info.effect = nil
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.effect_name_list[info.crystal_idx].end_effect,
				info.pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	end
	if info.fo ~= nil then
		info.fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		table.insert(self.crystal_pool_list, info.fo)
	end
	info = nil
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.knockback)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.knockback then
		if self.time_passed >= self.knockback_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.casting)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		if self.time_passed >= self.casting_duration_list[self.current_repeat_count] then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.casting)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.explosion_damage_duration then
				self:update_explosion_damage(dt)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_explosion_damage(dt)
	local b = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.zone_bound.center, self.zone_bound.size)
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(b, unity_class.vector3.zero)--move)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		--조건에 맞는 수정 위치
		local crystal_pos
		for _,v in pairs(self.crystal_info_list) do
			if v.crystal_idx == self.attack_oder_list[self.current_repeat_count] then
				crystal_pos = v.pos
			end
		end
		--방향
		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(crystal_pos - self.zone_bound.center)--unity_class.vector3.back
		local target_pos = crystal_pos + (dir * self.crystal_save_range)
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - crystal_pos)
		local bs = vector(1, 1.5, 1)

		local b2 = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(crystal_pos, bs)
		local fo_list2 = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(b2, diff)

		--조건에 맞는 보석 뒤라면 데미지를 받지 않는다.
		for _,v2 in pairs(fo_list2) do
			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
					v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) then
			else
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(v, v2) then
					return
				end
			end
		end

		fo_list2:Dispose()

		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or self:check_hit_target(v) then
		else
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			local add_rate = self.current_bead_count * self.bead_explosion_damage_rate
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(v) * (self.explosion_damage_rate + add_rate))

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(self.hit_target_list, v)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(target)
	for _,v in pairs(self.hit_target_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_pos_to_wall(dir, pos)
	local target_pos
	if dir == unity_class.vector3.right then
		target_pos = vector(self.zone_bound.max.x, 0, pos.z)
	elseif dir == unity_class.vector3.left then
		target_pos = vector(self.zone_bound.min.x, 0, pos.z)
	elseif dir == unity_class.vector3.forward then
		target_pos = vector(pos.x, 0, self.zone_bound.max.z)
	elseif dir == unity_class.vector3.back then
		target_pos = vector(pos.x, 0, self.zone_bound.min.z)
	end

	return target_pos
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	-- 구독 해제
	if self.subscribe_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		self.subscribe_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.cristal_size = nil
	self.hit_target_list = nil
	self.crystal_info_list = nil
	self.attack_oder_list = nil
	self.rune_effect = nil
	self.casting_effect = nil
	self.crystal_shadow_effect = nil
	self.effect_name_list = nil
	self.crystal_index = nil
	self.rune_offset = nil
	self.casting_offset = nil
	self.crystal_pool_list = nil
end

--필수 구현

	self.chain_hit_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChainHitRange", 1)

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	local modX = bound.size.x / 4
	local modZ = bound.size.z / 4

	self.sliced_zone_position = {}
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_position, bound.center + vector(-modX, 0, modZ))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_position, bound.center + vector(modX, 0, modZ))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_position, bound.center + vector(-modX, 0, -modZ))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_position, bound.center + vector(modX, 0, -modZ))
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	if self.hit_target_list ~= nil then
		self.hit_target_list = nil
	end
	self.hit_target_list = {}
	if self.hit_delay_target_list ~= nil then
		self.hit_delay_target_list = nil
	end
	self.hit_delay_target_list = {}
	self.oder_list = nil
	if self.main_Shot_info_list ~= nil then
		self.main_Shot_info_list = nil
	end
	self.main_Shot_info_list = {}
	self.target = target
	self.current_explosion_count = 0
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.explosion_time_passed = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	if self.chain_attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.chain_attack_range))
	end

	if self.main_Shot_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.main_Shot_info_list) do
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				v.effect:Dispose()
				v.effect = nil
			end
			self:dispose_chain_effect(v.chain_info)
		end
	end
	self.main_Shot_info_list = nil

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_shot_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_shot then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.chain_prepare then
		if self.chain_attack_range ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.chain_attack_range))
			self.chain_attack_range:Hide()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.chain then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.oder_list = self:set_oder_index()
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.main_shot_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
		local idx = self.oder_list[self.current_repeat_count]

		local target_pos = self:get_target_pos(self.sliced_zone_position[idx])
		target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, battle_util.get_height(target_pos) + 0.5)
		table.insert(self.main_Shot_info_list, {
			target_pos = target_pos,
			chain_info = {},
			is_chain_start = false,
			is_main_shot_start = false,
			is_done = false
		})

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, target_pos)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.main_shot_prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.main_shot_prepare_duration))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("main_shot_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("main_shot_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("main_shot_prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.main_shot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local main_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(
				"proj", self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].effect = main_effect
		self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].is_main_shot_start = true
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("main_shot")
	elseif next_state == self.state.chain_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:set_chain_info()
	elseif next_state == self.state.chain then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:start_chain_effect()
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("chain_start")
		self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].is_chain_start = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:get_target_pos(pos)
	local random_angle = unity_class.random.Range(0, 360)
	local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_angle, 0) * unity_class.vector3.right

	local random_range = unity_class.random.Range(0, self.main_shot_random_range)
	local target_pos = pos + dir * random_range

	return target_pos
end

function local_class:set_oder_index()
	local idx_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.repeat_count do
		table.insert(idx_list, i)
	end

	return random_util.get_values_in_array(idx_list, {count = self.repeat_count})
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state <= self.state.explosion then
		self:update_hit_targets(dt)
	end
	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.main_shot_prepare)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_shot_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.main_shot_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.main_shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_shot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.main_shot_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.chain_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.chain_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.chain_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.chain)
		else
			if self.time_passed <= self.chain_targeting_duration then
				self:update_attack_range()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.chain then
		if self.time_passed >= self.chain_duration then
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.main_shot_prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
			end
		else
			self:update_chain_shoot(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_delay_duration * self.current_explosion_count then
				if self.current_explosion_count < self.repeat_count then
					self.current_explosion_count = self.current_explosion_count + 1
					self:explosion_effect_update(self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_explosion_count])
					self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_explosion_count].is_done = true
					self.explosion_time_passed = 0
					if self.enhanced then
						self:shoot_radial_shot(self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_explosion_count].target_pos)
					end
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			else
				self.explosion_time_passed = self.explosion_time_passed + dt
				if self.explosion_time_passed < self.explosion_damage_duration then
					--구체 폭발 데미지
					self:update_explosion(self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_explosion_count])
					--사슬 폭발 데미지
					self:update_chain_explosion(self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_explosion_count])
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:explosion_effect_update(info)
	if info.effect ~= nil then
		info.effect:Dispose()
		info.effect = nil
	end

	if info.chain_info.effect ~= nil then
		self:dispose_chain_effect(info.chain_info)
	end
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", info.target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("main_shot_explosion")
end

function local_class:update_explosion(info)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(info.target_pos, self.explosion_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or self:check_hit_target(self.hit_target_list, v) then
		else
			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - info.target_pos).normalized

			if dmg_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dmg_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.target))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_damage_modifier

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(self.hit_target_list, {target = v})

			self:blood_bead(v)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_chain_explosion(info)
	local collision_width = self.chain_explosion_width
	local chain_bound_size = unity_class.vector3(collision_width, 1.5, collision_width)

	local b = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(info.chain_info.current_pos, chain_bound_size)
	local move = vector_util.get_x0z(info.chain_info.start_pos - info.chain_info.current_pos)
	self:chain_collsion_check(b, move)
end

function local_class:update_hit_targets(dt)
	--체인또는 구체에 닿았을 경우 데미지+넉백
	--넉백당한 후 일정시간동안 충돌하지 않음
	for i = #self.hit_delay_target_list, 1, -1 do
		self.hit_delay_target_list[i].time_passed = self.hit_delay_target_list[i].time_passed - dt
		if self.hit_delay_target_list[i].time_passed <= 0 then
			table.remove(self.hit_delay_target_list, i)
		end
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.main_Shot_info_list) do
		if not v.is_done and v.is_main_shot_start then
			self:hit_check_main_shot(v.target_pos)
			if v.is_chain_start and v.chain_info.length > 0 then
				self:hit_check_chain(v.chain_info)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:hit_check_main_shot(pos)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.main_shot_radius)
	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or self:check_hit_target(self.hit_delay_target_list, v) then
		else
			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(pos - v.Position).normalized
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.modifier = self.hit_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = -dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = -dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(self.hit_delay_target_list,{
				target = v,
				time_passed = self.hit_delay_duration})
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:hit_check_chain(chain_info)
	local collision_width = self.chain_width
	local chain_bound_size = unity_class.vector3(collision_width, 1.5, collision_width)
	local b = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(chain_info.current_pos, chain_bound_size)
	local move = vector_util.get_x0z(chain_info.start_pos - chain_info.current_pos)

	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(b, move)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or self:check_hit_target(self.hit_delay_target_list, v) then
		else
			local dir_xz = vector_util.get_xz(move).normalized
			local target_dir_xz = vector_util.get_xz(v.Bounds.center - chain_info.start_pos).normalized
			local det = vector_util.cross(dir_xz, target_dir_xz)
			local angle = 100
			if det > 0 then
				angle = -100
			end
			local knockback_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * move.normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = knockback_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.hit_damage_modifier
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(self.hit_delay_target_list,{
				target = v,
				time_passed = self.hit_delay_duration})
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end


function local_class:chain_collsion_check(b, move)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(b, move)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or self:check_hit_target(self.hit_target_list, v) then
		else
			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - move).normalized

			if dmg_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dmg_dir = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(v))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_damage_modifier

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(self.hit_target_list,{target = v})
			self:blood_bead(v)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(list, target)
	for _,v in pairs(list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.target, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_chain_info()
	self:set_chain_dir()
	self:set_chain_destination_pos()
	self:set_attack_range()
end

function local_class:set_attack_range()
	local info = self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].chain_info
	self.chain_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, vector(
			self.zone_bound.size.x, self.chain_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.chain_attack_range, info.start_pos, info.dir)
	self.chain_attack_range:Show(self.chain_prepare_duration)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.chain_attack_range))
end

function local_class:update_attack_range()
	local info = self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].chain_info
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - info.start_pos).normalized
	if dir.magnitude <= 0.05 then
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
	end
	info.dir = dir
	self:set_chain_destination_pos()

	local dist = vector_util.get_x0z(info.dest_pos - info.start_pos).magnitude
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.chain_attack_range, info.start_pos, info.dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.chain_attack_range))
end

function local_class:update_chain_shoot(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.main_Shot_info_list) do
		if v.chain_info.state == self.chain_state.shoot then
			local length = v.chain_info.length
			local reached = self:update_chain_effect(v.chain_info, length)

			if not reached then
				v.chain_info.length = length + self.chain_speed * dt
			else
				--체인이 벽에 도착
				v.chain_info.state = self.chain_state.wall_hit
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("chain_hit", v.chain_info.dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("chain_hit")
				stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_chain_effect(info)
	if not is_unity_null(info.cs_hook_shot) then
		info.cs_hook_shot:SetFromTo(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		info.effect:Dispose()
	end
	info.cs_hook_shot = nil
	info.effect = nil
end

function local_class:set_chain_dir()
	local info = self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count]
	local chain_start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(info.target_pos + vector(0, 0, 0),0.5)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - chain_start_pos).normalized
	if dir.magnitude <= 0.05 then
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
	end

	local chain_info = {
		start_pos = chain_start_pos + dir * CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength,
		dir = dir,
		dest_pos = nil,
		cs_hook_shot = nil,
		effect = nil,
		current_pos = nil,
		length = 0,
		distance = 0,
		state = self.chain_state.shoot,
		is_hit = false,
		is_wall_hit = false,
		is_done = false
	}

	self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].chain_info = chain_info
end

function local_class:set_chain_destination_pos()
	local info = self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].chain_info
	local dest = self:get_chain_destination_position(self.zone_bound, info.start_pos, info.dir)
	self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].chain_info.dest_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(dest,
			info.start_pos.y)
end

function local_class:start_chain_effect()
	self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].chain_info.effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(
			"chain", self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].chain_info.start_pos)
	self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].chain_info.cs_hook_shot =
	self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].chain_info.effect:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))
	self.main_Shot_info_list[self.current_repeat_count].chain_info.cs_hook_shot.HeadLength = 0.1
end

function local_class:update_chain_effect(info, length)
	local diff = info.dest_pos - info.start_pos
	local dir = diff.normalized

	local reached = false
	if length >= diff.magnitude then
		length = diff.magnitude
		reached = true
	end

	if length < CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength then
		length = CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength
	end

	info.current_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(info.start_pos + dir * length, info.start_pos.y)
	self:chain_visual_update(info)

	return reached
end

function local_class:blood_bead(target)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
			{
				-- 어떤 이벤트인지
				'blood_bead_drop_request_by_target',
				-- 어느 캐릭터 주위로 뿌릴것인지
				target.Name,
				1
			}))
end

function local_class:shoot_radial_shot(pos)
	for i = 1, self.radial_shot_count do
		local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.radial_shot_count, 0)
				* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(pos, dir, i, -1, nil, false, 0.3)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
		if hit_info.target ~= nil then
			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, hit_info.target.EntityGroup) or
					hit_info.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, hit_info.target) then
			else
				self:blood_bead(hit_info.target)
			end
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:chain_visual_update(info)
	if info.cs_hook_shot ~= nil then
		--사슬 도착지점 보정
		local pos = info.current_pos + -(info.dir * self.chain_head_margin)
		info.cs_hook_shot:SetFromTo(info.start_pos, pos)
	end
end

--체인 도착지점 계산
function local_class:get_chain_destination_position(b, p, d)
	local height = p.y
	local origin = vector_util.get_xz(p)
	local direction = vector_util.get_xz(d)

	local left_top = unity_class.vector2(b.min.x, b.max.z)
	local left_bottom = unity_class.vector2(b.min.x, b.min.z)
	local right_top = unity_class.vector2(b.max.x, b.max.z)
	local right_bottom = unity_class.vector2(b.max.x, b.min.z)

	if d.x > 0 then
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, direction, right_top, right_bottom, height, 0)
		if result then
			return vector_util.get_x0z(intersection, height)
		end
	end

	if d.x < 0 then
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, direction, left_top, left_bottom, height, 0)
		if result then
			return vector_util.get_x0z(intersection, height)
		end
	end

	if d.z > 0 then
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, direction, left_top, right_top, height, 0)
		if result then
			return vector_util.get_x0z(intersection, height)
		end
	end

	if d.z < 0 then
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, direction, left_bottom, right_bottom, height, 0)
		if result then
			return vector_util.get_x0z(intersection, height)
		end
	end
	return p
end

--체인 도착지점 계산
function local_class:get_hook_shot_land_position(b, p, safe_dist)
	if p.x > b.max.x - safe_dist then
		p.x = b.max.x - safe_dist
	elseif p.x < b.min.x + safe_dist then
		p.x = b.min.x + safe_dist
	end

	if p.z > b.max.z - safe_dist then
		p.z = b.max.z - safe_dist
	elseif p.z < b.min.z + safe_dist then
		p.z = b.min.z + safe_dist
	end

	return p
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.chain_state = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.chain_attack_range = nil
	self.main_Shot_info_list = nil
	self.hit_target_list = nil
	self.hit_delay_target_list = nil
	self.oder_list = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	--배틀존 분할
	self.random_interval_count_x = math.floor(self.zone_bound.size.x / self.random_thunder_interval_range - 2)
	self.random_interval_count_z = math.floor(self.zone_bound.size.z / self.random_thunder_interval_range - 2)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.random_pos_list = nil
	self.random_thunder_time_passed = 0
	self.current_thunder_index = 0

	if self.random_thunder_info_list ~= nil then
		self.random_thunder_info_list = nil
	end
	self.random_thunder_info_list = {}
	self.chain_info_list = nil
	self.current_target_thunder_index = 0
	self.is_start_target_thunder = false
	self.is_start_random_thunder = false
	self.target_thunder_info = nil
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	for _,v in pairs(self.random_thunder_attack_range_list) do
		if v ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			v:Hide()
		end
	end

	if self.target_thunder_attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.target_thunder_attack_range))
		self.target_thunder_attack_range:Hide()
	end

	if self.chain_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.chain_info_list) do
			if v.state ~= self.chain_state.done then
				self:dispose_chain_effect(v)
				v.state = self.chain_state.done
			end
		end
		self.chain_info_list = nil
	end


	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.random_thunder then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.target_thunder_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.target_thunder_attack_range))
		self.target_thunder_attack_range:Hide()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.target_thunder or
	self.current_state == self.state.target_chain then
		if self.current_target_thunder_index == self.target_thunder_count then
			for _,v in pairs(self.random_thunder_attack_range_list) do
				if v ~= nil then
					CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
					v:Hide()
				end
			end
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.random_pos_list = self:set_random_index()
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	-- 현재 self:change_state(self.state.random_thunder) 구문이 없습니다. self:set_random_target_attack_range(1)를 self.is_start_random_thunder = true 시점에 하도록 수정했습니다.
	elseif next_state == self.state.random_thunder then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("random_thunder")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("random_thunder")
		self:set_random_target_attack_range(1)
	elseif next_state == self.state.target_thunder_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("target_thunder_prepare")
		self.target_thunder_pos = self.target.Position
		if self.current_target_thunder_index == 1 and not self.is_start_random_thunder then
			self.is_start_random_thunder = true
			self:set_random_target_attack_range(1)
		end
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.target_thunder_attack_range, self.target_thunder_pos)
		self.target_thunder_attack_range:Show(self.target_thunder_prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.target_thunder_attack_range))
	elseif next_state == self.state.target_thunder then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("target_thunder")
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("target_thunder")
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("target_thunder")

		self.current_target_thunder_index = self.current_target_thunder_index + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("thunder_b", self.target_thunder_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.target_thunder_info = {
			target_pos = self.target_thunder_pos,
			radius = self.target_thunder_radius,
			damage_modifier = self.target_thunder_damage_modifier,
			hit_target_list = {}
		}

		--장판 sfx
		local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue("aoe")
		if has_value then
			sfx_info.playPosition = self.target_position
			sfx_info.parent = nil
		end

		stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, self.target_thunder_pos,
				self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("aoe"), self.aoe_spec, self.on_aoe_hit_func,
				sfx_info, nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.target_chain then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("target_chain")
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("target_chain")
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("target_chain")

		self.current_target_thunder_index = self.current_target_thunder_index + 1
		if self.current_target_thunder_index == 1 then
			if self.chain_info_list ~= nil then
				self.chain_info_list = nil
			end
			self.chain_info_list = {}
		end
		self:set_chain_effect(self.target_thunder_pos)
		self.target_thunder_info = {
			target_pos = self.target_thunder_pos,
			radius = self.target_thunder_radius,
			damage_modifier = self.target_thunder_damage_modifier,
			hit_target_list = {}
		}
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_chain_effect(target_pos)
	local chain_pos = self:get_chain_start_pos(target_pos)
	--체인 시작위치를 랜덤으로 찍어줘야됨
	local open_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("chain_open", chain_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(chain_pos - target_pos)
	local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, dir)
	--local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
	--		unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(chain_pos - target_pos)).eulerAngles.y
	open_effect.transform.rotation = rot
	local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("chain", chain_pos)
	local cs_hook_shot = effect:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))
	cs_hook_shot.HeadLength = 0.1
	table.insert(self.chain_info_list, {
		open_effect = open_effect,
		start_pos = chain_pos,
		dest_pos = target_pos,
		dir = vector_util.get_x0z(chain_pos - target_pos),
		chain_effect = effect,
		cs_hook_shot = cs_hook_shot,
		length = 0,
		time_passed = 0,
		state = self.chain_state.shoot
	})
end

function local_class:get_chain_start_pos(target_pos)
	--vector3.left기준 10~170도 중 랜덤방향
	local center_angle = unity_class.random.Range(10, 170)
	local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, center_angle, 0) * unity_class.vector3.left
	local pos = target_pos + (dir * self.chain_range)
	pos = vector(pos.x, pos.y + 2, pos.z)

	return pos
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.chain_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_chain_shoot(dt)
	end

	if self.is_start_random_thunder then
		self:random_thunder_update(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.target_thunder_prepare)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.random_thunder then
		if self.time_passed >= self.random_thunder_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.target_thunder_prepare)
		else
			--random index선택
			if self.current_thunder_index < self.random_thunder_count then
				if self.random_thunder_time_passed >= self.random_thunder_shoot_interval then
					self.random_thunder_time_passed = 0
					self.current_thunder_index = self.current_thunder_index + 1
					if self.current_thunder_index < self.random_thunder_count then
						self:set_random_target_attack_range(self.current_thunder_index + 1)
					end
					self:shoot_random_thunder(self.current_thunder_index)
				else
					self.random_thunder_time_passed = self.random_thunder_time_passed + dt
				end
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.target_thunder_prepare)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.target_thunder_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.target_thunder_prepare_duration then
			if self.enhanced then
				self:change_state(self.state.target_chain)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.target_thunder)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.target_thunder then
		if self.time_passed >= self.target_thunder_duration then
			if self.current_target_thunder_index >= self.target_thunder_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.target_thunder_prepare)
			end
		else
			self:update_thunder_damage(self.target_thunder_info)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.target_chain then --강화패턴 체인연출 장판x 연출 다름
		if self.time_passed >= self.target_thunder_duration then
			if self.current_target_thunder_index >= self.target_thunder_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.target_thunder_prepare)
			end
		else
			self:update_thunder_damage(self.target_thunder_info)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_random_target_attack_range(idx)
	local ar = self.random_thunder_attack_range_list[idx]
	local pos = self.random_pos_list[idx]
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, pos)
	battle_range_util.show(ar, self.random_thunder_shoot_interval - 0.02)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
end

function local_class:random_thunder_update(dt)
	if self.current_thunder_index < self.random_thunder_count then
		if self.random_thunder_time_passed >= self.random_thunder_shoot_interval then
			self.random_thunder_time_passed = 0
			self.current_thunder_index = self.current_thunder_index + 1
			if self.current_thunder_index < self.random_thunder_count then
				self:set_random_target_attack_range(self.current_thunder_index + 1)
			end
			self:shoot_random_thunder(self.current_thunder_index)
		end
			self.random_thunder_time_passed = self.random_thunder_time_passed + dt
	end

	self:update_random_thuder_damage(dt)
end

function local_class:shoot_random_thunder(idx)
	if self.random_thunder_attack_range_list[idx] ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.random_thunder_attack_range_list[idx]))
		self.random_thunder_attack_range_list[idx]:Hide()
	end

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("thunder_a", self.random_pos_list[idx], unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("random_thunder")

	table.insert(self.random_thunder_info_list, {
		target_pos = self.random_pos_list[idx],
		radius = self.random_thunder_radius,
		time_passed = 0,
		damage_modifier = self.random_thunder_damage_modifier,
		hit_target_list = {}
	})
end

function local_class:update_random_thuder_damage(dt)
	if #self.random_thunder_info_list > 0 then
		for i,v in pairs(self.random_thunder_info_list) do
			if v.time_passed > self.random_thunder_damage_delay then
				table.remove(self.random_thunder_info_list, i)
			else
				self:update_thunder_damage(v)
				v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_thunder_index >= self.random_thunder_count then
		self.is_start_random_thunder = false
	end
end

function local_class:update_thunder_damage(info)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(info.target_pos, info.radius)

	for _,v2 in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
				v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) or self:check_hit_target(info, v2) then
		else
			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v2.Position - info.target_pos).normalized

			if dmg_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dmg_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.target))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v2
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = info.damage_modifier

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(info.hit_target_list, v2)

			self:blood_bead(v2)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_aoe_hit(fo, dir, param1, param2)
	if not is_unity_null(fo) then
		self:blood_bead(fo)
	end
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(info, target)
	for _,v in pairs(info.hit_target_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_random_index()
	local index_list = {}
	local target_pos_list = {}
	for i = 1,  self.random_thunder_count do
		local idx = i
		if idx > self.random_interval_count_x * self.random_interval_count_z then
			idx = i % (self.random_interval_count_x * self.random_interval_count_z)
		end
		table.insert(index_list, idx)
	end

	for i = 1, self.random_thunder_count do
		local idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, #index_list)
		local x_index = index_list[idx] % self.random_interval_count_x
		local z_index = math.ceil(index_list[idx] / self.random_interval_count_x)
		local target_pos = vector(self.zone_bound.min.x + self.random_pos_margin + (x_index * self.random_thunder_interval_range),
				0, self.zone_bound.min.z + self.random_pos_margin + (z_index * self.random_thunder_interval_range))

		table.insert(target_pos_list, target_pos)
		table.remove(index_list, idx)
	end

	return target_pos_list
end

function local_class:get_random_pos()
	local pos

	return pos
end

function local_class:blood_bead(target)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
			{
				-- 어떤 이벤트인지
				'blood_bead_drop_request_by_target',
				-- 어느 캐릭터 주위로 뿌릴것인지
				target.Name,
				-- 몇개 뿌릴것인지
				1
			}))
end

function local_class:update_chain_shoot(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.chain_info_list) do
		if v.state ~= self.chain_state.done then
			if v.state == self.chain_state.shoot then
				--체인 발사
				local length = v.length
				local reached = self:update_chain_effect(v, length)

				if not reached then
					v.length = length + self.chain_speed * dt
				else
					v.state = self.chain_state.hit
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("chain_explosion", v.dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("chain_explosion")
				end
			else
				if v.state == self.chain_state.hit then
					if v.time_passed >= self.chain_duration then
						--체인 회수
						local length = v.length
						self:update_chain_effect(v, length)

						if length >= CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength then
							v.length = length - self.chain_speed * dt
						else
							--체인 이펙트 제거
							self:dispose_chain_effect(v)
							local end_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("chain_end", v.start_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
							local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.start_pos - v.dest_pos)
							local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, dir)
							end_effect.transform.rotation = rot
							self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("chain_end")
							v.state = self.chain_state.done
						end
					else
						v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
						--땅에 박혀있는 시간동안은 데미지와 넉백을 준다.
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_chain_effect(info, length)
	--local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(info.dest_pos - info.start_pos,
	--		battle_util.get_height(info.dest_pos - info.start_pos))
	local diff = info.dest_pos - info.start_pos
	local dir = diff.normalized

	local reached = false
	if length >= diff.magnitude then
		length = diff.magnitude
		reached = true
	end

	if length < CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength then
		length = CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength
	end

	info.current_pos = info.start_pos + dir * length
	self:chain_visual_update(info)

	return reached
end

function local_class:chain_visual_update(info)
	if info.cs_hook_shot ~= nil then
		info.cs_hook_shot:SetFromTo(info.start_pos, info.current_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_chain_effect(info)
	if not is_unity_null(info.cs_hook_shot) then
		info.cs_hook_shot:SetFromTo(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		info.chain_effect:Dispose()
		info.open_effect:Dispose()
	end
	info.cs_hook_shot = nil
	info.chain_effect = nil
	info.open_effect = nil
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	if CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoe(self.character)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.chain_state = nil
	self.aoe_spec = nil
	self.random_pos_list = nil
	self.target_thunder_pos = nil
	self.random_thunder_attack_range_list = nil
	self.target_thunder_attack_range = nil
	self.random_thunder_info_list = nil
	self.chain_info_list = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}
