local local_class = newclass('BossPunchkingProjectileBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		preapre_loop = 3,
		action = 4,
		interval = 5,
		post = 6,
	}

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.0)

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1.0)
	self.max_shot = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'MaxShot', 2)

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local proj_spec = nil
	local ele_type = CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCharacterSpec(self.character).ElementalType
	if ele_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.None then
		proj_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec('punchking_slime_shot_none')

	elseif ele_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Fire then
		proj_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec('punchking_slime_shot_fire')

	elseif ele_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Ice then
		proj_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec('punchking_slime_shot_ice')

	elseif ele_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Earth then
		proj_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec('punchking_slime_shot_earth')

	elseif ele_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Light then
		proj_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec('punchking_slime_shot_light')

	elseif ele_type == CS.Oak.ElementalType.Darkness then
		proj_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec('punchking_slime_shot_darkness')

	else
		proj_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec('punchking_slime_shot_super')

	end
	local pattern = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Cannon, ps, proj_spec, pattern,
			CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.None)

	-- interval
	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'IntervalDuration', 0.5)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	self.current_shot = 0

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end


function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_shot = 0
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', self.character.Position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('shot')

		self:shoot_projectile()

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.current_shot >= self.max_shot then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_projectile()
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shot', self.character.Position)
	local point_offset = vector_util.zero
	self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(self.target.Position, point_offset, -1)

	self.current_shot = self.current_shot + 1
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', hit_info.position)

	if hit_info.target == nil and not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
		return true
	end

	self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)

	return true
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

end

function local_class:trigger()

	end

		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then

	end

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

end

function local_class:start(info)

	self.is_damage_publish = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	else
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

	end

	self.current_state = next_state

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			if self.prepare_loop_duration > 0 then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare_loop)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.action)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_loop_duration then

local local_class = newclass('BossRedHoodBeamSaberBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)
	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRadius", 3)
	local attack_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackAngle", 180)
	self.attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDelay", 0)
	local attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDuration", 0.5)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.0)

	-- 돌전 관련
	self.charge_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDamageModifier", 1)
	self.charge_knock_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeKnockBackForce", 1)
	self.charge_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDistance", 3)
	local damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDamageterm", 0.1)
	self.charge_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDuration", 0.2)
	self.charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeWidth", 3)

	-- 돌진 공격 계산기
	local charge_info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	charge_info.Center = self.character.Position
	charge_info.DamageTerm = damage_term
	charge_info.Duration = self.charge_duration
	charge_info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(self.charge_width / 2, 3, self.charge_width / 2)
	self.charge_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, charge_info, false, 0, 0)

	-- 빔세이버 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.Direction = unity_class.vector3.right
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = attack_duration
	info.Radius = self.attack_radius
	info.Angle = attack_angle
	info.Height = 3
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, self.attack_delay, 1)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateArc(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_radius, attack_angle, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.charge_range = nil
	self.target = nil

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		charge = 3,
		action = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	self.atk_l_key = 'attack_l'
	self.atk_r_key = 'attack_r'
	self.prepare_key = 'prepare'
	self.action_key = 'action'

	self.cast_key = 'cast'
	self.charge_key = 'charge'
	self.trail_key = 'trail'

	self.fx_cast = nil
	self.fx_charge = nil
	self.fx_trail = nil

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.attack_radius + self.charge_distance
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_cast) then
		self.fx_cast:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_cast = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_charge) then
		self.fx_charge:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_charge = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_trail) then
		self.fx_trail:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_trail = nil

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

-- 상태 전이
-- 캐스팅 -> 돌진 -> 칼 휘두르기 -> 종료
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.charge_range:Hide()
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_cast) then
			self.fx_cast:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_cast = nil
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_range))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.charge_calculator:End()

		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_charge) then
			self.fx_charge:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_charge = nil
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_trail) then
			self.fx_trail:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_trail = nil
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

		if self.attack_range_shown then
			self.attack_range_shown = nil
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.charge_direction = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		self.charge_distance = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.target.Position)
		self.charge_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(self.charge_distance, self.charge_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.charge_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		self.charge_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_range))
		self.fx_cast = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_key, self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.charge_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.charge_calculator:Start()
		self.prev_progress = 0

		self.fx_charge = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.charge_key, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
		self.fx_trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.trail_key, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local direction = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		if direction.z > 0 then
			self.target_dir_vector = unity_class.vector3.forward
		else
			self.target_dir_vector = unity_class.vector3.back
		end

		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir_vector
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.attack_range_shown = true
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir_vector)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.attack_delay)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		if self.target_dir_vector.z > 0 then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.atk_r_key)
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.atk_l_key)
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.action_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self:update_charge(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.charge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:update_saber(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		elseif self.attack_range_shown and self.time_passed >= self.attack_delay then
			self.attack_range_shown = nil
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.charge_duration)
	local movement = progress - self.prev_progress
	self.prev_progress  = progress
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance * movement

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_side_dir(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.charge_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.charge_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			-- 넉백 방향이 돌진 방향과 같음.
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.charge_modifier
			damage_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.charge_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.charge_knock_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.target) then
				self:change_state(self.state.action)
			end
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_saber(dt)
	-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_radius = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil

	self.charge_modifier = nil
	self.charge_distance = nil
	self.charge_knock_force = nil
	self.charge_duration = nil

	self.target_direction = nil
	self.target_dir_vector = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.charge_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.charge_range)
	end
	self.charge_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.charge_calculator = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossRedHoodBombingBattleAction')
--전멸기
-- 캐스팅 없음. 배틀액션 관련 오브젝트 전체 파괴 (판넬 / 마이크로미사일 등) 이벤트 날려서 파괴 시킬것.

-- 준비 시간동안 캐스팅 하지말고 레이저 발사시와 동일하게 이륙하여 빠지도록..
--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.5)

	self.base_groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'GroggyDuration', 1.0)
	self.full_groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PerfectGroggyDuration', 0)
	self.groggy_duration = 0

	self.in_position = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'InPosition', -0.5)

	self.missile_shoot_offset = CS.Utils.GetVector3FromDictionary(params, 'MissileShootOffset', unity_class.vector3(0.5, 0, -1.25))

	self.camera_size = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraSize', 6)
	self.camera_resize_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraResizeDuration', 0.5)
	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeMagnitude', 0.5)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeDuration', 0.5)
	--프로젝타일
	self.projectile_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'Projectile', 'conquest_redhood_bomb')
	local ps = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.character)
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec(self.projectile_name)
	local pattern_info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_info.columns = 1
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional, ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	--돌진 범위에 대한 공격 범위 표시기
	self.is_enable_range = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'EnableMoveRange', true)
	self.move_range = nil

	self.voice_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'VoiceId', 12)
	local voice_jamming = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'VoiceJamming', 'CoopRun')
	self.enum_voice_jamming = CS.System.Enum.Parse(typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType), voice_jamming, true)
	local voice_explosion = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'VoiceExplosion', 'TouchReactionBad2')
	self.enum_voice_explosion = CS.System.Enum.Parse(typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType), voice_explosion, true)

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.shoot_missile_offset_x = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ShootMissileOffsetX', 3.0)
	self.target = nil
	self.battle_zone = nil
	self.time_passed = 0

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		-- 떠서
		rising = 2,
		-- 밖으로
		move_outside = 3,
		-- 들어올 준비 (기믹 시작, 보스 위치 이동)
		prepare = 4,
		-- 안으로 들어옴
		move_inside = 5,
		-- 실패하여 낙하
		groggy_fall = 6,
		-- 그로기
		groggy = 7,
		-- 종료
		post = 8
	}
	self.current_state = nil

	-- 이동 상태 관련
	self.move_direction = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.move_distance = 0
	self.current_altitude = 0
	local hover_alitiude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'HoverAltitude', 0.8)
	local hover_up_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'HoverUpTime', 0.5)
	self.hover_down_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'HoverDownTime', 1)
	--일단 상승/하강 시간 동일하게 세팅
	self:hover_init(hover_alitiude, hover_up_time, self.hover_down_time)

	self.subscribe_func = function(e)
		self:on_event(e)
	end

	self.is_missile_ready = false
	self.is_missile_launched = false
	self.is_try_damage = false

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.subscribe_func)

	self.rise_key = 'rise'
	self.forward_key = 'forward'
	self.groggy_key = 'groggy'
	self.explosion_key = 'explosion'
	self.dash_key = 'dash'
	self.dash_trail_key = 'dash_trail'
	self.jamming_key = 'jamming'
	self.show_key = 'show'
	self.bombard_key = 'bombard'

	self.fx_groggy = nil
	self.fx_rise = nil
	self.fx_explosion = nil
	self.fx_dash = nil
	self.fx_trail = nil

	self.max_distance = nil
	self.end_position = nil
	self.prev_progress = 0

	self.activated_jammer = nil

	self.is_can_use_jammer = false

	-- 약화상태 강제할 것인지에 대한 값
	self.force_debilitate = false
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'jammer_activated' then
			-- 보스가 실제로 재머에 적중되었을경우 (범위내에 들어왔을 경우)에만 이벤트 발송하므로 다른 검사는 하지 않음.
			-- 메시지 타이밍 문제로 이쪽에서 발사 종료되었다면 그로기 들어가지 않음
			if not self.is_missile_ready then
				-- 재밍 성공시에 카메라 정상화
				stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
				stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.BattleCamSize, self.camera_resize_duration, false)
				self.max_distance = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
				self:change_state(self.state.groggy_fall)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone)
	self.battle_zone = zone
	local size = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.size.x, self.battle_zone.size.z)
	local pos = self.battle_zone.center
	pos.y = 0.3
	self.move_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,  unity_class.vector2(size.x, 3), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.move_range:Hide()
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(pos, size)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.is_missile_ready = false
	self.is_missile_launched = false
	self.is_try_damage = false
	-- 강제 설정 상태가 아니라면 본부에서 값 가져와서 설정 하도록 한다.
	if not self.force_debilitate then
		local debilitate_status = CS.Oak.GuildConquestClient.Instance:GetHQDebilitateStatus()
		self.is_can_use_jammer = debilitate_status:Contains(4)
	end
	self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
	self:change_state(self.state.rising)
end

-- 강제로 값 조작하여 재머 사용 / 미사용 하도록 하는 함수
function local_class:force_debilitate_jammer(can_use)
	self.force_debilitate = true
	self.is_can_use_jammer = can_use
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_dash) then
		self.fx_dash:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_dash = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_trail) then
		self.fx_trail:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_trail = nil

	-- 폭탄 폭발시 게임 종료되면서 폭발이펙트 동시에 사라지므로 캔슬될때 강제 dispose 하지 않음
	-- 연결만 끊어주고 fx 자체에서 dispose 시키기만 할것. ( 데이터 설정 필수로 할것 )
	self.fx_explosion = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_rise) then
		self.fx_rise:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_rise = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_groggy) then
		self.fx_groggy:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_groggy = nil

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('jammer_marker')
	if self.activated_jammer ~= nil then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'remove_jammer', self.activated_jammer.Name }))
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end
	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.rising then
		-- 다 떳으면 이동 시작하게 됨. rise 애니메이션 제거
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_rise) then
			self.fx_rise:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_rise = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_outside then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_inside then

		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_dash) then
			self.fx_dash:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_dash = nil

		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_trail) then
			self.fx_trail:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_trail = nil

		self.move_range:Hide(0)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy_fall then
		if next_state ~= self.state.groggy then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			if not is_unity_null(self.fx_groggy) then
				self.fx_groggy:Dispose()
			end
			self.fx_groggy = nil
			-- 감췄던 부착 이펙트 복구
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'redhood_show_effects' }))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_groggy) then
			self.fx_groggy:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_groggy = nil
		-- 감췄던 부착 이펙트 복구
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'redhood_show_effects' }))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.rising then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_resize_duration, false)
		-- 상승 시작
		self:rising()
		self.fx_rise = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.rise_key, self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.rise_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.rise_key)
		-- 캐스팅 이후 공격 대상이 되지 않는다.
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	elseif next_state == self.state.move_outside then
		--밖으로 이동한다. 현재 보고 있는 방향으로 나감.
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)
		local dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(direction)
		--밖으로 나가는 방향 계산
		local bound_position = unity_class.vector3((self.battle_zone.extents.x + self.out_position) * dir_vec.x, self.battle_zone.center.y, self.character.Position.z)
		self.end_position = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertToZoneRelativeToWorldToLua(self.battle_zone, bound_position)
		self.end_position = unity_class.vector3(self.end_position.x, self.character.Position.y, self.character.Position.z)
		self.move_direction = vector_util.normalized(self.end_position - self.character.Position)
		self.move_distance = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.end_position)
		self.prev_progress = 0

		--애니메이션 방향 설정
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.forward_key)

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 발동된 기믹이 존재하는 위치 파악하여 시작할 위치로 캐릭터 옮김
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		--재머 초기화
		self:jammer_init()
		--보스 나간 이후 재등장 방향 결정
		self:reposition_boss()

	elseif next_state == self.state.move_inside then
		-- 안으로 들어오는중. 기믹에 의한 방해가 가능해짐
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)
		--안으로 들어오는 방향 계산 현재 위치의 반대편 화면 밖을 종료지점으로 잡고 계산하도록 한다.
		local dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(direction)
		self.end_position = unity_class.vector3(self.battle_zone.center.x + (self.battle_zone.extents.x + self.out_position) * dir_vec.x, self.character.Position.y, self.battle_zone.center.z)
		self.move_direction = vector_util.normalized(self.end_position - self.character.Position)
		self.move_distance = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.end_position)
		self.prev_progress = 0

		if self.is_enable_range then
			local dir = unity_class.vector3(self.move_direction.x, 0, 0)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.move_range, self.battle_zone.center)
			self.move_range.CacheTransform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, dir)
			self.move_range:Show(self.move_inside_duration - 0.02)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.show_key)
		end

		local effect_position = self.character.Position
		effect_position.y = self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset.y
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.dash_key)
		self.fx_dash = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.dash_key, effect_position, self.move_direction, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
		self.fx_trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.dash_trail_key, effect_position, self.move_direction, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.forward_key)

	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy_fall then
		-- 기믹에 의해 방해되서 그로기 상태가 됨
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.prev_progress = 0
		local effect_position = self.character.Position
		effect_position.y = self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset.y
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.jamming_key)
		music_player:PlayVoice(self.voice_id, nil, 0, self.enum_voice_jamming)
		self:instantiate_jammer_chain()
		self:enter_groggy()
		-- 연출 컨트롤러에서 붙힌 이펙트를 감춰달라 요청
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'redhood_hide_effects' }))
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		-- 배틀액션 종료
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:landing()
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:instantiate_jammer_chain()
	if not is_unity_null(self.activated_jammer) then
		local start_pos = self.activated_jammer.Position
		local end_pos = self.character.Bounds.center + unity_class.vector3(0, self.current_altitude, 0)
		end_pos.z = end_pos.y * math.cos(math.rad(stage_camera.Transform.eulerAngles.x)) + end_pos.z
		end_pos.y = 0
		local fx_jamming = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.jamming_key, end_pos)
		local scaling_component = fx_jamming:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScalingEffect))
		if scaling_component then
			local diff = start_pos - end_pos
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.normalized(diff))
			local scale = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

			scaling_component:SetTransform(end_pos, rot, scale)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if self:hover_update(dt) then
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3(0, self.current_altitude, 0)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.rising then
		if self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.hovering then
			--호버링 상태가 되면 다음 스탭으로
			self:change_state(self.state.move_outside)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_outside then
		self:move_outside(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_outside_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.move_inside)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_inside then
		-- 안쪽으로 이동중
		self:move_inside(dt)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy_fall then
		self:move_groggy(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.hover_down_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	if self.subscribe_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.subscribe_func)
	end
	self.subscribe_func = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.move_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.move_range)
	end
	self.move_range = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.move_outside_duration = nil
	self.move_inside_duration = nil
	self.out_position = nil
	self.in_position = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.battle_zone = nil
	self.base_groggy_duration = nil
	self.full_groggy_duration = nil
	self.groggy_duration = nil
	self.move_direction = nil
	self.move_distance = nil
	self.current_altitude = nil
	self.is_missile_ready = nil
	self.is_missile_launched = nil
	self.rise_key = nil
	self.forward_key = nil
	self.groggy_key = nil
	self.explosion_key = nil
	self.fx_groggy = nil
	self.fx_rise = nil
	self.fx_explosion = nil
	self.max_distance = nil
	self.end_position = nil
	self.prev_progress = nil
	self.activated_jammer = nil
	self.current_hover_state = nil
	self.hover_state = nil
	self.max_alt = nil
	self.rise_time = nil
	self.land_time = nil
	self.current_altitude = nil
	self.hover_time_passed = nil
	self.is_hover_initialized = nil
	self.force_debilitate = nil
end

function local_class:jammer_init()

	local close_jammer_list = {  }
	local min_dist = 9999
	--제일 가까운 재머 위치 찾기
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local jammer = get_field_object('jammer_'..i)
		if not is_unity_null(jammer) then
			local dist = vector_util.distance(jammer.Position, user_party_leader.Position)
			if dist <= min_dist then
				min_dist = dist
				-- 거리가 동일한 재머가 존재한다면 모두 빼기 위해서 리스트에 넣음
				table.insert(close_jammer_list, i)
			end
		end
	end

	local select_value = 0
	-- 제일 가까운것 제외하고 나머지중 랜덤하게 픽한다.
	local jammer_list = table_util.remove_if(function(x) return table_util.contain_value(close_jammer_list, x) end, { 1, 2, 3, 4 })
	local idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, #jammer_list)
	select_value = jammer_list[idx]

	self.activated_jammer = get_field_object('jammer_'..select_value)
	if self.is_can_use_jammer then
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('jammer_marker', 0, false, self.activated_jammer)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'activate_jammer', 'jammer_'..select_value }))
	end

end

--보스 등장위치로 순간이동
function local_class:reposition_boss()
	character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'disabled')
	--중앙보다 재머가 왼쪽이면
	local jammer_dir_vec = vector_util.normalized(self.activated_jammer.Position - self.battle_zone.center)
	local direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(jammer_dir_vec)
	local dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(direction)
	local new_position_x = self.battle_zone.center.x + ((self.battle_zone.extents.x + self.in_position) * dir_vec.x)
	-- 위치에 대한 조정 필요
	self.character.Position = unity_class.vector3(new_position_x, self.character.Position.y, self.battle_zone.center.z)
	self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.battle_zone.center - self.character.Position)

	character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'enabled')
end

function local_class:move_outside(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.move_outside_duration)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	local movement = progress - self.prev_progress
	self.prev_progress = progress

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.move_direction
	move_info.magnitude =  self.move_distance * movement

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
end

function local_class:move_inside(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.move_inside_duration)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	local movement = progress - self.prev_progress
	self.prev_progress = progress

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.move_direction
	move_info.magnitude =  self.move_distance * movement

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
	if not self.is_missile_ready then
		-- 진행 방향에 따라 중앙을 지나쳣다면 미사일 발사함.
		if self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			if self.battle_zone.center.x <= self.character.Position.x then
				self.is_missile_ready = true
			end
		else
			if self.battle_zone.center.x >= self.character.Position.x then
				self.is_missile_ready = true
			end
		end
		-- 중앙을 지나갔다면 취소.
		if self.is_missile_ready then
			if self.is_can_use_jammer then
				CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('jammer_marker')
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'remove_jammer', self.activated_jammer.Name }))
			end
		end
	else
		if not self.is_missile_launched then
			if self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
				if self.battle_zone.center.x + self.shoot_missile_offset_x <= self.character.Position.x then
					self.is_missile_launched = true
				end
			else
				if self.battle_zone.center.x - self.shoot_missile_offset_x >= self.character.Position.x then
					self.is_missile_launched = true
				end
			end

			if self.is_missile_launched then
				self.attack_range:Show(0)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
				music_player:PlayVoice(self.voice_id, nil, 0, self.enum_voice_explosion)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.bombard_key)
				local missile_launch_position = unity_class.vector3(0, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform.position.y, 0)
				self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(self.battle_zone.center, missile_launch_position, 0, nil, false)
			end
		end
	end

	if self.prev_progress >= 1.0 then
		-- 이동 종료되었다면 마무리 루틴으로
		self:change_state(self.state.post)
	end
end

--그로기중에 앞으로 이동 및 비틀비틀 하면서 떨어질수 있도록 수정
function local_class:move_groggy(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.hover_down_time)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	local movement = progress - self.prev_progress
	self.prev_progress = progress

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.move_direction
	move_info.magnitude =  3 * movement

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		--바닥에 맞았다면 데미지로..
		-- 프로젝타일 자체 설정으로 바닥에 닿는 순간이 hit 되는 순간으로 설정됨.
		self:landing()
		self:change_state(self.state.post)
		self:death_to_all()
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
		-- 폭탄 터지면서 카메라 정상화
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.BattleCamSize, self.camera_resize_duration, false)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:enter_groggy()
	--호버 종료
	self:landing()
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.groggy_key)
	self.fx_groggy = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.groggy_key, self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.Transform)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.groggy_key)
	-- 재머기믹 활성화 되지 않았다면 들어올일 없음
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('jammer_marker')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'remove_jammer', self.activated_jammer.Name }))

	-- 영역 안에 들어와있는지 판단 하여 성공/실패 는 기믹에서 판단하여 넘어왔으므로 도달거리에 따른 계산만 하여 시간값 결정함
	local current_dist = vector_util.distance(unity_class.vector3(self.battle_zone.center.x, 0, 0), unity_class.vector3(self.character.Position.x, 0, 0))
	local perfect_timing = current_dist / self.max_distance <= 0.5
	self.groggy_duration = perfect_timing and self.full_groggy_duration or self.base_groggy_duration
end

-- 배틀존 내 생존 캐릭터들 전체 데미지
function local_class:death_to_all()
	if not self.is_try_damage then
		self.fx_explosion = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_key, self.battle_zone.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.damage = CS.Oak.DamageConstants.InstantKillDamage
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
		self.is_try_damage = true
	end

end

function local_class:hover_init(max_altitude, rise_time, land_time)
	self.hover_state = {
		none = 1,
		rising = 2,
		hovering = 3,
		landing = 4,
		finish = 5
	}
	--현재 상태
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.none
	--최대고도
	self.max_alt = max_altitude
	-- 상승시간
	self.rise_time = rise_time
	--하강시간
	self.land_time = land_time
	-- 현재고도
	self.current_altitude = 0
	-- 지난시간
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	-- 값 초기화 하여 사용 가능하게 되었는지
	self.is_hover_initialized = true
end

function local_class:hover_update(dt)
	if self.is_hover_initialized == false then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.none then
		return false
	end

	self.hover_time_passed = self.hover_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.rising then
		if self.hover_time_passed < self.rise_time then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInSine(self.hover_time_passed, 0, 1, self.rise_time))
			self.current_altitude = progress * self.max_alt
		else
			self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.hovering
			self.current_altitude = self.max_alt
		end
	elseif self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.hovering then
		self.current_altitude = self.max_alt
	elseif self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.landing then
		if self.hover_time_passed < self.land_time then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutBounce(self.hover_time_passed, 0, 1, self.land_time))
			self.current_altitude = (1 - progress) * self.max_alt
		else
			self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.finish
			self.current_altitude = 0
		end
	elseif self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.finish then
		self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.none
		self.current_altitude = 0
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:rising()
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.rising
end

function local_class:landing()
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.landing
end

function local_class:stop()
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.finish
	self.current_altitude = 0
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		return false

		local dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_key, self.character.Bounds.center, dir)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--그로기 애니메이션 플레이
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.groggy_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.groggy_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.groggy_key)
		self.groggy_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.groggy_key, self.character.Position + self.groggy_effect_offset)
		-- AOE 폭파
		self:explode_aoe()
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.current_state = next_state;
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	--캐스팅
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
		--돌진
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			-- 돌진 루틴 실행.
			self:charge_routine(dt)
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환. 카운트별 다르게
			if self.current_charge_count < self.charge_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.recast)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
		-- 충돌 후 다시 차지로
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.recast then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
		--종료
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

--돌진후 충돌시에도 발동하기 때문에 마지막 돌진에서도 체크 함.
function local_class:prepare_charge(time)
	if self.current_charge_count < self.charge_count then

		local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
			direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
		end

		-- 돌진 방향 보정
		self.charge_direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.battle_zone, self.character.Bounds, direction)
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.charge_direction)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(time)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.charge_start_pos = self.character.Position
		local count = self.attack_length / self.aoe_offset + 1

		-- 장판 설치 위치 셋팅
		self.aoe_positions = { }
		for i = 0, count - 1 do
			local dist = self.aoe_offset * i
			local pos = self.character.Position + (vector_util.normalized(self.charge_direction) * dist)
			dist = dist - 0.5
			table.insert(self.aoe_positions, { position = pos, is_start = false, sqr_distance = dist * dist})
		end
	end
end

function local_class:explode_aoe()
	stage.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoe(self.character)

	for i = #self.active_explosions, 1, -1 do
		local v = self.active_explosions[i]
		if v.is_start then
			local cantidates = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(v.position, self.attack_width / 2, 3)
			for idx = 0, cantidates.Count - 1 do
				local fo = cantidates.Values[idx]
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.explode_damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
					--에어본 확정
					damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.aerial_ailment, 1)
					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			cantidates:Dispose()
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explode_key, v.position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.explode_key)
		end
		table.remove(self.active_explosions, i)
	end
end

function local_class:charge_routine(dt)
	--돌진방향으로 튕겨냄. + 돌진위치 끝에 낙뢰
	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			-- 넉백 방향이 돌진 방향과 같음.
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.charge_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.charge_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	-- 시작지점으로부터 캐릭터의 거리가 aoe의 거리보다 크거나 같은 경우 장판 설치
	local sqr_charge_distance = vector_util.sqr_distance(self.charge_start_pos, self.character.Position)
	for i = 1, #self.aoe_positions do
		if self.aoe_positions[i].is_start == false then
			if self.aoe_positions[i].sqr_distance < sqr_charge_distance then
				stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, self.aoe_positions[i].position, self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool(self.aoe_key), self.aoe_spec, self.on_aoe_hit_func)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.aoe_key, self.aoe_positions[i].position)
				self.aoe_positions[i].is_start = true
				table.insert(self.active_explosions, self.aoe_positions[i])
			end
		end
	end

	-- 이동을 나중에
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.attack_length / self.action_duration * dt
	move_info.magnitude = move_info.magnitude * self.charge_speed
	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_side_dir(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if not is_unity_null(blocker) then
				-- 충돌 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.crash_key, blocker.Bounds:ClosestPoint(self.character.Bounds.center), unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.crash_key)
				stage.StageCamera:Shake(self.crash_camera_shake_modifier, self.crash_camera_shake_duration)
				-- 스테이트 전환. 카운트별 다르게
				if self.current_charge_count < self.charge_count then
					self:change_state(self.state.recast)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 장판에 데미지 주기 위한 콜백
function local_class:on_aoe_hit(fo, dir, param1, param2)
	if not is_unity_null(fo) then
		for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, v) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = param1
				damage_info.direction = dir
				damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:explode_aoe()

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.charge_damage_modifier = nil
	self.aoe_damage_modifier = nil
	self.explode_damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_width = nil
	self.attack_length = nil
	self.damage_term = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil
	self.charge_count = nil
	self.action_delay = nil
	self.charge_speed = nil
	self.groggy_effect_offset = nil
	self.crash_camera_shake_modifier = nil
	self.crash_camera_shake_duration = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.aoe_spec = nil

	self.aoe_positions = nil
	self.active_explosions = nil
	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.aerial_ailment = nil
	self.on_aoe_hit_func = nil

	self.charge_direction = nil
	self.current_charge_count = nil
	self.battle_zone = nil

	self.state = nil

	self.cast_key = nil
	self.charge_key = nil
	self.smoke_key = nil
	self.trail_key = nil
	self.groggy_key = nil
	self.crash_key = nil
	self.explode_key = nil
	self.aoe_key = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossRedHoodCrossShotBattleAction')

--region 미사일 클래스
local missile_class = {
	action = nil,
	cs_action = nil,
	missile = nil,
	spine = nil,
	is_spine = nil,
	core = nil,
	start_pos = nil,
	end_pos = nil,
	time_passed = nil,
	target_time = nil,
	current_state = nil,
	state = nil
}
missile_class.mt = { __index = missile_class }

function missile_class:new(parent_class, start_pos, end_pos)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.missile = obj.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(parent_class.missile_key, start_pos)
	obj.spine = obj.missile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	obj.is_spine = not is_unity_null(obj.spine)
	if obj.is_spine then
		obj.always_update_origin = obj.spine.AlwaysUpdateSpine
		obj.spine.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	end
	obj.core = nil
	obj.start_pos = start_pos
	obj.end_pos = end_pos
	obj.time_passed = 0
	obj.target_time = nil
	obj.state = parent_class.missile_state
	obj:change_state(obj.state.begin)
	return obj
end

function missile_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if next_state == self.state.begin then
		self.target_time = self.action.missile_rise_delay
		effect_util.update_object(self.missile, self.start_pos)
		self:set_missile_anim('launch_start', false, 4)
		self.cs_action:PlaySfx(self.action.action_key, self.start_pos)
	elseif next_state == self.state.rise then
		self.target_time = self.action.missile_rise_duration
		self.start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.start_pos, self.start_pos.y + 2)
		effect_util.update_object(self.missile, self.start_pos)
		self:set_missile_anim('launch_loop', true)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.target_time = self.action.missile_fall_duration
		effect_util.update_object(self.missile, self.end_pos + self.action.missile_rising_pos)
		self:set_missile_anim('reentry', true)
	elseif next_state == self.state.stop then
		self.target_time = self.action.missile_wait_duration
		effect_util.update_object(self.missile, self.end_pos)
		self:set_missile_anim('detonation', false)

		self.core = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(self.action.pre_laser_key, vector_util.get_x0z(self.end_pos, self.end_pos.y + 0.5))
		if not is_unity_null(self.core) then
			self.core.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
		end
		-- 낙하 충격파
		self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(self.action.land_key, self.end_pos)
		self.cs_action:PlaySfx(self.action.land_key, self.end_pos)
		self.cs_action:PlaySfx(self.action.pre_laser_key, self.end_pos)
		hits = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(self.end_pos, self.action.missile_radius)
		for hit_idx = 0, hits.Count - 1 do
			local fo = hits[hit_idx]
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.action.character, fo) then
				self.action:on_hit_missile(fo, self.end_pos)
			end
		end
		hits:Dispose()
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function missile_class:dispose()
	self.action = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
	if self.is_spine and not is_unity_null(self.spine) then
		self.spine.AlwaysUpdateSpine = self.always_update_origin
		self.is_spine = nil
		self.always_update_origin = nil
	end
	self.spine = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.missile) then
		self.missile:Dispose()
	end
	self.missile = nil
	self.spine = nil
	self.is_spine = nil
	if not is_unity_null(self.core) then
		self.core:Dispose()
	end
	self.core = nil
	self.start_pos = nil
	self.end_pos = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.target_time = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.state = nil
end

function missile_class:set_missile_anim(animation, loop, scale)
	if self.is_spine then
		local time_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
		self.spine:SetAnimation(0, animation, loop, time_scale)
	end
end

function missile_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none or self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	local progress = self.time_passed / self.target_time

	if self.current_state == self.state.begin then
		-- 미사일 사출 연출
		local calc_pos = self.start_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * progress * 2
		effect_util.update_object(self.missile, calc_pos)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.rise then
		-- 미사일 상승
		local calc_pos = self.start_pos + self.action.missile_rising_pos * progress
		effect_util.update_object(self.missile, calc_pos)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		-- 미사일 하강
		local calc_pos = self.end_pos + self.action.missile_rising_pos * (1 - progress)
		effect_util.update_object(self.missile, calc_pos)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stop then
		local calc_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress * 0.5
		if not is_unity_null(self.core) then
			self.core.transform.localScale = calc_scale
		end
	end

	if self.target_time and self.time_passed >= self.target_time then
		-- 시간이 지나면 다음 상태로 전이
		self:change_state(self.current_state + 1)
	end
end

function missile_class:is_working()
	return self.current_state ~= self.state.wait
end

		local attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, collision_info)
