function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone)
	self.battle_zone = zone

	local center = zone.center
	local mod_x = zone.size.x / 3
	local mod_z = zone.size.z / 3
	size = unity_class.vector3(mod_x, zone.size.y, mod_z)
	self.region_size = vector_util.get_xz(size)
	self.fall_regions = {}
	-- 9분할된 9분면 바운드..
	table.insert(self.fall_regions, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-mod_x, 0, -mod_z), size))
	table.insert(self.fall_regions, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -mod_z), size))
	table.insert(self.fall_regions, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(mod_x, 0, -mod_z), size))
	table.insert(self.fall_regions, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-mod_x, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.fall_regions, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size))
	table.insert(self.fall_regions, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(mod_x, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.fall_regions, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-mod_x, 0, mod_z), size))
	table.insert(self.fall_regions, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, mod_z), size))
	table.insert(self.fall_regions, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(mod_x, 0, mod_z), size))
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)

	self.total_shot_count = self.missile_count
	self.synced = false
	self.is_canceled = false
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	self.selected_targets = {}
	-- 남아있는 미사일/레이저는 없애준다.
	self:change_laser_state(self.laser_state.none)
	self:remove_missiles()
	self:change_state(self.state.shockwave)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if not self.is_disposing and not self.is_force_canceled then
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
		trigger_info_util.append_number(info, self:get_index_of_floating_in_front())
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true
	self:cancel()
	self:change_laser_state(self.laser_state.none)
	self:remove_missiles()
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.shockwave then
		if next_state ~= self.state.prepare then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.shockwave_calculator)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if next_state ~= self.state.wait then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.shockwave then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.shockwave_calculator, self.character.Position)
		local direction = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.character.Direction)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.shockwave_calculator, direction)
		area_collision_util.start(self.shockwave_calculator)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.shockwave_key)
		local shockwave_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.shockwave_key, self.character.Position)
		shockwave_fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.shockwave_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.prepare_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.wait then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.post_key)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_force_canceled then
		return
	end

	self:update_laser(dt)
	self:update_missile(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.shockwave then
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.shockwave_calculator, dt)
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
				self:on_hit_shockwave(target)
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.shockwave_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.synced then
			self.synced = true
			local pos, fo = self:search_position_with_target()
			self:send_shot_position(pos, fo)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		if self.time_passed >= self.missile_interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit_shockwave(fo)
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
	local knock_back_dir = direction
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(direction.sqrMagnitude) then
		knock_back_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.character.Direction)
	end

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = self.shockwave_modifier
	damage_info.direction = direction
	damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_back_dir
	damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.is_force_canceled then
		return
	end

	if trigger_info_util.contains_number(info) then
		-- cancel로 인한 처리 활성화
		self.is_canceled = true
		local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))
		if idx > 0 then
			self:remove_til_certain_index(idx)
		end
	else
		-- 미사일 투하 위치 sync
		local destination = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		table.insert(self.missile_holders, self:create_missile(destination))

		if #self.missile_holders < self.missile_count then
			self.synced = false
			self:change_state(self.state.wait)
			-- 캐릭터 지정으로 선정된 위치였으면 제외 대상에 추가
			if trigger_info_util.contains_target(info) then
				local fo = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
				table.insert(self.selected_targets, fo)
			end
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_missile(end_pos)
	return missile_class:new(self, self:get_missile_shoot_pos(), end_pos)
end

function local_class:remove_missiles()
	if self.missile_holders and #self.missile_holders > 0 then
		for idx = #self.missile_holders, 1, -1 do
			local holder = table.remove(self.missile_holders, idx)
			holder:dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_til_certain_index(target_idx)
	if self.missile_holders and #self.missile_holders > 0 then
		for idx = #self.missile_holders, target_idx, -1 do
			local holder = table.remove(self.missile_holders, idx)
			holder:dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_index_of_floating_in_front()
	if self.missile_holders and #self.missile_holders > 0 then
		for idx = 1, #self.missile_holders do
			local holder = self.missile_holders[idx]
			if holder.current_state ~= self.missile_state.wait and holder.current_state ~= self.missile_state.stop then
				return idx
			end
		end
	end

	return 0
end

function local_class:get_missile_shoot_pos()
	-- 연출용이라 그냥 본으로 기준 잡음
	local bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.character, 'missile' .. random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)).Bone
	return CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(bone, self.character) + self.missile_shoot_offset
end

function local_class:search_position_with_target()
	-- 유효한 위치 선정
	local avail_regions = {}
	-- 인접 여부에 따른 점수 테이블, 이 시점에서 같이 초기화
	local scores = {}
	local is_empty = true
	for idx, bound in ipairs(self.fall_regions) do
		local available = true

		for _, holder in ipairs(self.missile_holders) do
			local diff = holder.end_pos - bound.center
			if (math.abs(diff.x) <= 2 and math.abs(diff.z) <= 2) then
				available = false
				break
			end
		end

		scores[idx] = 0
		if available then
			is_empty = false
			table.insert(avail_regions, bound)
		else
			-- avail_regions 0은 nil로 취급한다.
			table.insert(avail_regions, 0)
		end
	end

	-- 유효한 위치가 없다면 이전에 발사된 위치는 고려하지 않는다.
	if is_empty then
		avail_regions = self.fall_regions
	end

	local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.character)

	if targets ~= nil then
		-- intersect 한 fo가 많을 수록 우성
		local high_score = -1
		local selection_idx_list = {}
		local selection_count = 0

		for idx = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
			local fo = targets[idx]
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				-- 선정된 적이 없는 캐릭터라면 바로 위치를 반환함
				if not table_util.contain_value(self.selected_targets, fo) then
					targets:Dispose()
					return fo.Position, fo
				end

				-- 현제 위치에 점수 증가
				local curr_x = math.floor((fo.Position.x - self.battle_zone.min.x) / self.region_size.x) + 1
				local curr_y = math.floor((fo.Position.z - self.battle_zone.min.z) / self.region_size.y)
				local current_idx = curr_x + curr_y * 3
				-- 바로 또 점수 올릴테니 high_score체크는 미룸
				if avail_regions[current_idx] ~= 0 then
					scores[current_idx] = scores[current_idx] + 1
				end

				local low_x = math.max(1, curr_x - 1)
				local max_x = math.min(3, curr_x + 1)
				local low_y = math.max(0, curr_y - 1)
				local max_y = math.min(2, curr_y + 1)

				-- 현 위치 + 인접한 다른 위치에 점수 증가
				for x = low_x, max_x do
					for y = low_y, max_y do
						current_idx = x + y * 3
						if avail_regions[current_idx] ~= 0 then
							scores[current_idx] = scores[current_idx] + 1

							if scores[current_idx] > high_score then
								high_score = scores[current_idx]
								selection_count = 1
								selection_idx_list[selection_count] = current_idx
							elseif scores[current_idx] == high_score and
									not table_util.contain_value(selection_idx_list, current_idx) then
								selection_count = selection_count + 1
								selection_idx_list[selection_count] = current_idx
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		targets:Dispose()

		-- 하나라도 선정된 위치가 있으면 반환
		if selection_count > 0 then
			local final_idx = selection_idx_list[random_util.get_random_int(1, selection_count)]
			return avail_regions[final_idx].center, nil
		end
	end

	-- 선정되지 못했다면 유효하지 않은 위치는 제거한다
	-- 보통 이 시점까지 오지 않을 것
	if avail_regions ~= self.fall_regions then
		for idx = #avail_regions, 1, -1 do
			if avail_regions[idx] == 0 then
				table.remove(avail_regions, idx)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 무작위로 반환한다.
	return avail_regions[random_util.get_random_int(1, #avail_regions)].center, nil
end

function local_class:send_shot_position(position, fo)
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, battle_util.get_ground_pos(position))
	if not is_unity_null(fo) then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, fo)
	end

	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:update_missile(dt)
	if self.missile_holders and #self.missile_holders > 0 then
		local unfinished = false
		for idx = #self.missile_holders, 1, -1 do
			local holder = self.missile_holders[idx]
			holder:update_frame(dt)
			unfinished = unfinished or holder:is_working()
		end

		-- 모든 미사일의 업데이트가 완료되지 않았다면 이탈
		if unfinished then
			return
		end

		if self.is_canceled or #self.missile_holders >= self.missile_count then
			self:change_laser_state(self.laser_state.ongoing)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit_missile(fo, pos)
	local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - pos).normalized
	local knock_back_dir = direction
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(direction.sqrMagnitude) then
		knock_back_dir = unity_class.vector3.right
	end

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = self.missile_modifier
	damage_info.direction = direction
	damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_back_dir
	damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

--region Laser 관련
function local_class:change_laser_state(next_state)
	if self.current_laser_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_laser_state == self.laser_state.ongoing then
		self:remove_lasers()
	end

	if next_state == self.laser_state.ongoing then
		self:create_lasers()
		self:remove_missiles()
	end

	self.laser_time_passed = 0
	self.current_laser_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_laser(dt)
	if self.current_laser_state == self.laser_state.none then
		return
	end

	self.laser_time_passed = self.laser_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_laser_state == self.laser_state.ongoing then
		-- 레이저 판정처리
		for calc_idx = 1, self.active_laser_count do
			local calculator = self.laser_calculators[calc_idx]
			local hits = calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

			for idx = 0, hits.Count - 1 do
				local fo = hits[idx]

				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					self:on_hit_laser(fo, calculator.Position)
				end
			end

			hits:Dispose()
		end

		if self.laser_time_passed >= self.laser_duration then
			self:change_laser_state(self.laser_state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit_laser(fo, pos)
	local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - pos).normalized

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = self.laser_modifier
	damage_info.direction = direction

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

function local_class:create_lasers()
	local direction = unity_class.vector3.left

	for group_idx, holder in ipairs(self.missile_holders) do
		local position = holder.end_pos
		local individual_idx = (group_idx - 1) * self.laser_per_missile

		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.laser_key,
				vector_util.get_x0z(position, position.y + 0.25))
		table.insert(self.laser_effect_holder, effect)

		for inner_idx = 1, self.laser_per_missile do
			local idx = individual_idx + inner_idx
			local temp = direction.x
			direction.x = direction.z
			direction.z = -temp

			-- virtual attack range 설정
			local range = self.virtual_laser_ranges[idx]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(range, position, direction)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))

			-- 판정기 설정
			local calculator = self.laser_calculators[idx]
			calculator.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(position, position.y + self.laser_width * 0.5)
			calculator.Direction = direction
			calculator:Start()
		end

		table.insert(self.laser_sfx_holder, self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.laser_key, position))
	end

	self.active_laser_count = #self.missile_holders * self.laser_per_missile
end

function local_class:remove_lasers()
	for idx = #self.laser_effect_holder, 1, -1 do
		local effect = table.remove(self.laser_effect_holder, idx)
		effect:Dispose()
	end

	for idx = #self.laser_sfx_holder, 1, -1 do
		local sfx = table.remove(self.laser_sfx_holder, idx)
		sfx:FadeOut()
	end

	for _, range in ipairs(self.virtual_laser_ranges) do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	end

	for _, calculator in ipairs(self.laser_calculators) do
		calculator:End()
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self.is_disposing = true

	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.target = nil
	self.battle_zone = nil
	self.region_size = nil
	self.fall_regions = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.laser_time_passed = nil
	self.laser_state = nil
	self.current_laser_state = nil

	self.missile_state = nil

	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil

	self.shockwave_modifier = nil
	self.shockwave_duration = nil
	self.knock_back_force = nil
	self.shockwave_calculator = nil

	self.missile_count = nil
	self.missile_radius = nil
	self.missile_interval = nil
	self.missile_modifier = nil
	self.missile_rise_delay = nil
	self.missile_rise_duration = nil
	self.missile_fall_duration = nil
	self.missile_wait_duration = nil
	self.missile_shoot_offset = nil

	self.missile_rising_pos = nil

	self.laser_length = nil
	self.laser_width = nil
	self.laser_modifier = nil
	self.laser_duration = nil
	self.laser_damage_term = nil

	self.selected_targets = nil
	self.missile_holders = nil
	self.laser_effect_holder = nil
	self.laser_sfx_holder = nil

	self.laser_per_missile = nil

	self.virtual_laser_ranges = nil
	self.laser_calculators = nil

	self.synced = nil
	self.is_canceled = nil
	self.is_force_canceled = nil

	self.is_disposing = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	-- 레이저 데미지 배율
	self.laser_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserDamageModifier", 1)
	-- 레이저 캐스팅 시간
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2.5)
	-- 타겟 추적시간
	local chasing_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChasingTime", 2.3)
	-- 추적 종료 -> 레이저 발사시 인터벌
	self.interval_duration = self.prepare_duration - chasing_time
	if self.interval_duration > 0 then
		-- 캐스팅 시간 인터벌 만큼 감소
		self.prepare_duration = self.prepare_duration - self.interval_duration
	end
	-- 타겟 추적 속도
	self.chasing_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChasingSpeed", 2)
	--넉백 강도
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1)
	-- 데미지 들어가는 텀
	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 0.1)
	-- 공격범위 넓이
	self.attack_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackWidth", 3)
	-- 공격범위 길이
	self.attack_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackLength", 20)
	-- 범위 위치 오프셋
	self.laser_attack_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserOffsetX", -2)
	-- 액션 중
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 2)

	-- 그로기 관련 값
	--스톰프 데미지 배율
	self.stomp_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StompDamageModifier", 1)
	--동작 마무리 후 바닥으로 떨어져서 그로기 되어있는 시간.
	self.groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "GroggyDuration", 1)
	-- 땅으로 떨어질때닁 영향범위
	self.stomp_damage_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StompDamageRange", 1)
	-- 추락시 폭발이펙트 재생 텀
	self.fall_explosion_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FallExplosionTerm", 0.5)
	-- 그로기 이펙트 오프셋
	self.groggy_effect_offset = CS.Utils.GetVector3FromDictionary(params, "GroggyEffectOffset", unity_class.vector3.zero)

	--바운드 밖에 위치해야 하는 포지션 x 값
	self.outpos_json = CS.Utils.GetJsonObjectFromDictionary(params, 'OutPosition')
	self.outpos_right = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(self.outpos_json, 'Right', 0.5)
	self.outpos_left = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(self.outpos_json, 'Left', -0.5)

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.battle_zone = nil

	-- 이동 상태 관련
	self.move_direction = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.move_distance = 0
	self.current_altitude = 0
	local hover_alitiude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "HoverAltitude", 0.8)
	local hover_up_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "HoverUpTime", 0.5)
	self:hover_init(hover_alitiude, hover_up_time, self.move_inside_duration)
	self.explosion_time_passed = 0

	self.voice_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'VoiceId', 12)
	local voice_attack = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'VoiceAttack', 'Attack3')
	self.enum_voice_attack = CS.System.Enum.Parse(typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType), voice_attack, true)

	-- 레이저 관련
	self.laser_point = nil
	self.is_chasing_laser = false
	self.laser_fx = nil
	self.charge_fx = nil
	self.target_position = nil

	-- 공격 계산기
	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = self.damage_term
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	local extents = unity_class.vector3(self.attack_length / 2, 3, self.attack_width /2)
	info.Extents = extents
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,  unity_class.vector2(self.attack_length, self.attack_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	-- ai들 회피 쉽게 하기 위한 추가 가상 범위 설정
	self.virtual_attack_range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_length, self.attack_width * 1.5, 0)
	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		prepare = 1,
		rising = 2,
		interval_move = 3,
		move_outside = 4, --밖으로 이동
		prepare_laser = 5,--레이저 준비
		interval_laser = 6, -- 레이저 준비/발사 사이 대기
		action = 7,-- 레이저 발사
		move_inside = 8,-- 안으로 이동 및 낙하
		groggy = 9, -- 그로기
		post = 10
	}
	self.current_state = nil

	-- 키 모음
	self.prepare_key = 'cast'
	self.rise_key = 'rise'
	self.backward_key = 'backward'
	self.forward_key = 'forward'
	self.laser_cast_key = 'laser_cast'
	self.laser_loop_key = 'laser_loop'
	self.laser_end_key = 'laser_end'
	self.groggy_key = 'groggy'
	self.explosion_key = 'explosion'

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:set_laser_pos(laser_pos)
	self.laser_point = laser_pos.localPosition
end

function local_class:get_laser_pos()
	if character_util.get_look_direction(self.character) == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return unity_class.vector3(-self.laser_point.x, self.laser_point.y + self.current_altitude, self.laser_point.z)
	else
		return unity_class.vector3(self.laser_point.x, self.laser_point.y + self.current_altitude, self.laser_point.z)
	end
	local direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)
	local dir_vec = vector_util.to_side_dir(direction)
	return unity_class.vector3(self.laser_point.x * dir_vec.x, self.laser_point.y + self.current_altitude, self.laser_point.z)
end

function local_class:vector_convert_y_to_z(pos, remain)
	local z_result = (pos.y - remain) * math.cos(math.rad(stage_camera.Transform.eulerAngles.x)) + pos.z
	return unity_class.vector3(pos.x, remain, z_result)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone)
	self.battle_zone = zone
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.explosion_time_passed = 0

	-- 배틀액션 트리거 커맨드 보내지 않으면 start 되지 않는다.
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.rising then
		-- 다 떳으면 이동 시작하게 됨. rise 애니메이션 제거
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_outside then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_laser then
		self.is_chasing_laser = false
		if next_state ~= self.state.interval_laser then
			if not is_unity_null(self.charge_fx) then
				self.charge_fx:Dispose()
			end
			self.charge_fx = nil
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))
		end
		-- 레이저 발사됨
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval_laser then
		if not is_unity_null(self.charge_fx) then
			self.charge_fx:Dispose()
		end
		self.charge_fx = nil
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			-- 다음 상태가 액션 상태가 아닐경우 RangeEnd
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.is_chasing_laser = false

		self.attack_calculator:End()
		if self.laser_sfx_holder then
			self.laser_sfx_holder:Stop()
			self.laser_sfx_holder = nil
		end
		if not is_unity_null(self.laser_fx) then
			self.laser_fx:Dispose()
		end
		self.laser_fx = nil
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.laser_end_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.laser_end_key)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))
		-- 러이저 발사 종료. 여기서 정리
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_inside then
		-- 낙하 완료
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self:stop()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		-- 그로기 종료하고 포스트로
		-- 그로기 애니메이션 삭제
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if not is_unity_null(self.groggy_fx) then
			self.groggy_fx:Dispose()
		end
		self.groggy_fx = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.prepare_key, self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.cast_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.rising then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--공중으로 띄우는 루틴 시작
		self:rising()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.rise_key, self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.rise_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.rise_key)
		-- 캐스팅 이후 공격 대상이 되지 않는다.
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	elseif next_state == self.state.interval_move then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.move_outside then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		--밖으로 나가는 방향 계산
		if self.character.Position.x > self.battle_zone.center.x then
			-- 오른쪽으로 나감
			local bound_position = unity_class.vector3(self.outpos_right + self.battle_zone.extents.x, self.battle_zone.center.y, self.battle_zone.center.z)
			self.end_position = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertToZoneRelativeToWorldToLua(self.battle_zone, bound_position)
		else
			-- 왼쪽으로 나감
			local bound_position = unity_class.vector3(self.outpos_left - self.battle_zone.extents.x, self.battle_zone.center.y, self.battle_zone.center.z)
			self.end_position = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertToZoneRelativeToWorldToLua(self.battle_zone, bound_position)
		end
		self.end_position = unity_class.vector3(self.end_position.x, self.character.Position.y, self.character.Position.z)
		self.move_direction = vector_util.normalized(self.end_position - self.character.Position)
		self.move_distance = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.end_position)
		self.prev_progress = 0

		--애니메이션 방향 설정
		local look_direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)
		if look_direction == vector_util.to_side_dir(self.move_direction) then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.forward_key)
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.backward_key)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare_laser then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.battle_zone.center - self.character.Position)
		local laser_point = self:get_laser_pos() + self.character.Position
		local direction_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.character.Direction)

		self.target_position = self:vector_convert_y_to_z(laser_point, battle_util.get_height(laser_point))
		self.target_position = self.target_position + direction_vector * self.laser_attack_offset

		-- VirtualAttackRange가 AttackRange의 영역을 전부 커버하기 때문에 VirtualAttackRange만 이벤트 배포
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.target_position, direction_vector)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.interval_duration)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.virtual_attack_range, self.target_position, direction_vector)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))

		self.charge_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.laser_cast_key, laser_point,
				direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)), self.character.transform)
		self.is_chasing_laser = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.laser_cast_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.laser_cast_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.interval_laser then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.is_chasing_laser = true

		music_player:PlayVoice(self.voice_id, nil, 0, self.enum_voice_attack)
		local laser_point = self:get_laser_pos() + self.character.Position

		self.laser_sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.laser_loop_key)
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.laser_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.laser_loop_key, laser_point,
				direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)), self.character.transform)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.laser_loop_key)

	elseif next_state == self.state.move_inside then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		--안으로 들어오는 방향 계산
		--최종위치는 중앙이 될것.
		self.end_position = self.battle_zone.center
		self.move_direction = vector_util.normalized(self.end_position - self.character.Position)
		self.move_distance = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.end_position)
		self.prev_progress = 0
		self:landing()
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:stomp_damage()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.groggy_key)
		self.groggy_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.groggy_key, self.character.Position + self.groggy_effect_offset)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.groggy_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end
	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if self:hover_update(dt) then
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3(0, self.current_altitude, 0)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.is_chasing_laser then
		local current_pos_z = self.target_position.z
		local target_pos_z = self.target.Position.z
		local diff_z = current_pos_z - target_pos_z

		if math.abs(diff_z) > self.chasing_speed * dt then
			if target_pos_z > current_pos_z then
				diff_z = self.chasing_speed * dt
			else
				diff_z = -self.chasing_speed * dt
			end
		end

		self.target_position.z = self.target_position.z + diff_z
		local t = self.character.Position
		self.character.Position = unity_class.vector3(t.x, t.y, t.z + diff_z)
		local direction_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.character.Direction)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.target_position, direction_vector)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.virtual_attack_range, self.target_position, direction_vector)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.rising)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.rising then
		if self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.hovering then
			--호버링 상태가 되면 다음 스탭으로
			self:change_state(self.state.interval_move)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval_move then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.move_outside)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_outside then
		--공중으로 띄우고, 가까운 왼쪽 / 오른쪽으로 이동

		self:move_outside(dt)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_laser then
		-- 실제 공격 시작 하기전 딜레이를 준다.
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval_laser)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval_laser then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

		self:laser_update(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.move_inside)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_inside then
		self:move_inside(dt)
		if self.battle_zone:Contains(self.character.Bounds.min) and self.battle_zone:Contains(self.character.Bounds.max) then
			if lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour) then
				self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
				self.death_type = nil
			end
			if lua_helper.type_compare(self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour, CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour) then
				self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_outside(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.move_outside_duration)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	local movement = progress - self.prev_progress
	self.prev_progress = progress

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.move_direction
	move_info.magnitude =  self.move_distance * movement

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	if self.time_passed > self.move_outside_duration then
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare_laser)
	end
end

function local_class:move_inside(dt)
	self.explosion_time_passed = self.explosion_time_passed + dt

	if self.explosion_time_passed >= self.fall_explosion_term then
		local bound = bounds_util.get_bounds(self.character)
		local rand_offset_x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-bound.size.x, bound.size.x )
		local rand_offset_y = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, bound.size.y )
		local rand_offset_z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-bound.size.z, bound.size.z )
		local rand_offset = unity_class.vector3(rand_offset_x, rand_offset_y , rand_offset_z)
		local spine = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.character)
		-- 폭발 여기저기 연출
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_key, spine.position + rand_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.explosion_key, spine.position + rand_offset)
		self.explosion_time_passed = 0
	end

	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.move_inside_duration)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	local movement = progress - self.prev_progress
	self.prev_progress = progress

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.move_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.move_distance * movement

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_side_dir(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	if self.time_passed > self.move_inside_duration then
		-- 낙하 하면서 데미지 + 밀쳐내기
		self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
	end
end

function local_class:laser_update(dt)
	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position + direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.character.Direction) * (self.attack_length * 0.5)

	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for i = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[i]
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.laser_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			if fo.Position.z > self.target_position.z then
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
			else
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
			end
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:stomp_damage()
	--데미지 입을 대상자
	local cantidates = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.character.Position, self.stomp_damage_range)
	for i = 0, cantidates.Count - 1 do
		local fo = cantidates.Values[i]
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local dest_pos = fo.Position
			local target_diff = vector_util.get_x0z(dest_pos - self.character.Position)
			local target_dist = target_diff.magnitude
			if target_dist <= self.stomp_damage_range then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.stomp_damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
	end
	cantidates:Dispose()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	--호버 스탑
	self:stop()
	self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3(0, self.current_altitude, 0)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	-- 중단되는 시기에 따라 NullDamagedBehaviour가 유지되는 경우가 있음
	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour) then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
		self.death_type = nil
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.cast_duration = nil
	self.move_interval_duration = nil
	self.move_outside_duration = nil
	self.move_inside_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil

	self.laser_damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.interval_duration = nil

	self.attack_width = nil
	self.attack_length = nil

	self.action_duration = nil

	self.groggy_duration = nil
	self.stomp_damage_range = nil
	self.fall_explosion_term = nil
	self.groggy_effect_offset = nil

	self.outpos_json = nil
	self.outpos_right = nil
	self.outpos_left = nil

	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.battle_zone = nil
	self.move_direction = nil
	self.move_distance = nil
	self.laser_point = nil
	self.is_chasing_laser = nil
	self.laser_fx = nil
	self.charge_fx = nil
	self.target_position = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.virtual_attack_range = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.prepare_key = nil
	self.rise_key = nil
	self.backward_key = nil
	self.forward_key = nil
	self.laser_cast_key = nil
	self.laser_loop_key = nil
	self.laser_end_key = nil
	self.groggy_key = nil
	self.explosion_key = nil

	self.hover_state = nil
	self.current_hover_state = nil
	self.max_alt = nil
	self.rise_time = nil
	self.land_time = nil
	self.current_altitude = nil
	self.hover_time_passed = nil
	self.is_hover_initialized = nil
end

function local_class:hover_init(max_altitude, rise_time, land_time)
	self.hover_state = {
		none = 1,
		rising = 2,
		hovering = 3,
		landing = 4,
		finish = 5
	}
	--현재 상태
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.none
	--최대고도
	self.max_alt = max_altitude
	-- 상승시간
	self.rise_time = rise_time
	--하강시간
	self.land_time = land_time
	-- 현재고도
	self.current_altitude = 0
	-- 지난시간
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	-- 값 초기화 하여 사용 가능하게 되었는지
	self.is_hover_initialized = true
end

function local_class:hover_update(dt)
	if self.is_hover_initialized == false then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.none then
		return false
	end

	self.hover_time_passed = self.hover_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.rising then
		if self.hover_time_passed < self.rise_time then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInSine(self.hover_time_passed, 0, 1, self.rise_time))
			self.current_altitude = progress * self.max_alt
		else
			self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.hovering
			self.current_altitude = self.max_alt
		end
	elseif self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.hovering then
		self.current_altitude = self.max_alt
	elseif self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.landing then
		if self.hover_time_passed < self.land_time then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutBounce(self.hover_time_passed, 0, 1, self.land_time))
			self.current_altitude = (1 - progress) * self.max_alt
		else
			self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.finish
			self.current_altitude = 0
		end
	elseif self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.finish then
		self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.none
		self.current_altitude = 0
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:rising()
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.rising
end

function local_class:landing()
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.landing
end

function local_class:stop()
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.finish
	self.current_altitude = 0
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if self.shoot_helper and not self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded() then
		return false
	elseif self.micro_shoot_helper and not self.micro_shoot_helper:IsLoaded() then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone)
	self.battle_zone = zone
end

function local_class:set_missile_pos(missile_pos)
	self.missile_point = missile_pos.localPosition
	self.missile_point_z = (self.missile_point.y) * math.cos(math.rad(stage_camera.Transform.eulerAngles.x)) + self.missile_point.z
end

function local_class:get_missile_pos()
	if character_util.get_look_direction(self.character) == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return unity_class.vector3(-self.missile_point.x, self.missile_point.y, self.missile_point.z)
	else
		return unity_class.vector3(self.missile_point.x, self.missile_point.y, self.missile_point.z)
	end
end

function local_class:vector_convert_y_to_z(pos, remain)
	local z_result = (pos.y - remain) * math.cos(math.rad(stage_camera.Transform.eulerAngles.x)) + pos.z
	return unity_class.vector3(pos.x, remain, z_result)
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 배틀액션 트리거 커맨드 보내지 않으면 start 되지 않는다.
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.force_canceled = false
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if self.disable_charge then
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	else
		self:change_state(self.state.move)
	end

end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.move then
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 미사일은 계속 돌고 있음. 일정시간 지난 후 해제 되기 때문에 할일 없음.
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		-- 수행할 작업 없음
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.move then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.destination = self.battle_zone.center
		self.destination.z = self.destination.z - self.missile_point_z
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.prepare_key)
		self.container_left_count = self.container_total_count
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:shoot_to_manual()
		self.container_left_count = self.container_left_count - 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.action_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.post_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.post_key)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if #self.missile_containers > 0 then
		self:micro_missile_routine(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.move then
		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.destination - self.character.Position)

		move_info.direction = diff.normalized
		move_info.magnitude = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.DashSpeed * dt

		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_side_dir(move_info.direction), false)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

		if diff.sqrMagnitude < self.avail_sqr_distance then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			-- 한발 쏴두고 일정시간 다음 상태로 변경 준비로 넘어감
			if self.container_left_count > 0 then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.container_term then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:prepare_missile()
	local missile = {
		start_position = nil,
		offset = self.micro_missile_start_point,
		time_passed = 0,
		counter = 1
	}
	return missile
end

function local_class:shoot_to_manual()
	local missile = self:prepare_missile()
	local missile_point = self:get_missile_pos()
	missile_point = missile_point + self.character.Position
	-- y 좌표값을 기준으로 z좌표 보정
	local remain_height = battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position) + self.container_height
	missile_point = self:vector_convert_y_to_z(missile_point, remain_height)
	missile.start_position = missile_point

	-- 보는 방향 기준으로 각도 제한
	local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - missile.start_position).normalized
	local look_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
	local angle = unity_class.vector3.SignedAngle(look_direction, direction, vector_util.up)

	if math.abs(angle) > self.angle_limit then
		if angle > 0 then
			direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.angle_limit, 0) * look_direction
		else
			direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -self.angle_limit, 0) * look_direction
		end
	end

	--프로젝타일 미사일
	self.container_counter = self.container_counter + 1
	self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(missile.start_position, direction, self.container_counter, 0, nil, false)
	missile.container = self.shoot_helper:GetProjectile(self.container_counter)
	missile.label = self.container_counter

	-- 발사된 양이 현재 존재하는것보다 많다면 기존것 제거
	if #self.missile_containers >= self.container_total_count then
		if self.missile_containers[1] ~= nil then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_key, self.missile_containers[1].container.moveInfo.position)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.explosion_key, self.missile_containers[1].container.moveInfo.position)
			self.missile_containers[1].container:Deactive()
			table.remove(self.missile_containers, 1)
		end
	end

	table.insert(self.missile_containers, missile)
end

function local_class:micro_missile_routine( dt )
	for _, missile in ipairs(self.missile_containers) do
		missile.time_passed = missile.time_passed + dt
		local current_position = missile.container.moveInfo.position
		local remain_height = current_position.y - self.container_height + self.micro_missile_height
		current_position = self:vector_convert_y_to_z(current_position, remain_height)
		local current_direction = missile.container.moveInfo.direction

		if missile.time_passed >= self.micro_missile_term then
			if missile.counter % 2 == 0 then
				dir = self:rotate_vector(current_direction, 90)
				missile.offset = missile.offset - self.micro_missile_distance_between
			else
				dir = self:rotate_vector(current_direction, -90)
			end
			local target_pos = current_position + current_direction * missile.offset
			self.micro_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(target_pos, dir, 0, 0, nil, false)
			missile.time_passed = 0

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.micro_key, target_pos)

			if missile.counter % self.micro_missile_amount == 0 then
				missile.offset = self.micro_missile_start_point
			end
			missile.counter = missile.counter + 1
		end
	end
end

--벡터 회전
function local_class:rotate_vector(target, angle)
	local angle_vector = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local radians = math.rad(angle)

	local sin = math.sin(radians)
	local cos = math.cos(radians)

	local tx = target.x;
	local ty = target.z;

	angle_vector.x = (cos * tx) - (sin * ty);
	angle_vector.z = (sin * tx) + (cos * ty);

	return angle_vector;
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.force_canceled then return true end

	-- 투사체 컨테이너
	if label > 0 then
		if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction or hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.force_eliminate then
			for idx = 1, #self.missile_containers do
				if self.missile_containers[idx].label == label then
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_key, move_info.position)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.explosion_key, move_info.position)
					table.remove(self.missile_containers, idx)
					break
				end
			end
		end
		-- 컨테이너 데미지 없음
	else
		if self.micro_shoot_helper then -- 라벨이 0이면 컨테이너가 아님.
			if hit_info.target ~= nil then
				--맞춘 대상이 타격 가능한 경우
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = hit_info.target
					damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					self.micro_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.force_canceled = true
	for idx = #self.missile_containers, 1, -1 do
		local holder = table.remove(self.missile_containers, idx)

		if not self.disposing and
				holder.container and
				holder.container.active then
			holder.container:Deactive()
		end
	end
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.disposing = true

	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.avail_sqr_distance = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.container_term = nil
	self.container_height = nil
	self.container_total_count = nil
	self.missile_proj_name = nil
	self.micro_proj_name = nil
	self.micro_missile_term = nil
	self.micro_missile_height = nil
	self.angle_limit = nil
	self.micro_missile_row = nil
	self.micro_missile_amount = nil
	self.micro_missile_distance_between = nil
	self.micro_missile_start_point = nil

	self.missile_containers = nil
	self.container_counter = nil
	self.destination = nil
	self.container_left_count = nil

	self.current_state = nil
	self.missile_point = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.micro_shoot_helper = nil

	self.force_canceled = nil

	self.ailment_info = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.prepare_key = nil
	self.action_key = nil
	self.micro_key = nil
	self.post_key = nil
	self.explosion_key = nil

	self.disposing = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossRedHoodPanelBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	-- 돌진 데미지 배율
	self.charge_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDamageModifier", 1)
	--판넬 사출 갯수
	self.panel_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "PanelAmount", 2)
	-- 필드에 배치된 판넬 총 수량
	self.total_panel_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "TotalPanelOnTilemap", 2)
	-- 캐스팅 시간
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	-- 액션 중
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	-- 판넬 스폰 딜레이
	local spawn_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SpawnDelay", 0)
	self.spawn_delay = math.min(self.action_duration, spawn_delay)
	-- 동작 마무리 시간
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 0.5)
	-- 공격범위 넓이
	self.attack_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackWidth", 3)
	-- 공격범위 길이
	self.charge_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDistance", 6)
	-- 데미지 들어가는 텀
	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 0.1)
	--넉백 강도
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1)
	-- 움직이는 시간
	self.charge_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDuration", 1)
	-- 중앙을 향한 돌진 비 활성화
	self.disable_charge = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'DisableCharge', false)
	-- 타일 맵에 배치된 판넬 명칭 접두사
	self.panel_label_prefix = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'PanelLabelPrefix', 'panel_')

	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = self.damage_term
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(self.attack_width / 2,  3, self.attack_width / 2)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false)

	self.battle_zone = nil

	self.panels = { }
	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		move = 2, -- 돌진 필요시 돌진 스테이트
		prepare = 3,-- 캐스팅
		action = 4,-- 사출
		post = 5-- 종료
	}

	self.no_charge_bound = nil
	self.charge_start_position = nil
	self.offsets = {}
	self.cast_key = 'preapare'
	self.emission_key = 'emission'
	self.charge_key = 'charge'
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone)
	self.battle_zone = zone
	local size = self.battle_zone.size
	size.x = size.x - 4
	size.z = size.z - 4
	self.no_charge_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.battle_zone.center, size)

	self:init_panels()
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_offsets(offsets)
	for idx = 1, #offsets do
		table.insert(self.offsets, offsets[idx].localPosition)
	end
end

function local_class:get_offset(idx)
	if #self.offsets == 0 then return unity_class.vector3.zero end

	local target = self.offsets[idx % #self.offsets + 1]

	if character_util.get_look_direction(self.character) == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return unity_class.vector3(-target.x, 0, target.y * math.cos(math.rad(stage_camera.Transform.eulerAngles.x)) + target.z)
	else
		return unity_class.vector3(target.x, 0, target.y * math.cos(math.rad(stage_camera.Transform.eulerAngles.x)) + target.z)
	end
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)

	-- 트리거 전에 돌진 여부를 판단한다.
	if self.disable_charge or self.no_charge_bound:Contains(self.character.Position) then
		info:AppendNumber(self.state.prepare)
	else
		info:AppendNumber(self.state.move)
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self:init_panels()
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self:change_state(unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(info:GetNumberAt(0)))
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	if self.disposing ~= true then
		-- 남아있는 판넬을 즉사시킨다.
		for idx = 1, #self.panels do
			local panel = self.panels[idx]

			if not panel.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = panel
				damage_info.damage = panel.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.move then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	if next_state == self.state.move then
		--조건이 맞을때 캐스팅 및 공격 범위 표시 없이 돌진함.
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- FIXME : ChargeCrashBehaviour로 판정해야하지 않을까? 바운드 크기 확정되면 수정할 것
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self:prepare_charge()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.charge_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.charge_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		--캐스팅
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cast_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		--사출 애니메이션 출력
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.emission_key)
		self.need_to_spawn = true;
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		-- 종료
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.move then
		self:charge_routine(dt)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.need_to_spawn and self.time_passed >= self.spawn_delay then
			self:summon_panel()
			self.need_to_spawn = false
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end

end

function local_class:init_panels()
	if #self.panels == 0 then
		for i = 1, self.total_panel_amount do
			local panel = get_character(self.panel_label_prefix .. i)
			if not is_unity_null(panel) then
				--동작 안한때는 disabled 처리
				character_util.set_active_state(panel,'disabled')
				panel.Position = unity_class.vector3(999, 999, 999)
				table.insert(self.panels, panel)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:summon_panel()
	local spawn_count = 0

	-- 적대 대상 중 적용 가능한 대상을 취합한다
	local available_targets = {}
	local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.character)
	for i = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, targets[i]) and
				targets[i].ActiveState & CS.Oak.ActiveState.InField == CS.Oak.ActiveState.InField then
			table.insert(available_targets, targets[i])
		end
	end
	targets:Dispose()

	if #available_targets == 0 then
		return
	end

	local target_index = 1
	for i = 1, #self.panels do
		local panel = self.panels[i]

		if panel.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
			if panel.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				-- 힐
				local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
				heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
				heal_info.heal = panel.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
				heal_info.isRevive = true
				heal_info.skipEffect = true
				heal_info.sender = self.character
				heal_info.target = panel
				command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
			end

			-- 초기 소환 루틴
			panel.Position = self.character.Position + self:get_offset(i)
			character_util.set_active_state(panel,'enabled')

			-- 처음 소환되는 위치면 이펙트, 사운드 출력
			if i <= #self.offsets then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.emission_key, panel.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.emission_key, panel)
			end

			-- 노티스 대상을 설정한다.
			local panel_target = available_targets[target_index]
			if target_index == #available_targets then
				target_index = 1
			else
				target_index = target_index + 1
			end

			-- 몬스터 노티스 이벤트를 쏴준다
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(panel, panel_target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
			message_system:Send(panel.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(panel, panel_target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

			spawn_count = spawn_count + 1
		end

		if spawn_count >= self.panel_amount then
			-- 한번에 소환할 수 있는 수량에 도달하면 중단
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:prepare_charge()
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.battle_zone.center - self.character.Position))
	self.charge_direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.battle_zone, self.character.Bounds, direction)
	self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.charge_direction)
	self.charge_start_position = self.character.Position
end

function local_class:charge_routine(dt)
	if self.time_passed >= self.charge_duration then
		--돌진시간이 지나면 다음상태로 변경
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		return
	end
	--돌진방향으로 튕겨냄.
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.charge_duration * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_side_dir(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			-- 넉백방향이돌진 방향과 같음.
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.charge_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.charge_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.disposing = true
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.charge_damage_modifier = nil
	self.panel_amount = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_width = nil
	self.charge_distance = nil
	self.damage_term = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil
	self.charge_duration = nil
	self.disable_charge = nil
	self.panel_label_prefix = nil
	self.battle_zone = nil
	self.panels = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil

	self.disposing = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossRedHoodPhaseShiftBattleAction')
--필수 구현
--Bombing 이후 벽에서 가까운쪽으로 이탈 (보통 Bombing 캔슬된 이후 발동할것이므로 현재 방향과 반대방향으로 가게 될것)
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)
	self.move_outside_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MoveOutsideDuration", 3)
	self.move_inside_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MoveInsideDuration", 1.5)
	self.out_position = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'OutPosition', 0.5)
	self.phase2_skin_postfix = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'Phase2SkinPostfix', '_en')

	self.voice_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'VoiceId', 12)
	local voice_phase = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'VoicePhase', 'StrongEnemyBattleStart')
	self.enum_voice_phase = CS.System.Enum.Parse(typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType), voice_phase, true)

	self.direction_vector = nil
	self.battle_zone = nil
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.string_end_with = function(str, ending)
		return ending == "" or str:sub(-#ending) == ending
	end
