	--일단 상승/하강 시간 동일하게 세팅
	self:hover_init(hover_alitiude, hover_up_time, hover_up_time)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		move_outside = 3,
		changing_sprite = 4,
		move_inside = 5,
		post = 6
	}
	self.current_state = nil

	self.rise_key = 'rise'
	self.forward_key = 'forward'
	self.drop_key = 'drop'
	self.groggy_key = 'groggy'

	self.prev_progress = nil
	self.move_direction = nil
	self.move_distance = nil

	self.fx_rise = nil
	self.fx_groggy = nil

	self.change_waiting_time = 0.2
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance

	--진행할 방향으로 커맨드 생성.
	local dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(  self.character.Position - self.battle_zone.center)
	local direction = direction_util.to_vector3(dir)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, direction)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone)
	self.battle_zone = zone
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.direction_vector = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_rise) then
		self.fx_rise:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_rise = nil
	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_groggy) then
		self.fx_groggy:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_groggy = nil
	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_rise) then
			self.fx_rise:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_rise = nil
		if next_state ~= self.state.move_outside then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_outside then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.changing_sprite then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_inside then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character.Position = self.end_position
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.rise_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.rise_key)
		self.fx_rise = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.rise_key, self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.fx_groggy = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.groggy_key, self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
		self:rising()
	elseif next_state == self.state.move_outside then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.forward_key)
		local direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.direction_vector)
		local dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(direction)

		--밖으로 나가는 방향 계산
		local bound_position = unity_class.vector3((self.battle_zone.extents.x + self.out_position) * dir_vec.x, self.battle_zone.center.y, self.character.Position.z)
		self.end_position = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertToZoneRelativeToWorldToLua(self.battle_zone, bound_position)

		self.character.Direction = direction
		self.end_position = unity_class.vector3(self.end_position.x, self.character.Position.y, self.character.Position.z)

		self.move_direction = vector_util.normalized(self.end_position - self.character.Position)
		self.move_distance = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.end_position)
		self.prev_progress = 0

		--애니메이션 방향 설정
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.forward_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.changing_sprite then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 캐릭터 스프라이트 교환 이전 그로기 이펙트 삭제
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_groggy) then
			self.fx_groggy:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_groggy = nil
		-- 스킨 변경되어 들어올때는 더이상 떨면서 날고 있지 않도록 함.
		self:hover_mode_change()
		--스킨이름 변경
		local original_skin_name = self.character.SpineController.SkinName
		if original_skin_name == nil then
			original_skin_name = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.SpineSkinName
		end
		local new_skin_name = nil
		if original_skin_name ~= nil and not self.string_end_with(original_skin_name, self.phase2_skin_postfix) then
			new_skin_name = original_skin_name..self.phase2_skin_postfix
		else
			--스킨이름 유지
			new_skin_name = original_skin_name
		end

		if new_skin_name ~= nil then
			self.character.SpineController.SkinName = new_skin_name
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'redhood_next_phase' }))
		else
			print('no phase2 skin for ', self.character)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.move_inside then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.forward_key)
		local dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
		self.end_position = unity_class.vector3(self.battle_zone.center.x + (self.battle_zone.extents.x * dir_vec.x), self.character.Position.y, self.battle_zone.center.z)
		self.move_direction = -dir_vec
		self.move_distance = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.end_position)
		self.prev_progress = 0
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.move_direction)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.drop_key)
		music_player:PlayVoice(self.voice_id, nil, 0, self.enum_voice_phase)
		self:landing()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.drop_key)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self:hover_update(dt) then
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3(0, self.current_altitude, 0)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration and self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.hovering_before then
			self:change_state(self.state.move_outside)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_outside then
		self:move_outside(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_outside_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.changing_sprite)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.changing_sprite then
		if self.time_passed >= self.change_waiting_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.move_inside)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_inside then
		self:move_inside(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_inside_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_outside(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.move_outside_duration)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	local movement = progress - self.prev_progress
	self.prev_progress = progress

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.move_direction
	move_info.magnitude =  self.move_distance * movement

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
end

function local_class:move_inside(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.move_inside_duration)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	local movement = progress - self.prev_progress
	self.prev_progress = progress

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.move_direction
	move_info.magnitude =  self.move_distance * movement

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
end

function local_class:hover_init(max_altitude, rise_time, land_time)
	self.hover_state = {
		none = 1,
		rising = 2,
		hovering_before = 3,
		hovering_after = 4,
		landing = 5,
		finish = 6
	}
	--현재 상태
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.none
	--최대고도
	self.max_alt = max_altitude
	-- 상승시간
	self.rise_time = rise_time
	--하강시간
	self.land_time = land_time
	-- 현재고도
	self.current_altitude = 0
	-- 지난시간
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	-- 값 초기화 하여 사용 가능하게 되었는지
	self.is_hover_initialized = true
	self.hover_reverse = false
end

function local_class:hover_update(dt)
	if self.is_hover_initialized == false then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.none then
		return false
	end

	self.hover_time_passed = self.hover_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.rising then
		if self.hover_time_passed < self.rise_time then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutBounce(self.hover_time_passed, 0, 1, self.rise_time))
			self.current_altitude = progress * self.max_alt
		else
			self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.hovering_before
		end
	elseif self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.hovering_before then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutBounce(self.hover_time_passed, 0, 1, 1))
		if progress >= 1 then
			self.hover_time_passed = 0
			self.hover_reverse = not self.hover_reverse
		end
		if self.hover_reverse then
			self.current_altitude = (1 - progress) * self.max_alt
		else
			self.current_altitude = progress * self.max_alt
		end
	elseif self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.hovering_after then
		self.current_altitude = self.max_alt
	elseif self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.landing then
		if self.hover_time_passed < self.land_time then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.hover_time_passed, 0, 1, self.land_time))
			self.current_altitude = (1 - progress) * self.max_alt
		else
			self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.finish
			self.current_altitude = 0
		end
	elseif self.current_hover_state == self.hover_state.finish then
		self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.none
		self.current_altitude = 0
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:rising()
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.rising
end

function local_class:hover_mode_change()
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.hovering_after
end
function local_class:landing()
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.landing
end

function local_class:stop()
	self.hover_time_passed = 0
	self.current_hover_state = self.hover_state.finish
	self.current_altitude = 0
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.move_outside_duration = nil
	self.direction_vector = nil
	self.out_position = nil

	self.hover_state = nil
	self.current_hover_state = nil
	self.max_alt = nil
	self.rise_time = nil
	self.land_time = nil
	self.current_altitude = nil
	self.hover_time_passed = nil
	self.is_hover_initialized = nil

end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossRedHoodProjectileBattleAction')

-- 프로젝타일 액션의 경우에 페이즈 1 에서 사용되는 일 없이 페이즈2에서만 사용하게 변경되므로
-- 중앙으로 이동하는 기능이 필요하지 않아 아예 빼버림.
--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱

	-- 액션 시작 캐스팅
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.5)
	-- 동작 마무리 시간
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)
	-- 배틀존 중심으로부터 미사일 사출 가능한 거리
	local avail_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AvailableDistanceFromCenter", 3)
	self.avail_sqr_distance = avail_distance * avail_distance

	-- 프로젝타일 관련 값

	-- 프로젝타일 발사 갯수
	self.projectile_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ProjectileCount', 12)
	-- 프로젝타일 발사 텀
	self.projectile_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ProjectileTerm', 0.02)
	-- 프로젝타일 발사 위치 오프셋 리스트
	local offset_json = CS.Utils.GetJsonObjectFromDictionary(params, 'ProjectileOffsets')
	self.x_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(offset_json, 'OffsetX')
	self.z_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(offset_json, 'OffsetZ')


	-- 프로젝타일 명칭
	self.missile_proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'Projectile', 'projectile_redhood_missile_container')
	-- 프로젝타일 각도 제한
	local raw_angle_limit = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootAngleLimit", 90)
	self.angle_limit = math.min(raw_angle_limit, 360) / 2
	-- 상태이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	-- 미사일 발사 포지션. 캐릭터에서 찾아서 세팅할것.
	self.missile_point = nil

	self.current_shoot_count = 0

	--프로젝타일
	local ps = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.character)
	local container_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec(self.missile_proj_name)
	local pattern_info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)

	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, container_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot, 0)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		prepare = 1,
		shoot_prepare = 2,
		shoot = 3,
		post = 4
	}
	self.current_state = nil

	-- 키 모음
	self.action_key = 'shoot'

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if self.shoot_helper and not self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded() then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:set_phase(phase)
	self.current_phase = phase
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone)
	self.battle_zone = zone
end

function local_class:set_missile_pos(missile_pos)
	self.missile_point = missile_pos
end

function local_class:get_missile_pos(index)
	local pos = self.missile_point.localPosition
	if index < self.x_offsets.Count then
		pos.x = pos.x + self.x_offsets[index]
	end

	if index < self.z_offsets.Count then
		pos.y = pos.y + self.z_offsets[index]
	end
	if character_util.get_look_direction(self.character) == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return unity_class.vector3(-pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
	else
		return unity_class.vector3(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
	end
end

function local_class:vector_convert_y_to_z(pos, remain)
	local z_result = (pos.y - remain) * math.cos(math.rad(stage_camera.Transform.eulerAngles.x)) + pos.z
	return unity_class.vector3(pos.x, remain, z_result)
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	self.current_shoot_count = 0
	-- 배틀액션 트리거 커맨드 보내지 않으면 start 되지 않는다.
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_prepare then
		-- 준비과정 후 발사
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		-- 미사일은 계속 돌고 있음. 일정시간 지난 후 해제 되기 때문에 할일 없음.
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.projectile_term))
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:shoot_to_manual()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.action_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.projectile_term then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.current_shoot_count >= self.projectile_count then
			-- 한발 쏴두고 일정시간 다음 상태로 변경 준비로 넘어감
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_prepare)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_to_manual()
	local missile_point = self:get_missile_pos(self.current_shoot_count)
	missile_point = missile_point + self.character.Position
	-- y 좌표값을 기준으로 z좌표 보정
	local ground_height = battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position) + 0.3
	-- FIXME : 임의로 45도 기준으로 적용중, 카메라 각도를 가져와서 보정하도록 변경
	missile_point = self:vector_convert_y_to_z(missile_point, ground_height)

	-- 보는 방향 기준으로 각도 제한
	local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - missile_point).normalized
	local look_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
	local angle = unity_class.vector3.SignedAngle(look_direction, direction, vector_util.up)

	if math.abs(angle) > self.angle_limit then
		if angle > 0 then
			direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.angle_limit, 0) * look_direction
		else
			direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -self.angle_limit, 0) * look_direction
		end
	end

	self.current_shoot_count = self.current_shoot_count + 1
	--프로젝타일 미사일
	self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(missile_point, direction)

end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper then
	-- 상태이상치 추가를 위해
		if hit_info.target ~= nil then
			--맞춘 대상이 파티원일 경우 상태이상 추가.
			for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, v) then
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = hit_info.target
					damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
		end
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)

	end
	return true
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.current_shoot_count = nil

	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.avail_sqr_distance = nil
	self.projectile_count = nil
	self.projectile_term = nil
	self.missile_proj_name = nil
	self.angle_limit = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.missile_point = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil

	self.x_offsets = nil
	self.z_offsets = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.action_key = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--타겟방향으로 RadialShotAngle 각도내에서 흩뿌리듯 프로젝타일을 날린다.

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.battle_zone = nil

	--파라미터 파싱
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 5)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1)
	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IntervalDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.shot_each_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotEachDelay", 0.1)
	self.radial_shot_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RadialShotAngle", 80)
	self.radial_shot_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RadialShotCount", 6)
	self.combo_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ComboCount", 2)

	--- 어택 큐 UI 표시여부
	self.show_attack_queue = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(params, 'ShowAttackQueue')
	--- trigger 시점에 방향을 고정할 것인지
	self.lock_direction_on_trigger = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(params, 'LockDirectionOnTrigger')

	-- 투사체
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "Projectile", "boss_pan_arrow_a")
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec(proj_name)
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		interval = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	self.target = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.is_reverse_dir = false
	self.current_combo_count = 0
	self.current_shot_count = 0
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)
	self.zone_bounds = bounds
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	--- 대상으로 향하는 방향 계산
	local dir_vector = self:calculate_direction_toward(target)

	--- 트리거 정보 취합
	local trigger_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
	trigger_info_util.append_target(trigger_info, target)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(trigger_info, dir_vector)

	--- 배틀액션 트리거 배포
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, trigger_info)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	--- 대상 싱크
	local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)

	self:set_battle_zone(battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position))

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	--- 방향 싱크
	self.target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	self.current_combo_count = 0
	self.current_shot_count = 0
	self.is_reverse_dir = false
	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:calculate_direction_toward(target)
	local diff = bounds_util.get_center(target) - bounds_util.get_center(self.character)
	return vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(diff))
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 어택 큐를 보여준 경우 회수한다.
		if self.show_attack_queue then
			attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.character)
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
		-- 어택 큐를 보여줄 경우 처리
		if self.show_attack_queue then
			attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.character, self.prepare_duration)
		end

		-- 방향 고정형 액션인 경우 prepare에서 start에서 받아돈 방향으로 고정한다.
		if self.lock_direction_on_trigger then
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.target_dir)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		-- 방향 고정형 액션이 아닌 경우 action 마다 재계산한다.
		if not self.lock_direction_on_trigger then
			self.target_dir = self:calculate_direction_toward(self.target)
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.target_dir)
		end

		self.current_combo_count = self.current_combo_count + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.is_reverse_dir = not self.is_reverse_dir
		self.current_shot_count = 0

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.current_combo_count < self.combo_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		else
			self:update_proj()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_proj(index)
	local dir_index = index
	if self.is_reverse_dir then
		dir_index = (self.radial_shot_count - 1) - index
	end

	local angle = self.radial_shot_angle / (self.radial_shot_count - 1) * (dir_index)
	local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle -
			(self.radial_shot_angle / 2), 0) * self.target_dir

	self.ani_dir = dir
	self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(self.character.Bounds.center + dir * 1, dir)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("each_action", nil)

	self.current_shot_count = self.current_shot_count + 1
end

function local_class:update_proj()
	--시간에 따라 순차적으로 발사
	if self.current_shot_count < self.radial_shot_count then
		if self.current_shot_count * self.shot_each_delay <= self.time_passed then
			self:shoot_proj(self.current_shot_count)
		end
	else
		if self.current_combo_count < self.combo_count then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	end

	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.character, bounds_util.get_center(self.character)
			+ self.ani_dir, bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱

	self.fall_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FallDuration", 1.0)
	self.rock_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RockModifier", 1)
	self.rock_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RockRadius", 1)

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(self.charge_distance, charge_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 낙하 바위 어택레인지
	self.rock_ranges = {}
	for _ = 1, self.rock_count do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.rock_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.rock_ranges, range)
	end

	-- 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = damage_term
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(charge_width / 2, 2, charge_width / 2)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)

	-- 투사체
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "Projectile", "monster_shot_small_red_energy")
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec(proj_name)
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:get_fall_range()
	if #self.rock_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.rock_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.rock_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		return range
	end

end

function local_class:return_fall_range(range)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	range:Hide()

	if self.rock_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.rock_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.charge_distance
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 방향으로 커맨드 생성
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, target)
	if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
		direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
	end

	-- 돌진 방향 보정
	direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, direction)

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, direction)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.charge_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.synced = nil
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if not is_unity_null(self.smoke_fx) then
			self.smoke_fx:TriggeredDispose()
		end
		self.smoke_fx = nil

		if not is_unity_null(self.wind_fx) then
			self.wind_fx:TriggeredDispose()
		end
		self.wind_fx = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.synced = false
		-- 돌진 시작
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("charge")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("charge")

		self.smoke_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("smoke", self.character.Position, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
		self.wind_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wind", self.character.Bounds.center, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:falling_rock_damage(damage_pos)
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(damage_pos, self.rock_radius, 2)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects.Values[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.rock_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 낙하 오브젝트 업데이트 처리
	if self.falling_rocks ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.falling_rocks, 1, -1 do
			local rock_tp =  self.falling_rocks[i].time_passed + dt
			self.falling_rocks[i].time_passed = rock_tp

			-- 완료시 삭제
			if rock_tp >= self.fall_duration then
				-- 낙하 위치에 데미지 + 넉백
				self:falling_rock_damage(self.falling_rocks[i].position)
				-- 투사체 패턴 발사.
				local shoot_pos = self.falling_rocks[i].position
				shoot_pos.y = shoot_pos.y + 0.2
				self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, unity_class.vector3.forward, i, -1, nil, false, 0)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot", shoot_pos)
				-- 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("break", shoot_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("break", self.falling_rocks[i].position)
				-- 오브젝트 삭제
				if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object) then
					self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
				end
				self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object = nil
				-- 그림자 제거 (TimeLimit 이므로 연출로 자연 소멸하게 놔둠)
				self.falling_rocks[i].shadow = nil
				-- 어택 레인지 반납
				self:return_fall_range(self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range)
				self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range = nil
				-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
				table.remove(self.falling_rocks, i)
			elseif rock_tp >= 0 then
				local prog = rock_tp / self.fall_duration
				local calc_pos = self.falling_rocks[i].position + self.fall_height * (1 - prog * prog) * unity_class.vector3.up

				if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object) then
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				else
					self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("rock", calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.falling_rocks[i].shadow = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shadow", self.falling_rocks[i].position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.action_duration * dt

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
					local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
					local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
					local knock_direction
					if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
					else
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_rocks()
	-- 낙하중이던 오브젝트 해제
	if self.falling_rocks ~= nil then
		for i = #self.falling_rocks, 1, -1 do
			-- 오브젝트 제거
			if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object) then
				self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object = nil
			-- 그림자 제거 (remove 시엔 즉시 제거)
			if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].shadow) then
				self.falling_rocks[i].shadow:Dispose()
			end
			self.falling_rocks[i].shadow = nil
			-- 어택 레인지 반납
			self:return_fall_range(self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range)
			self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range = nil
			-- 해제 & 리스트에서 제거
			table.remove(self.falling_rocks, i)
		end
	end
	self.falling_rocks = nil
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:remove_rocks()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	-- Active 상태일 때만 sync.
	if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		-- 이전 데이터 남아있다면 먼저 지움
		if self.falling_rocks ~= nil then
			self:remove_rocks()
		end

		-- 새 바위 데이터 생성해서 넣음
		self.falling_rocks = {}
		local poses = info.Positions
		for i = 0, poses.Count-1 do
			local pos = poses[i]
			local range = self:get_fall_range()
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, pos)
			range:Show(self.initial_fall_delay + i * self.fall_delay + self.fall_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			table.insert(self.falling_rocks, {
				position = pos,
				time_passed = - self.initial_fall_delay - i * self.fall_delay,
				attack_range = range
			})
		end

		-- 스테이트 변경
		self:change_state(self.state.post)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.action and not self.synced then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if not is_unity_null(blocker) then
				if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
					self.synced = true

					-- 충돌 이펙트
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crash", blocker.Bounds:ClosestPoint(self.character.Bounds.center), unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("crash")
					stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.5)

					if self.sliced_zone_bounds ~= nil then
						-- 바위 낙하할 위치 선택
						local available_shoot_points = {}
						for _, bound in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
							-- 현재 캐릭터의 바운드와 겹치지 않는 곳만 추가
							if not bound:Intersects(self.character.Bounds) then
								table.insert(available_shoot_points, bound.center)
							end
						end
						local random_points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_shoot_points, {count = self.rock_count})

						-- 돌 떨어질 위치에 대해 싱크 커맨드
						local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
						for _, point in ipairs(random_points) do
							point.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(point):GetHeightAt(point)
							info:AppendPosition(point)
						end

						local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
						command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.rock_count = nil
	self.charge_distance = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil
	self.initial_fall_delay = nil
	self.fall_delay = nil
	self.fall_height = nil
	self.fall_duration = nil
	self.rock_modifier = nil
	self.rock_radius = nil

	self.charge_direction = nil

	if self.rock_ranges ~= nil then
		for _, range in ipairs(self.rock_ranges) do
			if range ~= nil then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(range)
			end
		end
		self.rock_ranges = nil
	end

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.sliced_zone_bounds = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
	-- zone bound 9등분 해서 저장
	local center = bound.center
	local modX = bound.size.x / 3
	local modZ = bound.size.z / 3
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, bound.size.y, modZ)

	self.sliced_zone_bounds = {}
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, -modZ), size))
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:get_fall_range()
	if #self.rock_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.rock_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.rock_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()

	end

end

function local_class:return_fall_range(range)
	if self.is_risk_map_on then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	end

	range:Hide()

	if self.rock_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.rock_ranges, range)
	end

function local_class:is_loaded()

		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()

end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.charge_distance
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 방향으로 커맨드 생성
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, target)

function local_class:start(info)

function local_class:cancel()

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then

		self.attack_calculator:End()
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if not is_unity_null(self.smoke_fx) then
			self.smoke_fx:TriggeredDispose()
		end
		self.smoke_fx = nil

		if not is_unity_null(self.wind_fx) then
			self.wind_fx:TriggeredDispose()
		end
		self.wind_fx = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action_interval then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.slash_attack_range:Hide()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_action then
		self.slash_attack_calculator:End()
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.slash_attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.synced = false
		-- 돌진 시작
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("charge")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("charge")

		self.smoke_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("smoke", self.character.Position, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
		self.wind_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wind", self.character.Bounds.center, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action_interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.slash_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.slash_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.slash_direction)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.slash_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.slash_direction)
		self.slash_attack_range:Show(self.slash_prepare_duration)
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.slash_attack_range))
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.slash_prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("slash_prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.slash_action then
	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.slash_attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.slash_attack_calculator.Direction = self.slash_direction
		self.slash_attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("slash_action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("slash_action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:falling_rock_damage(damage_pos)
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(damage_pos, self.rock_radius, 2)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects.Values[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.rock_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 낙하 오브젝트 업데이트 처리
	if self.falling_rocks ~= nil then
		self:update_rocks(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			self:update_charge(dt)
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			self:change_state(self.state.action_interval)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action_interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.slash_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.slash_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.slash_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.slash_action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_slash(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_rocks(dt)
	-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
	for i = #self.falling_rocks, 1, -1 do
		local rock_tp =  self.falling_rocks[i].time_passed + dt
		self.falling_rocks[i].time_passed = rock_tp

		-- 완료시 삭제
		if rock_tp >= self.fall_duration then
			-- 낙하 위치에 데미지 + 넉백
			self:falling_rock_damage(self.falling_rocks[i].position)
			-- 투사체 패턴 발사.
			local shoot_pos = self.falling_rocks[i].position
			shoot_pos.y = shoot_pos.y + 0.2
			self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, unity_class.vector3.forward, i, -1, nil, false, 0)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot", shoot_pos)
			-- 폭파 이펙트
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("break", shoot_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("break", self.falling_rocks[i].position)
			-- 오브젝트 삭제
			if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object) then
				self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object = nil
			-- 그림자 제거 (TimeLimit 이므로 연출로 자연 소멸하게 놔둠)
			self.falling_rocks[i].shadow = nil
			-- 어택 레인지 반납
			self:return_fall_range(self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range)
			self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range = nil
			-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
			table.remove(self.falling_rocks, i)
		elseif rock_tp >= 0 then
			local prog = rock_tp / self.fall_duration
			local calc_pos = self.falling_rocks[i].position + self.fall_height * (1 - prog * prog) * unity_class.vector3.up

			if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object) then
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			else
				self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("rock", calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.falling_rocks[i].shadow = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shadow", self.falling_rocks[i].position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.action_duration * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
			local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
			local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
			local knock_direction
			if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
			else
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_slash(dt)
	-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
	local objects = self.slash_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.slash_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.slash_knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:remove_rocks()
	-- 낙하중이던 오브젝트 해제
	if self.falling_rocks ~= nil then
		for i = #self.falling_rocks, 1, -1 do
			-- 오브젝트 제거
			if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object) then
				self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object = nil
			-- 그림자 제거 (remove 시엔 즉시 제거)
			if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].shadow) then
				self.falling_rocks[i].shadow:Dispose()
			end
			self.falling_rocks[i].shadow = nil
			-- 어택 레인지 반납
			self:return_fall_range(self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range)
			self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range = nil
			-- 해제 & 리스트에서 제거
			table.remove(self.falling_rocks, i)
		end
	end
	self.falling_rocks = nil
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:remove_rocks()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	-- Active 상태일 때만 sync.
	if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		-- 이전 데이터 남아있다면 먼저 지움
		if self.falling_rocks ~= nil then
			self:remove_rocks()
		end

		-- 새 바위 데이터 생성해서 넣음
		self.falling_rocks = {}
		local poses = info.Positions
		for i = 0, poses.Count-1 do
			local pos = poses[i]
			local range = self:get_fall_range()
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, pos)
			range:Show(self.initial_fall_delay + i * self.fall_delay + self.fall_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			table.insert(self.falling_rocks, {
				position = pos,
				time_passed = - self.initial_fall_delay - i * self.fall_delay,
				attack_range = range
			})
		end

		-- 스테이트 변경
		self:change_state(self.state.action_interval)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.action and not self.synced then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if not is_unity_null(blocker) then
				if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
					self.synced = true

					-- 충돌 이펙트
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crash", blocker.Bounds:ClosestPoint(self.character.Bounds.center), unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("crash")
					stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.5)

					if self.sliced_zone_bounds ~= nil then
						-- 바위 낙하할 위치 선택
						local available_shoot_points = {}
						for _, bound in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
							-- 현재 캐릭터의 바운드와 겹치지 않는 곳만 추가
							if not bound:Intersects(self.character.Bounds) then
								table.insert(available_shoot_points, bound.center)
							end
						end
						local random_points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_shoot_points, {count = self.rock_count})

						-- 돌 떨어질 위치에 대해 싱크 커맨드
						local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
						for _, point in ipairs(random_points) do
							point.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(point):GetHeightAt(point)
							info:AppendPosition(point)
						end

						local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
						command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.rock_count = nil
	self.charge_distance = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil
	self.initial_fall_delay = nil
	self.fall_delay = nil
	self.fall_height = nil
	self.fall_duration = nil
	self.rock_modifier = nil
	self.rock_radius = nil

	self.charge_direction = nil

	if self.rock_ranges ~= nil then
		for _, range in ipairs(self.rock_ranges) do
			if range ~= nil then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(range)
			end
		end
		self.rock_ranges = nil
	end

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.sliced_zone_bounds = nil
	self.slash_attack_calculator = nil
	self.slash_attack_range = nil
	self.slash_direction = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
	-- zone bound 9등분 해서 저장
	local center = bound.center
	local modX = bound.size.x / 3
	local modZ = bound.size.z / 3
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, bound.size.y, modZ)

	self.sliced_zone_bounds = {}
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, -modZ), size))
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:is_loaded()

		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= math.max(self.attack_distance, self.attack_radius)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟의 4way 방향으로 커맨드 생성
	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(target.Position - self.character.Position)
	if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)
	end

	local dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(direction)
	local position = self.character.Position + self.attack_distance * dir_vec

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.Create(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName,
			position, dir_vec, nil)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.target_position = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			if self.is_risk_map_on then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			end

			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.sfx_holder:Stop()
			self.sfx_holder = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_started = nil
		self.shot_complete = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()

		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_started = false
		self.shot_complete = false
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.attack_started and self.time_passed >= self.attack_delay then
			self.attack_started = true
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("clash", self.target_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end

		-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		-- 투사체 발사하는 타이밍 체크해서 발사
		if not self.shot_complete and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
			self.shot_complete = true

			-- 투사체 패턴 발사. (높이 적당히 추가)
			local shoot_pos = self.target_position
			shoot_pos.y = shoot_pos.y + 0.2
			self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, self.target_direction, 0, -1, nil, false, 0)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_radius = nil
	self.shoot_timing = nil
	self.attack_delay = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil

	self.target_direction = nil
	self.target_position = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,

local local_class = newclass('BossRobotKnightDuelBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.shoot_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootTerm", 1)
	self.bolt_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MissileRadius", 1)
	self.bolt_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FallHeight", 10)
	self.bolt_fall_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FallDuration", 1)
	self.safe_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SafeDistance", 2)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 3)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 0)
	self.duel_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DuelDuration", 8)
	self.max_none_shot_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxNoneShotTime", 1)
	self.alert_effect_scale = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AlertEffectScale", 1)

	self.is_risk_map_on = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsUseRiskMap', false)

	self.duel_virtual_range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateCustom()

	-- 포격 낙하 어택레인지
	self.fall_ranges = {}
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.bolt_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.fall_ranges, range)
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.remain_time = 0
	self.bolts = {}
	self.target_timer = create_generic_dictionary(CS.Oak.IFieldObject, CS.System.Single)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:get_fall_range()
	if #self.fall_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.fall_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.bolt_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		return range
	end
end

function local_class:return_fall_range(range)

	if self.is_risk_map_on then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	end

	range:Hide()

	if self.fall_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.fall_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 커맨드 생성
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.zone_bound.center)
	cmd:AppendNumber(self.zone_bound.size.x)
	cmd:AppendNumber(self.zone_bound.size.z)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

end

function local_class:start(info)
	-- bound info sync
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(info:GetPositionAt(0), unity_class.vector3(info:GetNumberAt(0), 1, info:GetNumberAt(1)))
