	self.force_canceled = false
	self.target_timer:Clear()

	self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self:cancel_risk_range()
		end
		if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.sfx_holder:Stop()
			self.sfx_holder = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self:update_risk_range()
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		-- action 스테이트 시작하는 시점에서 타이머 입력
		self.remain_time = self.duel_duration
		self.time_since_last_shot = 0
		-- 시전 이펙트
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("start", self.character.Position + unity_class.vector3(0, 3.3, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.Transform)
		-- 범위 이펙트
		self.alert_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("alert", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.Transform)
		self.alert_effect.transform.localScale = vector(self.alert_effect_scale, 1, self.alert_effect_scale)
		self.alert_sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("loop")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.remain_time > 0 then
		self.remain_time = self.remain_time - dt
		self.time_since_last_shot = self.time_since_last_shot + dt

		-- 범위에 포함된 적 + 타이머 체크 후 싱크 커맨드
		local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
		if targets ~= nil then
			for index = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
				-- 거리 검사
				if battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, targets[index]) > self.safe_distance then
					local has_value, value = self.target_timer:TryGetValue(targets[index])

					-- 이전에 쏜 시간 검사
					if has_value then
						if value - self.remain_time >= self.shoot_term then
							local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, targets[index].Position)
							command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

							self.target_timer[targets[index]] = self.remain_time
							self.time_since_last_shot = 0
						end
					else
						local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, targets[index].Position)
						command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

						self.target_timer[targets[index]] = self.remain_time
						self.time_since_last_shot = 0
					end
				end
			end
			targets:Dispose()
		end

		-- 포격 대상이 없는 상태로 일정 시간 경과할 경우 경계면에 한발 쏨
		if self.time_since_last_shot >= self.max_none_shot_time then
			local random_pos = self.character.Position + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, unity_class.random.Range(0, 360), 0) *
					unity_class.vector3.right * (self.safe_distance + self.bolt_radius)

			-- 바운드 바깥 영역에 떨어지려는 경우 바운드 안으로 떨어지게 함
			if not CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.zone_bound, random_pos) then
				local dir_to_center = vector_util.get_x0z(self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position).normalized
				random_pos = self.character.Position + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, unity_class.random.Range(-45, 45), 0) *
						dir_to_center * (self.safe_distance + self.bolt_radius)
			end

			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, random_pos)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
			self.time_since_last_shot = 0
		end

		if self.remain_time > 0 then
			self:update_risk_range()
		else
			self:cancel_risk_range()
			if not is_unity_null(self.alert_effect) then
				self.alert_effect:Dispose()
			end
			self.alert_effect = nil

			if self.alert_sfx_holder ~= nil then
				self.alert_sfx_holder:Stop()
				self.alert_sfx_holder = nil
			end
		end
	end

	-- 포격 업데이트
	if self.bolts ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.bolts, 1, -1 do
			local bolt_tp =  self.bolts[i].time_passed + dt
			self.bolts[i].time_passed = bolt_tp

			local b_position = self.bolts[i].position

			-- 완료시 삭제
			if bolt_tp >= self.bolt_fall_duration then
				-- 낙하 위치에 데미지
				local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(b_position, self.bolt_radius, 4)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects.Values[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end
				end
				objects:Dispose()
				-- 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", b_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", b_position)
				-- 오브젝트 삭제
				if not is_unity_null(self.bolts[i].pooled_object) then
					self.bolts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
				end
				self.bolts[i].pooled_object = nil

				if not is_unity_null(self.bolts[i].trail_object) then
					self.bolts[i].trail_object:TriggeredDispose()
				end
				self.bolts[i].trail_object = nil

				-- 어택레인지 반환
				self:return_fall_range(self.bolts[i].attack_range)
				self.bolts[i].attack_range = nil
				-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
				table.remove(self.bolts, i)
			elseif bolt_tp >= 0 then
				local prog = bolt_tp / self.bolt_fall_duration
				local calc_pos = b_position + self.bolt_height * (1 - prog * prog) * unity_class.vector3.up

				if not is_unity_null(self.bolts[i].pooled_object) then
					self.bolts[i].pooled_object.transform.localPosition = calc_pos
				end

				if not is_unity_null(self.bolts[i].trail_object) then
					self.bolts[i].trail_object.transform.localPosition = calc_pos + unity_class.vector3(0, 0.2, 0)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.force_canceled = true
	self:cancel()

	if self.remain_time > 0 then
		self.remain_time = 0
		self:cancel_risk_range()

		if not is_unity_null(self.alert_effect) then
			self.alert_effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.alert_effect = nil

		if self.alert_sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.alert_sfx_holder:Stop()
			self.alert_sfx_holder = nil
		end
	end

	-- 모든 포격 바로 중지
	if self.bolts ~= nil then
		for i = #self.bolts, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.bolts[i].pooled_object) then
				self.bolts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.bolts[i].pooled_object = nil
			if not is_unity_null(self.bolts[i].trail_object) then
				self.bolts[i].trail_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.bolts[i].trail_object = nil
			-- 어택레인지 반환
			self:return_fall_range(self.bolts[i].attack_range)
			self.bolts[i].attack_range = nil
			-- 제거
			table.remove(self.bolts, i)
		end

	if self.is_risk_map_on then

			CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.GetRectangleWithHoleIntersectGrids(self.zone_bound.center, self.zone_bound.size.x, self.zone_bound.size.z, 0, self.character.Position, self.safe_distance)))
	end

	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.force_canceled == false then
		-- Sync 받은 위치에 포격 개시
		local pos = info:GetPositionAt(0)
		local range = self:get_fall_range()

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, pos)
		range:Show(self.bolt_fall_duration)
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
		end

		local fx_pos = pos + unity_class.vector3(0,self.bolt_height,0)
		local fx_pool = self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("bolt")
		local fx = fx_pool:Instantiate(fx_pos, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0), nil)

		local trail_fx = trailfx_pool:Instantiate(fx_pos + unity_class.vector3(0, 0.2, 0), unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0), nil)

		table.insert(self.bolts, {
			position = pos,
			time_passed = 0,
			pooled_object = fx,
			trail_object = trail_fx,
			attack_range = range
		})
	end

	self.current_state = nil

	self.safe_distance = nil

				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(range)
			end
		end
		self.fall_ranges = nil
	end

	self.bolts = nil
	self.target_timer = nil

	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)

	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRadius", 1.5)
	self.attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDelay", 0)
	local attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDuration", 0.5)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.0)

	-- 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = attack_duration
	info.Radius = self.attack_radius
	info.Height = 3
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, self.attack_delay, 1)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_radius)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	-- 제자리에서 밀쳐내는 것이므로 그냥 true
	return true
	--if not is_unity_null(target) then
	--	return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.attack_radius
	--end
	--return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 상태만 체크
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName,
			self.character.Position)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target_position = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.sfx_holder:Stop()
			self.sfx_holder = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_started = nil
		self.shot_complete = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
		self.attack_range:Show(0)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_started = false
		self.shot_complete = false
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.attack_started and self.time_passed >= self.attack_delay then
			self.attack_started = true
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("clash", self.target_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end

		-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_radius = nil
	self.attack_delay = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil

	self.target_position = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.proj_b_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjBSpeed", 4)

	self.is_enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced", false)
	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	--- 프로젝타일 슈터
	self.cs_shooter = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)

	self.proj_a_speed = battle_util.get_number(self.proj_spec[1].Speed)

	--AttackRange
	self.attack_range_a_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.proj_a_count do
		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.proj_a_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_range_a_list, ar)
	end

	self.attack_range_b_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.proj_b_count do
		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.proj_b_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_range_b_list, ar)
	end

	self.target = nil
	self.proj_target_pos_list = nil
	self.proj_b_info_list = nil
	self.is_proj_b_active = false
	self.proj_b_time_passed = 0
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:get_proj_b_list()
	local info_list = self.proj_b_info_list
	for _,v2 in pairs(self.attack_range_b_list) do
		if v2 ~= nil then
			v2:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v2))
		end
	end
	--self.proj_b_info_list = nil
	--self.proj_b_info_list = {}
	return info_list
end

function local_class:get_proj_b_count()
	local count = 0
	if self.proj_b_info_list == nil then
		count = 0
	else
		count = #self.proj_b_info_list
	end
	return count
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	if self.proj_b_info_list == nil then
		self.proj_b_info_list = {}
	end

	if self.proj_target_pos_list ~= nil then
		self.proj_target_pos_list = nil
	end
	self.proj_target_pos_list = {}

	if self.proj_a_info_list ~= nil then
		self.proj_a_info_list = nil
	end

	self.is_proj_b_active = false
	self.proj_b_time_passed = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_a_list) do
		if v ~= nil then
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if self.proj_b_info_list ~= nil then
			for i = #self.proj_b_info_list, 1, -1 do
				self:dispose_proj_b(i, self.proj_b_info_list[i], true)
			end
			self.proj_b_info_list = nil
		end
		self.proj_b_info_list = {}
		self.proj_a_info_list = {}

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
		self:shoot_proj_a()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:shoot_proj_a()
	for i = 1, self.proj_a_count do
		local target_pos = self:get_random_position(self.character.Position, i)
		table.insert(self.proj_target_pos_list, target_pos)

		--self.shoot_helper[1]:ShootTargetPosition(target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero, i, nil, false)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_a_list[i], target_pos)
		local dist = (target_pos - self.character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
		local land_time = dist / self.proj_a_speed
		local duration = self.proj_a_duration
		local speed = dist / duration
		local effect =self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_a", self.character.Position,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_a_contrail", self.character.Position,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)

		table.insert(self.proj_a_info_list, {
			is_active = true,
			start_pos = self.character.Position,
			target_pos = target_pos,
			current_pos = self.character.Position,
			time_passed = 0,
			duration = duration,
			speed = speed,
			height = 5,
			effect = effect,
			trail = trail
		})

		self.attack_range_a_list[i]:Show(self.proj_a_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_a_list[i]))
	end
end

function local_class:update_shoot_proj_a(dt)

	for _,v in pairs(self.proj_a_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			local progress = v.time_passed / v.duration
			if progress > 1 then
				--도착하면 딜 체크하고 이팩트는 사라지고
				--적에게 히트하면 그냥 사라지고 히트하지않으면 분열한다.
				v.current_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(v.target_pos, battle_util.get_height(v.target_pos))
				local is_hit = self:update_proj_a_damage(v)

				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_a_list[_]))
				self.attack_range_a_list[_]:Hide()
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end
				if v.trail ~= nil then
					v.trail:Dispose()
					v.trail = nil
				end

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_a_explosion", v.current_pos,
						unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("proj_a_explosion")

				if not is_hit then
					self:shoot_proj_b(v.current_pos)
				end
				v.is_active = false
			else
				v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
				local h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * v.height
				local temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(v.start_pos, v.target_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * h
				v.current_pos = temp_pos
				v.effect.transform.localPosition = temp_pos
				v.trail.transform.localPosition = temp_pos
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj_a_damage(info)
	local is_hit = false
	if info.is_active then
		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(info.current_pos, self.proj_a_radius)

		for _2,v2 in pairs(fo_list) do
			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
					v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) then
			else
				local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(info.current_pos - v2.Position).normalized
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = v2
				damage_info.direction = dir
				damage_info.modifier = self.proj_a_damage_modifier
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				is_hit = true
			end
		end

		fo_list:Dispose()
	end

	return is_hit
end

function local_class:shoot_proj_b(target_pos)
	--6방향 프로젝타일 발사
	for i = 1, self.proj_b_count do
		local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.proj_b_count, 0)
				* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
		local pos = target_pos + (dir * self.proj_b_range)
		local diff = pos - target_pos
		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_b", target_pos,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_b_contrail", target_pos,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		trail.transform.parent = effect.transform
		self.is_proj_b_active = true

		local info = {
			effect = effect,
			trail_effect = nil,
			is_active = true,
			is_move_finish = false,
			diff = diff,
			life_time = diff.magnitude / self.proj_b_speed,
			progress_time = 0,
			start_pos = target_pos,
			dest_pos = pos,
			current_pos = target_pos,
			is_ready = false,
		}
		table.insert(self.proj_b_info_list, info)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_b_list[i]))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_b_list[i], pos)

		local dist = (pos - target_pos):GetX0z().magnitude
		local land_time = dist / self.proj_b_speed
		self.attack_range_b_list[i]:Show(land_time)
		self.is_active_mine = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot_proj_b_routine, self, info))
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_proj_b_routine(info)
	local vertical_speed = 4.5
	local gravity = 5.5
	local horizontal_speed = 2.5
	local y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(vertical_speed, gravity, 0, 0)
	y_calculator:ScaleTime(horizontal_speed)

	while self.is_active_mine do
		if info.effect == nil then
			-- force cancel 및 중복 실행 등으로 취소하고 이펙트 지워버렸다면 더 돌리지 않는다.
			-- (Dispose 시킬 때 명시적으로 다 nil 로 넣어주므로 is_unity_null 체크 안함).
			return
		elseif y_calculator:IsDone() then
			info.effect.transform.position = info.dest_pos
			info.is_ready = true
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			return
		else
			y_calculator:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

			local progress = y_calculator:GetProgress()
			local move_pos = info.start_pos * (1 - progress) + info.dest_pos * progress
			move_pos.y = y_calculator:GetDistance() + info.dest_pos.y
			info.effect.transform.position = move_pos
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--패턴 종료 후 proj 시퀸스는 계속 진행

	if self.proj_a_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_shoot_proj_a(dt)
	end

	if self.proj_b_info_list ~= nil and #self.proj_b_info_list > 0 then
		if #self.proj_b_info_list > 0 then
			self:update_proj_b_move(dt)
			self:update_proj_b()
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj_b()
	for _,v in pairs(self.proj_b_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(v.current_pos, self.proj_b_radius)

			for _2,v2 in pairs(fo_list) do
				if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
						v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
						lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) then
				else
					local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.dest_pos - v2.Position).normalized
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = v2
					damage_info.direction = dir
					damage_info.modifier = self.proj_b_damage_modifier

					if self.is_enhanced then
						damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
						damage_info.knockBackDirection = -dir
						damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
					end

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

					local idx = _ % self.proj_b_count
					if idx == 0 then
						idx = self.proj_b_count
					end
					if self.attack_range_b_list[idx] ~= nil then
						self.attack_range_b_list[idx]:Hide()
						CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_b_list[idx]))
					end

					self:dispose_proj_b(_, v)
				end
			end

			fo_list:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj_b_move(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.proj_b_info_list) do
		if v.is_active and not v.is_move_finish then
			if v.progress_time <= v.life_time then
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
				v.current_pos  = v.start_pos + v.progress_time / v.life_time * v.diff
			else
				v.current_pos = v.dest_pos
				v.progress_time = 0
				v.is_move_finish = true

				if v.trail_effect ~= nil then
					v.trail_effect:Dispose()
					v.trail_effect = nil
				end

				for _,v2 in pairs(self.attack_range_b_list) do
					if v2 ~= nil then
						v2:Hide()
						CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v2))
					end
				end
			end
		elseif v.is_active then
			if self.is_enhanced then
				if v.progress_time <= self.proj_b_duration then
					v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
				else
					self:dispose_proj_b(_, v)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_proj_b(idx, info)
	if info.effect ~= nil then
		info.effect:Dispose()
		info.effect = nil
		info.is_active = false
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_b_explosion", info.current_pos,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("proj_b_explosion")
	end

	if info.trail_effect ~= nil then
		info.trail_effect:Dispose()
		info.trail_effect = nil
	end

	table.remove(self.proj_b_info_list, idx)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper == nil then return true end

	local owner = self.character

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_a_list[label]))
	self.attack_range_a_list[label]:Hide()

	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.field_object or
			battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		--캐릭터에 맞았다면 끝
	elseif hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.map_hit then
		--포격 위치 범위내에 타겟이 있다면 proj_b 발동하지 않는다.
		local diff = self.target.Position - hit_info.position
		if math.abs(diff.magnitude) < self.proj_a_radius then
			self.shoot_helper[1]:OnHit(hit_info)
			return
		end

		--label이 1일 경우 6방향 proj2발사
		self.is_proj_b_active = true
		self:shoot_proj_b(hit_info.position)
	end

	self.shoot_helper[1]:OnHit(hit_info)

	return true
end

function local_class:get_random_position(center_pos, index)
	local shot_index = index - 1
	local count = self.proj_a_count
	if index > self.proj_a_count then
		count = index
	end
	local shot_area_angle = 360 / (count)
	local angle = unity_class.random.Range(shot_area_angle * shot_index + 30, (shot_area_angle * index - 30))
	local shoot_range = unity_class.random.Range(self.proj_a_min_range, self.proj_a_max_range)
	local random_pos = center_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle, 0)
			* (unity_class.vector3.right * shoot_range)

	if random_pos.x < self.zone_bound.min.x + 4 then
		local offset = random_pos.x - center_pos.x
		random_pos.x = center_pos.x + math.abs(offset)
	elseif random_pos.x > self.zone_bound.max.x - 4 then
		local offset = random_pos.x - center_pos.x
		random_pos.x = center_pos.x - math.abs(offset)
	end

	if random_pos.z < self.zone_bound.min.z + 4 then
		local offset = random_pos.z - center_pos.z
		random_pos.z = center_pos.z + math.abs(offset)
	elseif random_pos.z > self.zone_bound.max.z - 4 then
		local offset = random_pos.z - center_pos.z
		random_pos.z = center_pos.z - math.abs(offset)
	end

	if index >= 2 then
		local diff = self.proj_target_pos_list[1] - random_pos
		if math.abs(diff.magnitude) < 2 then

			random_pos = self:get_random_position(self.proj_target_pos_list[1], index + 1)
			--local dir = (self.zone_bound.center - self.proj_target_pos_list[1]).normalized
			--random_pos = random_pos + (dir * 3)
		end
	end
	return random_pos
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_a_list) do
		if v ~= nil then
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	end

	if self.attack_range_b_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_b_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	end

	if self.proj_b_info_list ~= nil then
		for i = #self.proj_b_info_list, 1, -1 do
			self:dispose_proj_b(i, self.proj_b_info_list[i])
		end
	end

	if self.proj_a_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.proj_a_info_list) do
			if v.is_active then
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end
				if v.trail ~= nil then
					v.trail:Dispose()
					v.trail = nil
				end
				v.is_active = false
			end
		end
		self.proj_a_info_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil
	self.cs_shooter = nil

local local_class = newclass('BossSalamandraBonfireSingleRaidBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.proj_a_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjAHitRadius", 0.9)
	self.proj_a_ignore_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjAIgnoreRange", 2)
	self.proj_a_min_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjAMinRange", 2)
	self.proj_a_max_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjAMaxRange", 3)

	self.proj_a_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjADamageModifier", 1.1)

	self.proj_b_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ProjBShootCount", 6)
	self.proj_b_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjBShootRange", 2)
	self.proj_b_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjBDuration", 2)
	self.proj_b_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjBDamageModifier", 1.1)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.1)
	self.proj_b_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjBSpeed", 4)

	local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.proj_a_radius, 99, -1)
	self.knockback_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {

	self.cs_shooter = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)

	self.attack_range_a_list = {}

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)

end

function local_class:get_proj_b_list()

			v2:Hide()

function local_class:get_proj_b_count()

function local_class:is_loaded()

end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	if self.proj_b_info_list == nil then
		self.proj_b_info_list = {}
	end

	if self.proj_target_pos_list ~= nil then
		self.proj_target_pos_list = nil
	end
	self.proj_target_pos_list = {}

	self.proj_b_time_passed = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if self.proj_b_info_list ~= nil then
			for i = #self.proj_b_info_list, 1, -1 do
				self:dispose_proj_b(i, self.proj_b_info_list[i], true)
			end
			self.proj_b_info_list = nil
		end
		self.proj_b_info_list = {}
		self.proj_a_info_list = {}

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
		self:shoot_proj_a()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_proj_a_count(count)
	self.proj_a_count = count
end

function local_class:shoot_proj_a()
	for i = 1, self.proj_a_count do
		local target_pos = self.target.Position
		if i > 1 then
			target_pos = self:get_random_position(self.character.Position, i)
		end
		table.insert(self.proj_target_pos_list, target_pos)

		--self.shoot_helper[1]:ShootTargetPosition(target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero, i, nil, false)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_a_list[i], target_pos)
		local dist = (target_pos - self.character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
		local land_time = dist / self.proj_a_speed
		local duration = self.proj_a_duration
		local speed = dist / duration
		local effect =self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_a", self.character.Position,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_a_contrail", self.character.Position,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("proj_a")

		table.insert(self.proj_a_info_list, {
			is_active = true,
			start_pos = self.character.Position,
			target_pos = target_pos,
			current_pos = self.character.Position,
			time_passed = 0,
			duration = duration,
			speed = speed,
			height = 5,
			effect = effect,
			trail = trail
		})

		self.attack_range_a_list[i]:Show(self.proj_a_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_a_list[i]))
	end
end

function local_class:update_shoot_proj_a(dt)

	for _,v in pairs(self.proj_a_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			local progress = v.time_passed / v.duration
			if progress > 1 then
				--도착하면 딜 체크하고 이팩트는 사라지고
				--적에게 히트하면 그냥 사라지고 히트하지않으면 분열한다.
				v.current_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(v.target_pos, battle_util.get_height(v.target_pos))
				local is_hit = self:update_proj_a_damage(v)

				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_a_list[_]))
				self.attack_range_a_list[_]:Hide()
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end
				if v.trail ~= nil then
					v.trail:Dispose()
					v.trail = nil
				end

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_a_explosion", v.current_pos,
						unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("proj_a_explosion")

				if not is_hit then
					self:shoot_proj_b(v.current_pos)
				end
				v.is_active = false
			else
				v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
				local h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * v.height
				local temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(v.start_pos, v.target_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * h
				v.current_pos = temp_pos
				v.effect.transform.localPosition = temp_pos
				v.trail.transform.localPosition = temp_pos
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj_a_damage(info)
	local is_hit = false
	if info.is_active then
		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(info.current_pos, self.proj_a_radius)

		for _2,v2 in pairs(fo_list) do
			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
					v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) then
			else
				local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(info.current_pos - v2.Position).normalized
				if dir == vector_util.zero then
					dir = vector_util.right
				end
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = v2
				damage_info.direction = dir
				damage_info.modifier = self.proj_a_damage_modifier
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.proj_a_knockback_force
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				is_hit = true
			end
		end

		fo_list:Dispose()
	end

	return is_hit
end

function local_class:shoot_proj_b(target_pos)
	--6방향 프로젝타일 발사
	for i = 1, self.proj_b_count do
		local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.proj_b_count, 0)
				* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
		local pos = target_pos + (dir * self.proj_b_range)
		local diff = pos - target_pos
		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_b", target_pos,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_b_contrail", target_pos,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		trail.transform.parent = effect.transform

		local info = {
			effect = effect,
			trail_effect = nil,
			is_active = true,
			is_move_finish = false,
			diff = diff,
			life_time = diff.magnitude / self.proj_b_speed,
			progress_time = 0,
			start_pos = target_pos,
			dest_pos = pos,
			current_pos = target_pos,
			is_ready = false,
		}
		table.insert(self.proj_b_info_list, info)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_b_list[i]))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_b_list[i], pos)

		local dist = (pos - target_pos):GetX0z().magnitude
		local land_time = dist / self.proj_b_speed
		self.attack_range_b_list[i]:Show(land_time)
		self.is_active_mine = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot_proj_b_routine, self, info))
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_proj_b_routine(info)
	local vertical_speed = 4.5
	local gravity = 5.5
	local horizontal_speed = 2.5
	local y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(vertical_speed, gravity, 0, 0)
	y_calculator:ScaleTime(horizontal_speed)

	while self.is_active_mine do
		if info.effect == nil then
			-- force cancel 및 중복 실행 등으로 취소하고 이펙트 지워버렸다면 더 돌리지 않는다.
			-- (Dispose 시킬 때 명시적으로 다 nil 로 넣어주므로 is_unity_null 체크 안함).
			return
		elseif y_calculator:IsDone() then
			info.effect.transform.position = info.dest_pos
			info.is_ready = true
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			return
		else
			y_calculator:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

			local progress = y_calculator:GetProgress()
			local move_pos = info.start_pos * (1 - progress) + info.dest_pos * progress
			move_pos.y = y_calculator:GetDistance() + info.dest_pos.y
			info.effect.transform.position = move_pos
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--패턴 종료 후 proj 시퀸스는 계속 진행

	if self.proj_a_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_shoot_proj_a(dt)
	end

	if self.proj_b_info_list ~= nil and #self.proj_b_info_list > 0 then
		if #self.proj_b_info_list > 0 then
			self:update_proj_b_move(dt)
			self:update_proj_b()
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj_b()
	for _,v in pairs(self.proj_b_info_list) do
		if v.is_active and v.is_ready then
			local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(v.current_pos, self.proj_b_radius)

			for _2,v2 in pairs(fo_list) do
				if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
						v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
						lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) then
				else
					local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.dest_pos - v2.Position).normalized
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = v2
					damage_info.direction = dir
					damage_info.modifier = self.proj_b_damage_modifier

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

					local idx = _ % self.proj_b_count
					if idx == 0 then
						idx = self.proj_b_count
					end
					if self.attack_range_b_list[idx] ~= nil then
						self.attack_range_b_list[idx]:Hide()
						CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_b_list[idx]))
					end

					self:dispose_proj_b(_, v)
				end
			end

			fo_list:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj_b_move(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.proj_b_info_list) do
		if v.is_active and not v.is_move_finish then
			if v.progress_time <= v.life_time then
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
				v.current_pos  = v.start_pos + v.progress_time / v.life_time * v.diff
			else
				v.current_pos = v.dest_pos
				v.progress_time = 0
				v.is_move_finish = true

				if v.trail_effect ~= nil then
					v.trail_effect:Dispose()
					v.trail_effect = nil
				end

				for _,v2 in pairs(self.attack_range_b_list) do
					if v2 ~= nil then
						v2:Hide()
						CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v2))
					end
				end
			end
		elseif v.is_active then
			if v.progress_time <= self.proj_b_duration then
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
			else
				self:dispose_proj_b(_, v)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_proj_b(idx, info)
	if info.effect ~= nil then
		if info.trail_effect ~= nil then
			info.trail_effect:Dispose()
			info.trail_effect = nil
		end
		info.effect:Dispose()
		info.effect = nil
		info.is_active = false
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_b_explosion", info.current_pos,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("proj_b_explosion")
	end

	if info.trail_effect ~= nil then
		info.trail_effect:Dispose()
		info.trail_effect = nil
	end

	table.remove(self.proj_b_info_list, idx)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper == nil then return true end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_a_list[label]))
	self.attack_range_a_list[label]:Hide()

	self.shoot_helper[1]:OnHit(hit_info)

	if self:publish_knockback(hit_info.position) == false then
		self:shoot_proj_b(hit_info.position)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:publish_knockback(pos)
	local result = false

	self.knockback_calculator:Start()
	self.knockback_calculator.Position = pos
	local objects = self.knockback_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			result = true

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - pos).normalized
			if dir == vector_util.zero then
				dir = vector_util.right
			end
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.proj_a_knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	self.knockback_calculator:End()

	return result
end

function local_class:get_random_position(center_pos, index)
	local shot_index = index - 1
	local count = self.proj_a_count
	if index > self.proj_a_count then
		count = index
	end
	local shot_area_angle = 360 / (count)
	local angle = unity_class.random.Range(shot_area_angle * shot_index + 30, (shot_area_angle * index - 30))
	local shoot_range = unity_class.random.Range(self.proj_a_min_range, self.proj_a_max_range)
	local random_pos = center_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle, 0)
			* (unity_class.vector3.right * shoot_range)

	if random_pos.x < self.zone_bound.min.x + 4 then
		local offset = random_pos.x - center_pos.x
		random_pos.x = center_pos.x + math.abs(offset)
	elseif random_pos.x > self.zone_bound.max.x - 4 then
		local offset = random_pos.x - center_pos.x
		random_pos.x = center_pos.x - math.abs(offset)
	end

	if random_pos.z < self.zone_bound.min.z + 4 then
		local offset = random_pos.z - center_pos.z
		random_pos.z = center_pos.z + math.abs(offset)
	elseif random_pos.z > self.zone_bound.max.z - 4 then
		local offset = random_pos.z - center_pos.z
		random_pos.z = center_pos.z - math.abs(offset)
	end

	if index >= 2 then
		local diff = self.proj_target_pos_list[1] - random_pos
		if math.abs(diff.magnitude) < 2 then

			random_pos = self:get_random_position(self.proj_target_pos_list[1], index + 1)
			--local dir = (self.zone_bound.center - self.proj_target_pos_list[1]).normalized
			--random_pos = random_pos + (dir * 3)
		end
	end
	return random_pos
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_a_list) do
		if v ~= nil then
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	end

	if self.attack_range_b_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_b_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	end

	if self.proj_b_info_list ~= nil then
		for i = #self.proj_b_info_list, 1, -1 do
			self:dispose_proj_b(i, self.proj_b_info_list[i])
		end
	end

	if self.proj_a_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.proj_a_info_list) do
			if v.is_active then
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end
				if v.trail ~= nil then
					v.trail:Dispose()
					v.trail = nil
				end
				v.is_active = false
			end
		end
		self.proj_a_info_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil

	self.attack_range_a = nil
	self.attack_range_b_list = nil
	self.proj_target_pos = nil
	self.proj_b_info_list = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:cancel()

	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.proj_list ~= nil then

			self:dispose_proj(_, v)
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
		self:shoot_projectile()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:shoot_projectile()
	for _,v in pairs(self.proj_list) do
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(v.current_pos, v.diff.normalized, _, -1, nil, false, 0.3)

		self:dispose_proj(_, v)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_proj(idx, info)
	if info.effect ~= nil then
		info.effect:Dispose()
		info.effect = nil
		info.is_active = false
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper == nil then return true end

	self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)

	return true
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil
	self.proj_list = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if next_state ~= self.state.casting then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if self.attack_range ~= nil then
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		if self.barrier_effect ~= nil then
			self.barrier_effect:Dispose()
			self.barrier_effect = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then

		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		if self.attack_range_safe ~= nil then
			self.attack_range_safe:Hide()
		end

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:set_ailment_resist()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink_start", self.character.Position)
		self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, vector(
				self.zone_bound.size.x, self.zone_bound.size.z), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink_thunder", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink_end", self.character.Position)

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.casting then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.casting_duration))

		--맵전체 어택레인지 표시
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.zone_bound.center)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.casting_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if self.attack_range_safe ~= nil then
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_safe, self.zone_bound.center)
			self.attack_range_safe:Show(0)
		end

		self.barrier_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("barrier", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("barrier_start")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("casting")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("casting")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("casting")
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("barrier_end", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("barrier_end")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("explosion")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("explosion")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explode")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		stage_camera:Shake(self.stomp_camera_shake_magnitude, self.stomp_camera_shake_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else

		end

function local_class:set_explosion_effect()
	self.random_pos_list = self:get_radom_pos_list()
	for i = 1, self.explosion_effect_count do
		local delay = unity_class.random.Range(self.effect_delay_min, self.effect_dealy_max)
		local info = {
			pos = self.random_pos_list[i],
			delay_time = delay,
			progress_time = 0,
			is_finish = false
		}

		table.insert(self.explosion_effect_list, info)
	end

	self.is_start_explosion_effect = true
end

function local_class:get_radom_pos_list()
	self.index_list = {}
	local target_pos_list = {}
	self.interval_count_x = self.zone_bound.size.x / self.interval_range - 2
	self.interval_count_z = self.zone_bound.size.z / self.interval_range - 2


	local index_count = self.interval_count_x * self.interval_count_z
	if index_count < self.explosion_effect_count then
		index_count = self.explosion_effect_count
	end

	for i = 1, index_count do
		local index = 0
		index = i
		if index > self.interval_count_x * self.interval_count_z then
			index = i % (self.interval_count_x * self.interval_count_z)
		end
		table.insert(self.index_list, index)
	end

	for i = 1, self.explosion_effect_count do
		local index, pos = self:get_random_pos()
		--범위 pos가
		table.insert(target_pos_list, pos)
		table.remove(self.index_list, index)
	end

	return target_pos_list
end

function local_class:get_random_pos()
	local index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.index_list)
	local x_index = self.index_list[index] % self.interval_count_x
	local z_index = math.ceil(self.index_list[index] / self.interval_count_x)
	local pos = vector(self.zone_bound.min.x + self.interval_range + (x_index * self.interval_range),
			0, self.zone_bound.min.z + self.interval_range + (z_index * self.interval_range))

	local diff = self.zone_bound.center - pos
	if math.abs(diff.magnitude) < self.effect_ignore_range then
		table.remove(self.index_list, index)
		index, pos = self:get_random_pos()
	end
	return index, pos
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)

end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:update_barrier(dt)
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then
			if not self.teleport_finish then
				self.teleport_finish = true
				self.character.Position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.zone_bound.center)
				character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
				self:change_state(self.state.casting)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		if self.time_passed >= self.casting_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		else
			self:update_barrier(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.current_explosion_damage_count < self.explosion_damage_count then
				if self.current_explosion_damage_count == 0 then
					self.current_explosion_damage_count = self.current_explosion_damage_count + 1
					self:update_explosion_damage()
				elseif self.current_explosion_damage_count > 0 and self.current_explosion_damage_progress > self.explosion_damage_dealy then
					self.current_explosion_damage_count = self.current_explosion_damage_count + 1
					self:update_explosion_damage()
				else
					self.current_explosion_damage_progress = self.current_explosion_damage_progress + dt
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_explosion_effect(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.explosion_effect_list) do
		if not v.is_finish then
			if v.progress_time > v.delay_time then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", v.pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				v.is_finish = true
			else
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_barrier(dt)
	--캐릭터 주변 넉백
	for i = #self.barrier_hit_target_list, 1, -1 do
		self.barrier_hit_target_list[i].time_passed = self.barrier_hit_target_list[i].time_passed - dt
		if self.barrier_hit_target_list[i].time_passed <= 0 then
			table.remove(self.barrier_hit_target_list, i)
		end
	end

	local target_pos = self.zone_bound.center
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(target_pos, self.barrier_radius)
	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if 	v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or self:check_hit_target(self.barrier_hit_target_list, v) then
		else
			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - v.Position).normalized
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.modifier = self.hit_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = -dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = -dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.barrier_knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(self.barrier_hit_target_list,{
				target = v,
				time_passed = self.barrier_hit_delay})
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_explosion_damage(dt)
	local b = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.zone_bound.center, self.zone_bound.size)
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(b, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		local fo_list2 = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.zone_bound.center, self.barrier_radius)
		local is_in_barrier = false
		--베리어 범위 안이라면 데미지를 받지 않는다.
		for _,v2 in pairs(fo_list2) do
			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
					v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) then
			else
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(v, v2) then
					is_in_barrier = true
				end
			end
		end
		fo_list2:Dispose()

		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or is_in_barrier then
		else
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(v) * 2)

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			if self.current_explosion_damage_count == 1 then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.UntouchablePartySwitchingSkillRemoveEvent.Create(v))
			end
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(target_list, target)
	local hit_targets = target_list
	if hit_targets == nil then
		hit_targets = self.hit_target_list
	end
	for _,v in pairs(hit_targets) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.target, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.range_light_color = nil
	self.range_dark_color = nil
	self.attack_range_safe = nil
	self.barrier_hit_target_list = nil
	self.barrier_effect = nil
	self.random_pos_list = nil
	self.explosion_effect_list = nil
	self.index_list = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}
